title: Who Shapes Brazil's Vaccine Debate? Semi-Supervised Modeling of Stance and Polarization in YouTube's Media Ecosystem
summary: Vaccination remains a cornerstone of global public health, yet the COVID-19 pandemic exposed how online misinformation, political polarization, and declining institutional trust can undermine immunization efforts. Most of the prior computational studies that analyzed vaccine discourse on social platforms focus on English-language data, specific vaccines, or short time windows, impairing our understanding of long-term dynamics in high-impact, non-English contexts like Brazil, home to one of the world's most comprehensive immunization systems. We here present the largest longitudinal study of Brazil's vaccine discourse on YouTube, leveraging a semi-supervised stance detection framework that combines self-labeling and self-training to classify nearly 1.4 million comments. By integrating stance with temporal patterns, engagement metrics, and channel taxonomy (legacy media, science communicators, digital-native outlets), we map how pro- and anti-vaccine narratives evolve and circulate within a hybrid media ecosystem. Our results show that semi-supervised learning substantially improves stance classification robustness, enabling fine-grained tracking of public attitudes across Brazil's full immunization schedule. Polarization spikes during epidemiological crises, especially COVID-19, but becomes fragmented across vaccines and interaction patterns in the post-pandemic period. Notably, science communication and digital-native channels emerge as the primary loci of both supportive and oppositional engagement, revealing structural vulnerabilities in contemporary health communication. Thus, our work advances computational methods for large-scale stance modeling while offering actionable evidence for public health agencies, platform governance, and online information ecosystems.

AI.tldr: 本文是 ACM WebSci '26 论文，用半监督立场检测（Llama 3.1 8B + QLoRA 低熵自训练）对巴西 YouTube 上 2018–2024 年约 142 万条疫苗评论做立场分类，并结合时间分期、疫苗词库、回复树结构与频道类型学，回答"谁在塑造巴西疫苗辩论"。主要发现：多数评论为"不确定/中性"（74.4%），明确极化仅约四分之一；极化比例从疫情前 13.62% 升至疫情期 26.02%、后疫情 28.84%；互动结构上，疫情期趋于对称对抗（跨立场回复各 0.43），后疫情期转为怀疑者自我强化（0.67）而亲疫苗方内聚减弱（0.50）；82.4% 的反疫苗评论发生在非 ANJ 认证频道，科学传播者与数字原生评论频道而非传统新闻机构成为极化主战场。
AI.motivation: 疫苗接种是公共卫生的核心干预，但 COVID-19 疫情暴露了线上错误信息、政治极化与机构信任下降对免疫的削弱。已有计算语言学研究存在两大局限：一是聚焦英语语料、单一疫苗（多为 COVID-19、HPV、MMR）或短期窗口，难以刻画完整国家免疫计划下的长期动态；二是很少分析 YouTube 信息生态的结构性组织——不同类型频道（新闻、科普、数字原生、独立博主）如何塑造疫苗叙事在时间上的可见性、扩散与持续性。巴西拥有 WHO 认可的最完善的国家免疫计划（PNI，30 种疫苗，本研究取国家免疫日程中的 19 种），且经历了高度政治化的疫苗辩论，但针对巴西语 YouTube 语料的研究严重不足。因此本文聚焦巴西 YouTube 疫苗话语（2018–2024），试图回答三个问题：半监督方法能否提升立场检测稳健性；极化在疫情前/中/后及不同疫苗间如何变化；哪类频道最有效地放大亲/反疫苗叙事。
AI.method:
数据采集：通过 YouTube Data API v3，以葡萄牙语、巴西地理定位检索 2018-01 至 2024-07；查询词基于 PNI 与卫生部/DataSUS 官方术语并按"意图修饰语"扩展（强制接种、危险、不良反应、致死、后遗症、覆盖率等）；对每个查询词每月取排序前 50 的视频，剔除标题含"professor/aula/curso/prova/revisão"等教学应试内容的噪声；语言识别采用微调 XLM-RoBERTa-base 与 langdetect 取并集保留葡萄牙语。最终语料：3,897 频道、14,318 视频、1,422,406 条评论、591,760 名用户。

标注与模型：每月随机抽 50 条，3 名信息系本科生独立标注为 Favorable/Against/Inconclusive，Fleiss κ=0.69，多数投票，完全分歧的 23 条剔除，得 3,476 条标注集（295/446/2,735）。基座模型 Llama 3.1 8B，QLoRA（4-bit NF4、bf16、r=64、α=16）参数高效微调，接单层分类头；上下文 192 tokens（覆盖 >95% 评论）、lr 2e-4、batch 128、最多 20 epoch、FP16；用与类频倒数成比例的加权交叉熵应对极端不平衡；分层 5 折交叉验证，训练/验证/测试折轮转，早停（patience=3），按验证 Macro F1 选最佳检查点；硬件为 A40 48GB。

半监督：自训练 + 低熵（Shannon 熵）筛选 + 逆频率采样，对每个类别取经验熵分布最低的若干高置信样本（实测阈值 Against 0.0002、Favorable 0.0041、Inconclusive 0.00004，约保留各类 top 0.01%/1.13%/0.002%），得到 2,004 条伪标签（1,133/749/122），与人工标注合并为 5,480 条训练集（+57.65%），并按新类频重算损失权重后二次微调。

下游分析：按 WHO 声明与巴西接种推进划分三阶段（疫情前 2018-01-01~2020-03-10、疫情期 2020-03-11~2023-05-04、后疫情 2023-05-05~2024-07-01）；构建疫苗同义词词典（官方名称、缩写、品牌、口语变体如"vacina da gotinha"→脊灰）用正则匹配评论并按疫苗-年份统计立场（必要时 z-score 归一化）；利用回复树计算条件回复概率 P(s_reply|s_parent) 及跨立场回复；频道按 ANJ（巴西全国报业协会）成员资格划分认证/非认证，并进一步区分传统新闻媒体（LNM）、科学/健康传播者（SC）、数字原生评论（DC），统计各频道立场分布、点赞/回复均值、唯一用户数、极化占比与对立回复条件概率。模型与词典已在 Hugging Face 公开。
AI.result:
方法上：低熵自训练在所有类别上均有提升且置信区间收窄。Against 的 P/R/F1 从 0.63/0.71/0.67 升至 0.87/0.89/0.88；Favorable（基线最差）提升最大，0.51/0.66/0.57→0.91/0.91/0.91；Inconclusive 0.96/0.91/0.93→0.95/0.94/0.94；整体准确率约 0.85→约 0.9。

语料结果：Inconclusive 1,039,538 条（74.4%），Against 204,179 条，Favorable 152,940 条，说明多数互动不表达明确立场。反疫苗评论人均点赞更高（4.1 vs 3.9），而亲疫苗评论人均回复更多（0.44 vs 0.36），即反疫苗多为"单向断言+点赞背书"，亲疫苗更具对话性。

时间与疫苗维度：z-score 热图显示话语高度事件驱动——2018 年黄热病疫情使黄热病几乎垄断讨论（亲/反双峰），2020 年 COVID-19 引发多疫苗反疫苗关注普涨，2021 年 DTP、脑膜炎、五联、MMRV、MMR 等亲反提及同步上升（极化加剧），流感疫苗因与 COVID 对比而升温，2022–2023 年注意力分散、碎片化，2024 年下降主要源于采集窗口仅前 7 个月。BCG、甲肝等时间轮廓稳定，流感、水痘、五联及 COVID-19 波动剧烈。

互动极化：极化评论占比从疫情前 13.62%（10,104/74,174）升至疫情期 26.02%（317,406/1,219,820）、后疫情期 28.84%（29,609/102,663）。回复结构上，疫情前亲疫苗方内聚最强（P(F|F)=0.69），跨立场互动由亲疫苗方主导（P(F|A)=0.41 > P(A|F)=0.31）；疫情期趋于对称（P(A|F)=P(F|A)=0.43，组内均 0.57）；后疫情期怀疑者自我强化（P(A|A)=0.67），而亲疫苗方内聚降至 0.50，且其下出现 0.50/0.50 的均分。

频道与视频层面：82.4% 的反疫苗评论出现在非 ANJ 认证频道；前 15 强频道中 14 个同时进入亲/反两侧榜单，说明同一空间既是信任建构场所也是科学权威被质疑的战场；Julio Pereira（神经外科医生，亲 29,345/反 27,121）与"Olá, Ciência!"（19,487/21,117）居双榜首；传统媒体（BBC Brasil、CNN Brasil、UOL、TV Cultura 等）更多是议程放大者而非极化核心，且反方评论普遍高于亲方；数字原生频道规模较小但对立评论密度高。视频层面，前 15 极化视频多为副作用、死亡、"第三针未告诉你的事"、AstraZeneca 血栓等争议性/不确定主题，5 个与阿斯利康相关（"极性磁体"），其中"怀疑者与布坦坦科学家对谈"等对话式格式吸引双侧高强度参与；极化程度与播放量不必然相关，主题敏感度比触达规模更能触发立场对抗。
AI.conclusion: 本文贡献在于方法与实证两方面：低熵置信度筛选的自训练半监督流程能在极端不平衡、语义模糊的 UGC 上以极低标注成本（3,476 条人工标签扩展至 5,480 条）显著提升少数类精度与跨折稳定性，为大规模纵向极化研究提供可复现范式（模型已开源）。实证上，证明巴西疫苗极化是动态而非静态的：它不仅体现在立场分布，更嵌入会话的交互结构中——疫情期趋于对称争辩，后疫情期则转为怀疑共同体巩固与亲疫苗方缓冲削弱；在生态层面，极化主要发生在由科学传播者与数字原生评论频道主导的混合媒体生态，而非认证传统新闻机构，揭示当代健康传播的结构性张力。因此，仅依赖内容审核不足以应对疫苗极化，治理与公共卫生沟通应同时面向互动动态与信任结构。局限包括：仅覆盖 YouTube、只测量公开表达立场而非被动暴露或线下效果；观察性设计不能建立因果关系，亦可能受推荐系统等平台机制影响；模型置信度只是准确性的代理，需系统性人工审计以检验语义漂移。未来工作可细分 Inconclusive 类内部结构、分析不同群体对具体疫苗的框架差异、扩展到跨平台与去中心化生态、引入多模态信号与社区发现，并将立场/极化指标与实际接种率或流行病学结局关联。

title: Students Know AI Should Not Replace Thinking, but How Do They Regulate It? The TACO Framework for Human-AI Cognitive Partnership
summary:
As generative artificial intelligence becomes increasingly embedded in educational practice, a central concern is whether students use AI as cognitive support or as a substitute for thinking. Prior research shows that learners recognise this boundary conceptually and acknowledge that "AI should not replace thinking." However, whether such awareness translates into structured regulation during actual AI use remains unclear.
  Drawing on data from Hong Kong secondary students, this study examines how learners perceive their management of the boundary between assistance and outsourcing in practice. Findings show that awareness did not consistently translate into regulation; ethical belief did not necessarily lead to strategic execution; and conceptual endorsement did not guarantee operational behaviour.
  These findings suggest that the challenge is not teaching students that AI should not replace thinking, as they already know this, but providing them with structured mechanisms to regulate how AI is used within learning processes. In response, the study introduces the TACO framework (Think-Ask-Check-Own), a process-oriented model designed to operationalise the boundary between cognitive support and cognitive substitution. By shifting attention from ethical awareness to cognitive regulation, the study contributes a learner-grounded approach to sustaining AI as a dynamic cognitive partner in education.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了香港中学生在人工智能学习中管理"辅助与替代"边界的能力。研究发现，学生虽有AI不应替代思考的道德意识，但这种意识未能有效转化为学习过程中的自我调节行为。基于此，文章提出TACO框架（思考-提问-核查-自主），旨在将伦理认知转化为可操作认知调节机制。
AI.motivation: 核心研究动机：探究学生在AI使用中是否真正将"AI不应替代思考"的概念性认知转化为结构化的学习调节行为，揭示认知意识与实际行为执行之间的落差。
AI.method: 研究方法：基于香港中学生群体的实证调研，分析学习者对AI辅助与认知替代边界的感知与管理实践。
AI.result: 主要发现：道德认知并不必然导致战略性执行；概念认同并不保证可操作行为的实现——即意识与调节行为之间存在显著断层。
AI.conclusion: 研究贡献：提出TACO框架（Think-Ask-Check-Own），将研究焦点从伦理意识转向认知调节，为将AI维持为动态认知伙伴提供以学习者为中心的操作模型。

title: Regulating Artificial Intimacy: From Locks and Blocks to Relational Accountability
summary: A series of high-profile tragedies involving companion chatbots has triggered an unusually rapid regulatory response. Several jurisdictions, including Australia, California, and New York, have introduced enforceable regulation, while regulators elsewhere have signaled growing concern about risks posed by companion chatbots, particularly to children. In parallel, leading providers, notably OpenAI, appear to have strengthened their self-regulatory approaches. Drawing on legal textual analysis and insights from regulatory theory, psychology, and information systems research, this paper critically examines these recent interventions. We examine what is regulated and who is regulated, identifying regulatory targets, scope, and modalities. We classify interventions by method and priority, showing how emerging regimes combine "locks and blocks", such as access gating and content moderation, with measures addressing toxic relationship features and process-based accountability requirements. We argue that effective regulation of companion chatbots must integrate all three dimensions. More, however, is required. Current regimes tend to focus on discrete harms, narrow conceptions of vulnerability, or highly specified accountability processes, while failing to confront deeper power asymmetries between providers and users. Providers of companion chatbots increasingly control artificial intimacy at scale, creating unprecedented opportunities for control through intimacy. We suggest that a general, open-ended duty of care would be an important first step toward constraining that power and addressing a fundamental source of chatbot risk. The paper contributes to debates on companion chatbot regulation and is relevant to regulators, platform providers, and scholars concerned with digital intimacy, law and technology, and fairness, accountability, and transparency in sociotechnical systems.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性审视了针对伴随型聊天机器人的最新监管干预措施，识别了监管目标与范围，将干预措施按方法分类，发现当前制度侧重于限制性措施和特定问责机制，但忽视了提供商通过人工亲密关系实现大规模控制这一根本权力问题，建议以一般性注意义务作为有效监管的起点。
AI.motivation: 伴随型聊天机器人引发了一系列高调悲剧事件，促使多司法管辖区（如澳大利亚、加利福尼亚州、纽约）出台强制性监管规定，领先提供商（如OpenAI）也加强了自我监管。当前监管制度存在局限性：聚焦于离散伤害、狭窄的脆弱性概念或特定问责流程，未能直面提供商与用户之间的深层权力不对称。
AI.method: 法律文本分析与监管理论、心理学、信息系统研究的多学科视角结合。
AI.result: 明确了监管目标、范围和模态；按方法和优先级对干预措施进行分类；识别出现有制度结合了"锁与阻"机制（如访问限制、内容审核）与应对有毒关系特征及基于过程的问责要求的措施。
AI.conclusion: 建议引入一般性、开放性的注意义务（duty of care）作为约束提供商权力、应对聊天机器人风险的第一步。

title: Writing Blog Posts Helps Students Connect Experiential Learning to the Workplace
comment: Will appear in Proceedings of the 31st ACM Conference on Innovation and Technology in Computer Science Education (ITiCSE 2026)
summary:
Undergraduates in work-based learning experiences often produce meaningful contributions as viewed by their supervisors, yet report a negative perception of their contributions because they struggled during the process or produced only a few lines of code change. As a result, many omit these contributions from their resumes and job interviews, losing a meaningful signal of technical ability.
  This study examines how guided blog posts help CS students in work based learning experiences reflect on what they learned and contextualize their experiences. It also evaluates the depth of reflection produced.
  The study included twenty-five juniors and seniors studying CS at CTCs and other affordable local colleges. All participated in one cohort during Fall 2024.
  Each student was assigned a simple open source issue to solve from a popular open source project over the course of several weeks with the help of an industry mentor. While working on the project, students drafted a LinkedIn blog post using a five-section outline covering project mission, assigned issue, technical architecture, challenges faced, and submitted solution. We conducted a thematic analysis of the published posts and measured reflection depth using Mejia and Turns's Knowledge Gain instrument.
  Four themes emerged from the posts: identifying problem solving techniques, growth mindset, the challenges and benefits of collaborative development, and the impacts of their contribution on users. Additionally, students demonstrated deep reflection across all four Knowledge Gain constructs.
  Structured blog posts offer a low-cost addition to experiential CS learning such as capstones, micro-internships, internships, and apprenticeships. This study is descriptive; future work should compare outcomes against a control group.

AI.tldr: CS学生常低估自己在工作学习体验中的技术贡献。本研究通过让25名学生在开源项目中解决简单issue，并撰写结构化LinkedIn博客文章（包含项目使命、任务、技术架构、挑战和解决方案五个部分），帮助学生反思学习成果。结果表明，结构化博客促进了深度反思，识别出四个主题：问题解决技术、成长心态、协作开发的挑战与益处、以及贡献对用户的影响。
AI.motivation: CS学生在工作学习体验中，常因过程中感到困难或产出有限（如仅修改少量代码）而低估自己的贡献，导致简历和面试中遗漏这些有意义的技能信号。即使主管认可其贡献，学生仍倾向于负面评价自己的表现。
AI.method: 研究纳入25名来自CTCs和当地平价院校的CS大三/大四学生（2024年秋季）。每名学生分配一个流行开源项目中的简单issue，在行业导师帮助下完成。期间学生按五部分大纲（项目使命、分配任务、技术架构、面临的挑战、提交方案）起草LinkedIn博客文章。研究团队对已发布文章进行主题分析，并使用Mejia和Turns的知识获取量表测量反思深度。
AI.result: 从博客文章中归纳出四个主题：（1）问题解决技术的识别；（2）成长心态；（3）协作开发的挑战与益处；（4）贡献对用户的影响。学生在前述知识获取四维度上均展现出深度反思。
AI.conclusion: 结构化博客文章是CS体验式学习（如顶点课程、微实习、实习、学徒制）的低成本补充手段。本研究为描述性研究，未来需与对照组比较以验证效果。

title: Superficial Success vs. Internal Breakdown: An Empirical Study of Generalization in Adaptive Multi-Agent Systems
comment: 27 pages, 4 figures. Equal contribution for the first two authors
summary: Adaptive multi-agent systems (MAS) are increasingly adopted to tackle complex problems.However, the narrow task coverage of their optimization raises the question of whether they can function as general-purpose systems.To address this gap, we conduct an extensive empirical study of adaptive MAS, revealing two key findings: (1) topological overfitting -- they fail to generalize across different domains; and (2) illusory coordination -- they achieve reasonable surface-level accuracy while the underlying agent interactions diverge from ideal MAS behavior, raising concerns about their practical utility.These findings highlight the pressing need to prioritize generalization in MAS development and motivate evaluation protocols that extend beyond simple final-answer correctness.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模实证研究揭示自适应多智能体系统(MAS)存在两个关键问题：拓扑过拟合（无法跨领域泛化）和虚假协调（表面精度合理但底层交互偏离理想行为），强调了MAS开发中泛化能力的重要性，并呼吁采用超越最终答案正确性的评估协议。
AI.motivation: 自适应多智能体系统虽被广泛应用于复杂问题求解，但其优化的任务覆盖范围狭窄，引发了这些系统能否作为通用系统的疑问。
AI.method: 对自适应多智能体系统进行了大规模实证研究。
AI.result: 发现两个关键问题：(1) 拓扑过拟合——系统无法跨不同领域泛化；(2) 虚假协调——系统达到合理的表面精度，但底层智能体交互与理想MAS行为存在偏差。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果强调了在MAS开发中优先考虑泛化能力的迫切需求，并推动建立超越简单最终答案正确性的评估协议。

title: The Public Health and Environmental Surveillance Open Data Model (PHES-ODM) Version 3: An Open, Relational Data Model and Interoperability Framework for Wastewater Surveillance
comment: 24 pages, 11 figures. Currently in peer review with the MDPI journal Microorganisms
summary: Wastewater surveillance (WWS) has emerged as a valuable tool for public health surveillance, particularly since the COVID-19 pandemic. Its long-term utility is constrained, however, by fragmented data systems, inconsistent metadata practices, and poor interoperability. The Public Health and Environmental Surveillance Open Data Model (PHES-ODM) was developed as an open, collaborative framework to standardize WWS data and support transparent, ethical data use aligned with FAIR principles. Adopted by the Public Health Agency of Canada and adapted by the EU Sewage Sentinel System, the model is now used in over 25 countries. This paper introduces version 3 of the model, which addresses persistent barriers to interoperability and data utility. Key enhancements include new tables for public health actions, external repository linkages (e.g., GISAID, GenBank), and analytical workflow documentation, as well as support for complex relational linkages across sites, samples, measures, and populations. Tools for mapping across other data formats, including PHA4GE and the US CDC National Wastewater Surveillance System, and for supporting long and wide data formats are also introduced. We compare PHES-ODM against six other WWS data standards across 25 features. Balancing robustness with usability, PHES-ODM v3 provides a scalable, modular infrastructure adaptable to diverse WWS and environmental surveillance programs.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了PHES-ODM v3，这是一款用于废水监测的开放数据模型标准，旨在解决WWS数据碎片化问题。新版本新增了公共卫生行动表、外部仓储链接、分析工作流文档等功能，支持复杂关系链接，并提供跨格式映射工具。与6种其他WWS标准在25个特征上进行了对比，已被加拿大公卫署和EU系统采纳，在25国使用。
AI.motivation: 废水监测（WWS）在COVID-19大流行期间展现了重要的公共卫生监测价值，但其长期应用受限于数据系统碎片化、元数据实践不一致以及互操作性差等问题。
AI.method: 开发了开放协作框架，支持FAIR原则（可发现、可访问、可互操作、可重用）；v3版本新增公共卫生行动表、外部仓储链接（GISAID、GenBank）、分析工作流文档，支持复杂关系链接；提供跨格式映射工具（PHA4GE、CDC NWSS）；与其他6种WWS数据标准在25个特征维度进行对比。
AI.result: 已被加拿大公共卫生署和欧盟污水哨兵系统采纳，在25个国家以上使用；v3版本解决了互操作性和数据可用性的持续障碍。
AI.conclusion: PHES-ODM v3通过平衡健壮性与可用性，提供了可扩展的模块化基础设施，可适应多种WWS和环境监测项目。

title: Dual-View Training for Instruction-Following Information Retrieval
summary: Instruction-following information retrieval (IF-IR) studies retrieval systems that must not only find documents relevant to a query, but also obey explicit user constraints such as required attributes, exclusions, or output preferences. However, most retrievers are trained primarily for semantic relevance and often fail to distinguish documents that match the topic from those that satisfy the instruction. We propose a dual-view data synthesis strategy based on polarity reversal: given a query, a document that is relevant under the instruction, and a hard negative that matches the query but violates the instruction, we prompt an LLM to generate a complementary instruction under which the two documents swap relevance labels. By presenting the same document pair under complementary instructions that invert their relevance labels, the training signal forces the retriever to reconsider the same candidate set through the instruction, rather than relying on fixed topical cues. On a 305M-parameter encoder, our method improves performance on the FollowIR benchmark by 45%, surpassing general-purpose embedding models of comparable or larger scale. Through head-to-head comparisons at matched data budgets, we further show that data diversity and instruction supervision play complementary roles: the former preserves general retrieval quality, while the latter improves instruction sensitivity. These results highlight the value of targeted data synthesis for building retrieval systems that are both broadly capable and instruction-aware.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于极性反转的双视图数据合成策略，通过让LLM生成互补指令使相关和不相关文档交换标签，从而训练检索器同时考虑主题相关性和指令约束。在305M参数编码器上，该方法在FollowIR基准上提升45%，超越同规模甚至更大规模的通用嵌入模型。
AI.motivation: 当前检索系统主要针对语义相关性训练，无法有效区分"主题匹配"与"满足指令约束"的文档。用户指令（如属性要求、排他条件、输出偏好）常被忽略，导致检索结果不符合用户显式需求。
AI.method: 提出双视图数据合成策略：给定查询、一个符合指令的相关文档和一个匹配查询但违反指令的困难负例，提示LLM生成互补指令，使两文档的标签交换。通过在同一候选文档对上展示标签反转的互补指令，强迫检索器通过指令重新审视文档，而非依赖固定的 topical 线索。
AI.result: 在305M参数编码器上，FollowIR基准性能提升45%；超越同规模或更大规模的通用嵌入模型。对比实验表明：数据多样性保持通用检索能力，指令监督提升指令敏感性，二者互补。
AI.conclusion: 目标数据合成对构建既具广泛能力又具指令感知能力的检索系统具有重要价值。极性反转策略有效解决了训练数据不足的问题，为IF-IR领域提供了有效的训练范式。

title: Coordinatewise Balanced Covering for Linear Gain Graphs, with an Application to Coset-List Min-2-Lin over Powers of Two
summary:
We study a list-constrained extension of modular equation deletion over powers of two, called Coset-List Min-2-Lin$^{\pm}$ over $\mathbb{Z}/2^d\mathbb{Z}$. Each variable is restricted to a dyadic coset $a+2^{\ell}(\mathbb{Z}/2^d\mathbb{Z})$, each binary constraint is of the form $x_u=x_v$, $x_u=-x_v$, or $x_u=2x_v$, and the goal is to delete a minimum number of constraints so that the remaining system is satisfiable. This problem lies between the no-list case and the poorly understood fully conservative list setting.
  Our main technical result is a coordinatewise balanced covering theorem for linear gain graphs labeled by vectors in $\mathbb{F}_2^r$. Given any balanced subgraph of cost at most $k$, a randomized procedure outputs a vertex set $S$ and an edge set $F$ such that $(G-F)[S]$ is balanced and, with probability $2^{-O(k^2r)}$, every hidden balanced subgraph of cost at most $k$ is contained in $S$ while all incident deletions are captured by $F$. The proof tensors the one-coordinate balanced-covering theorem of Dabrowski, Jonsson, Ordyniak, Osipov, and Wahlström across coordinates, and is combined with a rank-compression theorem replacing the ambient lifted dimension by the intrinsic cycle-label rank $ρ$.
  We also develop a cycle-space formulation, a cut-space/potential characterization of balancedness, a minimal-dimension statement for equivalent labelings, and an explicit bit-lifting analysis for dyadic coset systems. These yield a randomized one-sided-error algorithm running in \[ 2^{O(k^2ρ+k\log(kρ+2))}\cdot n^{O(1)}+\widetilde{O}(md+ρ^ω), \] and the same framework returns a minimum-weight feasible deletion set among all solutions of size at most $k$.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了在2的幂次模数域上变量受限的约束满足问题的最小删除求解，通过将单坐标平衡覆盖定理张量化扩展到多坐标情形，并利用秩压缩技术降低问题复杂度，最终给出了一种随机化单边错误算法，时间复杂度为 2^(O(k^2ρ+k log(kρ+2)))·n^(O(1)) + O~(md+ρ^ω)。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在探索列表约束模方程删除问题的一个中间地带——介于无列表情形和完全保守列表情形之间。具体研究对象是限制变量取值于 dyadic 陪集、二元约束为等式、负等式或倍增关系的 Coset-List Min-2-Lin± 问题，该问题在参数化复杂性理论中具有重要地位。
AI.method: 证明方法的核心是将Dabrowski等人关于单个坐标的平衡覆盖定理通过张量积操作扩展到多个坐标，并结合秩压缩定理用固有循环标签秩ρ取代环境提升维度。此外还发展了循环空间形式化、割空间/势函数平衡性刻画、等价标签的最小维度陈述以及 dyadic coset 系统的显式位提升分析。
AI.result: 主要技术成果是线性增益图的坐标方向平衡覆盖定理：对于任意成本至多k的平衡子图，随机化算法以概率 2^(-O(k^2 r)) 输出顶点集S和边集F，使得(G-F)[S]保持平衡，且每个成本至多k的隐藏平衡子图被包含在S中，所有相关删除被F捕获。算法时间复杂度为 2^(O(k^2ρ + k log(kρ+2)))·n^(O(1)) + O~(md + ρ^ω)，可找到所有规模至多k的解中的最小权重可行删除集。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过坐标方向的平衡覆盖定理和秩压缩技术，为列表约束的模方程删除问题提供了有效的算法框架，将问题复杂度从环境提升维度降低到固有循环标签秩ρ，实现了从无列表情形向完全保守列表情形的中间地带的突破。

title: HadAgent: Harness-Aware Decentralized Agentic AI Serving with Proof-of-Inference Blockchain Consensus
summary: Proof-of-Work (PoW) blockchain consensus consumes vast computational resources without producing useful output, while the rapid growth of large language model (LLM) agents has created unprecedented demand for GPU computation. We present HadAgent, a decentralized agentic AI serving system that replaces hash-based mining with Proof-of-Inference (PoI), a consensus mechanism in which nodes earn block-creation rights by executing deterministic LLM inference tasks. Because verification requires only re-executing a single forward pass under identical conditions, cross-node verification operates at consensus speed. HadAgent organizes validated records into a three-lane block body with dedicated DATA, MODEL, and PROOF channels, each protected by an independent Merkle root for fine-grained tamper detection. A two-tier node architecture classifies secondary nodes as trusted or non-trusted based on historical behavior: trusted nodes serve inference results in real time through optimistic execution, while non-trusted nodes must undergo full consensus verification. A harness layer monitors node behavior through heartbeat probes, anomaly detection via deterministic recomputation, and automated trust management, creating a self-correcting feedback loop that isolates malicious or unreliable participants. Experiments on a prototype implementation demonstrate 100% detection rate and 0% false positive rate for tampered records, sub-millisecond validation latency for record and hub operations, and effective harness convergence that excludes adversarial nodes within two rounds while promoting honest nodes to trusted status within five rounds.

AI.tldr: HadAgent 是一个去中心化 Agentic AI 推理服务系统，用「Proof-of-Inference（推理证明）」共识替代传统哈希挖矿：节点通过执行确定性的 LLM 推理任务来竞争出块权，任何节点只需重跑一次前向传播即可独立验证结果。系统采用 DATA/MODEL/PROOF 三通道区块体（各自独立 Merkle 根）、主节点/二级节点两层架构（可信节点乐观执行实时返回，非可信节点走完整共识验证），并引入 harness 层（心跳监测、确定性重算异常检测、信任升降级）形成自纠正反馈闭环。原型实验报告：篡改记录检测率 100%、误报率 0%，记录与 Hub 操作延迟亚毫秒级，两轮内排除对抗节点、五轮内将诚实节点提升为可信。
AI.motivation: 传统 PoW 共识消耗巨量算力却不产生有用产出（比特币网络年耗电超 100 TWh），而 LLM Agent 爆发式增长带来远超供给的 GPU 算力需求，二者存在天然矛盾：能否把共识所需的计算重定向到有价值的 AI 工作负载上？现有「有用工作证明」方案（Proof of Learning、Coin.AI、DLBC）存在三点局限：(1) 以模型训练作为挖矿任务，耗时数小时至数天，无法支撑秒级推理服务；(2) 共识粒度停留在模型级（谁训练得最好），而非请求级（给定输入的输出是否正确），与推理服务的粒度需求不匹配；(3) 所有节点一视同仁，无视历史信誉，带来无谓验证延迟且缺乏隔离不可靠节点的机制。此外，现有去中心化推理网络（Bittensor 主观打分、Ritual 依赖 TEE/ZKP、TensorOpera 无链上验证、Gensyn 面向训练）均未把确定性验证直接作为共识机制本身。
AI.method:
【共识机制】Proof-of-Inference：固定权重、输入与解码参数下的确定性推理，节点提交 PROOF 记录（含 dataset_hash、model_hash、validation_score、数字签名）作为出块权证明；验证只需一次前向重算，利用「执行–验证成本不对称」使跨节点验证达到共识速度。共识流程八步：agent 提交请求→master 路由至 secondary 节点→secondary 执行推理→master 重算并评估生成 DATA/MODEL/PROOF 记录→入 mempool（schema 校验+签名校验）→周期性跨 master 验证区间随机抽取近期任务（MMLU、HellaSwag 等标准化基准）独立复评→多 master 投票聚合→提交区块并回传响应。随机抽样使二级节点无法预测被审计任务。
【区块结构】区块头存高度、前一区块哈希、时间戳与三条独立 Merkle 根；区块体分 DATA/MODEL/PROOF 三通道，仅链上存哈希、元数据、分数与签名，原始数据/权重/完整输出留在链下。
【两层节点架构】master 负责路由、评估与出块；secondary 按历史行为分为 trusted 与 non-trusted（新加入或被降级）。trusted 走乐观执行，结果直接返回 agent，master 后台评估入库；non-trusted 走验证执行，须经 master 评估、mempool 与完整共识（含回溯检查）后才响应。晋升需连续正确证明（如 5 轮），降级只需单次被确认的失败（demotion 阈值 2），形成「赚信任慢、丢信任快」的成本不对称；新节点默认 non-trusted 使 Sybil 攻击者无法绕过验证。
【Harness 层】每轮末三阶段：HeartbeatMonitor 发活性探针并对超时节点故障转移重分配任务；AnomalyDetector 对每条 PROOF 记录重执行推理、与提交分数比较，超阈值即判为异常；TrustManager 依据累积证据执行 trusted→non-trusted→excluded 的降级或 non-trusted→trusted 的晋升。原型基于 CrewAI 实现，每个阶段建模为一个自治 agent 顺序执行。
【威胁模型与假设】拜占庭故障下至多 f/N 节点任意偏离；防御伪造推理（确定性重算）、不诚实 master（跨 master 投票防单方决定内容）、Sybil 攻击（新节点强制全验证）。假设：确定性推理（统一执行环境、固定框架版本与数值精度）、master 节点中诚实占严格多数、模型与数据可经链下分发且可由链上哈希校验。通信层为预配置 peer 间的 TCP 点对点 asyncio 消息（NEW_DATA_RECORD/NEW_MODEL_RECORD/NEW_PROOF_RECORD），未使用 P2P gossip。
AI.result:
Python 原型（macOS + Python 3.14 + pytest + asyncio），测试分为基线正确性、规模性能与组合评估三阶段，全部在单机单节点环境完成，未包含分布式网络。
(1) 完整性测试：块高度错误、前序哈希错误、三通道根哈希被改、签名伪造均被正确拒绝，合法链接块被接受。
(2) 证明验证精度：基线 13 个有效用例 / 16 个无效用例（缺失字段、哈希长度错误、无效签名等），组合评估 2013 个有效 / 16 个无效，两阶段检测率均 100%、误报率均 0%（覆盖 1000 条记录与 1005 次 Hub 操作）。
(3) 共识延迟：记录与 Hub 验证基本低于 1 ms 且方差很小，块验证因额外结构与密码学检查延迟更高并偶有尖峰，mempool 操作延迟可忽略；规模评估中 2000+ 次操作延迟与基线一致，说明扩展性稳定。注意该延迟仅为共识的验证阶段，而非从请求提交到出块确认的端到端延迟。
(4) Harness 收敛：恶意提分节点两轮内被检出并隔离，超时节点经同一降级路径被排除，诚实节点五轮内晋升为可信并进入实时服务通道。
结论解读：实验验证了「确定性推理可作为可验证的有用共识工作」这一核心论点，但受限于单机测试、未评估真实 P2P 网络条件下的共识收敛与证明传播时间，也未测量真实 LLM 前向重算的成本。
AI.conclusion: HadAgent 论证并原型验证了：将哈希挖矿替换为确定性 LLM 推理（PoI），可让每一份共识计算同时服务于网络安全与终端用户价值；三通道 Merkle 区块、两层可信度节点架构与 harness 自纠正反馈环共同实现了「可信节点实时服务、非可信节点严格验证」的混合路径，并能在数轮内完成信任收敛。局限与未来工作包括：替换预配置 TCP 直连为 libp2p 等生产级 gossip 协议，以支持自动 peer 发现、NAT 穿透、丢包/时延变化与节点抖动下的收敛研究；当前假设为有界时钟漂移、SHA-256/ECDSA 密码学硬度与固定节点集，尚未处理 eclipse 等网络层攻击；异构 GPU 上实现位级确定性推理可能需要软件模拟浮点等技术。总体而言，该工作为可扩展、可信任、实时的去中心化 AI 推理服务提供了原型基础。

title: From Business Problems to AI Solutions: Where Does Transformation Support Fail
summary: Translating business problems into well-specified machine learning solutions is a prerequisite for successful AI systems, yet this upstream translation is still one of the least supported steps in existing methodologies. We conduct a structured narrative literature review of 18 approaches spanning requirements engineering (RE), machine learning (ML) project management, and automation. We organize these approaches into a taxonomy of four families and compare them across six input artifact categories, six output artifact categories, and a transformation framework of seven stages, grounded in RE refinement theory and ML lifecycle process. Our study shows that most approaches list ML task or algorithm specification among their expected outputs, yet only four provide partial guidance for deriving it, and none provides systematic guidance. We characterize this gap as the Analytics Translation Problem (ATP) and derive five research recommendations addressing multi-formulation exploration, task derivation guidance, constraint-algorithm filtering, probabilistic traceability, and data-triggered revision.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了将业务问题转化为机器学习解决方案的需求工程问题，通过对18种方法的结构化文献综述，识别出现有方法缺乏系统性的ML任务推导指导，并将此gap定义为"分析转换问题(ATP)"，提出5个研究方向建议。
AI.motivation: 将业务问题转化为明确的ML解决方案是AI系统成功的先决条件，但这一上游转换步骤在现有方法论中支持最弱。
AI.method: 结构化叙事文献综述，涵盖需求工程(RE)、ML项目管理及自动化三大领域的18种方法，形成四族分类法，并从六类输入产物、六类输出产物及七个阶段的转换框架进行比较分析，理论基于RE精化理论和ML生命周期流程。
AI.result: 大多数方法将ML任务或算法规范列为预期输出，但仅有4种提供了部分推导指导，且无任何方法提供系统性指导。
AI.conclusion: 将这一gap定义为"分析转换问题(ATP)"，并提出5个研究方向：多公式探索、任务推导指导、约束-算法过滤、概率追溯及数据触发修订。

title: Two-dimensional early exit optimisation of LLM inference
summary: We introduce a two-dimensional (2D) early exit strategy that coordinates layer-wise and sentence-wise exiting for classification tasks in large language models. By processing input incrementally sentence-by-sentence while progressively activating deeper layers, our method achieves multiplicative computational savings that exceed those from optimizing either dimension independently. Experimental evaluation across four state-of-the-art LLMs (Llama 3.1, Llama 3.2, Gemma, Qwen; 3B-8B parameters) on three sentiment classification datasets demonstrates additional speed-ups of 1.4--2.3$\times$ over optimal layer-wise early exit for simpler tasks with vanilla models, with graceful degradation on complex multi-class problems. Fine-tuning reduces but does not eliminate this advantage. The approach is model-agnostic, requires only lightweight classification adapters, and is orthogonal to complementary efficiency methods such as quantization and pruning. Our findings indicate that 2D early exit strategies excel when semantic information accumulates predictably across input structure, suggesting possible applicability to sequence-processing tasks beyond sentiment classification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种协调层级和句子两个维度的早期退出策略，通过增量式处理输入实现乘法计算节省。该方法在四个主流LLM（3B-8B参数）和三个情感分类数据集上的实验中，相比最优的层级早期退出方法获得1.4-2.3倍加速，适用于语义信息可预测累积的任务场景。
AI.motivation: Current early exit strategies optimize either layer-wise or sentence-wise exiting independently, limiting computational savings. Coordinating both dimensions could achieve multiplicative savings beyond what either dimension alone can provide.
AI.method: A two-dimensional (2D) early exit strategy coordinating layer-wise and sentence-wise exiting for classification tasks in LLMs. The method processes input incrementally sentence-by-sentence while progressively activating deeper layers, leveraging lightweight classification adapters to enable model-agnostic adaptive inference.
AI.result: Experimental evaluation across four state-of-the-art LLMs (Llama 3.1, Llama 3.2, Gemma, Qwen; 3B-8B parameters) on three sentiment classification datasets demonstrates additional speed-ups of 1.4-2.3× over optimal layer-wise early exit for simpler tasks with vanilla models. The approach shows graceful degradation on complex multi-class problems, and fine-tuning reduces but does not eliminate this advantage.
AI.conclusion: Two-dimensional early exit strategies excel when semantic information accumulates predictably across input structure. The approach is model-agnostic, requires only lightweight classification adapters, and is orthogonal to complementary efficiency methods such as quantization and pruning, suggesting applicability to sequence-processing tasks beyond sentiment classification.

title: On Solving the Multiple Variable Gapped Longest Common Subsequence Problem
summary: This paper addresses the Variable Gapped Longest Common Subsequence (VGLCS) problem, a generalization of the classical LCS problem involving flexible gap constraints between consecutive solutions' characters. The problem arises in molecular sequence comparison, where structural distance constraints between residues must be respected, and in time-series analysis where events are required to occur within specified temporal delays. We propose a search framework based on the root-based state graph representation, in which the state space comprises a generally large number of rooted state subgraphs. To cope with the resulting combinatorial explosion, an iterative beam search strategy is employed, dynamically maintaining a global pool of promising candidate root nodes, enabling effective control of diversification across iterations. To exploit the search for high-quality solutions, several known heuristics from the LCS literature are utilized into the standalone beam search procedure. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first comprehensive computational study on the VGLCS problem comprising 320 synthetic instances with up to 10 input sequences and up to 500 characters. Experimental results show robustness of the designed approach over the baseline beam search in comparable runtimes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了可变间隙最长公共子序列（VGLCS）问题，这是经典LCS问题的扩展，允许连续字符之间存在灵活的间隙约束。提出了基于根状态图表示的迭代束搜索框架，包含全局候选根节点池和多种LCS启发式策略。实验在320个合成实例上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: VGLCS问题源于分子序列比较（需尊重残基间的结构距离约束）和时间序列分析（事件需在指定时间延迟内发生）。现有方法难以有效处理这类具有灵活间隙约束的组合优化问题。
AI.method: 1) 基于根状态图表示的搜索框架；2) 迭代束搜索策略，维护全局候选根节点池以控制搜索多样性；3) 集成多种LCS启发式策略提升解质量。
AI.result: 在320个合成实例（最多10条序列、每条500字符）上的实验表明，该方法在相当运行时间内比基线束搜索更具鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 首次针对VGLCS问题的系统性计算研究，提出的迭代束搜索框架能有效平衡搜索广度与深度，为该问题提供了可行的求解方案。

title: Compile to Compress: Boosting Formal Theorem Provers by Compiler Outputs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated significant potential in formal theorem proving, yet state-of-the-art performance often necessitates prohibitive test-time compute via massive roll-outs or extended context windows. In this work, we address this scalability bottleneck by exploiting an informative structure in formal verification: the observation that compilers map a vast space of diverse proof attempts to a compact set of structured failure modes. We introduce a learning-to-refine framework that leverages this compression to perform efficient learning and proof exploration. We perform tree search that corrects errors locally conditioned on explicit verifier feedback, thereby circumventing the costs associated with accumulating a long history of proof attempts. Extensive evaluations show that our method consistently amplifies the reasoning capabilities of base provers across varying scales. Notably, our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on PutnamBench among publicly reported $\sim$8B and $\sim$32B parameter models under comparable test-time budgets, offering a scalable paradigm for next-generation verifier-guided reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对LLM形式定理证明中测试时计算成本过高的问题，提出利用编译器将证明尝试映射到有限失败模式这一结构特性，设计基于验证器反馈的树搜索局部修正框架，实现高效推理。
AI.motivation: 当前最先进的LLM形式定理证明方法需要过高的测试时计算资源（大量roll-outs或扩展上下文窗口），存在可扩展性瓶颈。
AI.method: 采用树搜索方法，根据验证器的显式反馈对错误进行局部修正，绕过累积长证明历史的高成本。利用编译器将大量证明尝试映射到紧凑的结构化失败模式这一特性进行高效学习和证明探索。
AI.result: 在PutnamBench上，~8B和~32B参数模型在相同测试时预算下达到公开报告的最优性能。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为下一代验证器引导推理提供了一种可扩展的范式，尤其在中等规模模型（~8B和~32B参数）上实现了当前最优性能。

title: Governed Auditable Decisioning Under Uncertainty: Synthesis and Agentic Extension
comment: 30 pages, 2 tables. Companion artifact: Governance Benchmark Dataset (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19248723)
summary: When automated decision systems fail, organizations frequently discover that formally compliant governance infrastructure cannot reconstruct what happened or why. This paper synthesizes an operational governance evidence framework -- structural accountability collapse diagnostics, decision trace schemas, evidence sufficiency measurement, and label-free monitoring -- into an integrated chain and analytically assesses its transferability across four decision system architectures. The cross-architecture comparison reveals a governance coverage gradient: deterministic rule engines achieve full DES-property fillability, hybrid ML+rules systems achieve partial fillability, classical ML systems achieve only minimal fillability, and agentic AI systems encounter structural breaks. We introduce the cascade of uncertainty, showing how governance failures propagate through serial dependencies between framework layers. For agentic systems, we identify three structural breaks -- decision diffusion, evidence fragmentation, and responsibility ambiguity -- and propose corresponding analytical extensions. Four propositions formalize the gradient, cascade compounding, delegation-depth effects, and extension sufficiency, establishing boundary conditions for the framework's valid operating envelope.

AI.tldr: 本文综合了一套"运营性治理证据框架"，包含四个构件：结构性问责崩塌诊断（structural accountability collapse diagnostics）、决策追踪模式（decision trace schemas）、证据充分性度量（evidence sufficiency measurement）与无标签监控（label-free monitoring），并将其整合为一条分析链条；在四类决策系统架构（确定性规则引擎、混合 ML+规则、经典 ML、代理式 AI）上进行可迁移性评估。结果揭示出一个"治理覆盖梯度"：规则引擎可实现完整的 DES 属性填充，混合系统部分填充，经典 ML 仅最小填充，代理式 AI 则遭遇结构性断裂。作者提出"不确定性级联"，刻画治理失效如何沿框架各层串行依赖传播；针对代理式系统识别出决策扩散、证据碎片化、责任模糊三类结构性断裂，并给出对应的分析扩展；最后以四条命题形式化梯度、级联复利、委托深度效应与扩展充分性，从而界定框架的有效运行边界。
AI.motivation: 自动化决策系统一旦失效，组织往往发现形式上合规的治理基础设施既无法重构"发生了什么"，也无法重构"为什么"。现有治理文献多聚焦于合规性、透明度原则与事后问责的制度设计，缺乏一套可在运行时与事后取证中实际落地、可比较、可度量的证据性操作框架。本文动机在于：(1) 将"形式合规"与"可取证（evidence-reconstructible）"区分开来，指出前者的成立并不蕴含后者的成立；(2) 填补跨架构（规则引擎、混合 ML、纯 ML、代理式 AI）治理能力横向比较的空白；(3) 解释治理失效在框架层之间的传播机制，而非将其视为孤立事件。
AI.method: 采用"框架综合 + 跨架构比较 + 命题化边界条件"的分析路径。首先把四个既有构件整合为一条端到端链条：结构性问责崩塌诊断用于识别系统失效模式，决策追踪模式规定取证记录的结构，证据充分性度量给出可判定性刻度，无标签监控在无人工标注条件下持续探测治理缺口。随后以"DES 属性填充率（DES-property fillability）"为核心指标，在四类决策系统架构上横向评估该链条的可填充性，进而推导治理覆盖梯度。机制层面引入"不确定性级联"概念，形式化治理失效沿框架层间串行依赖的放大过程；针对代理式 AI 架构，识别决策扩散、证据碎片化、责任模糊三个结构性断裂点，并分别设计分析扩展（如分布式追踪归因、证据聚合/一致性校验、多主体责任映射）。最终以四条命题（P1 梯度、P2 级联复利、P3 委托深度效应、P4 扩展充分性）给出框架的适用边界与运行包络（valid operating envelope）。全文为分析性/概念性研究，非实证实验。
AI.result: 跨架构比较得到治理覆盖梯度：确定性规则引擎达到完整 DES 属性填充（其决策逻辑、触发条件与执行路径可被完全回放）；ML+规则混合系统获得部分填充（模型内部推理与规则覆盖路径之间存在可追溯性断层）；经典 ML 系统仅达最小填充（输入—输出映射可记录，但特征贡献、训练数据谱系与决策理由难以在运行时取得）；代理式 AI 系统出现结构性断裂，不存在可完整填充的取证链条。同时提出不确定性级联：上游层的证据缺口会以非线性方式向下游层放大，层间串行依赖使失效呈复利式累积，标注缺失、上下文丢失等单点缺陷可导致整体证据链不可用于问责。代理式系统的三类断裂为：决策扩散（决策责任分散于多代理/多步骤流水线）、证据碎片化（推理痕迹散落在异构存储与临时上下文中）、责任模糊（人类—代理间的委托链使责任主体难以锚定），并给出相应扩展加以缓解。
AI.conclusion: 治理证据的可得性并非架构无关，而是系统架构的函数：越靠近开放式、委托式、生成式的决策架构，形式合规的治理基础设施越难以支撑事后重构。论文由此将治理成熟度评估从"是否具备合规文档"转向"能否达到可取证阈值"，并明确框架的有效运行边界：当确定性递减、委托深度递增时，仅靠现有扩展不足以恢复完整填充，需引入额外的可观测性、因果归因与责任分配机制。后续方向包括将 DES 属性填充率操作化为可自动测量的工程指标、在真实代理式部署中验证级联效应量级，以及把无标签监控的异常检测与法务/审计取证流程对接。

title: Gated Coordination for Efficient Multi-Agent Collaboration in Minecraft Game
summary: In long-horizon open-world multi-agent systems, existing methods often treat local anomalies as automatic triggers for communication. This default design introduces coordination noise, interrupts local execution, and overuses public interaction in cases that could be resolved locally. To address this issue, we propose a partitioned information architecture for MLLM agents that explicitly separates private execution states from public coordination states. Building on this design, we introduce two key mechanisms. First, we develop an event-triggered working memory based on system-verified outcomes to maintain compact and low-noise local state representations. Second, we propose a cost-sensitive gated escalation mechanism that determines whether cross-region communication should be initiated by jointly considering node criticality, local recovery cost, and downstream task impact. In this way, communication is transformed from a default reaction into a selective decision. Experiments conducted on long-term construction tasks in open environments demonstrate that, compared to baseline models based on strong communication and planned structures, the introduction of gated communication and a partitioned information architecture results in superior performance in terms of blueprint completion quality and execution chain length. It also improves local self-recovery, reduces ineffective escalations, and increases the utility of public communication.

AI.tldr: 本文针对长期开放环境多智能体系统中通信过度的问题，提出分区信息架构结合事件触发工作记忆和成本敏感门控升级机制，将通信从默认触发转变为选择性决策，实验表明该方法有效提升了协调效率和任务完成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将本地异常默认为通信触发器，导致协调噪声增加、本地执行中断、公共交互过度使用，而许多情况实际上可以在本地解决。
AI.method: 提出分区信息架构将私有执行状态与公共协调状态分离；开发基于系统验证结果的事件触发工作记忆机制；提出成本敏感的门控升级机制，综合考虑节点关键性、本地恢复成本和下游任务影响来决定是否发起跨区域通信。
AI.result: 相比基于强通信和计划结构的基线模型，该方法在蓝图完成质量和执行链长度上表现更优；同时提升了本地自我恢复能力，减少了无效升级，提高了公共通信的效用。
AI.conclusion: 通信从默认反应转变为选择性决策，显著提升了长期多智能体系统中的协调效率。该方法在开放环境中的长期建设任务中验证了其有效性。

title: Heuristic Search Space Partitioning for Low-Latency Multi-Tenant Cloud Queries
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to IEEE IC2E 2026 (Industry and Experience Track). Technique patented as US11941006B2 and US12373434B2
summary: Large-scale cloud security platforms must continuously query millions of structured cloud resource records distributed across thousands of tenant accounts. Broad, account-spanning queries saturate database infrastructure, producing P95 latencies exceeding 60 seconds. We identify buffer cache pressure as the dominant latency driver: in a controlled experiment, the same query executing with the same plan completed in 3.7 seconds when its working set was memory-resident and 94 seconds when concurrent load had evicted those pages. No query plan optimization can address this; the only effective intervention is reducing the number of pages each query must touch. We present the Heuristic Search Space Partitioning System (HSSPS), a query-time optimization layer that logically partitions the search space through dynamic predicate injection, without schema modification. A two-phase heuristic engine selects partition key values and scores candidate query plans before execution. A client-side page token maintains cross-partition traversal state without server-side sessions, enabling horizontal scalability. Controlled evaluation across representative query types demonstrates 50-97% P95 latency reduction (95-97% on high-cardinality queries), 8-10x throughput improvement, and 41x reduction in average active sessions. Production rollout across live multi-tenant traffic reduced P95 latency from 61s to 2s across successive releases, sustained over 14,000 eligible queries per measurement window. The technique generalizes to any multi-tenant system where broad queries execute against large shared databases and physical schema modification is impractical.

AI.tldr: 针对大规模多租户云安全平台中宽泛查询导致P95延迟超60秒的问题，本文提出HSSPS系统，通过动态谓词注入实现搜索空间逻辑分区，在不修改物理Schema的情况下将P95延迟从61秒降至2秒，吞吐量提升8-10倍。该方案无需服务端会话状态，通过客户端页面令牌维护跨分区遍历状态。
AI.motivation: 在大规模多租户云安全平台中，跨账户的宽泛查询导致数据库基础设施饱和，P95延迟超过60秒。实验发现缓冲池缓存压力是主要延迟驱动因素：相同查询计划下，工作集在内存中仅需3.7秒，但被并发负载驱逐后需94秒。现有查询计划优化无法解决此问题，唯一有效干预是减少每个查询需访问的页面数。
AI.method: 提出HSSPS（启发式搜索空间分区系统），包含两个核心组件：1) 两阶段启发式引擎 - 选择分区键值并对候选查询计划进行评分；2) 客户端页面令牌 - 维护跨分区遍历状态，无需服务端会话，支持水平扩展。系统通过动态谓词注入实现搜索空间的逻辑分区，无需Schema修改。
AI.result: 受控评估显示：P95延迟降低50-97%（高基数查询达95-97%），吞吐量提升8-10倍，平均活动会话数减少41倍。生产环境部署后，P95延迟从61秒降至2秒，在14000+查询的测量窗口内保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 该技术可推广至任何执行宽泛查询的大型共享数据库多租户系统，尤其适用于物理Schema修改不切实际的场景。核心贡献在于将物理存储问题转化为逻辑分区问题，通过启发式方法在查询时自动识别最优分区策略。

title: STK-Adapter: Incorporating Evolving Graph and Event Chain for Temporal Knowledge Graph Extrapolation
summary: Temporal Knowledge Graph (TKG) extrapolation aims to predict future events based on historical facts. Recent studies have attempted to enhance TKG extrapolation by integrating TKG's evolving structural representations and textual event chains into Large Language Models (LLMs). Yet, two main challenges limit these approaches: (1) The loss of essential spatial-temporal information due to shallow alignment between TKG's graph evolving structural representation and the LLM's semantic space, and (2) the progressive dilution of the TKG's evolving structural features during LLM fine-tuning. To address these challenges, we propose the Spatial-Temporal Knowledge Adapter (STK-Adapter), which flexibly integrates the evolving graph encoder and the LLM to facilitate TKG reasoning. In STK-Adapter, a Spatial-Temporal MoE is designed to capture spatial structures and temporal patterns inherent in TKGs. An Event-Aware MoE is employed to model intricate temporal semantics dependencies within event chains. In addition, a Cross-Modality Alignment MoE is proposed to facilitate deep cross-modality alignment by TKG-guided attention experts. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that STK-Adapter significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods and exhibits strong generalization capabilities in cross-dataset task. The code is available at https://github.com/Zhaoshuyuan0246/STK-Adapter.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STK-Adapter，通过Spatial-Temporal MoE、Event-Aware MoE和Cross-Modality Alignment MoE三个混合专家模块，解决TKG推理中空间-时间信息丢失和结构特征稀释两大挑战，实现TKG结构表示与LLM语义空间的深度对齐。
AI.motivation: 当前TKG外推方法存在两个核心问题：(1) TKG图结构表示与LLM语义空间之间的浅层对齐导致空间-时间信息丢失；(2) LLM微调过程中TKG演化结构特征逐渐稀释。这些问题限制了TKG推理性能的进一步提升。
AI.method: STK-Adapter包含三个核心组件：① Spatial-Temporal MoE捕获TKGs的空间结构和时间模式；② Event-Aware MoE建模事件链中的时序语义依赖关系；③ Cross-Modality Alignment MoE通过TKG引导的注意力专家实现跨模态深度对齐。该适配器灵活集成了图编码器与LLM。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，STK-Adapter显著优于现有最先进方法，并在跨数据集任务中展现出强大的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: STK-Adapter通过混合专家机制有效解决了TKG外推中的信息损失问题，为时序知识图谱推理提供了一种有效的LLM增强方案。

title: Faster Linear-Space Data Structures for Path Frequency Queries
summary:
We present linear-space data structures for several frequency queries on trees, namely: path mode, path least frequent element, and path $α$-minority queries. We present the first linear-space data structures, requiring $O(n \sqrt{nw})$ preprocessing time, that can answer path mode and path least frequent element queries in $O(\sqrt{n/w})$ time. This improves upon the best previously known bound of $O(\log\log n \sqrt{n/w})$ achieved by Durocher et al. in 2016.
  For the path $α$-minority problem, where $α$ is specified at query time, we reduce the query time of the linear-space data structure of Durocher et al. from $O(α^{-1}\log\log n)$ down to $O(α^{-1})$ by employing a simple randomized algorithm with a success probability $\geq 1/2$.
  We also present the first linear-space data structure supporting "Path Maximum $g$-value Color" queries in $O(\sqrt{n/w})$ time, requiring $O(n \sqrt{nw})$ preprocessing time. This general framework encapsulates both path mode and path least frequent element queries. For our data structures, we consider the word-RAM model with $w\in Ω(\log n)$, where $w$ is the word size in bits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出线性空间数据结构，用于树上路径频率查询（路径众数、路径最不频繁元素、路径α-少数元素及路径最大g值颜色查询）。在词-RAM模型下，预处理时间O(n√(nw))，路径众数和路径最不频繁元素查询时间改进至O(√(n/w))，路径α-少数元素查询时间改进至O(α⁻¹)，并首次提出路径最大g值颜色查询的线性空间数据结构。
AI.motivation: 现有线性空间数据结构在路径频率查询上存在查询时间瓶颈。Durocher等人(2016)的结构虽采用线性空间，但查询时间为O(log log n √(n/w))，仍有优化空间。本文旨在构建更高效的线性空间数据结构以提升查询性能。
AI.method: 采用随机化算法结合分解技术。对于路径众数和路径最不频繁元素查询，通过改进算法复杂度实现查询时间从O(log log n √(n/w))降至O(√(n/w))；对于路径α-少数元素查询，采用简单随机算法使查询时间从O(α⁻¹ log log n)降至O(α⁻¹)，成功概率≥1/2。
AI.result: 首次实现路径众数和路径最不频繁元素的线性空间数据结构，查询时间O(√(n/w))；将路径α-少数元素查询时间从O(α⁻¹ log log n)降至O(α⁻¹)；提出首个支持路径最大g值颜色查询的线性空间数据结构，预处理O(n√(nw))，查询O(√(n/w))。
AI.conclusion: 本文在词-RAM模型(w∈Ω(log n))下，通过随机化算法显著提升了树上路径频率查询的效率，所有数据结构均保持线性空间，为该领域提供了更优的理论性能界限。

title: Locality, Not Spectral Mixing, Governs Direct Propagation in Distributed Offline Dynamic Programming
summary: We study the communication complexity of distributed offline dynamic programming, where a fixed batch dataset is partitioned across (M) machines connected by the data-induced dependency graph. We compare two paradigms: direct boundary-value propagation, which follows Bellman dependencies, and gossip averaging, which mixes local estimates. Our results show that **locality** is the fundamental driver of round complexity. In particular, we prove that no method can achieve (\varepsilon)-accuracy in fewer than (L_\varepsilon = \left\lfloor \log(1/2\varepsilon) / \log(1/γ) \right\rfloor) rounds on graphs of diameter at least (L_\varepsilon), and we show that direct propagation matches this scaling up to constants, attaining error (O(γ^T/(1-γ) + δ/(1-γ))) after (T) rounds. In contrast, gossip-style fitted value iteration incurs an additional (1/\mathrm{gap}(W)) dependence in both convergence rate and asymptotic error. We also prove bandwidth-sensitive lower bounds on path topologies and extend the analysis to asynchronous systems with bounded delays. Together, these results show that spectral dependence is an artifact of gossip-based algorithms, whereas locality is the intrinsic barrier in distributed offline dynamic programming.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了分布式离线动态规划的通信复杂度，对比了直接边界值传播和 gossip 平均化两种范式。研究表明，局部性（locality）是决定轮复杂度的根本因素，并给出了精确的下界和匹配上界。
AI.motivation: 分布式动态规划中，不同算法（如直接传播与 gossip 混合）在通信效率和收敛速度上存在显著差异，但缺乏严格的理论分析来揭示这些差异的本质来源。
AI.method: 基于图论框架，将固定批量数据集分配到 M 台机器上，通过数据诱导依赖图连接。分析两种范式在直径为 L_ε 的图上的 ε-精度收敛轮数。
AI.result: 证明在直径至少为 L_ε 的图上，任何方法达到 ε 精度都至少需要 L_ε = ⌊log(1/2ε)/log(1/γ)⌋ 轮。直接传播可匹配此下界（T 轮后误差 O(γ^T/(1-γ) + δ/(1-γ))），而 gossip 类算法额外依赖 1/gap(W) 项。还给出了路径拓扑的带宽敏感下界，并推广到有界延迟异步系统。
AI.conclusion: 局部性是分布式离线动态规划的本质障碍，谱依赖性（spectral dependence）仅是 gossip 类算法的副产品。直接边界值传播在理论上优于 gossip 风格方法。

title: Tractable Verification of Model Transformations: A Cutoff-Theorem Approach for DSLTrans
summary:
Model transformations are central to MDE, but formal verification is difficult because mainstream transformation languages are undecidable. DSLTrans was designed to be Turing-incomplete to improve verifiability, yet earlier verification based on path-condition enumeration still suffered exponential blow-up and did not scale to realistic cases.
  We present a tractable verification workflow for DSLTrans and formalize when it is complete. The method combines three contributions: (i) a Cutoff Theorem proving that bounded model checking is complete for a precise DSLTrans fragment and positive existence/traceability properties, turning an infinite search into a finite computable bound; (ii) composable, soundness-preserving optimizations (per-class bounds, CEGAR-based fragment verification, and trace-aware dependency analysis) that reduce SMT encoding size; and (iii) a Z3-based implementation evaluated on realistic transformations from the ATL Zoo and related benchmarks.
  On 29 concrete transformations and 899 properties spanning compiler lowering, schema translation, behavioral modeling, graph mapping, and stress tests, 552 properties are proved, 345 produce concrete counterexamples (including intentional negative and boundary cases), and only 2 remain undecided within timeout. For properties beyond the tractability budget, we introduce tractability-driven refinement (precondition specialization, postcondition decomposition, and transformation instrumentation), achieving up to 112x speedup while eliminating spurious counterexamples. The workflow is supported by a web IDE and a concrete execution engine for runtime validation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对模型变换（MDE）的形式化验证难题，提出一套面向非图灵完备语言 DSLTrans 的"可处理验证工作流"：以 F-LNR 变换片段与 G-BPP 正向存在/可追踪性质片段为对象，证明"截断定理（Cutoff Theorem）"，把无限模型空间上的性质验证归约为一个由静态参数算出界的有限有界模型检查（BMC）；再配合一系列可组合、保健全性的优化（按类界定点分析、片段化验证+CEGAR、溯源感知依赖剪枝、等可满足后置条件分解），基于 Z3 实现 Python 验证器与 Web IDE。在 29 个源自 ATL Zoo 等基准的真实变换、899 条性质上，552 条被证明、345 条给出具体反例、仅 2 条超时未决；性质精化技术带来最高 112× 加速。
AI.motivation: 模型变换是 MDE 的核心产物，ATL、QVT、Epsilon 等主流变换语言均为图灵完备，任意性质验证不可判定；即便限制性质类别，输入模型的组合爆炸也使穷举验证不可行。DSLTrans 出于可验证性刻意设计为图灵不完备（禁止无界递归、原地更新、负应用条件 NAC，采用单调"只增不删"语义），但作者此前基于符号路径条件枚举的验证方法仍存在指数级路径爆炸：在 15–20 条规则、10+ 性质的基准上常超内存或需数小时，无法支撑工程师所需的迭代式开发流程，既往优化（路径条件包含/合并）未能解决规模化问题。因此需要一种验证架构上的根本转变，而非路径条件上的增量压缩。
AI.method: 形式化基础：定义类型化图、规则（match/apply/backward）、分层变换与规则触发语义；界定 F-LNR 片段（R1 仅直接关联、R2 有界匹配元数 m、R3 分层执行、R4 反向依赖无环、R5 属性域有限、R6 单调性）；界定 G-BPP 性质片段（P1 有界模式大小 p、P2 无间接链接、P3 局部溯源约束、P4 正向存在/可追踪语义）。截断定理 4.1：若存在反例模型，则存在规模 |M'| ≤ K 的反例模型，其中 K = min(K_coarse, K_sharp, K_tight)，三者分别为 c(m+p)d'(a+1)、p(1+mr)d'(a+1)、p(1+(m-1)rd)(a+1)（c 相关源类数、m 相关规则最大匹配元数、p 性质最大模式元数、d 反向依赖深度、a 强制关联闭包度、r 相关规则数）；证明分四阶段：违例见证提取 → 有界规则参与（连通分量论证每步至多新增 m−1 元素）→ 关联闭包（×(a+1)）→ 由单调性得 T(M')⊆T(M) 故违例在缩小模型中保持。定理失效边界被明确列出：NAC、删除/更新语义、传递式/非局部匹配、反单调的全局缺失/唯一性性质。优化栈：片段化验证（引理 5.1 单调片段健全性）配合 CEGAR 反例引导抽象精化（引理 5.2 见证完备性，仅当被省略规则在反例上无源匹配时违例才成立）；按类界定点定理 5.6（源种子 → 源闭包 → 目标产出上界 K_C = p_C + Σ N_R·m_C(R)，其中 N_R ≤ ∏ K_S^{n_S(R)} → 目标闭包 → 全局 K 封顶）；溯源/属性感知相关性剪枝（引理 5.7 给出 r_true ≤ r_mode、d_true ≤ d_mode 的单调健全条件）与 legacy/trace-aware/trace-and-attribute-aware 三种模式；后置条件按连通分量分解的等可满足改写（引理 5.8，复杂度由 O(N^|P|) 降至 O(|P|·N^max|Ci|)）；引理 3.9 属性抽象的"主张边界"（抽象模型族上的证明仅在抽象保持可观察区分时上推到具体变换）。可组合性定理 5.9 断言任意顺序的有限优化组合保持验证的健全性与完备性。实现为 Python 3.12 + Z3 4.13，含解析层、截断分析层（片段校验、相关性计算、三套界公式、按类定点、最小/基线片段）、SMT 直接验证层（模型/规则/属性三个子编码器），配套具体执行引擎（XMI/Ecore）、自动抽象合成管线、继承扁平化，以及 React+Vite+Konva 的浏览器 IDE（DSLTrans Browser Studio，Node.js 服务桥接 Python 流式回传结果）。运行示例为 UML→Java AST（6 层 22 规则 29 性质）。
AI.result: 语料为 29 个具体变换、899 条性质（编译器下降、模式转换、行为建模、图映射与合成压力测试），单机 i7-12700H/32GB、每性质 600s 超时、单次墙钟计时：552 条 holds（在定理背书的界内证明，故对任意规模模型成立）、345 条 violated（给出具体源模型与目标模型作为反例，其中含大量故意失败的负向测试与"边界性质"——语义合理但强于当前变换契约的性质，用以标定已证正确性包络）、仅 2 条 unknown（OCLCompiler，源于表达式层深层类型层级）。规模上，单性质最长 472.43s（UML2Java），多数性质为亚秒级。优化效果显著：定理原始界常在数百至数千（如 MultiValuedPropertyHasAddHelper 为 735），经按类分析与溯源剪枝降至个位数（6，界缩减 122×），PropertyHasField 原始 K=102、按类后主导类 25、源侧 Property 仅需 2；UML2Java 多条性质的 r 由 10+ 降至 2–3，K 缩减 3–5×；整体验证时间因优化栈降低 10–1000×。性质精化（预条件特化/强化、后置条件分解、变换插桩标记类）把最初不可判定的性质转为 holds：BPMN2Petri 双边性诊断经预条件特化后 383.75s→3.41s（112×）并由 violated（因多态类型歧义导致的伪反例）转为 holds；UML2Java 的 PropertyHasGetter、WritablePropertyHasSetter、AddRemoveHelpers 三条由 >1800s unknown 转为约 10–12s holds。附录 C 的边界验证实验在 8 个规范、12 条性质上做 K±3 均匀扫描、按类单点 −1 扰动与具体执行交叉验证，结果 12/12、10/10、7/7 与定理预测一致，表明实现确实落到了定理要求的界上。作者亦坦承局限：定理未在证明助手中机械化、缺少与 Alloy/USE/AnATLyzer 的正面对比、语料主要是 ATL Zoo 移植的 out-place 结构映射，验证结果依赖当前抽象策略。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心贡献是把"有界模型检查"从启发式做法提升为在明确片段（F-LNR 变换 × G-BPP 性质）上完备的验证方法：截断定理给出可计算的、仅依赖静态特征的见证规模上界，单调语义是其数学根基，Z3 承担组合爆炸，优化的目标是逼近"有效的按类界向量"而非原始 K。实验表明该工作流可覆盖以往路径条件枚举完全不可及的规模（最多 55 规则的真实变换与 200 规则/300 性质的压力基准）。同时论文明确划定主张边界：结论不覆盖含间接链接/无界递归的变换、缺失/唯一性等反单调性质与不受限属性域；抽象证明仅对抽象模型族绝对，需属性抽象保持相关区分方可上推到具体变换。后续工作包括在 Coq/Lean 中机械化截断定理、验证器的变异测试、为缺失/唯一性等受限性质类建立新的截断论证、在保持可验证性的前提下有限扩展 F-LNR（受限 NAC、有界递归），以及在安全关键工业变换上的应用验证。

title: Probing for Reading Times
summary: Probing has shown that language model representations encode rich linguistic information, but it remains unclear whether they also capture cognitive signals about human processing. In this work, we probe language model representations for human reading times. Using regularized linear regression on two eye-tracking corpora spanning five languages (English, Greek, Hebrew, Russian, and Turkish), we compare the representations from every model layer against scalar predictors -- surprisal, information value, and logit-lens surprisal. We find that the representations from early layers outperform surprisal in predicting early-pass measures such as first fixation and gaze duration. The concentration of predictive power in the early layers suggests that human-like processing signatures are captured by low-level structural or lexical representations, pointing to a functional alignment between model depth and the temporal stages of human reading. In contrast, for late-pass measures such as total reading time, scalar surprisal remains superior, despite its being a much more compressed representation. We also observe performance gains when using both surprisal and early-layer representations. Overall, we find that the best-performing predictor varies strongly depending on the language and eye-tracking measure.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了语言模型表征是否捕捉人类阅读处理过程中的认知信号，通过在5种语言的眼动追踪语料库上使用正则化线性回归探测模型各层表征与人类阅读时间的对应关系，发现早期层表征在预测早期阅读指标（如首次注视、凝视时间）上优于surprisal，而晚期阅读指标（如总阅读时间）仍由surprisal主导，表明模型深度与人类阅读的时间阶段存在功能对齐。
AI.motivation: 语言模型表征已被证明编码丰富的语言信息，但尚不清楚它们是否也捕捉人类处理认知信号。本研究旨在探索模型表征与人类阅读时间的对应关系，检验模型各层是否反映人类阅读的不同阶段。
AI.method: 使用正则化线性回归，在5种语言（英语、希腊语、希伯来语、俄语、土耳其语）的眼动追踪语料库上，将模型各层表征与标量预测因子（surprisal、信息值、logit-lens surprisal）进行对比。采用早期通读指标（首次注视、凝视时间）和晚期通读指标（总阅读时间）评估预测性能。
AI.result: 早期层表征在预测早期通读指标（首次注视、凝视时间）上优于surprisal；晚期通读指标（总阅读时间）仍由标量surprisal主导；早期层表征与surprisal结合可提升性能；最佳预测因子因语言和眼动指标类型而显著变化。
AI.conclusion: 人类阅读处理特征主要由低层结构/词汇表征编码，模型深度与人类阅读时间阶段存在功能对齐；surprisal仍是晚期阅读加工的强基线；语言差异影响最优预测策略，表明认知加工与语言特性的复杂交互。

title: Beyond One Output: Visualizing and Comparing Distributions of Language Model Generations
summary: Users typically interact with and evaluate language models via single outputs, but each output is just one sample from a broad distribution of possible completions. This interaction hides distributional structure such as modes, uncommon edge cases, and sensitivity to small prompt changes, leading users to over-generalize from anecdotes when iterating on prompts for open-ended tasks. Informed by a formative study with researchers who use LMs (n=13) examining when stochasticity matters in practice, how they reason about distributions over language, and where current workflows break down, we introduce GROVE. GROVE is an interactive visualization that represents multiple LM generations as overlapping paths through a text graph, revealing shared structure, branching points, and clusters while preserving access to raw outputs. We evaluate across three crowdsourced user studies (N=47, 44, and 40 participants) targeting complementary distributional tasks. Our results support a hybrid workflow: graph summaries improve structural judgments such as assessing diversity, while direct output inspection remains stronger for detail-oriented questions.

AI.tldr: 针对语言模型单输出交互隐藏分布结构的问题，研究者通过形成性研究与用户研究，开发了GROVE文本图可视化工具，支持三条用户研究验证了"图形摘要+直接检查"的混合工作流程在评估语言模型分布时的有效性。
AI.motivation: 用户在通过单一输出来交互和评估语言模型时，隐藏了分布结构（如模式、边缘案例、对微小提示变化的敏感性），导致用户在迭代开放式任务的提示时过度泛化个体案例经验。形成性研究（n=13）揭示了当前工作流程的痛点。
AI.method: 设计并开发了GROVE交互式可视化系统，将多个语言模型生成结果表示为文本图中的重叠路径；同时开展三项众包用户研究（N=47, 44, 40）进行评估。
AI.result: 用户研究表明图形摘要与直接输出检查各有优势：图形摘要有助于结构性判断（如评估多样性），而直接输出检查对细节导向问题更有效。
AI.conclusion: 支持混合工作流程：图形摘要改善了结构性判断（如多样性评估），而直接检查原始输出对细节导向问题仍然更强。

title: Easy Samples Are All You Need: Self-Evolving LLMs via Data-Efficient Reinforcement Learning
summary: Previous LLMs-based RL studies typically follow either supervised learning with high annotation costs, or unsupervised paradigms using voting or entropy-based rewards. However, their performance remains far from satisfactory due to the substantial annotation cost and issues such as model collapse or reward hacking. To address these issues, we introduce a new perspective inspired by cognitive learning theory and propose a novel approach called EasyRL. The core of EasyRL is to simulate the human cognitive acquisition curve by integrating reliable knowledge transfer from easy labeled data with a progressive divide-and-conquer strategy that tackles increasingly difficult unlabeled data. Specifically, we initialize a warm-up model using supervised RL with few-shot labeled data. This is followed by a divide-and-conquer pseudo-labeling strategy on difficult unlabeled data, combining consistency-based selection for low-uncertainty cases and reflection-based resolution for medium-uncertainty cases. Finally, difficulty-progressive self-training with iterative pseudo-labeling and RL further strengthens the model's reasoning capability. EasyRL provides a unified self-evolving framework that facilitates data-efficient post-training of LLMs. Experimental results on mathematical and scientific benchmarks demonstrate that EasyRL, using only 10% of easy labeled data, consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: EasyRL proposes a cognitively-inspired RL framework that simulates human learning progression, achieving superior performance with just 10% labeled data through warm-up initialization, uncertainty-aware pseudo-labeling, and difficulty-progressive self-training.
AI.motivation: Existing LLM-based RL methods suffer from either high annotation costs (supervised learning) or performance degradation including model collapse and reward hacking (unsupervised paradigms).
AI.method: EasyRL integrates three components: (1) Supervised RL warm-up with few-shot labeled data; (2) Divide-and-conquer pseudo-labeling on difficult data using consistency-based selection (low-uncertainty) and reflection-based resolution (medium-uncertainty); (3) Difficulty-progressive self-training with iterative pseudo-labeling and RL.
AI.result: EasyRL outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on mathematical and scientific benchmarks using only 10% of easy labeled data.
AI.conclusion: EasyRL provides a unified self-evolving framework for data-efficient post-training of LLMs, achieving SOTA performance with minimal labeled data (10%).

title: Auditing LLMs for Algorithmic Fairness in Casenote-Augmented Tabular Prediction
summary: LLMs are increasingly being considered for prediction tasks in high-stakes social service settings, but their algorithmic fairness properties in this context are poorly understood. In this short technical report, we audit the algorithmic fairness of LLM-based tabular classification on a real housing placement prediction task, augmented with street outreach casenotes from a nonprofit partner. We audit multi-class classification error disparities. We find that a fine-tuned model augmented with casenote summaries can improve accuracy while reducing algorithmic fairness disparities. We experiment with variable importance improvements to zero-shot tabular classification and find mixed results on resulting algorithmic fairness. Overall, given historical inequities in housing placement, it is crucial to audit LLM use. We find that leveraging LLMs to augment tabular classification with casenote summaries can safely leverage additional text information at low implementation burden. The outreach casenotes are fairly short and heavily redacted. Our assessment is that LLM zero-shot classification does not introduce additional textual biases beyond algorithmic biases in tabular classification. Combining fine-tuning and leveraging casenote summaries can improve accuracy and algorithmic fairness.

AI.tldr: 本文审计了LLM在住房安置预测任务中的算法公平性。研究发现微调模型配合简短且经大量编辑的案例笔记摘要可同时改善分类准确性并减少公平性差异，表明LLM可安全地以低实施负担利用额外文本信息。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型(LLM)越来越多地被考虑用于高风险社会服务场景的预测任务，但其在这些背景下的算法公平性特性尚未被充分理解。鉴于住房安置领域存在历史性不公平现象，对LLM应用的审计至关重要。
AI.method:
采用算法公平性审计方法，对基于LLM的表格多分类任务进行错误率差异分析；实验包括零样本分类基线、微调模型、以及结合案例笔记摘要的增强方法；测试变量重要性改进对零样本表格分类的影响。

数据来源：与非营利组织合作获取的街道外展案例笔记，结合住房安置预测任务。
AI.result: 微调模型配合案例笔记摘要可提高准确性同时减少算法公平性差异；零样本表格分类不引入超出算法偏差之外的额外文本偏差；变量重要性改进对零样本分类的公平性结果混合。
AI.conclusion:
LLM增强表格分类可以安全利用附加文本信息，实施负担低；微调结合案例笔记摘要可提高准确性和算法公平性；历史住房不平等背景下，对LLM使用的审计至关重要。

关键发现：1）零样本分类不会引入超出表格分类算法偏差之外的额外文本偏差；2）微调模型配合案例笔记摘要可同时改善准确性和公平性；3）变量重要性改进对零样本表格分类的公平性影响混合。

意义：研究为社会服务领域LLM部署提供了实证依据，强调了在高风险决策场景中进行算法公平性审计的必要性。

title: ClawCoin: An Agentic AI-Native Cryptocurrency for Decentralized Agent Economies
summary:
Autonomous AI agents live or die by the API tokens they consume: without paid inference capacity they cannot reason, act, or delegate. Compute-token cost has become the binding resource of the emerging agent economy, yet it is non-transferable: it is account-bound, vendor-specific, and absent from on-chain ledgers. Existing payment rails such as x402 move fiat-backed value between agents, but they do not represent the quantity agents actually burn. As a result, agents can transport purchasing power but cannot quote, escrow, or settle workflows in a unit aligned with compute cost.
  We present ClawCoin, a tokenized, compute-cost-indexed unit of account and settlement asset for decentralized agent economies. ClawCoin combines four layers: a robust basket index over standardized prices; an oracle publishing signed fresh attestations; a NAV-based mint/redeem vault with coverage thresholds and rate limits; and an on-chain settlement layer for multi-hop delegations.
  We implement a prototype on an Ethereum-compatible L2 and evaluate it using a multi-agent simulator and the OpenClaw testbed. Across single-agent, multi-agent, workflow, and procurement experiments, ClawCoin stabilizes execution capacity under cost shocks, reduces cross-agent quote dispersion, eliminates partial settlements, and sustains cooperative market dynamics that fiat-denominated baselines cannot. These results suggest that compute-indexed units of account can improve decentralized agent coordination.

AI.tldr: ClawCoin 是一种基于算力成本指数化的代币化记账与结算资产，专为去中心化智能体经济设计。它通过四个层次实现：标准化价格篮子指数、签署新鲜预言机认证、基于NAV的铸造/赎回金库（带有覆盖率阈值和速率限制），以及多跳委托的链上结算层。在以太坊兼容L2上实现原型，通过多智能体模拟器和OpenClaw测试平台验证。结果表明ClawCoin在成本冲击下稳定执行容量、减少跨智能体报价分散、消除部分结算，并维持合作性市场动态。
AI.motivation: 当前自主AI智能体经济中，API代币是核心资源，但其具有账户绑定、供应商特定、链上账本缺失等特性，导致智能体可传输购买力却无法以算力成本对齐的单位报价、托管或结算工作流。现有支付轨道（如x402）仅转移法币价值，不反映智能体实际消耗量。
AI.method: 提出四层架构：(1) 标准化价格稳健篮子指数；(2) 发布签署新鲜认证的预言机；(3) 基于NAV的铸造/赎回金库，含覆盖率阈值和速率限制；(4) 多跳委托链上结算层。在以太坊兼容L2上实现原型，采用多智能体模拟器和OpenClaw测试台进行评估。
AI.result: 跨单智能体、多智能体、工作流和采购实验场景，ClawCoin在成本冲击下稳定执行容量，减少跨智能体报价分散，消除部分结算，并维持法币计价基线无法实现的合作性市场动态。
AI.conclusion: 算力索引记账单位可改善去中心化智能体协调能力。

title: LIVE: Learnable Monotonic Vertex Embedding for Efficient Exact Subgraph Matching (Technical Report)
summary: Exact subgraph matching is a fundamental graph operator that supports many graph analytics tasks, yet it remains computationally challenging due to its NP-completeness. Recent learning-based approaches accelerate query processing via dominance-preserving vertex embeddings, but they suffer from expensive offline training, limited pruning effectiveness, and heavy reliance on complex index structures, all of which hinder the scalability to large graphs. In this paper, we propose \textit{\underline{L}earnable Monoton\underline{I}c \underline{V}ertex \underline{E}mbedding} (\textsc{LIVE}), a learning-based framework for efficient exact subgraph matching that scales to large graphs. \textsc{LIVE} enforces monotonicity among vertex embeddings by design, making dominance correctness an inherent structural property and enabling embedding learning to directly optimize vertex-level pruning power. To this end, we introduce a query cost model with a differentiable surrogate objective to guide efficient offline training. Moreover, we design a lightweight one-dimensional \textit{iLabel} index that preserves dominance relationships and supports efficient online query processing. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that \textsc{LIVE} significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in efficiency and pruning effectiveness.

AI.tldr: LIVE 是一个面向大规模图的精确子图匹配框架：它把“支配正确性（无虚假丢弃）”从学习目标中解耦出来，通过构造性的单调顶点嵌入（VLE=softplus(标签嵌入)，VSE=邻居标签嵌入求和，o=α·o_l+β·o_s 且 α≫β）使支配关系成为嵌入的内在结构性质；再用查询代价模型 + 可微的反支配（anti-dominance）损失采样训练嵌入以最大化剪枝能力；并设计轻量一维 iLabel 索引（key=α‖o_l‖₂+β‖o_s‖₂，B+树）配合跳数/度数 MBR 摘要与 5 级剪枝策略完成在线检索与回溯精化。实验显示其在真实/合成数据集上全面超越 11 个基线（最大约一个数量级加速），在 3.77M 顶点图上单查询 6.53ms，在 10M 顶点图上 45.26ms，剪枝率最高 99.18%，离线训练与建索引成本远低于 GNN-PE。
AI.motivation: 精确子图匹配是图分析的基础算子，但 NP 完全，答案数可指数级增长。结构化方法（GraphQL、QuickSI、CFLMatch、VF2++、DP-iso、CECI、Hybrid、RapidMatch）依赖显式结构比较，候选过滤弱、计算开销高；学习型方法（学习匹配顺序、基于 GNN 的支配嵌入如 GNN-PE）虽能把匹配转化为向量运算并实现无虚假丢弃的过滤，但存在三个瓶颈：(1) 离线训练昂贵——为学习支配关系需为每个顶点枚举 1-hop 子图及其全部 1-hop 子结构（规模随度指数增长 ∑2^deg(v)），在百万级图上往往无法在实用时间内完成预处理；(2) 剪枝能力有限——嵌入学习被“支配正确性”强约束，只能勉强保住正确性而无余量优化过滤效果；(3) 依赖复杂索引结构（如路径型/多维索引）带来巨大存储与遍历开销。核心研究问题：能否设计一个学习式精确子图匹配框架，在保持轻量离线训练的同时不需要重型索引，并在线上高效检索候选。
AI.method:
框架分为离线（嵌入学习 + 索引构建）与在线（候选检索 + 精化）两阶段。

1) 单调顶点嵌入设计（第 3.2 节）：VLE o_l(v)=softplus(Emb(L(v))) 保证非负；VSE o_s(v)=Σ_{v_j∈N1(v)} o_l(v_j) 为非负向量求和，对邻居包含关系单调；最终 o(v)=α·o_l(v)+β·o_s(v)，α,β≥0 且 α≫β。由于求和与加权加法均单调，得 s1(v)⊆g1(v) ⇒ o(s1(v))⪯o(g1(v))（Lemma 1），即 1-hop 子结构包含关系被“构造性地”映射为坐标支配关系；因此若 q_i 可匹配 v_i，则 g1(q_i)⊆g1(v_i) ⇒ o(q_i)⪯o(v_i)，过滤时不会虚假丢弃（no-false-dismissal）。这与 GNN-PE 需在损失中“学习”支配不同：正确性由构造保证，学习目标得以解放以直接优化剪枝能力。

2) 代价模型与反支配优化（第 3.3 节）：查询代价用“被某嵌入支配的数据顶点数”的均值近似（Cost）；等价于最小化所有顶点对间的支配关系数量，即 anti-dominance cost L_cost=1/|V|² ΣΣ 1{o(v_i)⪯o(v_j)}。由于指示函数离散不可导，用 sigmoid 松弛 L=1/|V|² ΣΣ σ(min_k(o(v_i)[k]-o(v_j)[k])/τ)，min 为分段线性次可微，用自动微分求次梯度（借鉴 PointNet/Deep Sets）；τ→0+ 时 L 收敛到 L_cost，且任意有限 τ>0 时 L ≥ L_cost（Lemma 3）。全对求和为 O(|V|²)，故采用均匀采样顶点对的小批量 SGD（K=4096, 1000 epochs, Adam, lr=0.01）并退火 τ。额外非学习优化：对 VLE 做 L1 归一化 o_l'=o_l/‖o_l‖₁（Yeast 上平均查询代价 522.28→284.6），并取 α/β=10^5（732.6→103.34）。

3) iLabel 索引（第 4 节）：按标签聚类（同标签共享同一 VLE，簇中心即标签嵌入），一维键 key(v)=α‖o_l(v)‖₂+β‖o_s(v)₂（第一项为标签基址偏移，第二项给出簇内细粒度序）。Lemma 1 证明支配蕴含键序（dominant→key 单调），Lemma 2 给出簇区间严格不重叠的充分条件 α/β > M/Δ_min（M 为 VSE 最大 L2 范数，Δ_min 为相邻标签 VLE 范数最小差），离线一次线性扫描即可验证。在键上建 B+ 树（非叶节点只存键区间），并预计算两类轻量摘要：跳数 MBR_hop^(t)（t-hop 邻域内标签嵌入的逐维上下界，BFS 扩展得到）与度数 MBR_deg^(δ)（对 1-hop 邻居各维标签嵌入排序后，取最小/最大 δ 个之和作上下界，覆盖所有 δ-度 1-hop 子结构的 VSE 区间，避免指数级枚举）。构建复杂度 O(d|E| + t(|V|+|E|) + Σ_v d·deg(v)log deg(v) + |V|log|V|)，空间 O(|V|·d·t + d|E|)。

4) 在线算法（第 5 节，Algorithm 2）：对每个查询顶点算嵌入与 hop 摘要；自根下降 B+ 树到首个与区间 [key(q_i), key(L(q_i)+1)) 相交的叶节点，逐叶顺序扫描并串行应用 5 种剪枝——(1) key 下界剪枝（key(v)<key(q_i) 必不支配）、(2) key 上界剪枝（簇区间严格分离，超出标签簇范围可剪）、(3) 嵌入支配剪枝（o(q_i)⪯o(v_i)）、(4) hop 摘要剪枝（q 的 t-hop MBR 必须被 v 的 MBR 包含，粗到细检查）、(5) 度数摘要剪枝（q_i.vse 必须落在 MBR_deg^(deg(q_i)) 内）；随后按候选集大小贪心生成匹配顺序，最后用回溯搜索做注入性+边一致性精化，枚举全部精确匹配。复杂度 O(Σ_qi(deg(qi)·d + |E(q)| + k|V(q)|d + h + R_i·k·d) + |V(q)|² + Π|cand_set|)。
AI.result:
在 5 个真实图（Yeast 3.1K、HPRD 9.5K、DBLP 317K、Youtube 1.13M、US Patents 3.77M）与 Newman–Watts–Strogatz 合成图（syn-uni/gau/zipf）上评测，每图 100 个随机游走生成的连通查询图。

效率：LIVE 在所有数据集上均优于 11 个基线（GraphQL、QuickSI、RI、CFLMatch、VF2++、DP-iso、CECI、Hybrid、RapidMatch、GNN-PE、BSX），在大规模真实图（yt、up）上对最强竞争者取得最高约一个数量级加速；在 3.77M 顶点的 US Patents 上单次精确查询仅 6.53ms；合成图规模从 10K 扩到 10M 顶点时查询时间最低，10M 顶点上 45.26ms。参数敏感性：d=2 最优（>2 后剪枝饱和而比较成本线性上升），α/β 超过 1e5 后收益趋稳，t 呈 U 形（t=2 最优）；|Σ| 增大、查询图规模增大均使查询更快（更强的结构约束抵消遍历开销），查询平均度与数据图密度上升会推高但幅度有限（0.41→1.51ms）。

剪枝能力（候选检索阶段安全剔除的数据顶点比例）：随机初始化嵌入仅 66.32%；加入 L1 归一化与 α/β 调优后分别升至 76.49%、79.73%；加入反支配损失学习后达 98.43%；叠加全部剪枝策略达 99.18%。Yeast 上平均查询代价：VLE 1182.6→522.28（L1 后 284.6），VSE 1403.97→1027.27；α/β 优化使 732.6→103.34，接近理论下界 |V|/|Σ|=43.83。

离线成本：GNN-PE 训练成本高出约 10^4 倍（源于穷举 1-hop 子图-子结构对），LIVE 采用采样反支配损失后训练成本低且随图规模稳定；索引构建成本比 GNN-PE 低 82×（后者依赖路径型结构导致索引膨胀）。LIVE 索引构建时间从 19.98ms（10K 顶点）增至 163.59s（10M 顶点），索引存储从 7.93MB 增至 7400.51MB。
AI.conclusion:
本文的核心贡献是“解耦”：通过构造性单调嵌入把精确子图匹配的无虚假丢弃保证内化为嵌入的结构性质，使嵌入学习可完全聚焦于顶点级剪枝能力（反支配损失 + 可微松散 + 采样），并用一维 iLabel 索引把高维支配检索转化为 B+ 树区间查询、辅以 hop/度数 MBR 摘要做进一步无损剪枝，从而同时实现精确性、可扩展性与轻量离线成本。实验验证了“支配正确性本身并不意味着高效过滤”，并显示 LIVE 在效率、剪枝力、离线成本三方面均优于现有 SOTA。

需要注意的局限与可讨论之处：① 索引空间 O(|V|·d·t + d|E|) 在 10M 顶点时达 ~7.4GB，绝对开销不小，"轻量"更多是相对 GNN-PE 的路径型索引而言；② 关键的 α≫β、L1 归一化是启发式超参，跨数据集迁移性依赖标签分布（作者承认剩余差距源于标签倾斜）；③ 剪枝的正确性论证仅基于 1-hop 包含关系，高阶结构一致性仍需靠回溯精化，因此剪枝率高并不等于答案产出快；④ 一维键映射是"支配 ⇒ 键序"的单向保持，反向不成立，故只能做范围检索再做精确支配校验；⑤ 实验数据集与查询规模有限（查询图 5–12 顶点），稠密大查询与动态图场景仍待验证（作者以 DIVINE 等规则式动态匹配作对比说明其定位为静态大图）。

title: Think Before Writing: Feature-Level Multi-Objective Optimization for Generative Citation Visibility
summary: Generative answer engines expose content through selective citation rather than ranked retrieval, fundamentally altering how visibility is determined. This shift calls for new optimization methods beyond traditional search engine optimization. Existing generative engine optimization (GEO) approaches primarily rely on token-level text rewriting, offering limited interpretability and weak control over the trade-off between citation visibility and content quality. We propose FeatGEO, a feature-level, multi-objective optimization framework that abstracts webpages into interpretable structural, content, and linguistic properties. Instead of directly editing text, FeatGEO optimizes over this feature space and uses a language model to realize feature configurations into natural language, decoupling high-level optimization from surface-level generation. Experiments on GEO-Bench across three generative engines demonstrate that FeatGEO consistently improves citation visibility while maintaining or improving content quality, substantially outperforming token-level baselines. Further analyses show that citation behavior is more strongly influenced by document-level content properties than by isolated lexical edits, and that the learned feature configurations generalize across language models of different scales.

AI.tldr: FeatGEO introduces a feature-level, multi-objective optimization framework for generative engine optimization (GEO). It decouples high-level optimization from surface text generation by optimizing over interpretable document features, outperforming token-level baselines and demonstrating that document-level properties drive citation behavior more than lexical edits.
AI.motivation: Traditional SEO is insufficient for generative answer engines, which determine visibility through selective citation rather than ranked retrieval. Existing GEO methods rely on token-level text rewriting, offering limited interpretability and poor control over the trade-off between citation visibility and content quality.
AI.method: FeatGEO abstracts webpages into interpretable structural, content, and linguistic features, optimizes over this feature space (rather than direct text editing), and uses an LLM to realize feature configurations into natural language — effectively decoupling high-level optimization from surface-level generation. Evaluated on GEO-Bench across three generative engines.
AI.result: FeatGEO consistently outperforms token-level baselines: it improves citation visibility while maintaining or improving content quality across three generative engines on GEO-Bench.
AI.conclusion: FeatGEO provides a more interpretable and controllable approach to GEO by operating at the feature level, and its learned configurations generalize across different LLM scales, suggesting that document-level structural properties are more influential than token-level edits for citation visibility in generative engines.

title: Parameterized Capacitated Vertex Cover Revisited
comment: Abstract cropped to meet arXiv's requirements
summary: Capacitated Vertex Cover is the hard-capacitated variant of Vertex Cover: given a graph, a capacity for every vertex, and an integer $k$, the task is to select at most $k$ vertices that cover all edges and assign each edge to one of its chosen endpoints so that no chosen vertex receives more incident edges than its capacity. This problem is a classical benchmark in parameterized complexity, as it was among the first natural problems shown to be W[1]-hard when parameterized by treewidth. We revisit its exact complexity from a fine-grained parameterized perspective and obtain a much sharper picture for several standard parameters. For the natural parameter $k$, we prove under the Exponential Time Hypothesis (ETH) that no algorithm with running time $k^{o(k)} n^{\mathcal{O}(1)}$ exists. In particular, this shows that the known algorithms with running time $k^{\mathcal{O}(\mathrm{tw})} n^{\mathcal{O}(1)}$ are essentially optimal. We then turn to more general structural parameters. For vertex cover number $\mathrm{vc}$, we give evidence against a $2^{\mathcal{O}(\mathrm{vc}^{2-\varepsilon})} n^{\mathcal{O}(1)}$ algorithm, as such an improvement would imply corresponding progress for a broader class of integer-programming-type problems. We complement this barrier with a nearly matching upper bound for vertex integrity $\mathrm{vi}$, improving the previously known double-exponential dependence to an algorithm with running time $\mathrm{vi}^{\mathcal{O}(\mathrm{vi}^{2})} n^{\mathcal{O}(1)}$ using $N$-fold integer programming. For treewidth, we show that the standard dynamic programming algorithm with running time $n^{\mathcal{O}(\mathrm{tw})}$ is essentially optimal under the ETH, even if one parameterizes by tree-depth. Turning to clique-width, we prove that Capacitated Vertex Cover remains NP-hard already on graphs of linear clique-width $6$...

AI.tldr: 该论文对硬容量顶点覆盖问题进行了精细的参数化复杂度分析，在多个标准参数（自然参数k、顶点覆盖数vc、树宽tw、团宽）下给出了几乎最优的算法下界和上界，揭示了已知算法在这些参数下是本质最优的。
AI.motivation: 硬容量顶点覆盖是参数化复杂度领域的经典基准问题，此前已被证明是树宽参数化下W[1]难的。该文旨在重新审视其精确复杂度，获得更精细的参数化下界。
AI.method: 通过下界约化（ETH下界、最优性归约）和N-折叠整数规划算法设计，给出问题在不同参数下的精确复杂度刻画。
AI.result: 对于自然参数k，证明了不存在$k^{o(k)}n^{O(1)}$算法；顶点覆盖数参数下给出$2^{O(vc^{2-ε})}$下界障碍；树宽参数下证明$n^{O(tw)}$下界即使对树深度参数化也成立；并证明CVC在团宽6的图上已是NP难的。
AI.conclusion: 证明了硬容量顶点覆盖问题的精确复杂度下界，为结构参数化复杂性的细粒度分析提供了更清晰的图景。

title: ARGUS: Agentic GPU Optimization Guided by Data-Flow Invariants
summary:
LLM-based coding agents can generate functionally correct GPU kernels, yet their performance remains far below hand-optimized libraries on critical computations such as matrix multiplication, attention, and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE). Peak GPU performance requires coordinated reasoning over tightly coupled optimizations, including tiling, shared-memory staging, software pipelining, and instruction scheduling, while existing agents rely on sparse pass/fail feedback, leaving them unable to diagnose global constraint violations.
  We present Argus, an agentic framework that addresses this through data-flow invariants: compile-time specifications encoding how data must be choreographed throughout kernel execution. Argus introduces a tile-based, Pythonic DSL exposing hardware instructions and compiler policies while hiding low-level representations. The DSL provides tag functions to propagate symbolic annotations through data and control flow, and tag assertions to enforce relational constraints at use sites. When violations occur, the compiler returns concrete counterexamples identifying the thread, data element, and program point, enabling dense, structured feedback for targeted fixes. Invariants are verified at compile time via abstract interpretation over a layout algebra and SMT solving, with zero runtime overhead. An in-context reinforcement learning planner learns to select optimizations and synthesize effective invariants, supported by a curated knowledge base of GPU optimization techniques.
  We evaluate Argus on the AMD MI300X GPU across GEMM, flash attention, and MoE kernels accounting for over 90% of GPU time in LLM inference. Generated kernels achieve 99-104% of state-of-the-art hand-optimized assembly throughput and are 2-1543x faster than existing agentic systems. Argus further generalizes to 200 KernelBench tasks, solving 100% of Level 1 and 90% of Level 2 problems.

AI.tldr: Argus 是一个智能体式 GPU kernel 生成框架：通过引入"数据流不变量"（data-flow invariants）——即编译期对数据如何在 kernel 执行中被编排的规格说明——让 LLM 智能体能够诊断全局约束违规，而非仅依赖 pass/fail 的稀疏反馈。系统包含一个基于 tile 的 Pythonic DSL（暴露硬件指令与编译器策略，隐藏底层表示），提供 tag 函数以在数据流与控制流中传播符号注解，提供 tag 断言在使用点强制执行关系约束；违规时编译器返回具体反例（线程、数据元素、程序点），形成稠密、结构化的修复反馈。不变量通过在布局代数（layout algebra）上的抽象解释与 SMT 求解在编译期验证，零运行时开销。一个上下文强化学习（in-context RL）规划器学习选择优化方案并合成有效不变量，辅以 GPU 优化技术知识库。在 AMD MI300X 上，GEMM、Flash Attention、MoE 三类占 LLM 推理 GPU 时间 90% 以上的 kernel 上，生成 kernel 达到手工优化汇编吞吐量的 99–104%，比现有智能体系统快 2–1543 倍；并推广到 200 个 KernelBench 任务，Level 1 解决率 100%，Level 2 解决率 90%。
AI.motivation: LLM 编码智能体能生成功能正确的 GPU kernel，但其性能远低于手工优化库（矩阵乘、注意力、MoE）。峰值 GPU 性能需要对紧密耦合的优化进行协同推理：tiling（分块）、shared memory staging（共享内存暂存）、software pipelining（软件流水）、instruction scheduling（指令调度）。现有智能体仅获得稀疏的 pass/fail 反馈，无法诊断全局性约束违规（如数据布局与分块策略不一致、流水线阶段与存储同步冲突），因而难以自主定位并修复性能瓶颈。核心问题在于：智能体缺少一种既能表达"数据必须如何被编排"这一全局规格、又能给出稠密局部化错误信息的机制。
AI.method: 1) 数据流不变量：把"数据如何在 kernel 执行中被编排"编码为编译期规格，使智能体可推理全局约束，而非试错。2) 基于 tile 的 Pythonic DSL：暴露硬件指令与编译器策略，同时隐藏底层表示，支持 tag 函数在数据与控制流上传播符号注解，tag 断言在使用点强制关系约束；断言失败时编译器返回具体反例（具体线程、具体数据元素、具体程序点），形成稠密结构化反馈以指导定向修复。3) 编译期验证：通过布局代数上的抽象解释 + SMT 求解验证不变量，运行时开销为零。4) 上下文强化学习规划器：学习选择优化方案并合成有效不变量，配合精选的 GPU 优化技术知识库。
AI.result: 在 AMD MI300X 上评估 GEMM、Flash Attention、MoE（合计占 LLM 推理 GPU 时间 90% 以上）：生成 kernel 达到 SOTA 手工优化汇编吞吐量的 99–104%，相较现有智能体系统加速 2–1543×。泛化到 200 个 KernelBench 任务：Level 1 解决率 100%，Level 2 解决率 90%。编译期不变量验证带来零运行时开销，同时提供可定位的反例反馈。
AI.conclusion: 将"数据流不变量"作为 LLM 智能体与 GPU 编译器之间的接口，可在不引入运行时开销的前提下，把稀疏的 pass/fail 反馈转变为稠密、可定位的结构化反馈，从而使智能体能够推理并修复全局耦合的优化约束；结合 DSL + 抽象解释/SMT 验证 + in-context RL 规划器，Argus 生成的 kernel 性能可与手工优化汇编相当，并显著优于已有智能体系统，且能泛化到通用 KernelBench 任务。

title: Structural Verification for Reliable EDA Code Generation without Tool-in-the-Loop Debugging
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have enabled natural-language-driven automation of electronic design automation (EDA) workflows, but reliable execution of generated scripts remains a fundamental challenge. In LLM-based EDA tasks, failures arise not from syntax errors but from violations of implicit structural dependencies over design objects, including invalid acquisition paths, missing prerequisites, and incompatible API usage. Existing approaches address these failures through tool-in-the-loop debugging, repeatedly executing and repairing programs using runtime feedback. While effective, this paradigm couples correctness to repeated tool invocation, leading to high latency and poor scalability in multi-step settings. We propose to eliminate tool-in-the-loop debugging by enforcing structural correctness prior to execution. Each task is represented as a structural dependency graph that serves as an explicit execution contract, and a verifier-guided synthesis framework enforces this contract through graph-conditioned retrieval, constrained generation, and staged pre-execution verification with diagnosis-driven repair. On single-step tasks, our method improves pass rate from 73.0% (LLM+RAG) and 76.0% (tool-in-loop) to 82.5%, while requiring exactly one tool call per task and reducing total tool calls by more than 2x. On multi-step tasks, pass rate improves from 30.0% to 70.0%, and further to 84.0% with trajectory-level reflection. Uncertainty-aware filtering further reduces verifier false positives from 20.0% to 6.7% and improves precision from 80.0% to 93.3%.
