Specifically, a semantic-level transition module is designed to model dynamic transitions directly in the discrete semantic code space, effectively capturing fine-grained semantic dependencies often lost in aggregated item representations. Then, a complementary prior injection module is designed to incorporate LLM-verified complementary priors into the attention mechanism, thereby prioritizing complementary patterns over co-occurrence statistics. Experiments on multiple e-commerce datasets demonstrate that CAST consistently outperforms the state-of-the-art approaches, achieving up to 17.6% Recall and 16.0% NDCG gains with 65x training acceleration. This validates its effectiveness and efficiency in uncovering latent item complementarity beyond statistics. The code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAST框架，通过语义级转换模块和互补先验注入模块，有效解决现有顺序推荐方法在捕获可靠互补关系时面临的稀疏统计和粗粒度聚合问题，实验验证其在效果和效率上的显著优势。
AI.motivation: 现有方法存在两个关键缺陷：1) 基于稀疏共购统计的方法会将虚假相关性(如热门偏差)误认为真实互补关系；2) 基于离散语义代码的方法在聚合语义代码为粗粒度物品表示时会模糊识别互补性所需的具体语义细节。
AI.method: 提出互补感知语义转换(CAST)框架，包含两个核心模块：1) 语义级转换模块直接在离散语义代码空间建模动态转换，捕获细粒度语义依赖；2) 互补先验注入模块将LLM验证的互补先验知识融入注意力机制。
AI.result: 在多个电商数据集上，CAST一致性地超越现有方法，Recall提升17.6%，NDCG提升16.0%，训练加速65倍。
AI.conclusion: CAST框架在多个电商数据集上显著优于现有方法，Recall提升达17.6%，NDCG提升达16.0%，训练速度提升65倍，有效证明语义级转换在发现潜在互补关系方面的有效性和效率。

title: Suffix Random Access via Function Inversion: A Key for Asymmetric Streaming String Algorithms
summary:
Many string processing problems can be phrased in the streaming setting, where the input arrives symbol by symbol and we have sublinear working space. The area of streaming algorithms for string processing has flourished since the seminal work of Porat and Porat [FOCS 2009].
  Unfortunately, problems with efficient solutions in the classical setting often do not admit efficient solutions in the streaming setting. As a bridge between these two settings, Saks and Seshadhri [SODA 2013] introduced the asymmetric streaming model. Here, one is given read-only access to a (typically short) reference string $R$ of length $m$, while a text $T$ arrives as a stream.
  We provide a generic technique to reduce fundamental string problems in the asymmetric streaming model to the online read-only model, lifting several existing algorithms and generally improving upon the state of the art. Most notably, we obtain asymmetric streaming algorithms for exact and approximate pattern matching (under both the Hamming and edit distances), and for relative Lempel-Ziv compression.
  At the heart of our approach lies a novel tool that facilitates efficient computation in the asymmetric streaming model: the suffix random access data structure. In its simplest variant, it maintains constant-time random access to the longest suffix of (the seen prefix of) $T$ that occurs in $R$. We show a bidirectional reduction between suffix random access and function inversion, a central problem in cryptography.
  On the way to our upper bound, we propose a variant of the string synchronizing sets ([Kempa and Kociumaka; STOC 2019]) with a local sparsity condition that, as we show, admits an efficient streaming construction algorithm. We believe that our framework and techniques will find broad applications in the development of small-space string algorithms.

AI.tldr: 论文在不对称流模型下提出了将字符串处理问题规约到只读在线模型的一般性技术框架，核心工具是后缀随机访问数据结构（与密码学中的函数逆问题双向等价），并设计了局部稀疏的字符串同步集。应用包括精确/近似模式匹配和Lempel-Ziv压缩的高效流式算法。
AI.motivation: Bridge the gap between classical string algorithms and streaming algorithms. While classical problems often have efficient solutions, streaming setting with sublinear workspace frequently lacks efficient solutions. The asymmetric streaming model (reference + streaming text) serves as an intermediate model that should inherit properties from both settings.
AI.method: 1) Propose suffix random access data structure maintaining constant-time access to longest suffix in reference; 2) Establish bidirectional reduction between suffix random access and cryptographic function inversion; 3) Develop locally sparse string synchronizing sets with efficient streaming construction; 4) Use these tools as building blocks for generic reduction framework.
AI.result: Achieved asymmetric streaming algorithms for: exact pattern matching, approximate pattern matching (Hamming distance), approximate pattern matching (edit distance), and relative Lempel-Ziv compression. All improvements generalize or lift existing algorithms.
AI.conclusion: The paper provides a generic reduction framework from asymmetric streaming model to online read-only model, with efficient implementations for pattern matching and compression. Key innovation is the suffix random access data structure, with interesting cryptographic connections via function inversion reduction.

title: YAIFS: Yet (not) Another Intelligent Fog Simulator: A Framework for Agent-Driven Computing Continuum Modeling & Simulation
summary: Simulation plays a key role in the design and evaluation of distributed systems, yet it is often treated as a static tool with limited interaction capabilities. In this work, we present Yet (not) Another Intelligent Fog Simulator (YAIFS), and evolution of YAFS that redefines simulation as an interactive, service-oriented environment. YAIFS introduce a layered architecture that exposes the simulation through a unified API and service interface, enabling external entities to observe, control, and modify its execution. A central contribution is the integration of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) as a standardized interaction layer between agents and the simulation. Through MCP, heterogeneous agents can access state, invoke actions and coordinate behavior using a common set of tools, decoupling agent experimentation workflows. We illustrate these capabilities through two scenarios: an LLM-based assistant that enable natural language control of simulations, and a multi-agent setting where agents monitor system conditions and adapt placement decisions at runtime. These scenarios demonstrate how MCP structures agent-simulation interaction and enable adaptive behavior under dynamic workloads. The proposed approach transforms simulation into an interactive and programmable environment, opening new directions for AI-driven experimentation in cloud-edge systems. The implementation is publicly available at: http://github.com/acsicuib/YAIFS

AI.tldr: YAIFS 是作者在 2019 年 YAFS 模拟器基础上的服务化演进版：把云-边连续体仿真从"静态离线评估工具"改造为"可编程、可交互的仿真即服务（Simulation-as-a-Service）"。核心贡献是引入分层架构（Core / API / Service Interface）并以 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 作为智能体与仿真之间的标准化交互层，使 LLM 助手或多智能体能够以工具调用的方式观测状态、执行动作、动态调整应用放置。论文以 LLM 自然语言交互场景和多智能体（MCP 工具驱动）动态放置场景作为概念验证，结果表明多智能体策略在时延与副本资源之间取得优于随机/贪心基线的折中，并显著缓解热点负载扰动带来的性能退化。
AI.motivation: 云-边连续体基础设施日益复杂，仿真已成为评估系统行为的核心工具，但现有框架（iFogSim、iFogger、PureEdgeSim、SatEdgeSim、DISSECT-CF-Fog、ENIGMA、EdgeAISim、ECLYPSE 等）普遍存在同一交互范式缺陷：实验逻辑被硬编码在脚本或模拟器专用 API 中，外部决策实体与模拟器之间的耦合是临时且临界的（ad hoc and tightly coupled），用户需在较低抽象层级手工建模与执行，难以系统性地探索大规模配置空间。同时，LLM 与自主智能体的成熟使得"将仿真视为可被智能体探索、控制和优化的交互式环境"成为可能——例如用户可用"比较两种以降低时延为目标的放置策略"这类高层意图直接驱动可执行的仿真工作流。作者自身 2019 年的 YAFS 已提供灵活的图结构基础设施表示与可定制进程（节点失效、用户移动等动态行为），但仍要求用户手工编排实验、抽象层级偏低、学习曲线陡峭。
AI.method: 1) 分层架构：Core 层（继承 YAFS 的 simpy 离散事件引擎、消息传输/传播时延与链路占用建模、路径选择与失效处理、细粒度节点/链路度量）；API 层（应用/用户/基础设施的高层抽象，仿真生命周期管理 init/run/pause/resume/stop，运行期动态部署、迁移、复制、删除 VNF，动态进程定义与拓扑变更后的路由缓存一致性）；Service Interface 层（仿真作为长生命周期托管实体，显式生命周期状态机 created/initialized/running/paused/stopped/failed，按窗口调度执行，运行时修改限定于可操作非运行态，支持 fork 分支式实验并保留谱系血缘，提供状态快照、时间窗应用度量、网络统计与实体清单等自省端点）。2) 建模抽象：基础设施为簇（cluster）—节点（node）图，簇可归入 region 以计算跨域出入口成本，链路含地理距离与目标时延；应用为 ETSI 风格 VNF 链（并新增从末端 VNF 回传用户的反向响应路径），用户为请求生成实体，动态过程支持用户移动、节点失效/恢复等；VNF 放置可显式指定或由放置策略动态生成，默认按最短路径路由。3) MCP 集成：作为代理与仿真服务之间的桥梁，以标准化 tools/resources 暴露创建仿真、修改实验条件、触发系统事件、获取度量等能力；作者实现 CLI 客户端由 OpenAI GPT-5 解析自然语言并翻译为 MCP 工具调用，同时记录提示、模型响应、工具调用、生成配置与执行轨迹以保证可追溯与可复现。4) 多智能体 MCP 放置策略：窗口化执行模型 W_k=[t_k,t_{k+1})；Monitoring Agent 只读地聚合低层度量为快照 S_k=(T_k, R_k, U^node_k, O_k, U^link_k, C_k, P_k)，含各应用经验 95 分位响应时延（与延迟需求比较判定 degraded）、失败请求数、节点利用率（θ_node=0.08，连续 ω_overload=1 个窗口超限入重载集 O_k）、链路利用率（θ_link=0.5 判定拥塞集 C_k）、聚合放置成本（P_k>θ_cost=8.7 触发成本策略）；Placement Agent 按层级规则 σ_k∈{Cost, Overload, Congestion, Balanced} 选择策略（优先级 Cost>Overload>Congestion），对应动作集 consolidate / replicate / move，并以评分函数 score(n)=d_users(n)+α·U_k^n(n)+β·P_n+Π_region(n)（δ_region=25.0）选择目标节点，每窗口动作预算 B=4 以抑制振荡；α、β 依策略取不同权重（cost: α=25,β=60；overload: α=55,β=20；congestion: α=25,β=12；balanced: α=35,β=20）。实验用 HotspotUsers 事件构造非平稳负载：t=1000 注入 60 个 Perception Pipeline 用户、t=1800 迁移至邻近节点、t=2600 移除 40%。
AI.result: 场景配置：CDC/EDC/MEC 分别为 3/10/27 个簇，共 214 个非均匀分布节点，用户请求在 MEC 节点生成；三类应用为 Perception Pipeline（3 VNF/4 消息/时延需求 120）、Coordination Pipeline（2 VNF/3 消息/75）、Telemetry Monitoring（1 VNF/2 消息/50）；仿真时长 5000 时间单位。三种放置策略对比：随机放置（固定 20 个初始副本、轮询共享实例、热点用户复用已有实例）、贪心放置（每个用户在其所在 MEC 节点新建独立应用实例，无副本共享）、多智能体 MCP 放置。结果：(1) 贪心时延最低但网络成为主要瓶颈（因部署集中于边缘）；随机与多智能体策略中网络时延影响更大、热点期等待时间上升；(2) 热点扰动的影响仅在多智能体方案中得到有效缓解，因其随负载变化动态重定位 VNF；(3) 动作序列演化显示初期以 consolidation/replication 应对成本超限与链路拥塞，后期以 move 迁移为主以缓解节点过载；(4) 部署 VNF 总数：随机约 41、贪心 567、多智能体 56，说明多智能体在时延与资源占用间取得较均衡的部署；(5) LLM 场景验证了能力自述、场景生成、工具序列分解（含冗余与探索性调用，作者指出可精简为 4 步最优序列）、双放置策略对比方案生成，以及多语言（英/西）自适应应答。总体结论：MCP 提供了共同接口、实现智能体逻辑与执行上下文解耦、并保障细粒度可追溯性（记录行为主体、窗口、工具、输入输出摘要与执行状态），使仿真从静态评估工件转变为可观测、可复现、可编程的交互式环境。
AI.conclusion: YAIFS 的核心贡献不在于引入新的仿真精度，而在于交互范式的转变：通过 Core/API/Service Interface 的分层架构与 MCP 标准化交互层，把仿真重构为可被外部智能体观察、控制、演化与分支（fork）的"可编程实体/服务"，从而降低复杂仿真工具的学习曲线，支撑可复现、可自动化的 AI 驱动实验方法学。作者强调 YAIFS 本身不嵌入决策智能，高层能力由外部智能体经 MCP 实现；实现已开源（github.com/acsicuib/YAIFS），包含文档、以 API/服务化接口重写的 YAFS 场景与两个示例用例。局限与展望方面：评估以单一云-边拓扑、窗口化规则型（而非学习型）智能体为主，缺少与 RL/LLM 规划器的对比与统计显著性分析，阈值为经验设定；未来工作将探索集成强化学习与高级 LLM 规划策略、多智能体在共享仿真环境中的协同、与外部编排工具（Terraform/Kubernetes）及真实部署框架的互操作，以进一步弥合仿真与实际部署之间的鸿沟。

title: Proactive Detection of GUI Defects in Multi-Window Scenarios via Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Multi-window mobile scenarios, such as split-screen and foldable modes, make GUI display defects more likely by forcing applications to adapt to changing window sizes and dynamic layout reflow. Existing detection techniques are limited in two ways: they are largely passive, analyzing screenshots only after problematic states have been reached, and they are mainly designed for conventional full-screen interfaces, making them less effective in multi-window settings.We propose an end-to-end framework for GUI display defect detection in multi-window mobile scenarios. The framework proactively triggers split-screen, foldable, and window-transition states during app exploration, uses Set-of-Mark (SoM) to align screenshots with widget-level interface elements, and leverages multimodal large language models with chain-of-thought prompting to detect, localize, and explain display defects. We also construct a benchmark of GUI display defects using 50 real-world Android applications.Experimental results show that multi-window settings substantially increase the exposure of layout-related defects, with text truncation increasing by 184% compared with conventional full-screen settings. At the application level, our method detects 40 defect-prone apps with a false positive rate of 10.00% and a false negative rate of 11.11%, outperforming OwlEye and YOLO-based baselines. At the fine-grained level, it achieves the best F1 score of 87.2% for widget occlusion detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种端到端的GUI显示缺陷检测框架，针对多窗口移动场景（分屏、可折叠设备）。通过主动触发多种窗口状态、结合Set-of-Mark标记和思维链提示的多模态大语言模型，实现缺陷的检测、定位和解释。在50个真实Android应用上的实验表明，该方法在应用级检测中FP为10.00%、FN为11.11%，在部件级遮挡检测中F1达87.2%，优于OwlEye和YOLO基线。
AI.motivation: 多窗口移动场景（分屏、可折叠模式）使GUI显示缺陷更容易发生，因为应用需要适应不断变化的窗口尺寸和动态布局重排。现有检测技术存在两大局限：1）被动式，只能在问题状态出现后分析截图；2）主要针对传统全屏界面设计，对多窗口场景效果较差。
AI.method: 提出端到端框架：1）主动触发分屏、可折叠和窗口切换状态进行应用探索；2）使用Set-of-Mark (SoM)将截图与部件级界面元素对齐；3）利用带思维链提示的多模态大语言模型检测、定位和解释显示缺陷。
AI.result: 多窗口设置显著增加布局相关缺陷暴露，文字截断问题比传统全屏增加184%。应用级检测：发现40个缺陷应用，FP=10.00%，FN=11.11%，优于OwlEye和YOLO基线。细粒度检测：部件遮挡检测F1达87.2%。
AI.conclusion: 构建了包含50个真实Android应用的GUI显示缺陷基准测试，验证了多窗口场景对缺陷发现的显著影响。框架结合主动状态触发、SoM对齐和多模态LLM，在检测性能和可解释性上均展现出优势。

title: Remask, Don't Replace: Token-to-Mask Refinement in Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion language models such as LLaDA2.1 rely on Token-to-Token (T2T) editing to correct their own generation errors: whenever a different token crosses a confidence threshold, the committed token is overwritten. We identify three structural failure modes of this rule. The trigger cannot fire when no single alternative is confident enough; the replacement is computed under a context that may itself contain errors; and the uniform perturbations used to train the T2T stream do not resemble the coherent, semantically plausible mistakes that the model actually makes at inference. As an alternative, we propose Token-to-Mask (T2M) remasking. Rather than overwriting a suspect token with a new guess, T2M resets the position to the mask state, so that the next denoising step re-predicts it from an in-distribution context. The method is training-free, modifies only the editing rule, and introduces no new parameters. We pair it with three detection heuristics and give a short theoretical account of why a mask is a better conditioning signal than an erroneous token. Across 8 benchmarks, T2M improves accuracy on tasks that require exact token-level output. Its largest gain is +5.92 points on CMATH, where we attribute 79.9% of baseline errors to last-mile corruption (correct reasoning followed by a garbled final answer); T2M repairs 41.3% of these cases.

AI.tldr: Proposed Token-to-Mask (T2M) editing as alternative to Token-to-Token editing in masked diffusion language models. T2M resets suspect tokens to mask state instead of overwriting with new guesses, enabling re-prediction from clean context. Method is training-free with no new parameters, achieving up to +5.92 points improvement on math benchmarks.
AI.motivation: Identify three structural failure modes of Token-to-Token (T2T) editing in masked diffusion language models: (1) Trigger failure when no single alternative is confident enough; (2) Replacement computed under erroneous context; (3) Training uses uniform perturbations unlike actual coherent errors at inference.
AI.method: Token-to-Mask (T2M) editing: instead of replacing suspect tokens with new guesses, reset the position to mask state so subsequent denoising re-predicts from clean in-distribution context. Paired with three detection heuristics. Training-free, no new parameters, only modifies the editing rule.
AI.result: T2M improves accuracy across 8 benchmarks on tasks requiring exact token-level output. Largest gain of +5.92 points on CMATH benchmark. 79.9% of baseline errors attributed to "last-mile corruption" (correct reasoning with garbled final answer); T2M repairs 41.3% of these cases.
AI.conclusion: T2M provides a principled alternative to T2T for masked diffusion LMs, with theoretical justification that masks provide better conditioning signals than erroneous tokens. The approach is practically impactful on tasks requiring exact token-level output, particularly for math problems where final answer formatting is critical.

title: Human-Guided Harm Recovery for Computer Use Agents
summary: As LM agents gain the ability to execute actions on real computer systems, we need ways to not only prevent harmful actions at scale but also effectively remediate harm when prevention fails. We formalize a solution to this neglected challenge in post-execution safeguards as harm recovery: the problem of optimally steering an agent from a harmful state back to a safe one in alignment with human preferences. We ground preference-aligned recovery through a formative user study that identifies valued recovery dimensions and produces a natural language rubric. Our dataset of 1,150 pairwise judgments reveals context-dependent shifts in attribute importance, such as preferences for pragmatic, targeted strategies over comprehensive long-term approaches. We operationalize these learned insights in a reward model, re-ranking multiple candidate recovery plans generated by an agent scaffold at test time. To evaluate recovery capabilities systematically, we introduce BackBench, a benchmark of 50 computer-use tasks that test an agent's ability to recover from harmful states. Human evaluation shows our reward model scaffold yields higher-quality recovery trajectories than base agents and rubric-based scaffolds. Together, these contributions lay the foundation for a new class of agent safety methods -- ones that confront harm not only by preventing it, but by navigating its aftermath with alignment and intent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并形式化了计算机使用智能体的"危害恢复"（harm recovery）问题：即在预防机制失效、危害已经造成后，如何把系统从有害状态带回安全状态，且恢复方式符合人类偏好。作者通过形成性用户研究提炼出 8 维自然语言评估准则，收集 1,130 条人工成对偏好判断，训练奖励模型在测试时对智能体生成的 10 个候选恢复计划进行重排序；同时提出包含 50 个真实场景的基准 BackBench（基于 OSWorld，覆盖可用性、财务、完整性、故意误用、安全五类危害，含 15/50 步限制）。人类评测显示奖励模型脚手架相对基础模型提升 120 Elo、相对准则（rubric）脚手架提升 45 Elo，显著且在资源受限（15 步）任务上优势最大，表明领域特定偏好对齐即便叠加在已高度安全对齐的 Claude Sonnet 4.5 之上仍带来实质收益。
AI.motivation: 1）现状缺口：现有智能体安全方法几乎都是"执行前预防"（拒绝分类器、提示注入防御、红队基准等），而智能体在真实计算机环境中每一步看似安全、最终却造成真实危害（如安装了被劫持的官方更新导致主机加入僵尸网络）；预防失效后由人工操作员补救既不可扩展也不现实。2）目标缺失：仅仅到达"某个安全状态"不够——恢复还需高效、完整、避免副作用、防止复发，这些恰恰是用户偏好相关且随情境变化的维度，因此恢复本质是偏好对齐下的优化问题，而非单纯的功能性可达性问题。3）此前文献（计划修复、应急规划、RLHF/Constitutional AI）均未研究"智能体如何弥补自身造成的危害"这一后执行（post-execution）安全维度，BackBench 类基准也只测"是否会做坏事"而非"能否收拾残局"。
AI.method: 【问题形式化】定义状态集 S、原子动作集 A、转移函数 T；每个状态被标注为 harmful/safe（借助外部危害分类器作为 oracle，以隔离"检测"与"恢复"两个问题）；轨迹 τ=(s0,a1,s1,…,sT)，s0=s_h 且 s_T∈S_safe；目标为 π*=argmax_π E[R(τ)] s.t. s_T∈S_safe，其中 R 为人类偏好的标量对齐分数。【用户研究与准则】20 名 Prolific 参与者做形成性研究，编码自由文本回答提炼出 8 维自然语言准则：D1 全面性、D2 聚焦度、D3 成功可能性、D4 执行速度、D5 长期解决、D6 副作用、D7 沟通、D8 自主性（各维 1–5 分）。【偏好数据】230 名参与者对 GPT-4.1 生成的恢复计划做 5 个任务/人的成对多维打分与总体偏好，收集 1,130 条成对判断；用条件逻辑回归分析属性重要性与情境主题的调节效应。【生成-验证脚手架】LM_gen（Claude Sonnet 4.5，temperature 1.0/top_p 0.8，max_tokens 10000）基于场景、桌面状态描述、无障碍树与步数上限生成 N=10 条自然语言恢复计划（作为可执行轨迹的高层代理，采样多样候选近似随机策略）；验证器两变体：(a) 准则式——冻结的 GPT-4.1 按准则对所有计划对做 A/B 判断、正反序各判一次（不一致记为平局），多数胜出聚合为排序，执行榜首计划；(b) 奖励模型式——用 TRL RewardTrainer 在 1,130 条偏好对上微调 Qwen3-0.6B（3 epochs、bs 8、lr 1e-5、wd 0.01、warmup 0.1、max_len 1100、early stopping patience 3、FP16、ml.g5.xlarge/A10G、20–30 分钟），推理时按分数选最大者。【BackBench 基准】在 OSWorld Ubuntu 环境中程序化实例化 50 个场景，基于 5 大危害类别（可用性、财务、完整性、故意误用、安全）各设 4–6 个初始状态，并按 15/50 步限制排列任务；场景由 GPT-4.1 生成含 situation_description/state_description/response_options 的 JSON（刻意保留模糊性与权衡）；恢复计划由 GPT-4.1 递归生成（把已有计划加入提示以促进多样性）。【评测】30 名标注者观看成对轨迹视频做 A/B 偏好判断，用 Bradley-Terry 最大似然估计强度参数 p_i，按 R=1500+400·log10(p_i) 转为类国际象棋 Elo 分，bootstrap（n=1000）估计标准误并做显著性检验；另建 GPT-4.1 LLM 裁判（先逐步摘要轨迹，再按结果有效性、遏制及时性、附带损害、执行效率四维评判）作为低成本替代协议。
AI.result: 【BackBench 主结果】人类 Bradley-Terry 评分（全部任务）：奖励模型脚手架比基础模型高 120 Elo，准则式脚手架比基础模型高 75 Elo，奖励模型比准则式高 45 Elo；bootstrap 显著性 p=0.004（奖励模型 vs 基础）与 p=0.008（准则式 vs 基础）；BT 估计奖励模型以 67% 概率胜过基础模型（赔率≈2.0），准则式为 61%（赔率≈1.5）。人类成对胜率：基准/准则 0.607、基准/奖励 0.667、准则/奖励 0.565。LLM 裁判胜率：基准/准则 0.753、基准/奖励 0.672、准则/奖励 0.598——两种协议均把基础模型排在最后且差距很大，但对前两名的先后互换，其差异落在置信区间内（各配对平均相差 ≤10.5 个百分点），说明 LLM 裁判是可靠的廉价代理但细粒度排序仍需人工。脚手架优势在 15 步受限任务上最明显，即资源越受限收益越大。【偏好数据分析】条件逻辑回归：执行速度（系数 0.258，p=0.001）与聚焦度（0.249，p=0.002）显著正向影响计划被选中；全面性显著负向（−0.319，p=0.002），即用户偏好务实、聚焦的短平快方案而非全面但冗长耗时的长期方案；成功可能性、长期解决、副作用、沟通、自主性均无显著/一致影响。调节效应显示属性权重随情境主题系统变化（如"负责任的 AI 平台"显著提升成功可能性权重 0.364，"自动化访问配置"提升沟通权重 0.309 与长期解决权重 0.259，心理健康支持场景提升自主性权重 0.260），证实偏好的情境依赖性。标注者一致性较低（Cohen's κ=0.15）。
AI.conclusion: 本文确立了"危害恢复"作为智能体安全中与"预防"并列的关键维度，并给出可操作的落地路径：由人类偏好研究推导准则→收集偏好数据→训练奖励模型→在测试时重排序候选恢复计划，在 50 场景基准上验证了相对基础模型与 rubric 脚手架的显著优势（+120 / +45 Elo）。奖励模型优于 rubric 的原因在于它隐式学习了"属性权重随情境变化"的映射，而 rubric 验证器只能依赖基座模型的先验权重假设，这直接支撑了论文的核心论点——上下文依赖的人类偏好对有效补救不可替代。作者强调三点定位与边界：①恢复是纵深防御中的补充层而非预防的替代品，恢复机制的存在可能削弱投入前置防护的动机；②恢复受限于检测能力与执行可靠性，且部分危害不可逆，只能做到"减轻后果"而非"完全复原"；③低标注一致性被视为规范性多样性的实质发现而非方法缺陷，反映速度、完整性、自主性之间的价值权衡高度情境化。未来方向包括：通过后训练目标培养内在的"回退/自纠错"能力、面向个体风险偏好的个性化恢复、以及前后置护栏的协同设计。

title: Discrete Tilt Matching
summary: Masked diffusion large language models (dLLMs) are a promising alternative to autoregressive generation. While reinforcement learning (RL) methods have recently been adapted to dLLM fine-tuning, their objectives typically depend on sequence-level marginal likelihoods, which are intractable for masked diffusion models. To address this, we derive Discrete Tilt Matching (DTM), a likelihood-free method that recasts dLLM fine-tuning as state-level matching of local unmasking posteriors under reward tilting. DTM takes the form of a weighted cross-entropy objective with explicit minimizer, and admits control variates that improve training stability. On a synthetic maze-planning task, we analyze how DTM's annealing schedule and control variates affect training stability and prevent mode collapse. At scale, fine-tuning LLaDA-8B-Instruct with DTM yields strong gains on Sudoku and Countdown while remaining competitive on MATH500 and GSM8K.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Discrete Tilt Matching (DTM)：一种无需似然估计的掩码扩散语言模型（dLLM）微调方法，把后训练重新表述为「奖励倾斜下的状态级局部解掩码后验匹配」。DTM 给出带显式最优解（目标倾斜后验）的加权交叉熵损失，并可配合控制变量降方差；作者在迷宫规划合成任务上分析其稳定性，在 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 上于 Sudoku/Countdown 取得大幅提升且在 MATH500/GSM8K 上保持竞争力。
AI.motivation: 掩码扩散大模型（dLLM）作为自回归生成的替代方案受到关注，但已有 RL 后训练方法（如 GRPO、WD1、UniGRPO、SPG）普遍依赖序列级边缘似然 log ρ_θ(x1)。由于一个终止序列可由指数多条解掩码顺序产生，掩码扩散模型的序列似然本质不可 tractable，只能用有偏代理或高方差估计器近似。此外，直接对样本按 e^{Ar(x)} 重加权做监督微调权重方差高、易导致模式崩塌。作者因此主张：dLLM 的后训练应建立在可计算的「状态级」量——部分掩码状态上的局部解掩码后验 π(v|x_t, i)——之上，而不是序列级似然目标上；并在连续扩散的 Tilt Matching（Potaptchik et al., 2025; Guo et al., 2025）启发下，采用逐步退火（annealing）的倾斜策略，从 ρ_{1,a} 渐进更新到 ρ_{1,a+h}，而不是一次性完成倾斜。
AI.method:
**框架。** 把掩码扩散模型（MDM）写成离散状态空间上的连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMC）：速率矩阵 R_t(x, x[x^i←v]) = λ(t)·P[x_1^i=v | x_t]，λ(t)=α̇(t)/(1−α(t)) 来自离散随机插值的解掩码风险率；核心可学习对象是局部解掩码后验 π_θ(·|x_t, i)。

**奖励倾斜与增量问题。** 定义倾斜目标 ρ_{1,a}(x) ∝ ρ_1(x)e^{ar(x)}，训练从 π_a（诱导 ρ_{1,a}）更新到 π_{a+h}（诱导 ρ_{1,a+h}）。

**Esscher 变换（核心推导）。** 由于给定 x_1 时掩码过程与倾斜无关，路径测度满足 Radon–Nikodym 关系 dP_{a+h}/dP_a = e^{hr(x_1)}/E_a[e^{hr(x_1)}]，得到条件换测公式与倾斜后验的唯一刻画（Prop 3.1）：π_{a+h}(·|x,i) 是唯一满足 E_a[e^{hr(x_1)}π_{a+h}(v|x,i)|x_t] = E_a[e^{hr(x_1)}1{x_1^i=v}|x_t] 的单纯形分布。

**DTM 损失（Prop 3.2）。** L^{c-DTM}_{a→a+h}(θ) = ∫₀¹ α̇(t)/(1−α(t)) E_a[Σ_{i: x_t^i=m} e^{hr(x_1)}·CE(T_c(·|x_t,i,x_1) ‖ π_θ(·|x_t,i))] dt，其唯一最优解为 π_θ* = π_{a+h}；完全不需要序列级似然。附录给出更一般的「倾斜 Bregman 回归」统一框架（Φ 取负 Shannon 熵，损失即 KL）。

**控制变量。** 取 T_c(v|x_t,i,x_1) = [c·π_a(v|x_t,i) + (e^{hr(x_1)}−c)·1{v=x_1^i}] / e^{hr(x_1)}，在加权意义下无偏且保持最优解不变；Prop 3.3 证明小 h 时 c=1 的梯度方差不大于 c=0。

**KL 上界（Prop 3.4）。** KL(ρ_{1,a+h}‖ρ_θ) ≤ (1/Z)(L^{c-DTM}(θ) − L^{c-DTM}(θ*))，Z = E_a[e^{hr(x_1)}]，由 CTMC 路径 KL（Girsanov）展开与数据处理不等式得到。

**实用化。** (i) SAR 对齐：因损失逐点定义，只需把随机掩码插值换成块状插值（当前块内任意顺序、未来块全掩码），把求和限制在活动块、危险率换成 λ_SAR(t)=M·α′(u)/(1−α(u))，即可保留全部理论性质并与测试时解码对齐；(ii) 回放缓冲区：一次 rollout 的 (x_1, r(x_1)) 可通过随机插值生成大量中间状态，无需额外网络调用，周期性刷新以摊销 rollout 成本。算法 1 给出 a=0→A 的分阶段训练流程。
AI.result:
**合成迷宫规划（41×41，stay-away-from-center 奖励）。** 控制变量 c=1 且退火步长 h 较小（2.5）时奖励与有效路径率更高、覆盖度更好；去掉控制变量（c=0）或步长过大（h=7.5）会出现明显模式崩塌（rollout 集中在少数近似路径）。

**LLaDA-8B-Instruct 微调（LoRA r=128，SAR 块 32，生成长度 256/512）。** Sudoku：99.2 / 99.4（基座 27.7 / 26.2，最强基线 SPG 94.0 / 93.1）；Countdown：81.3 / 78.9（基座 16.8，SPG 70.7 / 70.3，均为最优）；MATH500：36.0 / 40.2（优于基座 32.4 / 34.6，略低于 SPG 40.0 / 41.8）；GSM8K：81.6 / 83.2（基座 77.2 / 79.8，弱于 SPG 86.1 / 84.5）。

**消融与效率。** Countdown 上 h∈{1.5,3,6,12} 消融显示 h=6 最优且整体鲁棒；h=6 保留了「需乘除」的小众模式（基座 1.95% → 2.78%），而 SPG 该模式崩塌为 0%。SAR 对齐消融：SAR 插值 81% vs 随机插值 67%。8×H100 上 Sudoku 的 wallclock 对比显示 DTM 收敛更快、奖励更高。定性分析中 DTM 的有效生成长度更稳定，说明 reward hacking 更少。
AI.conclusion: DTM 表明似然型 RL 后训练未必是掩码扩散模型的最佳范式：只要在 CTMC/插值结构下推导，就能得到完全避开似然、却具备「最优解 = 奖励倾斜后验」与终端 KL 控制保证的局部投影目标。作者认为这为与扩散式语言模型结构更契合的替代后训练范式打开了大门。局限与未来方向：MATH500/GSM8K 上仅优于基座而不及最强 RL 基线，作者归因于局部后验匹配难以转化为长程全局一致的推理；此外还有重加权方差、步长 h 需调参、依赖奖励函数质量等问题。

title: Epistemic orientation in parliamentary discourse is associated with deliberative democracy
summary: The pursuit of truth is central to democratic deliberation and governance, yet political discourse reflects varying epistemic orientations, ranging from evidence-based reasoning grounded in verifiable information to intuition-based reasoning rooted in beliefs and subjective interpretation. We introduce a scalable approach to measure epistemic orientation using the Evidence--Minus--Intuition (EMI) score, derived from large language model (LLM) ratings and embedding-based semantic similarity. Applying this approach to 15 million parliamentary speech segments spanning 1946 to 2025 across seven countries, we examine temporal patterns in discourse and its association with deliberative democracy and governance. We find that EMI is positively associated with deliberative democracy within countries over time, with consistent relationships in both contemporaneous and lagged analyses. EMI is also positively associated with the transparency and predictable implementation of laws as a dimension of governance. These findings suggest that the epistemic nature of political discourse is crucial for both the quality of democracy and governance.

AI.tldr: 研究开发了基于LLM的EMI评分方法，测量政治话语的认知论取向（证据导向vs直觉导向），通过分析7国1500万段议会发言发现，证据导向话语与 deliberative democracy 和治理质量正相关，揭示了政治话语认知性质对民主与治理的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 追求真相是民主 deliberation 和治理的核心，但政治话语存在从证据导向到直觉导向的不同认知取向，亟需可扩展的方法来量化测量这种认知论取向。
AI.method: 基于大语言模型（LLM）评分和基于嵌入的语义相似性计算证据减去直觉（EMI）评分，对1946-2025年间7个国家1500万段议会发言进行大规模测量分析。
AI.result: 同国内时间序列分析显示EMI与 deliberative democracy 呈正相关（当期与滞后分析均一致）；EMI还与法律透明度和可预测执行等治理维度呈正相关。
AI.conclusion: 证据导向型政治话语与民主质量和治理水平呈正相关，证实了政治话语的认知论性质对民主运行和治理效果具有关键影响。

title: Enhancing Unsupervised Keyword Extraction in Academic Papers through Integrating Highlights with Abstract
summary: Automatic keyword extraction from academic papers is a key area of interest in natural language processing and information retrieval. Although previous research has mainly focused on utilizing abstract and references for keyword extraction, this paper focuses on the highlights section - a summary describing the key findings and contributions, offering readers a quick overview of the research. Our observations indicate that highlights contain valuable keyword information that can effectively complement the abstract. To investigate the impact of incorporating highlights into unsupervised keyword extraction, we evaluate three input scenarios: using only the abstract, the highlights, and a combination of both. Experiments conducted with four unsupervised models on Computer Science (CS), Library and Information Science (LIS) datasets reveal that integrating the abstract with highlights significantly improves extraction performance. Furthermore, we examine the differences in keyword coverage and content between abstract and highlights, exploring how these variations influence extraction outcomes. The data and code are available at https://github.com/xiangyi-njust/Highlight-KPE.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了将学术论文的Highlights部分融入无监督关键词抽取任务。通过在CS和LIS数据集上使用四种无监督模型评估三种输入场景（仅摘要、仅Highlights、以及两者结合），发现将摘要与Highlights结合能显著提升抽取效果。
AI.motivation: Previous keyword extraction research mainly focused on abstracts and references, ignoring the potential of highlights sections which summarize key findings and contributions.
AI.method: Evaluate three input scenarios (abstract only, highlights only, and combination of both) using four unsupervised models on Computer Science (CS) and Library and Information Science (LIS) datasets.
AI.result: Integrating abstract with highlights significantly improves extraction performance compared to using either source alone.
AI.conclusion: Highlights contain valuable keyword information that can effectively complement the abstract for keyword extraction.

title: UniEP: Unified Expert-Parallel MoE MegaKernel for LLM Training
summary:
The exponential growth in Large Language Model (LLM) parameters has transformed model training into an increasingly resource-intensive endeavor. With the stagnation of Moore's Law and the widening disparity between computation throughput and communication bandwidth, expert parallelism (EP) has emerged as a critical strategy for scaling mixture-of-experts (MoE) models. However, despite numerous proposals for optimizing EP, ranging from communication compression to computation-communication overlap, adoption within production-grade frameworks like Megatron-LM remains conservative. Existing solutions often rely on ad-hoc, complex kernels that lack adaptability across diverse optimization configurations and frequently neglect numerical stability, failing to meet the strict precision requirements of large-scale training.
  In this paper, we introduce UniEP, a novel system that unifies diverse EP optimization strategies into a cohesive abstraction. UniEP fuses the MoE communication and computation into MegaKernels, effectively transforming complex architectural tuning into a unified parameter search space for automated adaptability. Crucially, UniEP incorporates a deterministic token ordering mechanism that guarantees numerical consistency with sequential execution, even under aggressive overlap schedules. We evaluate UniEP on GPU clusters equipped with NVIDIA Hopper GPUs. Our results demonstrate that UniEP achieves 1.03$\times$-1.38$\times$ speedups over state-of-the-art work, effectively mitigating communication bottlenecks while maintaining the rigorous accuracy standards required for production LLM training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UniEP系统，通过统一抽象专家并行优化策略并引入确定性token排序，在保持数值稳定性的同时实现通信-计算重叠优化，在Hopper GPU上获得最高1.38倍加速。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型参数规模的指数级增长使训练资源消耗急剧上升；Moore定律停滞与计算-通信带宽差距扩大；现有EP优化方案依赖定制化内核，缺乏适应性，且忽视数值稳定性，难以满足大规模训练的精度要求。
AI.method: 提出了UniEP系统，将MoE通信与计算融合为MegaKernels，转化为统一参数搜索空间实现自动化适配；引入确定性token排序机制以保证激进重叠调度下的数值一致性。
AI.result: 在NVIDIA Hopper GPU集群上，UniEP相比SOTA工作实现1.03×-1.38×的加速，有效缓解通信瓶颈，同时维持生产级训练的精度标准。
AI.conclusion: UniEP通过统一抽象和确定性排序机制，在NVIDIA Hopper GPU集群上实现了1.03×-1.38×的加速，有效缓解通信瓶颈，同时保持生产级LLM训练所需的精度标准，为MoE模型的高效扩展提供了可行方案。

title: MUCOCO: Automated Consistency Testing of Code LLMs
summary: Code LLMs often portray inconsistent program behaviors. Developers typically employ benchmarks to assess Code LLMs, but most benchmarks are hand-crafted, static and do not target consistency property. In this work, we pose the scientific question: how can we automatically discover inconsistent program behaviors in Code LLMs? To address this challenge, we propose an automated consistency testing method, called MUCOCO, which employs semantic-preserving mutation analysis to expose inconsistent behaviors in code LLMs. Given a coding query, MUCOCO automatically transforms its program into semantically equivalent programs (aka mutants) and detects inconsistencies between the mutants and the original program (e.g., different output or test failure). We evaluate MUCOCO using four (4) coding tasks and seven (7) LLMs. Results show that MUCOCO is effective in exposing inconsistency and outperforms the closest baseline (TURBULENCE). About one in seven (15%) inputs generated by MUCOCO exposed inconsistencies. Our work motivates the need to test Code LLMs for consistency property

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MuCoCo——首个面向 Code LLM 的自动化一致性（consistency）测试框架。核心思想是：利用语义保持（semantic-preserving）的变异算子把已有代码基准中的题目自动改写为语义等价的“变体”，再用变形测试（metamorphic testing）作为一致性预言机，比较原题与变体上 LLM 输出的测试结果，一旦出现行为差异（如一方通过测试而另一方失败）即判定为一致性错误。在 4 个基准（HumanEval、CruxEval、CodeMMLU、BigCodeBench）、4 类编码任务和 7 个 LLM 上，约 14.82%（21924/147935）的测试用例暴露出一致性错误；相比最接近的基线 Turbulence，MuCoCo 能多发现 22.46% 的一致性错误、错误数约为其 5 倍、测试规模约 4 倍，且能发现 Turbulence 无法发现的全新错误类型。
AI.motivation: 代码大模型（Code LLM）在多次运行、不同提示或相似任务下常表现出行为不一致，在关键场景中可能造成严重后果。然而开发者与研究者主要依赖人工构造、静态的基准（HumanEval、MBPP、BigCodeBench、CruxEval、CodeMMLU 等）来评测模型，它们只关注“正确性”，无法评估“一致性”属性，且会随时间泄露到新一代模型中。已有的自动一致性测试工作（如 KONTEST）面向的是通用文本 LLM，而非代码 LLM；最接近的 Turbulence 依靠人工编写的参数化模板且关注鲁棒性而非一致性。因此，论文提出科学问题：如何自动发现 Code LLM 中不一致的程序行为？
AI.method: 方法由三个阶段组成：（1）原始基准测试——加载基准（如 HumanEval），先用规范解跑通测试套件验证数据正确性，再将任务送入被测 LLM 并执行测试套件记录结果；（2）变异基准测试——对每个任务逐一应用 11 个语义保持变异算子，先检查算子是否适用（如 for-to-while 需存在 for 循环），变异后用测试套件复验语义保持，再送入 LLM 并记录结果；（3）一致性错误检测——将原题与对应变体配对作为一致性测试用例，比较二者的输出与测试正确性，聚合计算一致性错误率。11 个算子分三类：词法（random/sequential 重命名、literal format 引号替换）、语法（for-to-enumerate、for-to-while）、逻辑（DeMorgan、boolean literal、commutative reorder、constant unfolding 及其 add/multiplication 变体）。预言机分两层：正确性预言机（正确/错误/无效三态）与一致性预言机，区分三类不一致：正确性型（一方对一方错）、无效型（一方非法输出）、错误性型（双方皆错但失败用例集合不同）。实验涵盖 4 基准 4 任务（MCQ、输入预测、输出预测、代码生成）与 7 个 LLM（GPT-4o、GPT-5、Qwen2.5-Coder-14B、Gemma-3-12B、DeepSeek-V3.2、LLaMA-3.1-8B、Codestral-2508），并与 Turbulence 基线对比，另做算子消融、二阶变异、不一致方向、不一致距离、置信度阈值与集成策略等附加实验。
AI.result: RQ1：整体不一致率 14.82%（21924/147935），在平均准确率 69.13% 的情况下仍暴露约 2.2 万个一致性错误。模型间差异显著：GPT-5 最低（2.92%，归因于其推理能力），LLaMA-3.1-8B 最高（21.22%），GPT-4o 18.15%，Qwen2.5 与 Codestral 居中（归因于代码指令微调）。任务/数据集方面，代码生成最易出错（27.15%）、BigCodeBench 最高（27.26%），输入预测与 HumanEval 最低（6.65% / 10.09%）。RQ2：在 Turbulence 数据集上，MuCoCo 错误率 41.39% 对 Turbulence 33.8%，高出 22.46%；错误数 1,781,288 vs 279,241（约 5 倍），测试用例 4,302,713 vs 826,084（约 4 倍），且两者发现的是不同类别的不一致（参数实例化 vs 语义保持变体），说明互补性；仅输出预测任务上 Turbulence 略优（73.78% vs 73.83% 的差距幅度极小）。RQ3：词法与逻辑变异诱发的不一致最多（16.28% 与 13.91%），高于语法变异（11.59%）；词法高源于 LLM 对有意义变量名的依赖，逻辑高源于代码复杂度上升；多数变异提高或保持准确率，仅 commutative reorder 与 constant unfolding 降低准确率。附加实验：55.08% 为正确性型不一致、44.05% 为错误性型、0.42% 为无效型；不一致主要由变异题而非原题引起；开源权重模型的不一致距离大于闭源模型（差 0.084）；提高置信度阈值可将不一致率由 8.03% 降至 1.89%（降幅 76%）；加权模型集成策略最优，将不一致率由 14.82% 降至 2.94%；二阶（双重）变异不一致率 25.17% 高于原子变异 19.36%。
AI.conclusion: MuCoCo 是首个自动评估 Code LLM 一致性属性的方法，结合语义保持变异与变形测试，提供 11 个覆盖词法/语法/逻辑的变异算子，无需人工干预且可施加于任意现有代码基准。实验表明：尽管模型准确率约 69%，代码不一致在 SOTA Code LLM 中普遍存在（约七分之一输入可暴露不一致），且词法重命名与逻辑改写是最有效的暴露手段。相对 Turbulence，MuCoCo 效率更高、覆盖更广并与之互补，凸显了对 Code LLM 进行一致性（而非仅正确性）自动化测试的必要性。局限：仅在 Python 上评估（语法变异依赖语言，其他语言的词法/逻辑变异可迁移）；不同基准可用的提示配置不一致（零样本/单样本），跨数据集比较可能部分反映提示差异；模型随机性无法完全消除（温度设为 0、GPT-5 采用 minimal 推理但 API 不支持温度设定）。

title: Syntax as a Rosetta Stone: Universal Dependencies for In-Context Coptic Translation
summary: Low-resource machine translation requires methods that differ from those used for high-resource languages. This paper proposes a novel in-context learning approach to support low-resource machine translation of the Coptic language to English, with syntactic augmentation from Universal Dependencies parses of input sentences. Building on existing work using bilingual dictionaries to support inference for vocabulary items, we add several representations of syntactic analyses to our inputs , specifically exploring the inclusion of raw parser outputs, verbalizations of parses in plain English, and targeted instructions of difficult constructions identified in sub-trees and how they can be translated. Our results show that while syntactic information alone is not as useful as dictionary-based glosses, combining retrieved dictionary items with syntactic information achieves significant gains across model sizes, achieving new state-of-the-art translation results for Coptic.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种用于科普特语（Coptic）到英语低资源机器翻译的新方法，通过上下文学习结合通用依赖关系的句法分析和双语词典条目。实验表明，单独使用句法信息的效果不如词典注释，但将词典检索项与句法信息结合可在不同模型规模下获得显著提升，实现科普特语翻译的最新最优结果。
AI.motivation: Low-resource machine translation of Coptic language requires different methods than high-resource languages, as traditional approaches may not be effective.
AI.method: Novel in-context learning approach using syntactic augmentation from Universal Dependencies parses, combining retrieved bilingual dictionary items with multiple syntactic representations (raw parser outputs, verbalized parses, targeted instructions for difficult constructions).
AI.result: While syntactic information alone is less useful than dictionary-based glosses, combining dictionary items with syntactic information achieves significant gains across model sizes.
AI.conclusion: Achieves new state-of-the-art translation results for Coptic language to English.

title: From Natural Language to Executable Narsese: A Neuro-Symbolic Benchmark and Pipeline for Reasoning with NARS
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are highly capable at language generation, but they remain unreliable when reasoning requires explicit symbolic structure, multi-step inference, and interpretable uncertainty. This paper presents a neuro-symbolic framework for translating natural-language reasoning problems into executable formal representations using first-order logic (FOL) and Narsese, the language of the Non-Axiomatic Reasoning System (NARS). To support this direction, we introduce NARS-Reasoning-v0.1, a benchmark of natural-language reasoning problems paired with FOL forms, executable Narsese programs, and three gold labels: True, False, and Uncertain. We develop a deterministic compilation pipeline from FOL to executable Narsese and validate retained examples through runtime execution in OpenNARS for Applications (ONA), ensuring that the symbolic targets are not only syntactically well formed but also behaviorally aligned with the intended answer. We further present Language-Structured Perception (LSP), a formulation in which an LLM is trained to produce reasoning-relevant symbolic structure rather than only a final verbal response. As an initial proof of concept, we also train and release a Phi-2 LoRA adapter on NARS-Reasoning-v0.1 for three-label reasoning classification, showing that the benchmark can support supervised adaptation in addition to executable evaluation. Overall, the paper positions executable symbolic generation and execution-based validation as a practical path toward more reliable neuro-symbolic reasoning systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种神经符号框架，将自然语言推理问题翻译为FOL和Narsese形式化表示，通过确定性编译管线与OpenNARS运行时验证确保语义正确性，并提出LSP范式训练LLM输出推理相关符号结构。引入NARS-Reasoning-v0.1benchmark并验证了Phi-2 LoRA微调的可行性，为可靠神经符号推理系统提供了实践路径。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在需要显式符号结构、多步推理和可解释不确定性的任务中仍不可靠，需探索将自然语言推理转化为可执行形式化表示的方法以提升推理可靠性
AI.method: 1. 设计神经符号框架，将自然语言推理翻译为FOL和Narsese形式化表示；2. 开发确定性编译管线（FOL → 可执行Narsese），通过OpenNARS运行时验证语义正确性；3. 提出LSP范式，训练LLM输出结构化符号而非仅文本答案；4. 发布NARS-Reasoning-v0.1基准数据集；5. 微调Phi-2 LoRA进行三标签分类实验
AI.result: 成功构建可执行符号生成与执行验证的神经符号推理框架；NARS-Reasoning-v0.1benchmark可支持监督微调与可执行评估两种评估模式；Phi-2 LoRA适配器在分类任务上验证了框架的可行性
AI.conclusion:
该研究将自然语言推理问题转化为可执行的形式化表示，并通过执行验证确保符号目标的Behavioral correctness，为构建更可靠的神经符号推理系统提供了一条可行路径。

• Benchmark（NARS-Reasoning-v0.1）：提供自然语言推理问题配套FOL形式化、Executable Narsese程序及True/False/Uncertain三类标签
• Pipeline：确定性编译流程（FOL → Narsese），通过OpenNARS运行时验证语义正确性
• 方法（LSP）：训练LLM生成推理相关符号结构，而非仅输出最终文本答案
• 实验：Phi-2 LoRA微调适配三标签分类任务，验证benchmark支持监督学习

title: Beyond Coefficients: Forecast-Necessity Testing for Interpretable Causal Discovery in Nonlinear Time-Series Models
summary:
Nonlinear machine-learning models are increasingly used to discover causal relationships in time-series data, yet the interpretation of their outputs remains poorly understood. In particular, causal scores produced by regularized neural autoregressive models are often treated as analogues of regression coefficients, leading to misleading claims of statistical significance.
  In this paper, we argue that causal relevance in nonlinear time-series models should be evaluated through forecast necessity rather than coefficient magnitude, and we present a practical evaluation procedure for doing so. We present an interpretable evaluation framework based on systematic edge ablation and forecast comparison, which tests whether a candidate causal relationship is required for accurate prediction. Using Neural Additive Vector Autoregression as a case study model, we apply this framework to a real-world case study of democratic development, modeled as a multivariate time series of panel data - democracy indicators across 139 countries. We show that relationships with similar causal scores can differ dramatically in their predictive necessity due to redundancy, temporal persistence, and regime-specific effects.
  Our results demonstrate how forecast-necessity testing supports more reliable causal reasoning in applied AI systems and provides practical guidance for interpreting nonlinear time-series models in high-stakes domains.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对非线性时间序列模型中因果推断的可解释性问题，提出因果相关性应通过"预测必要性"而非系数大小来评估，并设计了基于系统性边消融和预测比较的可解释评估框架，应用于139个国家民主发展的面板数据案例研究。
AI.motivation: Nonlinear machine-learning models are increasingly used to discover causal relationships in time-series data, but the interpretation of their outputs remains poorly understood. Causal scores from regularized neural autoregressive models are often treated as analogues of regression coefficients, leading to misleading claims of statistical significance.
AI.method: The authors propose an interpretable evaluation framework based on systematic edge ablation and forecast comparison, which tests whether a candidate causal relationship is required for accurate prediction. They use Neural Additive Vector Autoregression (NAVAR) as a case study model.
AI.result: Relationships with similar causal scores can differ dramatically in their predictive necessity due to redundancy, temporal persistence, and regime-specific effects.
AI.conclusion: Forecast necessity testing provides a more reliable approach for causal reasoning in applied AI systems and offers practical guidance for interpreting nonlinear time-series models in high-stakes domains.

title: Explicit Trait Inference for Multi-Agent Coordination
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) show promise on complex tasks but remain prone to coordination failures such as goal drift, error cascades, and misaligned behaviors. We propose Explicit Trait Inference (ETI), a psychologically grounded method for improving coordination. ETI enables agents to infer and track partner characteristics along two established psychological dimensions--warmth (e.g., trust) and competence (e.g., skill)--from interaction histories to guide decisions. We evaluate ETI in controlled settings (economic games), where it reduces payoff loss by 45-77%, and in more realistic, complex multi-agent settings (MultiAgentBench), where it improves performance by 3-29% depending on the scenario and model, relative to a CoT baseline. Additional analysis shows that gains are closely linked to trait inference: ETI profiles predict agents' actions, and informative profiles drive improvements. These results highlight ETI as a lightweight and robust mechanism for improving coordination in diverse multi-agent settings, and provide the first systematic evidence that LLM agents can (i) reliably infer others' traits from interaction histories and (ii) leverage structured awareness of others' traits for coordination.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ETI方法，通过推断追踪合作伙伴的热情和能力两个心理维度特征来改善LLM多智能体系统的协调能力。在博弈实验和复杂环境中均验证了其有效性，并首次系统证明LLM智能体能够可靠地从交互历史中推断他人特质并用于协调决策。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的多智能体系统（MAS）在复杂任务中表现有潜力，但容易出现协调失败，如目标漂移、错误级联和行为错位等问题。
AI.method: ETI通过从交互历史中推断和追踪合作伙伴的两个心理维度特征——热情（信任）和能力（技能），来指导决策。评估分别在受控环境（经济学博弈）和复杂多智能体环境（MultiAgentBench）中进行。
AI.result: 在经济学博弈中减少收益损失45-77%，在MultiAgentBench中提升性能3-29%。ETI特征能够预测智能体行为，且信息丰富的特征剖面推动了性能提升。
AI.conclusion: ETI作为一种轻量且鲁棒的机制，能够有效提升LLM多智能体系统的协调能力。首次系统性地证明LLM智能体能够从交互历史中可靠地推断他人特质，并能利用结构化的他人特质认知来改善协调效果。

title: LoopCTR: Unlocking the Loop Scaling Power for Click-Through Rate Prediction
summary: Scaling Transformer-based click-through rate (CTR) models by stacking more parameters brings growing computational and storage overhead, creating a widening gap between scaling ambitions and the stringent industrial deployment constraints. We propose LoopCTR, which introduces a loop scaling paradigm that increases training-time computation through recursive reuse of shared model layers, decoupling computation from parameter growth. LoopCTR adopts a sandwich architecture enhanced with Hyper-Connected Residuals and Mixture-of-Experts, and employs process supervision at every loop depth to encode multi-loop benefits into the shared parameters. This enables a train-multi-loop, infer-zero-loop strategy where a single forward pass without any loop already outperforms all baselines. Experiments on three public benchmarks and one industrial dataset demonstrate state-of-the-art performance. Oracle analysis further reveals 0.02--0.04 AUC of untapped headroom, with models trained with fewer loops exhibiting higher oracle ceilings, pointing to a promising frontier for adaptive inference.

AI.tldr: LoopCTR针对Transformer CTR模型扩展中算力与参数增长不匹配的问题，提出循环缩放范式，通过递归复用共享层增加训练算力。结合三明治架构、超连接残差和专家混合机制，并在每层深度进行过程监督，实现训练多循环、推理零循环的策略，在多个数据集上达到SOTA性能，同时揭示了自适应推理的潜力。
AI.motivation: 基于Transformer的点击率模型通过堆叠更多参数来扩展性能，导致计算和存储开销急剧增长，形成扩展雄心与工业部署约束之间的日益扩大的差距。
AI.method: 1) 循环缩放范式：通过递归复用共享模型层增加训练算力，而非增加参数量；2) 三明治架构结合超连接残差（Hyper-Connected Residuals）和专家混合（MoE）；3) 在每个循环深度引入过程监督，将多循环收益编码至共享参数；4) 采用"训练多循环、推理零循环"策略。
AI.result: 在三个公开基准测试和一个工业数据集上达到SOTA性能。Oracle分析显示存在0.02-0.04 AUC的未挖掘提升空间，训练时使用更少循环的模型展现出更高的oracle上限。
AI.conclusion: LoopCTR通过循环复用共享层实现了训练算力与参数规模的解耦，无需循环推理即可超越所有基线模型。三 benchmarks 和一工业数据集验证了SOTA性能。Oracle分析揭示了0.02-0.04 AUC的未挖掘潜力，更少循环训练的模型呈现更高oracle上限，为自适应推理开辟了有前景的方向。

title: A Simple Communication Scheme for Distributed Fast Multipole Methods
summary: We present a simple hierarchical communication scheme for distributed Fast Multipole Methods (FMMs) based on MPI neighborhood collectives and uniform trees. The method targets the common case of extending an existing high-performance shared-memory uniform-tree FMM implementation to distributed memory with minimal redesign while preserving any shared memory optimizations optimizations. Benchmarks on the ARCHER2 supercomputer demonstrate that our method can scale to very large problem sizes, we demonstrate weak-scaling up to 3.2e10 uniformly distributed points on 512 nodes of the machine in our largest runs. Our simplifications based on uniform trees result in worse asymptotic scaling for non-uniform points, however we still obtain practically useful runtimes due to the ability to retain our shared memory optimizations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于MPI邻域集合和均匀树的高性能分布式快速多极子方法(FMM)分层通信方案，能够在ARCHER2超算上扩展到512节点、320亿点规模。
AI.motivation: 将现有的高性能共享内存均匀树FMM实现扩展到分布式内存环境，同时保留共享内存优化，这是一个常见的工程需求。
AI.method: 采用MPI邻域集合和均匀树结构实现简单的分层通信方案，最小化对现有共享内存FMM代码的改造。
AI.result: 在ARCHER2超算上实现了良好的弱可扩展性，最大规模达512节点、320亿均匀分布点。
AI.conclusion: 基于均匀树的简化方案对非均匀点分布导致更差的渐近复杂度，但由于保留了共享内存优化，实际运行时间仍具实用性。

title: Model-Agnostic Meta Learning for Class Imbalance Adaptation
summary: Class imbalance is a widespread challenge in NLP tasks, significantly hindering robust performance across diverse domains and applications. We introduce Hardness-Aware Meta-Resample (HAMR), a unified framework that adaptively addresses both class imbalance and data difficulty. HAMR employs bi-level optimizations to dynamically estimate instance-level weights that prioritize genuinely challenging samples and minority classes, while a neighborhood-aware resampling mechanism amplifies training focus on hard examples and their semantically similar neighbors. We validate HAMR on six imbalanced datasets covering multiple tasks and spanning biomedical, disaster response, and sentiment domains. Experimental results show that HAMR achieves substantial improvements for minority classes and consistently outperforms strong baselines. Extensive ablation studies demonstrate that our proposed modules synergistically contribute to performance gains and highlight HAMR as a flexible and generalizable approach for class imbalance adaptation. Code is available at https://github.com/trust-nlp/ImbalanceLearning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HAMR（Hardness-Aware Meta-Resample），一种面向 NLP 类别不平衡的统一元学习框架。它通过双层优化动态估计样本级重要性权重（Adaptive Weight Estimation），并结合基于语义近邻的困难区域重采样（Hardness-Aware Region Resampling），在 6 个不平衡数据集（3 个 NER + 3 个分类）上以 DeBERTa-v3-base 为主干取得 0.7–7.1 个 Macro-F1 点的绝对提升，且在 ModernBERT、Qwen3、LLaMA3 等架构上均稳定优于强基线；消融实验表明两个模块具有互补作用，少数类性能显著改善而多数类性能不降。
AI.motivation: 类别不平衡在文本分类、NER 等 NLP 任务中普遍存在，会诱导模型偏向多数类，导致少数类（往往更关键）泛化能力差。已有方法主要集中在两大类：损失重加权（ICF、focal loss、Dice loss、EN 有效样本数）与数据层重采样/增广（过采样、合成数据、LNR 标签噪声再平衡），以及元重加权（GBC 在梯度空间聚类构造元集）。这些方法的共同缺陷是依赖预定义、静态的类别级启发式：整个训练过程使用固定调整率，并把同类样本视为同质。然而样本难度与类别归属并不对齐——并非所有少数类样本都难学，也并非所有多数类样本都容易；静态重加权可能压低信息丰富的多数类样本、过度强调简单的少数类样本。此外，现有元学习重加权只解决"如何加权"，未解决"采样什么"。因此需要一种能随模型对数据分布的理解演化而动态识别并优先处理"真正困难"样本（无论其属于哪个类别）的自适应方法。
AI.method: 整体框架由两个模块构成，通过"学什么权重"与"采什么样本"的解耦实现。1) Adaptive Weight Estimation (AWE)：定义任务特定的难度度量——token 级任务（NER）取句内最大 token 损失 ℓ̃_i = max_t ℓ_{i,t}，序列标注/分类任务取逐样本交叉熵；再做 batch 内 z-score 归一化得到 ℓ̂_i，送入轻量权重网络 f_θ 映射为重要性权重 w_i（重归一化到均值 1 并截断）。双层元优化：内层用 pre-meta 权重 w^pre 做一次中间参数更新 φ' = φ - α∇φ Σ w^pre ℓ̃；外层在平衡元验证集 D_meta（用完整验证集 + 从训练集按类补采样至验证集中位类规模构造）上以平均交叉熵为目标更新权重网络 θ（β 步长），随后用更新后的网络重算 post-meta 权重 w^post 完成真正的模型更新。2) Hardness-Aware Region Resampling：以 post-meta 权重的 EMA（平滑因子 γ）累积全局难度 h_i；每隔 F 个 epoch（如每 epoch）用 FAISS 索引在预计算的 bge-large-en-v1.5 句向量上做 KNN，取难度最高的前 N%（knn_ratio）样本为 hard set，统计每个样本作为 hard 样本近邻的命中次数得到 neighborhood boost b_i（归一化到 [0,1]），并按 p_i ∝ (h_i+ε)^τ · (1+λ b_i)（温度 τ<1 平滑）构造采样概率重塑训练分布。算法 1 给出统一的逐 epoch 训练流程。实现上以 HuggingFace Trainer 的自定义子类承载 WNet 元学习模块与 KNN 增强模块，AdamW + FP16 训练 8 epoch，所有超参在给定搜索空间内按验证集最优选取。
AI.result: 主结果（DeBERTa-v3-base，三次随机种子平均）：HAMR 在 6 个数据集上全面超越 Dice、Focal、ICF、EN、GBC、LNR 六个基线，Macro-F1 绝对提升 0.7–7.1 点，Micro-F1 提升 0.3–6.8 点；在最严重的 Cyclone-Idai19（IR=98.4）上 Macro-F1 65.7 vs LNR 63.4、GBC 62.8，Micro-F1 81.4 vs 78.8；BioNLP Macro-F1 72.7（次优 70.6）。消融：完整模型最优；去掉 AWE 在 BioNLP/TweetNER 上 Macro-F1 分别降 1.5/3.1 点；去掉重采样在 Idai19 降 4.2 点（65.7→61.5）、Irma17 降 1.6 点；仅去掉 KNN 传播影响较小（0.2–1.0 点），说明其为补充性精炼。少数类分析：按标签频率四分位分组，HAMR 在 Q1（最稀有 25%）上较 LNR 大幅领先（如 SST-5 +4.7 点），且 Q3/Q4 保持稳定或略升，说明增益并非以牺牲多数类为代价。邻域扩展验证：Hard∪Neighbors 的局部标签一致性在三个分类数据集上均高于 Hard Samples（如 Idai19 0.504→0.567），且随机采样显著更低，说明邻域扩展确实引入了语义更一致、标签更连贯的区域。跨骨干泛化：ModernBERT-base 上 HAMR 在 6 个数据集中 5 个取得最佳（BioNLP Macro-F1 68.8，比 GBC +1.9，比 LNR +5.4）；decoder-only（LoRA 微调 Qwen3-4B/8B、LLaMA3-8B）上全部设置优于 LNR，中位提升 NER 3.2 点、CLS 1.0 点，说明在 token 级严重不平衡的结构化预测任务上收益更大；同时观察到单向 decoder 在 NER 上明显弱于 encoder（BioNLP Macro-F1 低 30 点以上）。效率：每 epoch 仅做一次 KNN 检索，相对 GBC 在 BioNLP 上训练时间减少 47%（4012s vs 7603s）、峰值显存减少 68%（11.3GB vs 35.2GB），开销介于 GBC 与 LNR 之间。稳定性：多数数据集标准差 <1.0 点，危机类数据集波动较大（1.0–1.8 点）；超参敏感性分析显示 BioNLP 上对 hardness_alpha、knn_k、knn_ratio 均不敏感，Cyclone-Idai19 上推荐 knn_k≈10、hardness_alpha≈0.7、knn_ratio≈0.7。
AI.conclusion: HAMR 通过双层元学习动态调整样本重要性，并结合语义近邻级别的重采样，统一处理类别不平衡与实例难度，在多样任务与多架构上稳定有效，是长尾分布下兼顾少数类提升与多数类稳定的灵活方案。局限：双层优化与周期性邻域更新带来额外计算成本，向更大模型/语料扩展需进一步优化；重采样依赖预计算嵌入质量，语义表示不稳定或领域覆盖不足时性能可能下降；实验仅覆盖文本分类与 NER，对关系抽取、多模态等任务的泛化性有待验证。

title: How Adversarial Environments Mislead Agentic AI?
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2026
summary: Tool-integrated agents are deployed on the premise that external tools ground their outputs in reality. Yet this very reliance creates a critical attack surface. Current evaluations benchmark capability in benign settings, asking "can the agent use tools correctly" but never "what if the tools lie". We identify this Trust Gap: agents are evaluated for performance, not for skepticism. We formalize this vulnerability as Adversarial Environmental Injection (AEI), a threat model where adversaries compromise tool outputs to deceive agents. AEI constitutes environmental deception: constructing a "fake world" of poisoned search results and fabricated reference networks around unsuspecting agents. We operationalize this via POTEMKIN, a Model Context Protocol (MCP)-compatible harness for plug-and-play robustness testing. We identify two orthogonal attack surfaces: The Illusion (breadth attacks) poison retrieval to induce epistemic drift toward false beliefs, while The Maze (depth attacks) exploit structural traps to cause policy collapse into infinite loops. Across 11,000+ runs on five frontier agents, we find a stark robustness gap: resistance to one attack often increases vulnerability to the other, demonstrating that epistemic and navigational robustness are distinct capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出「Adversarial Environmental Injection（AEI，对抗性环境注入）」威胁模型与开源评测框架 POTEMKIN（MCP 兼容），指出工具增强型智能体的评测存在「信任缺口」：现有基准只测能力、不测怀疑能力。作者把攻击分为两个正交面——宽度攻击 The Illusion（污染检索内容导致认知漂移）与深度攻击 The Maze（注入幻影引用节点构成结构性陷阱导致策略崩溃/步数预算耗尽）。在 5 个前沿智能体、11,000+ 次运行（另加 5 个 2026 前沿模型验证）中发现「鲁棒性断裂（Robustness Schism）」：抗内容投毒能力几乎无法预测抗导航陷阱能力（跨维度迁移 AUC 仅 0.55–0.58，共享预测方差 <5%）；并发现「诚实惩罚（Punishment of Honesty）」：带不确定措辞的真命题被拒率是自信断言的 2.1 倍。
AI.motivation: 工具增强型 LLM 智能体被广泛部署的前提是"外部工具能把输出锚定到现实"，但这一依赖本身构成了攻击面：智能体默认接受工具返回的内容为事实（类比《楚门的世界》的"Truman Show Problem"）。现有评测（AgentBench、GAIA、ToolBench、WebArena、SWE-bench、ReportBench）都假设环境是合作性的、可信的，只问"智能体能否正确使用工具"，从不问"如果工具在撒谎会怎样"。既有安全研究多聚焦于提示注入、越狱与 RAG 语料投毒——这些是"内容型"攻击，只覆盖威胁面的一半；作者指出还存在一个正交维度：利用智能体的"导航/程序性信任"（reference-following）而非"信念更新"的**结构性攻击**。此外，RAG 防御研究（投毒防御）投入集中，而工具输出可被中间人篡改这一层完全缺乏标准化、可复现的对抗评测工具。作者还观察到现有防御集中在"相信工具"与"怀疑工具"之间的张力（Grounding Paradox）：降低幻觉的行为同时提高了对对抗环境的脆弱性。
AI.method:
**威胁模型形式化**：智能体 A: Q×E→R，E 为工具输出集合；对手为 Man-in-the-Tool（MitT，类比网络层的中间人），控制变换 τ: E→E'，使 A(q,τ(e))≠A(q,e)，但无法访问智能体内部状态/系统提示/权重。可行性依架构而异：第三方工具可被元数据发现者 > 接受用户投稿的 RAG > SEO 操纵的网页搜索 > 沙箱纯 API 部署。

**两类正交攻击面**：
1) 宽度攻击（The Illusion，认知层）：按 PoisonedRAG 式在知识库注入恶意文本，变量为污染率 ρ∈{10%,30%,50%} 与语言风格 Professor / Wire / Rumor（对应引用权威性梯度）；度量 Drift Rate（DR，条件于非弃答时的错误断言率，区别于 ASR，弃答不计为漂移）。
2) 深度攻击（The Maze，导航层）：向信息图注入幻影节点集合 P 形成环或死胡同，变量为环长 ℓ∈{2,3,5} 与似真度 Phantom / Signal / Glitch；度量 Entry Rate（ER，是否进入陷阱）与 Step-Budget Waste（BW，幻影节点步数占总遍历步数比）。

**POTEMKIN 框架**：作为透明 MitT 代理拦截工具调用响应并施加对抗变换，无需修改提示或插桩；提供 MCP Server 与 Python Library 双模式；用冻结快照消除在线 API 内容漂移，扰动按种子确定性执行。

**实验配置**：5 个受害智能体（GPT-4o-2024-08-06、Claude-3.5-Sonnet、Llama-3-70B、Qwen2.5-72B、DeepSeek-V3），温度 T=0，步数预算 10 次工具调用；开源模型统一 ReAct 脚手架，Llama-3 另测 Reflexion；对抗内容全部由 Gemini 2.5 Pro/Flash 作 Red Team 生成以避免生成者-受害者重叠。数据集：Potemkin-S2（Semantic Scholar 真实引用拓扑 9,878 篇真实论文 + 1,797 条真实引用链）、Potemkin-Phantoms（4,281 篇伪造论文，三档似真度）、Potemkin-Claims（AVeriTeC 150 条命题 + 450 个变体）。7 个实验/2 个战役：1a 污染率、1b 风格、1c 基线、1d 最小对（hedge vs booster，字符数 ±5% 匹配，McNemar 配对检验）、2a 环长、2b 似真度、2c 干净基线。**方法学**：报告 engagement indicator（是否真的调用工具），区分"条件脆弱性"与"无条件脆弱性"，低参与度智能体记为"未测"而非"鲁棒"；用 SHAP 做双维度平行特征归因，并用逻辑回归做跨维度迁移测试（Breadth→Depth、Depth→Breadth，Transfer AUC≈0.5 表示机制独立，>0.6 表示统一脆弱性）。选学术引用图作为主测试床的理由：拓扑稳定可复现（免受 link rot 与点击农场干扰）、且 LLM 幻觉引用在高风险领域已造成实际危害。
AI.result:
**宽度攻击（The Illusion）**：污染饱和很快——DR 从 10% 污染的 40.2% 跳到 30% 的 55.8%，50% 时仅 57.9%，说明攻击者无需控制语料主体。风格上反直觉地是中性风格最有效：Wire 54.8% > Professor 42.4% > Rumor 36.9%（智能体被训练成警惕明显的说服性内容，却不加批判地接受"中性事实"）。逐模型差异大：Claude-3.5 最强（21.5–40.7%），Qwen2.5-72B 最弱（56.9–71.4%），且低污染下已 71.1%，提示架构性差异。

**诚实惩罚（Exp 1d，最小对）**：带 hedge 的 TRUE 命题被拒率 14.5% vs 自信 TRUE 6.8%（约 2.1×），而对 FALSE 命题自信措辞毫无检测收益（43.1% vs 45.7%）。Llama-3、DeepSeek-V3 上 hedging 使真命题错误率上升 20 个百分点。攻击者只需给真命题加限定词即可抑制之。

**深度攻击（The Maze）**：进入率极高——Qwen2.5-72B 96.1%、GPT-4o 94.6%、DeepSeek-V3 74.7%、Claude-3.5 25.3%、Llama-3 5.6%（后者为"参与度缺口"假象）；一旦陷入，44–73% 的检索预算被幻影论文吃掉，且环长（2/3/5 跳）几乎不影响有效性。似真度梯度显示智能体具备一定鉴别力：Phantom 55.4% vs Glitch 26.4%（约 2×），Claude-3.5 判别最佳（相对下降 68.2%），GPT-4o 最平（45.8%，连明显异常陷阱也捕获 52.4%）。失败模式三分：Loop Trap / Dead-end / Authority Cascade（整体 0.9% / 30.6% / 27.0% / 逃脱 41.5%）。行为类型学：Claude=怀疑式逃脱（低循环 0.16）、GPT-4o/Qwen=自信接受、DeepSeek=激进遍历（循环 0.79，最高预算浪费 72.8%），说明陷阱深度由"引用跟随激进度"而非认知怀疑决定。

**参与度缺口与方法学纠偏**：Llama-3 仅 8/450（1.8%）满足参与标准，其中 7 次中招（条件脆弱性 87.5%），故其 5.6% 无条件进入率是能力失败而非安全；作者建议以条件脆弱性+参与率联合报告。Reflexion 脚手架把参与率提到 11.4%，条件进入率从 87.5% 降至 68.6%（-19pp）。

**鲁棒性断裂（核心发现）**：跨维度迁移 AUC Breadth→Depth = 0.55 [0.47,0.67]、Depth→Breadth = 0.58 [0.53,0.62]，近随机；SHAP 显示宽度由"认知特征"（hedge 密度、确定性标记、风格）主导，深度由"程序特征"（工具调用数、步数预算、循环检测）主导，共享预测方差 <5%。抗 RAG 投毒能力对导航陷阱几乎零保证。**前沿模型验证**（GPT-5.2、Claude Sonnet 4.6、DeepSeek-V3.2、Qwen3.5-397B-A17B、Kimi-K2.5）：平均 DR 从 58.4% 降至 42.5%（认知推理有进步），但平均陷阱进入率仍为 72.7%（几乎未变）；Claude Sonnet 4.6 漂移最低 26.3% 却仍 58% 中招，Qwen3.5 漂移 46.5% 却 99.0% 中招——断裂是当前智能体架构的结构性属性。

**防御探索（Exp 3）**：perplexity 过滤把宽度 ASR 从 41% 降到 22%（深度 ASR 归零），spotlighting 降到 14%，二者叠加 16%；但干净输入效用从 83% 跌至 48–58%（-25 至 -35pp）；perplexity 阈值 100 可把效用从 48% 恢复到 58%。无任何配置同时满足效用 >70% 且 ASR <20%，Pareto 前沿仍需改进。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心贡献是提出 AEI 这一以"环境欺骗"（而非指令劫持）为核心的威胁模型，并首次系统化研究深度/结构性攻击——它不需要智能体相信假信息，只要诱使它"做错事"（跟随链接陷入导航环、耗尽步数预算）。结论要点：(1) 鲁棒性断裂表明"认知鲁棒性"与"导航鲁棒性"是彼此独立的能力，需要分层防御而非单点加固；仅做 RAG 投毒加固的智能体仍暴露于结构性攻击；(2) The Maze 是全新攻击类，最高 96% 进入率、49–73% 预算浪费；(3) 诚实惩罚揭示智能体系统性误校准——惩罚科学不确定表述却不从自信语言获益，形成"只要加 hedge 即可压制真命题"的 perverse incentive；(4) 方法学建议：必须报告 engagement-conditional 脆弱性，把低参与智能体视为"未测"；(5) POTEMKIN 以 Apache 2.0 开源（含攻击配置、11,000+ 匿名执行日志、分析 notebook、冻结快照与哈希），可作部署前的鲁棒性检查工具，支持 YAML 自定义攻击与插件式后端（医疗知识库、金融 API 等）。局限：仅以学术引用图为主域（MitT 机制可推广至网页搜索、代码工具、数据库助手但尚未实证）；快照评测无法预测未来模型；防御分析仅属探索性（perplexity filtering、spotlighting），尚需检索溯源交叉验证、训练期干预、证据收集与信念更新模块分离等架构级方案，并计划与 AgentDojo、InjecAgent 集成以做跨范式基准比较。

title: Handling and Interpreting Missing Modalities in Patient Clinical Trajectories via Autoregressive Sequence Modeling
summary: An active challenge in developing multimodal machine learning (ML) models for healthcare is handling missing modalities during training and deployment. As clinical datasets are inherently temporal and sparse in terms of modality presence, capturing the underlying predictive signal via diagnostic multimodal ML models while retaining model explainability remains an ongoing challenge. In this work, we address this by re-framing clinical diagnosis as an autoregressive sequence modeling task, utilizing causal decoders from large language models (LLMs) to model a patient's multimodal trajectory. We first introduce a missingness-aware contrastive pre-training objective that integrates multiple modalities in datasets with missingness in a shared latent space. We then show that autoregressive sequence modeling with transformer-based architectures outperforms baselines on the MIMIC-IV and eICU fine-tuning benchmarks. Finally, we use interpretability techniques to move beyond performance boosts and find that across various patient stays, removing modalities leads to divergent behavior that our contrastive pre-training mitigates. By abstracting clinical diagnosis as sequence modeling and interpreting patient stay trajectories, we develop a framework to profile and handle missing modalities while addressing the canonical desideratum of safe, transparent clinical AI.

AI.tldr: 本文针对医疗多模态学习中的缺失模态问题，提出将临床诊断重塑为自回归序列建模任务，利用LLM因果解码器和缺失感知对比预训练整合多模态数据，在MIMIC-IV和eICU数据集上验证了方法有效性，并通过可解释性分析证明了对比预训练对缓解模态缺失影响的积极作用。
AI.motivation: 医疗多模态机器学习面临训练和部署中处理缺失模态的核心挑战；临床数据集本质上是时序的且模态存在稀疏；需要在捕获预测信号的同时保持模型可解释性。
AI.method: 采用因果解码器的大语言模型(LLM)将临床诊断重塑为自回归序列建模任务；引入缺失感知对比预训练目标，在共享潜在空间中整合具有缺失性的多模态数据；使用基于Transformer的架构进行建模。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-IV和eICU微调基准测试中，自回归序列建模优于基线方法；可解释性分析表明移除模态会导致不同行为，而对比预训练能够缓解这一问题。
AI.conclusion: 通过将临床诊断抽象为序列建模，并解释患者住院轨迹，开发了一个能够分析和处理缺失模态的框架，同时满足了安全、透明临床AI的核心需求。

title: Large Language Models Exhibit Normative Conformity
summary: The conformity bias exhibited by large language models (LLMs) can pose a significant challenge to decision-making in LLM-based multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS). While many prior studies have treated "conformity" simply as a matter of opinion change, this study introduces the social psychological distinction between informational conformity and normative conformity in order to understand LLM conformity at the mechanism level. Specifically, we design new tasks to distinguish between informational conformity, in which participants in a discussion are motivated to make accurate judgments, and normative conformity, in which participants are motivated to avoid conflict or gain acceptance within a group. We then conduct experiments based on these task settings. The experimental results show that, among the six LLMs evaluated, up to five exhibited tendencies toward not only informational conformity but also normative conformity. Furthermore, intriguingly, we demonstrate that by manipulating subtle aspects of the social context, it may be possible to control the target toward which a particular LLM directs its normative conformity. These findings suggest that decision-making in LLM-MAS may be vulnerable to manipulation by a small number of malicious users. In addition, through analysis of internal vectors associated with informational and normative conformity, we suggest that although both behaviors appear externally as the same form of "conformity," they may in fact be driven by distinct internal mechanisms. Taken together, these results may serve as an initial milestone toward understanding how "norms" are implemented in LLMs and how they influence group dynamics.

AI.tldr: 该研究从社会心理学视角将LLM的conformity区分为信息性conformity和规范性conformity两类机制，通过设计区分性实验任务，发现6个LLM中有5个同时表现出两类conformity倾向，且可通过操控社会情境微妙因素控制规范性conformity的目标指向，揭示LLM conformit可能存在内部机制差异，为理解LLM中"规范"的实现及其对群体 dynamics的影响提供基础。
AI.motivation: LLM-MAS中的conformity bias对决策构成重大挑战，但此前研究仅将conformity视为意见改变的简单现象，缺乏对underlying mechanism的深入理解，亟需从社会心理学角度进行机制层面的分析。
AI.method: 设计能够区分信息性conformity（追求准确判断）和规范性conformity（避免冲突或获得接纳）的新任务；基于这些任务设置对6个LLM进行实验；通过操控社会情境的微妙方面观察conformity目标的变化；分析信息性和规范性conformity相关的内部向量。
AI.result: 6个LLM中多达5个同时表现出信息性和规范性conformity倾向；通过操控社会情境的微妙因素可以控制特定LLM规范性conformity的目标指向；尽管两种conformity行为外在表现形式相同，但可能由不同的内部机制驱动。
AI.conclusion: LLM-MAS的decision-making容易被少量恶意用户操控；"规范"在LLM中的实现方式及其对群体dynamics的影响值得进一步研究；该成果为理解LLM中norms的实现奠定了初步基础。

title: Diagnosable ColBERT: Debugging Late-Interaction Retrieval Models Using a Learned Latent Space as Reference
summary: Reliable biomedical and clinical retrieval requires more than strong ranking performance: it requires a practical way to find systematic model failures and curate the training evidence needed to correct them. Late-interaction models such as ColBERT provide a first solution thanks to the interpretable token-level interaction scores they expose between document and query tokens. Yet this interpretability is shallow: it explains a particular document--query pairwise score, but does not reveal whether the model has learned a clinical concept in a stable, reusable, and context-sensitive way across diverse expressions. As a result, these scores provide limited support for diagnosing misunderstandings, identifying irreasonably distant biomedical concepts, or deciding what additional data or feedback is needed to address this. In this short position paper, we propose Diagnosable ColBERT, a framework that aligns ColBERT token embeddings to a reference latent space grounded in clinical knowledge and expert-provided conceptual similarity constraints. This alignment turns document encodings into inspectable evidence of what the model appears to understand, enabling more direct error diagnosis and more principled data curation without relying on large batteries of diagnostic queries.

AI.tldr: 本立场论文指出当前生物医学检索系统中late-interaction模型的可解释性不足，提出Diagnosable ColBERT框架，通过将token嵌入对齐到临床知识参考空间，实现模型理解的可检验性诊断，从而支持更直接的错误诊断和更有原则的数据整理工作。
AI.motivation: 现有Late-interaction模型（如ColBERT）的可解释性较浅，仅能解释特定文档-查询对的得分，无法揭示模型是否以稳定、可复用、上下文敏感的方式学习了临床概念。这导致难以诊断误解、识别不合理的远程生物医学概念，或决定需要何种额外数据或反馈来解决问题。
AI.method: 提出Diagnosable ColBERT框架，将ColBERT token嵌入对齐到由临床知识和专家提供的概念相似性约束所支撑的参考潜在空间。
AI.result: 对齐后的文档编码可转化为可检验的证据，用于了解模型的认知状态。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过将文档编码转化为可检验的模型理解证据，实现更直接的错误诊断和更有原则的数据整理，且无需依赖大量诊断查询。

title: POLAR-PIC: A Holistic Framework for Matrixized PIC with Co-Designed Compute, Layout, and Communication
summary: Particle-in-Cell (PIC) simulations are fundamental to plasma physics but often suffer from limited scalability due to particle-grid interaction bottlenecks and particle redistribution costs. Specifically, the particle-grid interaction computations have not taken full advantage of the emerging Matrix Processing Units (MPUs), the particle motion introduces irregular memory accesses, and the bulk-synchronous redistribution further destroys long-term data locality thereby limiting parallel efficiency. To address these inefficiencies, we present POLAR-PIC, a co-designed framework for large-scale PIC simulations that (i) reformulates Field Interpolation into an MPU-friendly outer-product form, (ii) maintains a physically ordered particle layout to preserve memory contiguity, and (iii) overlaps particle communication with Deposition to hide redistribution overhead. The evaluation on the pilot system of an Exascale supercomputer demonstrates that POLAR-PIC accelerates the entire particle-processing phase by up to 10.9x in uniform plasma and 4.4x in real-world laser-ion acceleration scenarios compared to the native WarpX reference pipeline on LX2. Ablation studies reveal that the speedups achieved by Interpolation and Deposition are 8.0x and 13.2x, respectively, and the asynchronous communication design sustains a 99.1% overlap ratio. In cross-platform comparisons, POLAR-PIC achieves 13.2% of theoretical peak efficiency on the CPU-based LS system, while WarpX reaches 9.6% on NVIDIA A800 GPUs. Notably, the scalability evaluation demonstrates that POLAR-PIC maintains 67.5% weak scaling efficiency on over 2 million cores under high-migration dynamic workloads, highlighting the importance of holistic co-design for future matrix-centric HPC systems.

AI.tldr: POLAR-PIC是一个针对大规模粒子网格(PIC)模拟的协同设计框架，通过将场插值重构为矩阵处理单元友好的外积形式、维护物理有序的粒子布局以保持内存连续性、以及将粒子通信与沉积过程重叠执行，显著提升了PIC模拟的可扩展性和性能。在百亿亿次超级计算机试点系统上的评估表明，该框架在统一等离子体场景中实现了最高10.9倍加速，在激光离子加速实际场景中实现4.4倍加速，且在超过200万核心的高迁移动态工作负载下维持67.5%的弱扩展效率。
AI.motivation: 粒子网格(PIC)模拟是等离子体物理的基础工具，但受限于可扩展性瓶颈：(1)粒子-网格交互计算的矩阵处理单元(MPU)潜力未充分挖掘；(2)粒子运动的内存访问模式不规则；(3)同步重分布机制破坏了长期数据局部性，降低并行效率。
AI.method: (1)将场插值重构为MPU友好的外积形式；(2)维护物理有序的粒子布局以保持内存连续性；(3)设计异步通信机制，使粒子通信与沉积过程重叠执行以隐藏重分布开销。
AI.result: 在百亿亿次超级计算机试点系统评估中，统一等离子体场景加速10.9倍，激光离子加速场景加速4.4倍；消融实验显示插值加速8.0倍、沉积加速13.2倍，异步通信设计实现99.1%的重叠率；跨平台对比中，POLAR-PIC在CPU系统LS上达到理论峰值效率的13.2%，而WarpX在NVIDIA A800 GPU上为9.6%；弱扩展测试中在200万+核心下维持67.5%的效率。
AI.conclusion: 协同设计方法对于未来以矩阵为中心的高性能计算系统至关重要。POLAR-PIC通过硬件-算法协同优化，有效解决了PIC模拟中的可扩展性瓶颈，为大规模等离子体模拟提供了高效的计算框架。

title: Cascaded Code Editing: Large-Small Model Collaboration for Effective and Efficient Code Editing
comment: This paper is accepted in FSE 2026
summary: Code editing constitutes a fundamental practice in software development, wherein developers modify existing codebases according to natural language requirements. Accurate code editing necessitates a comprehensive understanding of both the existing codebase and the modification requirements. Although large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated promising performance in code editing tasks, they suffer from substantial inefficiency by generating entire modified files that largely consist of unchanged code. While smaller models could potentially address this inefficiency, they typically lack the capacity to effectively comprehend long code contexts required for accurate editing. To ensure both effectiveness and efficiency, we propose to decompose code editing into a two-stage cascade: \textbf{edit sketch generation}, wherein a large model first produces concise sketches representing the requisite modifications (the more challenging phase), and \textbf{edit sketch application}, wherein a smaller model integrates these sketches into the original code to produce the final output edited code (the simpler phase). This cascaded design reduces the number of tokens generated by the large model, as the majority of the output is handled by the smaller, more efficient model, thereby enhancing overall efficiency. However, the effectiveness of this approach is constrained by current small models' limited capabilities in handling long-context scenarios and cross-file dependencies, which are essential for accurate sketch application in real-world codebases. To address these limitations and enhance smaller models' sketch application capabilities, ...

AI.tldr: 本文（FSE 2026, PACMSE）提出“级联代码编辑”框架：把代码编辑拆成两阶段——大模型生成精简的“编辑草图（edit sketch）”，小模型负责把草图合并回原代码。为补齐小模型在长上下文与跨文件合并上的短板，作者构建了首个大规模草图应用数据集（118,280 条训练实例、827.4M tokens、1,981 条人工校验评测集），并提出渐进式训练策略 CLC SFT 与 G-CLC SFT。实验表明该方案在 Aider/CanItEdit 上可比甚至超过大模型直接编辑，同时显著降低时间与成本（如 DeepSeek-R1 草图 + 微调 Qwen2.5-Coder-14B 应用：Pass@2 提升 11.1%，时间 −13%、成本 −19%）。
AI.motivation: 代码编辑（依据自然语言指令修改已有代码）是软件维护的核心环节，占开发工作量的 60–80%。现有 LLM 直接编辑范式存在“有效性—效率”两难：(1) 现代代码库结构复杂、文件动辄数千 token 且存在跨文件依赖，必须依赖 DeepSeek-V3/R1、Claude-4 等大模型；但大模型需重新生成整个修改后的文件，而实证显示软件更新中平均仅约 15% 的代码被改动，剩余绝大部分是冗余复制，造成高成本与高延迟（实测 DeepSeek-R1 在 Aider 基准上单请求平均超过 7 分钟，整套跑完 27.31 小时、$6.54，输出 2.6M tokens）。(2) 小模型虽然高效（如 Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B 达 754 token/s），但缺乏长上下文理解与跨文件依赖处理能力，编辑质量不足（0.5B–14B 在 Aider 上 Pass@2 仅 0.9–8.9，远低于 DS-R1 的 67.6）。因此需要一个既保留大模型推理能力、又把小模型的机械性集成负担接过去的分工方案，同时必须专门增强小模型的“草图应用”能力。
AI.method:
【框架】级联代码编辑 = 编辑草图生成（大模型：给定原文件 O 与指令 I，输出仅含目标改动的精简代码片段草图 S）+ 草图应用（小模型：把 S 合并入 O，输出最终文件 F）。

【数据构建】从 105 个开源 GitHub 仓库（12 种语言、MIT/Apache2.0 许可、star>1k）收集 342,883 次提交与约 130 万源文件。两条流水线产出 (O, S, F) 三元组：① 提交数据——用 git diff 抽取 ≥10 处修改块的 diff 作为草图，经规则过滤（整文件增删、纯格式化/注释改动）、DeepSeek-V3 辅助质量校验、simhash 去重（相似度>60%）、AI 一致性校验（模拟应用后与提交结果比对），得 73,762 条；② 合成数据——由 DeepSeek-R1 分析文件并生成草图与应用后代码，再经规则过滤、DeepSeek-V3 审查、simhash 跨流水线去重，得 44,518 条。评测集用独立仓库构建 2,168 条，经两位作者独立人工评估与交叉确认后保留 1,981 条。

【训练策略】(1) CLC SFT：按原代码长度以 4,096 token 为界划分短/长上下文，Stage1 用 8,192 截断窗口训练短上下文，Stage2 合并真实长上下文样本与随机拼接短样本构造的多文件实例、用 16,384 窗口训练；(2) G-CLC SFT：在上述两个阶段以 1:1 混入 OpenCoder SFT 通用域数据以增强域外泛化。训练采用全参微调、DeepSpeed ZeRO-3（7B/14B 长上下文开启 CPU offload）、Flash Attention、梯度检查点，8×H20；大模型用 SGLang 16×H20 部署，小模型用单卡 vLLM。

【实验设置】大模型：DeepSeek-V3、DeepSeek-R1（亦作为直接编辑基线）；小模型：Qwen2.5-Coder 0.5B/1.5B/3B/7B/14B；基准：Aider Polyglot（225 题）与 CanItEdit（210 题，lazy/descriptive 两种指令），另加自建草图应用基准；指标：Pass@1/Pass@2、CodeBLEU、Fuzzy Match、Exact Match、Over-Edit/Under-Edit Rate、token 数、墙钟时间、API 成本；4 个 RQ 分别考察级联 vs 直接编辑、训练策略消融、对级联性能的影响、跨 LLM 泛化。
AI.result: 1) 效率：Aider 上 DS-V3 草图阶段 token 由 357.1K 降至约 221K（−38%），CanItEdit 上 −56%；尽管总 token 略增（因小模型需输出完整文件），小模型吞吐率高使总时间反而下降（如 DS-R1 直接 27.31h→23.80h，−13%；成本 $6.54→$5.32，−19%）。2) 效果：DS-V3 + 微调 QC-14B 得 Pass@1/2 = 29.8/54.2，接近 DS-V3 直接的 29.3/56.0；DS-R1 + 微调 QC-14B 达 39.1/75.1，Pass@2 较 DS-R1 直接提升 11.1%，超过官方榜单上的 Gemini-2.5-Pro 与 Claude-4-Opus；CanItEdit 上级联同样持平或优于直接编辑。3) 草图应用基准：微调使 CodeBLEU/Fuzzy Match/Exact Match 分别提升 0.3–12%、5.5–296%、6.9–302%；CLC SFT 进一步提升长文本鲁棒性（14B 从 1K→4K 的 FM/EM 衰减由 39%/52% 降至 8.2%/23.3%）；G-CLC SFT 在专用基准上略降 1–4%，但下游级联编辑更优。4) 消融：在 Aider（DS-V3 草图）上 SFT/CLC/G-CLC 平均 Pass@2 提升 29.7%/44.9%/60.6%；CanItEdit 上为 25.7%/33.2%/39.7%；G-CLC 较 CLC 再提升约 6.5–6.6%。5) 泛化：Qwen3-235B、Qwen3-Coder-480B、GPT-OSS-120B 作为草图模型时，微调 QC-14B 后平均 Pass@1/Pass@2 相对直接编辑提升 19.7%/5.4%；QC-14B 自身 Pass@2 由 8.9→13.3，Qwen3-Coder-30B 由 27.1→30.2。6) 机制分析：级联编辑的 Over-Edit Rate 25.6%（S&R 直接编辑 40.1%）、Under-Edit 8.3%（10.5%）、生成准确率 92.8%（87.5%），Stage-2 应用 over/under-edit 仅 5.2%/2.1%；直接编辑中 search&replace 与 whole-file 相当，unified diff 最差（token 最多），原因是定位需输出 [Old Code] 锚点导致“Context Tax”。7) 草图加入自然语言描述会显著增加 token（+94.9%）与时间（+65.2%），仅对未微调的 0.5B–3B 有正收益，对已训练模型几乎无影响，说明微调降低了模型对草图 NL 说明的依赖。
AI.conclusion: 级联代码编辑通过“高层编辑规划（大模型）+ 低层机械合并（小模型）”的分工，同时缓解了 LLM 代码编辑的有效性—效率矛盾：它把大模型从冗余重写整文件的负担中解放出来，又通过专用数据与课程式微调把小模型打造成高保真的草图应用器，使组合方案在精度上可比甚至超越大模型直接编辑，并降低时间与成本，为 AI-IDE 中的高效代码编辑提供了新范式。局限在于实验仅覆盖 DeepSeek 与 Qwen2.5-Coder 系列及两个基准，成本/时间测量易受硬件与网络影响，多文件场景的构造方式（随机拼接短样本）较为理想化，且后续仍需在更多模型、更多真实仓库与更复杂的跨文件依赖任务上验证。作者已开源数据与代码（github.com/adf1178/cascaded_code_editing）。

title: An Empirical Study of Multi-Generation Sampling for Jailbreak Detection in Large Language Models
summary: Detecting jailbreak behaviour in large language models remains challenging, particularly when strongly aligned models produce harmful outputs only rarely. In this work, we present an empirical study of output based jailbreak detection under realistic conditions using the JailbreakBench Behaviors dataset and multiple generator models with varying alignment strengths. We evaluate both a lexical TF-IDF detector and a generation inconsistency based detector across different sampling budgets. Our results show that single output evaluation systematically underestimates jailbreak vulnerability, as increasing the number of sampled generations reveals additional harmful behaviour. The most significant improvements occur when moving from a single generation to moderate sampling, while larger sampling budgets yield diminishing returns. Cross generator experiments demonstrate that detection signals partially generalise across models, with stronger transfer observed within related model families. A category level analysis further reveals that lexical detectors capture a mixture of behavioural signals and topic specific cues, rather than purely harmful behaviour. Overall, our findings suggest that moderate multi sample auditing provides a more reliable and practical approach for estimating model vulnerability and improving jailbreak detection in large language models. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过实验表明，在评估语言模型越狱脆弱性时，适度多次采样审计比单次输出评估更可靠，并揭示了检测信号在不同模型间的泛化能力以及词法检测器同时捕捉行为和主题特征的现象。
AI.motivation: 强对齐的大型语言模型仅在少数情况下产生有害输出，使得基于输出的越狱检测面临重大挑战。
AI.method: 使用JailbreakBench Behaviors数据集，在不同对齐强度的多个生成模型上，评估了词法TF-IDF检测器和基于生成不一致性的检测器，并在不同采样预算下进行测试。
AI.result: 1）单一输出评估系统性地低估了模型的越狱脆弱性，增加采样数量可揭示更多有害行为；2）从单次生成到适度采样时改进最显著，更大采样预算收益递减；3）检测信号在不同模型间部分泛化，且在同一模型家族内迁移效果更强；4）词法检测器不仅捕捉行为信号，还包含主题特定线索，而非纯粹的有害行为特征。
AI.conclusion: moderate multi-sample auditing provides a more reliable and practical approach for estimating model vulnerability and improving jailbreak detection in LLMs.

title: Formally Verified Patent Analysis via Dependent Type Theory: Machine-Checkable Certificates from a Hybrid AI + Lean 4 Pipeline
summary: We present a formally verified framework for patent analysis as a hybrid AI + Lean 4 pipeline. The DAG-coverage core (Algorithm 1b) is fully machine-verified once bounded match scores are fixed. Freedom-to-operate, claim-construction sensitivity, cross-claim consistency, and doctrine-of-equivalents analyses are formalized at the specification level with kernel-checked candidate certificates. Existing patent-analysis approaches rely on manual expert analysis (slow, non-scalable) or ML/NLP methods (probabilistic, opaque, non-compositional). To our knowledge, this is the first framework that applies interactive theorem proving based on dependent type theory to intellectual property analysis. Claims are encoded as DAGs in Lean 4, match strengths as elements of a verified complete lattice, and confidence scores propagate through dependencies via proven-correct monotone functions. We formalize five IP use cases (patent-to-product mapping, freedom-to-operate, claim construction sensitivity, cross-claim consistency, doctrine of equivalents) via six algorithms. Structural lemmas, the coverage-core generator, and the closed-path identity coverage = W_cov are machine-verified in Lean 4. Higher-level theorems for the other use cases remain informal proof sketches, and their proof-generation functions are architecturally mitigated (untrusted generators whose outputs are kernel-checked and sorry-free axiom-audited). Guarantees are conditional on the ML layer: they certify mathematical correctness of computations downstream of ML scores, not the accuracy of the scores themselves. A case study on a synthetic memory-module claim demonstrates weighted coverage and construction-sensitivity analysis. Validation against adjudicated cases is future work.

AI.tldr: 提出首个基于Lean 4依赖类型理论的专利分析形式化验证框架，将专利权利要求编码为DAG，通过经验证的完备格和monotone函数传播置信度。核心算法完全机器验证，高层定理采用kernel-checked架构防护。数学正确性保证限于ML分数下游计算，不保证分数准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有专利分析方法存在根本缺陷：手工专家分析速度慢、不可扩展；ML/NLP方法概率性强、不透明、不可组合。缺乏将交互式定理证明（基于依赖类型理论）应用于知识产权分析的先例。
AI.method: (1) 将专利权利要求编码为Lean 4中的DAG结构；(2) 匹配强度建模为经数学证明的完备格元素；(3) 置信度通过已证 monotone 函数沿依赖关系传播；(4) 使用kernel-checked候选证书进行规格级形式化；(5) 构建coverage-core生成器并证明closed-path恒等式 coverage = W_cov；(6) 采用架构缓解策略处理高层定理：生成器不可信但输出经kernel检查且无sorry标注。
AI.result: 完成了：(1) Algorithm 1b的DAG-coverage核心在固定边界匹配分数下完全机器验证；(2) 在规格级别形式化了5种IP用例（专利-产品映射、自由实施、权利要求构造敏感性、跨权利要求一致性、等同原则）；(3) 证明了结构引理和closed-path恒等式coverage = W_cov；(4) 对合成存储模块权利要求进行了加权覆盖和构造敏感性分析的案例研究。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在形式化验证IP分析方面具有创新意义，但存在两个关键局限：(1)高层定理仍为非形式化草图，仅靠kernel-checked机制防护；(2)数学正确性保证仅适用于ML分数下游计算，不保证分数本身的准确性。验证依赖于trusted auditors和sorry-free审计架构。未来需对已判决案例进行验证。

title: Towards Understanding the Robustness of Sparse Autoencoders
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to optimization-based jailbreak attacks that exploit internal gradient structure. While Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) are widely used for interpretability, their robustness implications remain underexplored. We present a study of integrating pretrained SAEs into transformer residual streams at inference time, without modifying model weights or blocking gradients. Across four model families (Gemma, LLaMA, Mistral, Qwen) and two strong white-box attacks (GCG, BEAST) plus three black-box benchmarks, SAE-augmented models achieve up to a 5x reduction in jailbreak success rate relative to the undefended baseline and reduce cross-model attack transferability. Parametric ablations reveal (i) a monotonic dose-response relationship between L0 sparsity and attack success rate, and (ii) a layer-dependent defense-utility tradeoff, where intermediate layers balance robustness and clean performance. These findings are consistent with a representational bottleneck hypothesis: sparse projection reshapes the optimization geometry exploited by jailbreak attacks.

AI.tldr: 通过在Transformer残差流中集成预训练稀疏自编码器(SAE)，可以在不修改模型权重或阻断梯度的情况下，将LLM的越狱攻击成功率降低至多5倍。该防御机制在多种模型和攻击场景下有效，其作用机制可能源于SAE引入的表示瓶颈重塑了越狱攻击所利用的优化几何结构。
AI.motivation: LLMs remain vulnerable to optimization-based jailbreak attacks exploiting internal gradient structure, and while SAEs are widely used for interpretability, their robustness implications remain underexplored.
AI.method: Pretrained Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) were integrated into transformer residual streams at inference time across four model families (Gemma, LLaMA, Mistral, Qwen), evaluated against two white-box attacks (GCG, BEAST) and three black-box benchmarks, with parametric ablations examining L0 sparsity levels and layer-specific effects.
AI.result: SAE-augmented models achieve up to 5x reduction in jailbreak success rate relative to undefended baseline, reduce cross-model attack transferability, and exhibit monotonic dose-response relationship between L0 sparsity and attack success, with intermediate layers providing optimal balance between robustness and clean performance.
AI.conclusion: SAE integration reshapes optimization geometry exploited by jailbreak attacks, providing a novel, non-invasive defense mechanism that preserves model utility while significantly enhancing robustness against both white-box and black-box attacks.

title: Integrating Anomaly Detection into Agentic AI for Proactive Risk Management in Human Activity
summary: Agentic AI, with goal-directed, proactive, and autonomous decision-making capabilities, offers a compelling opportunity to address movement-related risks in human activity, including the persistent hazard of falls among elderly populations. Despite numerous approaches to fall mitigation through fall prediction and detection, existing systems have not yet functioned as universal solutions across care pathways and safety-critical environments. This is largely due to limitations in consistently handling real-world complexity, particularly poor context awareness, high false alarm rates, environmental noise, and data scarcity. We argue that fall detection and fall prediction can usefully be formulated as anomaly detection problems and more effectively addressed through an agentic AI system. More broadly, this perspective enables the early identification of subtle deviations in movement patterns associated with increased risk, whether arising from age-related decline, fatigue, or environmental factors. While technical requirements for immediate deployment are beyond the scope of this paper, we propose a conceptual framework that highlights potential value. This framework promotes a well-orchestrated approach to risk management by dynamically selecting relevant tools and integrating them into adaptive decision-making workflows, rather than relying on static configurations tailored to narrowly defined scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将跌倒检测与预测重新定义为异常检测问题，并通过智能体AI系统进行处理的理论框架。旨在克服现有系统在上下文感知、误报率、环境噪声和数据稀缺等方面的局限性，实现对老年人口跌倒风险的动态管理。
AI.motivation: 当前跌倒缓解系统尚未成为跨护理路径和安全关键环境的通用解决方案，主要受限于：上下文感知能力差、误报率高、环境噪声敏感以及数据稀缺等问题。
AI.method: 将跌倒检测与预测重新表述为异常检测问题，提出基于智能体AI的概念框架，通过动态选择相关工具并将其整合到自适应决策工作流中，而非依赖针对狭窄场景定制的静态配置。
AI.result: 该框架能够早期识别运动模式中的细微偏差，这些偏差可能源于年龄相关功能下降、疲劳或环境因素，从而实现更有效的风险预警与管理。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一个概念框架以凸显潜在价值，但技术实现的详细要求不在本文范围内。未来需进一步探索智能体AI在运动相关风险管理和跌倒预防中的实际应用。

title: From Top-1 to Top-K: A Reproducibility Study and Benchmarking of Counterfactual Explanations for Recommender Systems
summary: Counterfactual explanations (CEs) provide an intuitive way to understand recommender systems by identifying minimal modifications to user-item interactions that alter recommendation outcomes. Existing CE methods for recommender systems, however, have been evaluated under heterogeneous protocols, using different datasets, recommenders, metrics, and even explanation formats, which hampers reproducibility and fair comparison.
