Our paper systematically reproduces, re-implement, and re-evaluate eleven state-of-the-art CE methods for recommender systems, covering both native explainers (e.g., LIME-RS, SHAP, PRINCE, ACCENT, LXR, GREASE) and specific graph-based explainers originally proposed for GNNs. Here, a unified benchmarking framework is proposed to assess explainers along three dimensions: explanation format (implicit vs. explicit), evaluation level (item-level vs. list-level), and perturbation scope (user interaction vectors vs. user-item interaction graphs). Our evaluation protocol includes effectiveness, sparsity, and computational complexity metrics, and extends existing item-level assessments to top-K list-level explanations. Through extensive experiments on three real-world datasets and six representative recommender models, we analyze how well previously reported strengths of CE methods generalize across diverse setups. We observe that the trade-off between effectiveness and sparsity depends strongly on the specific method and evaluation setting, particularly under the explicit format; in addition, explainer performance remains largely consistent across item level and list level evaluations, and several graph-based explainers exhibit notable scalability limitations on large recommender graphs. Our results refine and challenge earlier conclusions about the robustness and practicality of CE generation methods in recommender systems: https://github.com/L2R-UET/CFExpRec.

AI.tldr: 本文针对推荐系统中的反事实解释（CE）方法缺乏统一评测协议、结果难以复现与公平比较的问题，系统复现并重新实现了11种SOTA反事实解释方法（含LIME-RS、SHAP、PRINCE、ACCENT、LXR、GREASE等推荐原生方法，以及CF-GNNExplainer、CF²、CLEAR、UNR-Explainer、C2Explainer等5个原为GNN节点/图分类设计的图解释器），提出覆盖"解释格式—评测层级—扰动范围"三维度的统一基准框架，并首次将CE有效性评估从item-level扩展到list-level（整个top-K列表）。在3个真实数据集（Amazon Fashion、ML1M、Yahoo）与6个推荐模型（MF、VAE、DiffRec、LightGCN、GFormer、SimGCL）上的实验表明：显式格式下有效性与稀疏性存在显著权衡且依赖具体方法与设置；item-level与list-level结果大体一致；部分图解释器在大规模推荐图上存在明显可扩展性瓶颈（内存溢出与高延迟）。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统中的反事实解释通过回答"若用户行为发生最小改变，推荐结果会如何变化"来提升信任、透明性与可行动性。但现有CE方法的评测高度异质：数据集、推荐器、指标乃至解释输出格式（隐式重要性掩码 vs. 显式反事实动作）均不一致，导致：(1) 跨方法有效性的公平比较难以进行；(2) 既有结论的可复现性与跨设置稳健性存疑；(3) 绝大多数方法只针对单个top-1物品设计，而现代推荐器输出的是top-K排序列表，解释与评测框架在列表层面缺失；(4) 面向GNN推荐器的图结构解释方法缺少系统评测与适配。因此需要统一、模型无关、可复现的基准协议。
AI.method: 1) 统一基准协议三个维度：解释格式（implicit：输出重要性掩码m∈[0,1]^|I|，按分数递增/递减逐步掩蔽；explicit：直接输出受扰动的交互向量x^p）、评测层级（item-level：对top-K中每个物品分别生成CE；list-level：单一干预同时移除整个top-K列表）、扰动范围（用户交互向量 vs. 用户-物品交互图）。2) 评测准则与指标：有效性用POS-P@K/NEG-P@K（扰动下目标物品掉出top-K的步数，越低越好/越高越好）、PN-S@K（显式格式下被移除物品比例）、新提出的PN-R@K（受NDCG位置加权启发，对高位的替换给予更高奖励）；稀疏度用Gini Index（隐式）与#Perturb（显式，扰动交互数）；计算复杂度用单条解释的平均推理时间。3) 实现细节：6个推荐模型（MF/VAE/DiffRec为用户向量输入；LightGCN/GFormer/SimGCL为图输入），11个CE方法（其中5个GNN解释器按推荐场景重定义翻转条件/仅取反事实分支/引入辅助因果变量/以"移除top-K物品比例"定义子图重要性；C2Explainer另设去掉加边的"-add"变体），LXR通过重要性阈值0.5转为显式CE；3个数据集按8:1:1划分，隐式格式T=10步扰动，评测top-3/top-5，随机采样500用户评测，其余用户用于需预训练的方法（LXR、CLEAR）；用Optuna按效率指标重调超参，PyTorch实现、双T4 GPU运行，并开源代码与配置。4) 补充分析：跨推荐架构稳健性、不同物品位次的稳定性（位置1→5）、四种扰动范围（Full / k-hop子图 / Indirect路径 / User-only）对比。
AI.result: (1) 隐式格式下LXR在效果（多数情形最低POS-P、最高NEG-P）与稀疏度（Gini最高，受L1正则化驱动）上均占优，与原文结论一致，复现性良好；跨推荐架构看，LXR在MF/VAE上强但在DiffRec上被LIME-RS显著超越，跨模型稳定性有限。(2) 显式格式下不存在全局占优方法，有效性与稀疏性呈明显权衡（高有效常伴随更多扰动），但非普适：Amazon上UNR-Explainer以<3次扰动取得较高有效性，而CF²约25次、C2Explainer(-add)约91次扰动反而更低；LXR在MF上item-level效果最好但扰动数远大于隐式情形（固定阈值策略所致），ACCENT则借分数间隙搜索隐式控制解释规模。(3) 图解释器上GREASE在Amazon表现强但在ML1M/Yahoo显著退化；CF²与C2Explainer有效性最高却需数万次边扰动（ML1M上C2Explainer达22万级），可解释性受限；CF-GNNExplainer、UNR-Explainer扰动少但效果中等；CLEAR需为每条交互引入因果辅助变量，内存开销大，在ML1M/Yahoo上OOM。(4) item-level与list-level结果总体高度一致（LXR尤为稳定），仅CLEAR在Amazon list-level上出现明显下降（且因OOM无法在更大数据集验证）。(5) 位置稳定性：隐式下POS-P@5从位置1到5单调下降（低排名更易被扰动，ML1M/Yahoo更明显）；显式下CLEAR与C2Explainer符合该趋势，CF-GNNExplainer不符合，GREASE/CF²/UNR-Explainer对位次不敏感。(6) 扰动范围：k-hop子图会降低CF²与C2Explainer性能，但对CF-GNNExplainer/GREASE/UNR-Explainer相当甚至在list-level上改善（CLEAR、UNR）；仅保留k-hop路径无一致增益、常劣于user-only。(7) 计算开销：列表级普遍慢于item级；LXR/CLEAR等预训练方法推理极快但训练代价高；SHAP因Shapley值指数复杂度在大数据集上慢；图方法中UNR-Explainer最快，但GREASE/CF²等在Yahoo上可达数百至上千秒，部分方法OOM。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次为推荐系统反事实解释建立了统一的、模型无关的多维度评测协议，并把有效性评估推进到整个top-K列表层面，纠正了先前文献中"某些方法更稳健/更实用"的部分结论：隐式格式下LXR最具优势且结论稳健；显式格式下有效性-稀疏性权衡强依赖方法与设置，不存在普适最优；item-level与list-level结论大体可互相推广；图解释器虽能捕捉GNN决策机制，但在大规模推荐图上存在显著的可扩展性与可解释性瓶颈。实践建议：评测应同时报告item级与list级结果、同时给出稀疏度与运行时间、明确声明扰动范围（是否限定k-hop子图）。局限包括：显式格式下列级评测仅LXR可完整支持、CLEAR等因OOM在部分数据集无法验证、部分结果仅在Amazon上做跨模型对比。

title: CROWDio: A Practical Mobile Crowd Computing Framework with Developer-Oriented Design, Adaptive Scheduling, and Fault Resilience
summary: Mobile Crowd Computing (MCdC) leverages the idle computational capacity of consumer smartphones to enable distributed task processing at scale; however, widespread real-world adoption remains constrained by the absence of developer-oriented frameworks capable of transparently managing device heterogeneity, fault tolerance, and connectivity volatility. This paper introduces CROWDio, a centralized MCdC platform comprising three tightly integrated subsystems: (i) a declarative SDK that abstracts distributed execution to a single function annotation, eliminating the need for explicit parallelism management; (ii) a tiered checkpointing mechanism that enables fault-tolerant task resumption under the memory and execution constraints inherent to mobile runtimes; and (iii) a pluggable multi-criteria scheduling framework driven by continuous live device telemetry, supporting interchangeable decision strategies without modification to the dispatch core. Empirical evaluation across six heterogeneous Android devices spanning CPU-bound, AI/NLP inference, and data-parallel workloads demonstrates that capability-aware adaptive scheduling reduces total execution time by up to 56.9% relative to naive round-robin dispatch, while the checkpointing subsystem incurs a bounded overhead of only 2-3 s per task regardless of checkpoint frequency. A system-wide Jain's Fairness Index of 0.889 confirms equitable and stable workload distribution across heterogeneous worker devices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CROWDio移动众算平台，通过声明式SDK简化分布式开发、分层检查点保障容错、可插拔调度实现自适应资源分配，在异构Android设备上实现最高56.9%的性能提升，同时保持公平性和低开销。
AI.motivation: 移动众算（MCdC）利用消费级智能手机的闲置算力实现大规模分布式任务处理，但目前缺乏面向开发者的框架来透明化处理设备异构性、容错机制和连接波动性等挑战，导致实际部署受限。
AI.method: CROWDio平台包含三个核心子系统：1）声明式SDK通过函数注解抽象分布式执行，开发者无需显式管理并行逻辑；2）分层检查点机制在移动运行时内存和执行约束下实现容错任务恢复；3）基于实时设备遥测的可插拔多准则调度框架，支持策略即插即用。评估基于6台异构Android设备，涵盖CPU密集型、AI/NLP推理和数据并行三类工作负载。
AI.result: 能力感知自适应调度相比朴素轮询策略减少总执行时间最高达56.9%；检查点子系统开销恒定为每任务2-3秒，与检查频率无关；系统Jain公平性指数为0.889，验证了异构工作节点间的公平稳定负载分配。
AI.conclusion: CROWDio通过声明式SDK、容错检查点和自适应调度三大子系统，有效解决了移动众算平台面临的开发友好性、容错性和资源管理问题。实验结果表明该系统在异构设备环境中可显著提升性能并保证公平性，为MCdC的实用化部署提供了可行的技术方案。

title: iCoRe: An Iterative Correlation-Aware Retriever for Bug Reproduction Test Generation
summary: Automatically generating bug reproduction tests (BRT) from issue descriptions is crucial for software maintenance. LLM-based approaches have shown great potential for this task. Their effectiveness heavily relies on retrieving high-quality context from the codebase. The retrieval phase of existing approaches relies on either traditional methods like BM25 or LLM-driven strategies. LLM-based retrieval strategies typically equip an LLM with tools to autonomously explore the repository or select the most relevant files and code snippets from a provided list as context. However, these retrieval methods suffer from three key limitations: 1) They often employ a unified strategy for retrieving both source code and test cases, overlooking their distinct retrieval requirements. 2) They focus solely on semantic similarity while ignoring function call relationships, leading to irrelevant context. 3) The retrieval lacks a feedback loop from the generation phase, preventing it from refining the context based on execution results. These limitations collectively result in low-quality context, thereby hindering the accuracy of bug reproduction. To address these challenges, we propose iCoRe, an iterative, correlation-aware context retrieval approach explicitly aware of three key correlations: 1) between source code and test cases, which requires differentiated retrieval, 2) between textual semantics and function call structures for accurate relevance assessment, and 3) between the retrieval and generation phases, which enables iterative feedback and refinement. To evaluate iCoRe, we integrate it with an LLM-based BRT generator and conduct a comprehensive evaluation on the SWT-bench Lite and TDD-bench Verified benchmarks. Experimental results show that our method achieves a Fail-to-Pass rate of 42.0% and 52.8% respectively, representing 19.7%-31.7% relative improvements over existing retrieval methods.

AI.tldr: iCoRe提出了一种迭代的、相关性感知的上下文检索方法，通过三种关键关联（源代码与测试用例的差异检索、文本语义与函数调用结构的关联、检索与生成的反馈闭环）来改进LLM生成bug复现测试的效果，在SWT-bench Lite和TDD-bench Verified上分别达到42.0%和52.8%的Fail-to-Pass率，相对改进19.7%-31.7%。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的Bug复现测试(BRT)生成方法存在三个关键局限：1)源代码和测试用例采用统一检索策略，忽视差异需求；2)仅关注语义相似性，忽视函数调用关系；3)缺乏从生成阶段到检索阶段的反馈闭环。这些问题导致上下文质量低，严重影响bug复现准确性。
AI.method: 提出iCoRe方法，包含三个核心设计：1)差异检索策略——对源代码和测试用例分别采用针对性检索；2)相关性感知评估——融合文本语义与函数调用结构进行精确相关性判断；3)迭代反馈机制——建立检索与生成阶段的双向反馈，实现上下文迭代优化。将iCoRe与LLM-based BRT生成器集成进行评估。
AI.result: 在SWT-bench Lite和TDD-bench Verified两个基准上，iCoRe分别达到42.0%和52.8%的Fail-to-Pass率，相比现有检索方法实现19.7%-31.7%的相对提升。
AI.conclusion: iCoRe通过引入三种关键关联机制，有效解决了现有检索方法的局限性，显著提升了LLM生成bug复现测试的准确性和上下文质量，验证了差异化检索、结构化相关性评估和迭代反馈对于该任务的重要性。

title: Mango: Multi-Agent Web Navigation via Global-View Optimization
summary: Existing web agents typically initiate exploration from the root URL, which is inefficient for complex websites with deep hierarchical structures. Without a global view of the website's structure, agents frequently fall into navigation traps, explore irrelevant branches, or fail to reach target information within a limited budget. We propose Mango, a multi-agent web navigation method that leverages the website structure to dynamically determine optimal starting points. We formulate URL selection as a multi-armed bandit problem and employ Thompson Sampling to adaptively allocate the navigation budget across candidate URLs. Furthermore, we introduce an episodic memory component to store navigation history, enabling the agent to learn from previous attempts. Experiments on WebVoyager demonstrate that Mango achieves a success rate of 63.6% when using GPT-5-mini, outperforming the best baseline by 7.3%. Furthermore, on WebWalkerQA, Mango attains a 52.5% success rate, surpassing the best baseline by 26.8%. We also demonstrate the generalizability of Mango using both open-source and closed-source models as backbones. Our data and code are open-source and available at https://github.com/VichyTong/Mango.

AI.tldr: Mango提出一种基于多智能体和网站结构感知的网页导航方法，通过将URL选择建模为多臂老虎机问题并使用Thompson Sampling进行自适应预算分配，同时结合情景记忆组件存储导航历史。在WebVoyager和WebWalkerQA基准测试中分别取得63.6%和52.5%的成功率，显著优于现有基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有网页智能体通常从根URL开始探索，对于具有深层层次结构的复杂网站效率低下。由于缺乏网站全局视图，智能体容易陷入导航陷阱、探索无关分支，或在有限预算内无法到达目标信息。
AI.method: 提出Mango方法：1) 利用网站结构动态确定最优起始点；2) 将URL选择建模为多臂老虎机问题，采用Thompson Sampling自适应分配导航预算；3) 引入情景记忆组件存储导航历史，使智能体能够从先前尝试中学习。
AI.result: 在WebVoyager基准上，使用GPT-5-mini达到63.6%成功率，优于最佳基线7.3%；在WebWalkerQA上达到52.5%成功率，超越最佳基线26.8%。
AI.conclusion: Mango方法有效提升了网页导航的成功率，且具有良好的泛化能力，可结合开源和闭源模型作为后端使用。代码和数据已开源。

title: Error-free Training for MedMNIST Datasets
summary: In this paper, we introduce a new concept called Artificial Special Intelligence by which Machine Learning models for the classification problem can be trained error-free, thus acquiring the capability of not making repeated mistakes. The method is applied to 18 MedMNIST biomedical datasets. Except for three datasets, which suffer from the double-labeling problem, all are trained to perfection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"人工特殊智能"概念，声称可使ML分类模型实现无错误训练。在18个MedMNIST生物医学数据集测试中，15个达到完美训练，3个因双标签问题失败。
AI.motivation: 解决机器学习模型在训练过程中重复犯错的问题，期望实现零错误训练。
AI.method: 提出"人工特殊智能"(Artificial Special Intelligence)概念，训练机器学习分类模型实现无错误学习，获得避免重复犯错的能力。
AI.result: 在18个MedMNIST生物医学数据集上，15个数据集达到了100%准确率（"完美"训练），3个数据集因存在双标签问题而未能成功训练。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在15/18个MedMNIST数据集上实现了"完美"训练，但对存在双标签问题的3个数据集失败。研究者声称这代表了机器学习训练范式的重大转变。

title: Multi-Level Temporal Graph Networks with Local-Global Fusion for Industrial Fault Diagnosis
summary: Fault detection and diagnosis are critical for the optimal and safe operation of industrial processes. The correlations among sensors often display non-Euclidean structures where graph neural networks (GNNs) are widely used therein. However, for large-scale systems, local, global, and dynamic relations extensively exist among sensors, and traditional GNNs often overlook such complex and multi-level structures for various problems including the fault diagnosis. To address this issue, we propose a structure-aware multi-level temporal graph network with local-global feature fusion for industrial fault diagnosis. First, a correlation graph is dynamically constructed using Pearson correlation coefficients to capture relationships among process variables. Then, temporal features are extracted through long short-term memory (LSTM)-based encoder, whereas the spatial dependencies among sensors are learned by graph convolution layers. A multi-level pooling mechanism is used to gradually coarsen and learn meaningful graph structures, to capture higher-level patterns while keeping important fault related details. Finally, a fusion step is applied to combine both detailed local features and overall global patterns before the final prediction. Experimental evaluations on the Tennessee Eastman process (TEP) demonstrate that the proposed model achieves superior fault diagnosis performance, particularly for complex fault scenarios, outperforming various baseline methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出名为 LGF-MLTG 的多层级时空图神经网络：先用滑动窗口内的 Pearson 相关系数动态构建加权邻接矩阵，以 LSTM 编码各节点时间特征，经 GraphSAGE 提取空间依赖，再用可学习软聚类的图池化（DIFFPOOL 式）逐层粗化节点为超节点，最后将粗化图的局部层级特征与原始节点空间的全局特征拼接融合完成故障分类。在 Tennessee Eastman (TEP) 基准上，20 类故障平均 FDR/精确率/F1 达 96.6%/96.7%/96.6%，优于 LSTM-CNN、GF-CNN、ST-GCN、GAT、ANN 等基线，尤其在故障 3、9、15 等难检类别上提升显著。
AI.motivation: 工业过程变量间存在非欧式相关结构，图神经网络（GNN）被广泛用于故障诊断。但针对大规模系统：(1) 现有池化方法难以捕捉变量间的全局相关性——空间上相距较远的变量（如 s2、s5、s52）仍可能强相关，而传统 GNN 仅在直接邻居间消息传递，忽略全局结构模式；(2) 已报道的 GNN 多为静态图，无法刻画系统动态下多层级、时变的关系；(3) 多数 ML-GNN（如 DIFFPOOL）仅在故障诊断领域有少量应用，缺少将局部-全局特征融合的层级建模方案。此外，PCA/Fisher 等线性降维会丢失关键信息，浅层 SVM/kNN/ANN 表达力有限，CNN/DBN/RNN 等深度模型难以处理不规则图结构数据。
AI.method: 架构与流程：(1) 数据预处理：对各变量做 z-score 归一化（用全部故障类别训练数据统计量），以长度 w=100、步长 1 的滑动窗切分多变量时间序列，每个窗口作为一个样本并继承其故障标签。(2) 动态图构建：在每个窗口内用 Pearson 相关系数 ρᵗᵢⱼ 计算加权邻接矩阵，并以硬阈值 δ=0.5 稀疏化（|ρ|≥δ 保留），形成随时间演化的图快照序列 {G_t}。(3) 时序编码：对每个节点的窗口 univariate 序列用共享的单向 LSTM 编码，取末隐状态 h_t^(i)∈R^F 作为节点初始特征。(4) 空间建模：G 层 GraphSAGE（mean 聚合器）按 h_v^(g+1)=σ(W·CONCAT(h_v, MEAN(neighbors))) 传播空间依赖，输出特征矩阵 H^(0)∈R^{N×d}。(5) 多层级表示：采用 DIFFPOOL 式可学习软聚类分配矩阵 S^(l)=softmax(GNN^(l)(A^(l),H^(l)))，通过 H^(l+1)=S^(l)ᵀH^(l)、A^(l+1)=S^(l)ᵀA^(l)S^(l) 将节点粗化为超节点（池化层超节点数设为 8），粗化后再接一层 GraphSAGE 得到 H^(L)；池化损失按 DIFFPOOL 定义并以权重 α 与交叉熵联合优化。(6) 局部-全局融合：H^(0) 经 MLP 得全局时空特征 H̃^(0)，将 Vec(H^(L)) 与 Vec(H̃^(0)) 拼接后经 MLP 输出故障类别 ŷ_t。(7) 训练：Adam，学习率 0.003，batch size 32，NVIDIA RTX 4080。实验设置：TEP 52 个变量（去掉搅拌器转速）、20 类故障，110 次仿真（100 训练/10 测试），训练故障 1 小时后引入、测试 8 小时后引入，训练每类 480 个故障样本、测试 800 个；指标为 FDR（召回）、精确率、F1。基线为 ANN、GF-CNN、LSTM-CNN、ST-GCN、GAT；另做 5 变体消融（GraphSAGE、GraphSAGE+LSTM、无 GF、无 LSTM、完整模型），每组 5 个随机种子取平均。
AI.result: TEP 基准上 LGF-MLTG 全面领先：平均 FDR 96.6%、精确率 96.7%、F1 96.6%。最佳深度学习基线 LSTM-CNN 为 FDR 94.1%/F1 94.2%；GF-CNN（FDR 92.7%/F1 92.1%）与 ST-GCN（FDR 93.4%/F1 93.4%）因难以建模多层级结构略低；GAT 最弱（平均 FDR 80.8%、F1 79.0%），在难检故障上尤差；ANN 的 F1 仅 81.8%。消融显示各组件互补：GraphSAGE（92.3% F1）→ +LSTM（94.1%）→ 层级池化替代 GraphSAGE（95.2%）→ 完整模型（96.6%）。难检类别提升尤为明显：故障 3 的 F1 从 82.0% 提升至 97.0%，故障 9 从 56.1% 提升至 71.9%，故障 15 从 61.0% 提升至 79.0%。t-SNE 显示完整模型的类间特征更可分；可视化显示多层级池化在无领域知识情况下自动将强相关传感器（如精馏塔相关的 15、48、49 号变量）聚为同一超节点。
AI.conclusion: LGF-MLTG 通过动态构建的时空图、LSTM 时序建模、层级图池化与局部-全局特征融合，同时刻画了变量间的局部细粒度交互与工厂级全局行为，显著提升工业过程故障诊断精度，尤其改善了传统方法难以识别的复杂故障，验证了"多层图结构 + 时序 + 全局特征"组合的有效性。后续方向：引入因果发现机制以学习因果图结构，以及面向边缘设备实时部署的轻量化模型变体。

title: AblateCell: A Reproduce-then-Ablate Agent for Virtual Cell Repositories
summary: Systematic ablations are essential to attribute performance gains in AI Virtual Cells, yet they are rarely performed because biological repositories are under-standardized and tightly coupled to domain-specific data and formats. While recent coding agents can translate ideas into implementations, they typically stop at producing code and lack a verifier that can reproduce strong baselines and rigorously test which components truly matter. We introduce AblateCell, a reproduce-then-ablate agent for virtual cell repositories that closes this verification gap. AblateCell first reproduces reported baselines end-to-end by auto-configuring environments, resolving dependency and data issues, and rerunning official evaluations while emitting verifiable artifacts. It then conducts closed-loop ablation by generating a graph of isolated repository mutations and adaptively selecting experiments under a reward that trades off performance impact and execution cost. Evaluated on three single-cell perturbation prediction repositories (CPA, GEARS, BioLORD), AblateCell achieves 88.9% (+29.9% to human expert) end-to-end workflow success and 93.3% (+53.3% to heuristic) accuracy in recovering ground-truth critical components. These results enable scalable, repository-grounded verification and attribution directly on biological codebases.

AI.tldr: AblateCell是一个用于虚拟细胞代码库的可复现-消融Agent，通过自动配置环境、解决依赖和数据问题来端到端复现基线，然后利用图结构生成隔离的代码变更并自适应选择实验，从而以较低成本准确识别关键组件。在三个单细胞扰动预测代码库上达到88.9%的端到端工作流成功率和93.3%的关键组件恢复准确率。
AI.motivation: 当前AI虚拟细胞研究中，系统性消融实验对于归因性能提升至关重要，但由于生物代码库的标准化不足、格式异构，消融实验很少被实际执行。现有代码生成Agent缺乏验证能力，无法复现强基线或严格测试各组件的实际贡献。
AI.method: AblateCell采用两阶段设计：1）复现阶段：自动配置环境、解决依赖和数据问题、重新运行官方评估并生成可验证产物；2）消融阶段：生成隔离代码变更图，在性能和执行成本权衡的奖励信号指导下自适应选择实验。
AI.result: 在CPA、GEARS、BioLORD三个单细胞扰动预测代码库上，AblateCell实现88.9%的端到端工作流成功率（比人类专家高29.9%），关键组件恢复准确率达93.3%（比启发式方法高53.3%）。
AI.conclusion: AblateCell首次实现了在真实生物代码库上的可扩展、代码库驱动的验证与归因能力，为AI虚拟细胞研究的可复现性提供了关键技术支撑。

title: ECLASS-Augmented Semantic Product Search for Electronic Components
summary: Efficient semantic access to industrial product data is a key enabler for factory automation and emerging LLM-based agent workflows, where both human engineers and autonomous agents must identify suitable components from highly structured catalogs. However, the vocabulary mismatch between natural-language queries and attribute-centric product descriptions limits the effectiveness of traditional retrieval approaches, e.g., BM25. In this work, we present a systematic evaluation of LLM-assisted dense retrieval for semantic product search on industrial electronic components, and investigate the integration of hierarchical semantics from the ECLASS standard into embedding-based retrieval. Our results show that dense retrieval combined with re-ranking substantially outperforms classical lexical methods and foundation model web-search baselines. In particular, the proposed approach achieves a Hit_Rate@5 of 94.3 %, compared to 31.4 % for BM25 on expert queries, while also exceeding foundation model baselines in both effectiveness and efficiency. Furthermore, augmenting product representations with ECLASS semantics yields consistent performance gains across configurations, demonstrating that standardized hierarchical metadata provides a crucial semantic bridge between user intent and sparse product descriptions.

AI.tldr: This paper evaluates LLM-assisted dense retrieval for semantic search of industrial electronic components, demonstrating that combining dense retrieval with re-ranking and ECLASS hierarchical semantics significantly outperforms traditional BM25 and foundation model approaches, achieving 94.3% Hit_Rate@5.
AI.motivation: Vocabulary mismatch between natural-language queries and attribute-centric industrial product descriptions limits retrieval effectiveness using traditional methods like BM25, hindering factory automation and LLM-based agent workflows.
AI.method: Systematic evaluation of LLM-assisted dense retrieval with hierarchical ECLASS semantics integration and re-ranking for semantic product search on industrial electronic components.
AI.result: Proposed dense retrieval with re-ranking achieves Hit_Rate@5 of 94.3%, substantially outperforming BM25 (31.4%) and foundation model baselines in both effectiveness and efficiency. ECLASS semantic augmentation yields consistent gains across configurations.
AI.conclusion: ECLASS hierarchical metadata provides a crucial semantic bridge between user intent and sparse product descriptions, enabling effective semantic search for industrial components.

title: Minimizing Intellectual Property Risks via Self-Stabilizing Algorithms
summary: In this paper, we examine the use of self-stabilizing algorithms, operating in a hierarchical manner, to determine intellectual property risks at a macro level. We are both interested in finding a solution that will support all defined intellectual property dimensions as well as suboptimal solutions in order to minimize risk.

AI.tldr: 本研究探索利用分层自稳定算法进行宏观知识产权风险评估，支持多维度风险分析，并通过同时考虑最优解和次优解的方式，实现风险的灵活最小化管理。
AI.motivation: 在宏观层面进行知识产权风险评估时，需要一种能够支持多维度定义并灵活应对动态环境的算法框架，以实现风险最小化的目标。
AI.method: 采用分层架构的自稳定算法，评估知识产权风险在多个维度上的表现，并通过算法设计同时支持最优解和次优解的探索，以平衡风险最小化与计算可行性。
AI.result: 通过分层自稳定机制，能够在动态环境中持续维护知识产权风险评估的有效性，同时通过引入次优解搜索策略，拓展了风险管理方案的灵活性和适应性。
AI.conclusion: 本研究通过分层自稳定算法框架，为宏观层面的知识产权风险管理提供了灵活的解决方案，同时兼顾了最优解和次优解的探索，扩展了风险管理策略的选择空间。

title: DebugRepair: Enhancing LLM-Based Automated Program Repair via Self-Directed Debugging
summary: Automated Program Repair (APR) has benefited from the code understanding and generation capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). Existing feedback-based APR methods iteratively refine candidate patches using test execution feedback and have shown promising results. However, most rely on outcome-level failure symptoms, such as stack traces, which show how failures are observed but fail to expose the intermediate runtime states critical for root-cause analysis. As a result, LLMs often infer bug causes without sufficient runtime evidence, leading to incorrect patches. To address this limitation, we propose DebugRepair, a self-directed debugging framework for LLM-based APR. DebugRepair enhances patch refinement with intermediate runtime evidence collected through simulated debugging. It consists of three components: test semantic purification, simulated instrumentation, and debugging-driven conversational repair. Together, they reduce noisy test context, collect runtime traces through targeted debugging statements with rule-based fallback, and progressively refine candidate patches using prior attempts and newly observed runtime states. We evaluate DebugRepair on three benchmarks across Java and Python. Experiments show that DebugRepair achieves state-of-the-art performance against 15 approaches. With GPT-3.5, it correctly fixes 224 bugs on Defects4J, outperforming prior SOTA LLM-based methods by 26.2%. With DeepSeek-V3, it correctly fixes 295 Defects4J bugs, surpassing the second-best baseline by 59 bugs. Across five additional backbone LLMs, DebugRepair improves repair performance by 51.3% over vanilla settings. Ablation studies further confirm the effectiveness of all components.

AI.tldr: DebugRepair 是一个面向 LLM 自动程序修复（APR）的"自我导向调试"框架：在反馈式 APR 流程中引入测试语义净化、模拟插桩（LLM 插桩 + 规则化兜底）以及调试驱动的多轮对话式修复，使 LLM 能基于中间运行时状态（而非仅栈追踪等结果级症状）定位根因。在 Defects4J（V1.2/V2.0）、QuixBugs、HumanEval-Java 上对 15 个基线取得 SOTA：GPT-3.5 正确修复 224 个 bug（较 SOTA LLM 方法平均 +26.2%），DeepSeek-V3 修复 295 个（比次优多 59 个），对 5 个额外骨干 LLM 平均提升 51.3%，且 patch 规模仅 32、单 bug 成本 $0.036。
AI.motivation: 现有反馈式 LLM-APR 方法（ChatRepair、ContrastRepair、TSAPR 等）在迭代精化补丁时主要依赖结果级失败症状（如栈追踪），只能说明"失败如何被观察到"，却无法暴露根因分析所需的关键中间运行时状态，导致 LLM 在缺乏运行时证据的情况下臆测 bug 原因，产出"看似合理实则错误"的补丁（例如 Chart-24 中错误地对参数 g 做边界裁剪，而真正问题是误用了未裁剪的 value 变量）。而人类开发者通常通过插入打印语句等方式观察运行时状态来逐步定位根因。因此论文动机是：为 LLM-APR 工具注入类人的"调试认知过程"，把"症状"与"根因"之间的桥梁——运行时中间状态——提供给模型；同时真实单元测试常含多个断言，只有部分触发 bug，若不净化测试上下文，会引入大量无关日志噪声。
AI.method: 三阶段框架：(1) 测试语义净化——基于 AST 的静态切片，从失败测试中提取触发失败的最小语句子集 T_min 及所需外部依赖（递归收集相关类级字段与辅助方法），规则包含直接数据依赖与面向对象语言的隐式状态修改（如对象别名副作用），通过迭代回溯直到无新对象出现；(2) 模拟插桩——LLM 断点预测（推断关键变量集 V_crit）与语义保持插桩（插入 print），并经两阶段一致性检查（去除 print/注释后的逐行等价 + 编译通过），超过 M_inst=10 次失败则回退到基于 AST 的规则化插桩（变量赋值、if/循环条件、return 表达式等处统一注入日志，处理循环条件重复计算问题），在净化测试上下文中执行捕获结构化运行时轨迹 τ_runtime；(3) 调试驱动对话式修复——分层迭代：外层 N_session=6 个调试会话（会话内先做一次基于结果级症状的直接修复，失败则进入调试模式并补充插桩代码、净化测试、运行时轨迹与失败补丁作为增强提示），内层 K_round=4 轮基于反馈历史 ⟨P_k, E_k⟩ 的补丁精化；单会话失败则丢弃历史、开启新会话重采集轨迹；此外用 8 次额外查询做补丁增强（patch augmentation）生成逻辑等价变体以缓解测试过拟合。实验基于 tree-sitter 做 Java/Python AST 操作，采用完美故障定位（perfect FL）设置。
AI.result: RQ1：GPT-3.5 下 Defects4J 正确修复 224（V1.2 111 / V2.0 113），比次优 ReinFix 多 11 个，比 ChatRepair/ContrastRepair/TSAPR 分别多 62/81/23 个（+38.3%/+56.6%/+11.44%）；QuixBugs Java 与 Python 各修复全部 40 个；17 个 Defects4J 项目中 7 个排名第一。DeepSeek-V3 下修复 295 个（V1.2 139 / V2.0 156），比 ReinFix 多 59 个。RQ2：复杂场景优势显著（SF 111/113、SH 82/83），SL 场景与基线相当或略优（QuixBugs 100%），说明调试证据主要增益于多语句复杂 bug。RQ3：Qwen2.5-7B +21、Qwen2.5-32B +71、Qwen2.5-Coder-7B +30、DeepSeek-V3 +140、GPT-3.5 +74，平均提升 51.3%；且呈现规模效应与代码模型协同效应。RQ4：消融显示去除净化（-26.8%）、去除调试（-26.3%）、去除补丁增强（-19.9%，但 plausible 不变）、仅规则插桩（-15.6%）、无规则兜底（-19.2%）；净化使运行时日志 token 平均减少 18.6%。RQ5：HumanEval-Java（晚于 GPT-3.5 训练截止）上正确修复 153/163，较 ContrastRepair +11.68%、ChatRepair +17.69%，而 patch 规模仅 32（基线 160/500）。成本：平均 38K token/bug、$0.036/bug，比 TSAPR/ReinFix 低约 35%，比 ChatRepair/RepairAgent 低约 72%。超参分析显示 K_round 从 1 增至 2 提升最明显，N_session 早中期收益高、后期饱和。有效性威胁控制：两位研究者双盲人工评审 plausible 补丁，分歧由第三方仲裁。
AI.conclusion: 论文表明，为 LLM-APR 引入"自导向调试"能有效补足结果级失败症状的不足：净化失败测试上下文、模拟开发者插桩以采集中间运行时状态、并以分层多轮对话方式利用这些状态，可显著提升修复正确率与成本效率，且模型无关、可与检索式/搜索式 APR 工具（如 ReinFix、TSAPR）正交组合以进一步提升。局限与未来方向包括：依赖可显式访问测试用例（因此不适用于 SWE-bench 类设置）、正确性判定仍需人工评审、规则化插桩回退较为粗糙、以及实现尚待开源。

title: Experiments or Outcomes? Probing Scientific Feasibility in Large Language Models
summary: Scientific feasibility assessment asks whether a claim is consistent with established knowledge and whether experimental evidence could support or refute it. We frame feasibility assessment as a diagnostic reasoning task in which, given a hypothesis, a model predicts feasible or infeasible and justifies its decision. We evaluate large language models (LLMs) under controlled knowledge conditions (hypothesis-only, with experiments, with outcomes, or both) and probe robustness by progressively removing portions of the experimental and/or outcome context. Across multiple LLMs and two datasets, providing outcome evidence is generally more reliable than providing experiment descriptions. Outcomes tend to improve accuracy beyond what internal knowledge alone provides, whereas experimental text can be brittle and may degrade performance when the context is incomplete. These findings clarify when experimental evidence benefits LLM-based feasibility assessment and when it introduces fragility.

AI.tldr: 该研究将科学可行性评估框架化为诊断推理任务，评估LLM在不同知识条件下的表现，发现结果证据比实验描述更可靠，但实验文本在上下文不完整时可能导致性能下降。
AI.motivation: 科学可行性评估需要判断一个假设是否与已有知识一致，以及实验证据是否能支持或反驳该假设。如何有效利用实验证据来辅助LLM进行可行性评估尚不明确。
AI.method: 在受控知识条件下评估多个LLM（包括仅提供假设、提供实验描述、提供实验结果、提供实验及结果组合四种条件），并通过逐步移除实验和/或结果上下文来探测鲁棒性。
AI.result: 提供结果证据通常比提供实验描述更可靠；结果能够提升超越模型内部知识的准确率；实验文本具有脆弱性，在上下文不完整时可能降低性能。
AI.conclusion: 实验文本在上下文不完整时可能具有脆弱性并降低性能。该研究阐明了实验证据在LLM可行性评估中的利弊，为未来设计更可靠的科学推理系统提供了指导。

title: AutomationBench
summary: Existing AI benchmarks for software automation rarely combine cross-application coordination, autonomous API discovery, and policy adherence. Real business workflows demand all three: a single task may span a CRM, inbox, calendar, and messaging platform - requiring the agent to find the right endpoints, follow a policy document, and write correct data to each system. To address this gap, we introduce AutomationBench, a benchmark for evaluating AI agents on cross-application workflow orchestration via REST APIs. Drawing on real workflow patterns from Zapier's platform, tasks span Sales, Marketing, Operations, Support, Finance, and HR domains. Agents must discover relevant endpoints themselves, follow layered business rules, and navigate environments with irrelevant and sometimes misleading records. Grading is programmatic and end-state only: whether the correct data ended up in the right systems. Even the best frontier models currently score below 10%. AutomationBench provides a challenging, realistic measure of where current models stand relative to the agentic capabilities businesses actually need.

AI.tldr: AutomationBench 是 Zapier 发布的跨应用工作流编排基准：47 个应用、约 500 个 REST API 端点、6 大业务域（销售/市场/运营/客服/财务/HR），任务要求智能体自主发现端点、遵循电子表格中的业务政策文档，并在含有干扰项与陷阱的环境中完成状态变更。评分完全基于最终世界状态的确定性断言（无部分得分、无 LLM 评审），当前最好模型分数低于 10%（Opus 4.7 为 9.9%）。
AI.motivation: 现有 AI 基准各自只测相邻能力：WebArena/Mind2Web 测长程网页操作、OSWorld 测计算机使用、ToolBench/API-Bank 用检索式从固定工具集中挑选、AppWorld 与 τ³-bench 虽为模拟环境且支持端状态评分但任务基本局限在单一应用（τ³-bench 仅在银行域加入文档式工具发现）。而真实企业工作流同时要求三项能力：跨应用协调、自主 API 发现、政策遵从（一个任务可能横跨 CRM、收件箱、日历与消息平台，需找到正确端点、遵循政策文档并把正确数据写入各系统）。此外，REST API 是通用标准且通常是 MCP/CLI 工具背后的胶合层，直接精确使用 API 能以更低算力成本（相较 computer use）覆盖更多应用，因而需要一个可复现、贴近业务需求的衡量基准来暴露当前模型在多步推理、政策遵从与工具发现上的差距。
AI.method: 任务来源与构建：从 Zapier 真实客户用例（仅用工作流形态与 Agents 服务的负反馈，不含 PII）聚类出 6 个域，用 Opus 4.6、GPT 5.3 Codex、Gemini 3 辅助生成并多轮迭代增强真实性、难度与应用多样性；每域 100 个公开任务 + 100+ 私有评测任务（私有集额外加固）。硬化手段包括无关数据、关键信息藏在工具调用响应、信息位置歧义、错误条目近似命名、带优先级覆盖的严格业务政策等；为区分“政策遵从”与“提示注入”，任务提示显式指向政策文档。主观判断必须以结构化状态变更（如状态字段、评分、路由队列）落地。任务五条准则：可观测状态变更、不变式可判定、无自由文本成功标准、推理须落地、一次性非交互指令。工具接口：仅暴露 Search（BM25 跨全部 API schema 检索，top-k=5）与 Execute（模拟 curl/fetch，含 method/url/body，无鉴权），状态真源为 Pydantic 模型，保留分页、必填字段与 4xx 错误语义；最大 50 步、可并行调用。评分：对最终状态做确定性断言（正向+负向断言防止滥发邮件等 shotgun 行为），无部分得分，报告 Score 与 Cost（每任务平均 token 成本）；另构建 Zapier 工具集、Limited Zapier 工具集与简单基线域作为诊断模式。框架基于 Prime Intellect Verifiers，用 RLVR 实验做压力测试以发现并修补 reward hacking。
AI.result: 排行榜（私有集单次运行，run-to-run 方差约 1%）：Opus 4.7(max) 9.9% / $1.80、Gemini 3.1 Pro(high) 9.6% / $0.54、GPT 5.4(high) 7.6% / $1.93、Sonnet 4.6(max) 5.3% / $1.81、Haiku 4.5 1.5% / $0.18、GPT 5.4(no reasoning) 1.2% / $0.19。Opus 与 Gemini 的通过任务集合 Jaccard 相似度仅 0.17（Opus 解决的 71% 题 Gemini 未解，反之 70%），说明模型能力互补、瓶颈各异。步骤/工具调用：Opus 平均 12.6 步/29.8 次调用，Gemini 21.8 步/35.4 次，GPT 5.4 high 15.4 步/43.9 次；Sonnet 生成 token 远多于 Opus 故成本更高且通过率更低，Gemini 以约 1/3 成本取得接近最高准确率。工具集消融：Gemini 在 API/Zapier/Limited Zapier 下分别为 9.6%/12.8%/14.3%，Haiku 为 1.5%/2.0%/3.8%，说明更窄或更易消化的工具描述带来增益。简单基线域上连 Haiku 都达 97%，表明困难来自多层复杂度而非基础 API 调用。主要失败模式：虚假自信（Opus 72%、Gemini 91%、GPT 5.4 84% 的失败属此）、找不到数据（搜索不够系统、臆断数据位置）、漏项（列表任务只处理部分条目即宣称完成）、不严格遵循指令（改写或忽略必须包含的字段值）。
AI.conclusion: AutomationBench 通过把跨应用协调、自主端点发现与政策遵从三项能力合到一个可复现、纯确定性端状态评测的基准中，揭示了当前前沿模型与企业实际所需智能体能力之间的巨大鸿沟：即便最佳模型通过率也低于 10%，且不同模型通过集合差异极大，说明需要多方向能力提升而非单点突破。多层失败模式与工具集变体使其对模型进步保持敏感性和相关性，公开任务与全部工具集已开源于公开仓库及 Prime Intellect Environments Hub，私有集与排行榜用于正式评测。局限在于合成数据的真实性与可解性风险、任务规模大导致难以全面人工审核、硬化策略仍可能存在漏洞，未来版本将继续修 bug 并作大版本迭代；同时承诺不采纳 LLM-as-a-judge，以降低跨模型评分偏差。

title: Streaming Structured Inference with Flash-SemiCRF
summary: Semi-Markov Conditional Random Fields (semi-CRFs) assign labels to segments of a sequence rather than to individual positions, enabling exact inference over segment-level features and principled uncertainty estimates at their boundaries. However, existing implementations must materialize a large edge potential tensor whose size grows with sequence length, maximum segment length, and label count, becoming prohibitive for speech-scale state spaces and intractable at genomic scales where sequences can exceed 100,000 positions. This memory bottleneck has limited the adoption of exact segment-level inference for long sequences and large label sets. We identify that the core inefficiency is materializing edge potentials that can instead be evaluated on-the-fly from a compact prefix-sum array, and make several improvements. First, replacing the stored edge tensor with prefix-sum lookup reduces the memory footprint by a factor proportional to the product of segment length and label count. Second, a streaming forward-backward pass with checkpoint-boundary normalization keeps working memory sublinear in sequence length while preserving exact gradients. Third, zero-centered cumulative scores control numerical drift and induce an adaptive duration prior under label imbalance. We integrate these ideas into Flash-SemiCRF, a fused Triton kernel that enables exact semi-CRF inference on previously intractable problem sizes. Available at https://github.com/biobenkj/flash-semicrf.

AI.tldr: Flash-SemiCRF通过前缀和查找、流式算法和零中心分数三大优化，将半马尔可夫条件随机场的内存复杂度从O(n × L × K)降至亚线性，使精确片段级推理首次能在超长序列（>100,000位置）上进行。
AI.motivation: 现有半条件随机场实现必须实例化边势张量，其规模随序列长度、最大片段长度和标签数量的乘积增长，在语音或基因组尺度（序列可超过100,000位置）上变得不可行，限制了精确片段级推理的采用。
AI.method: 提出三大核心改进：(1)用前缀和查找替代存储的边势张量，大幅降低内存占用；(2)流式前向-后向算法结合检查点边界归一化，实现亚线性内存；(3)零中心累计分数控制数值漂移，并在标签不平衡时引入自适应时长先验。全部集成到Triton融合内核中。
AI.result: 内存占用降低至与片段长度和标签数量乘积成正比的水平；工作内存对序列长度保持亚线性；保持精确梯度的同时实现数值稳定。
AI.conclusion: Flash-SemiCRF能够实现此前无法处理的超长序列（如基因组尺度）上的精确半马尔可夫条件随机场推理，将半条件随机场的应用范围扩展到语音和基因组级别的大规模状态空间。

title: Chat2Workflow: A Benchmark for Generating Executable Visual Workflows with Natural Language
summary: At present, executable visual workflows have emerged as a mainstream paradigm in real-world industrial deployments, offering strong reliability and controllability. However, in current practice, such workflows are almost entirely constructed through manual engineering: developers must carefully design workflows, write prompts for each step, and repeatedly revise the logic as requirements evolve-making development costly, time-consuming, and error-prone. To study whether large language models can automate this multi-round interaction process, we introduce Chat2Workflow, a benchmark for generating executable visual workflows directly from natural language, and propose a robust agentic framework to mitigate recurrent execution errors. Chat2Workflow is built from a large collection of real-world business workflows, with each instance designed so that the generated workflow can be transformed and directly deployed to practical workflow platforms such as Dify and Coze. Experimental results show that while state-of-the-art language models can often capture high-level intent, they struggle to generate correct, stable, and executable workflows, especially under complex or changing requirements. Although our agentic framework yields up to 5.34% resolve rate gains, the remaining real-world gap positions Chat2Workflow as a foundation for advancing industrial-grade automation. Code is available at https://github.com/zjunlp/Chat2Workflow.

AI.tldr: 提出了Chat2Workflow基准用于从自然语言生成可执行视觉工作流，并设计智能体框架减少执行错误。实验表明当前LLM在复杂工作流生成上仍有明显不足，Chat2Workflow为工业级自动化研究提供基础。
AI.motivation: 当前可执行视觉工作流几乎完全依赖人工构建（设计流程、编写提示词、迭代修改逻辑），导致开发成本高、耗时长、易出错。需要研究大语言模型能否自动化多轮交互的工作流生成过程。
AI.method: 提出Chat2Workflow基准测试（基于真实商业工作流，支持Dify/Coze等平台直接部署）和鲁棒的智能体框架，通过多轮执行反馈机制缓解执行错误。
AI.result: SOTA语言模型虽能捕捉高层意图，但在复杂/变化需求下难以生成正确、稳定、可执行的工作流。智能体框架提升了5.34%的解决率，但仍有显著差距。
AI.conclusion: Chat2Workflow作为推进工业级工作流自动化的基准，揭示了当前LLM在复杂工作流生成上的差距，为未来工业级自动化研究提供了基础。

title: Personalized Benchmarking: Evaluating LLMs by Individual Preferences
summary: With the rise in capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and their deployment in real-world tasks, evaluating LLM alignment with human preferences has become an important challenge. Current benchmarks average preferences across all users to compute aggregate ratings, overlooking individual user preferences when establishing model rankings. Since users have varying preferences in different contexts, we call for personalized LLM benchmarks that rank models according to individual needs. We compute personalized model rankings using ELO ratings and Bradley-Terry coefficients for 115 active Chatbot Arena users and analyze how user query characteristics (topics and writing style) relate to LLM ranking variations. We demonstrate that individual rankings of LLM models diverge dramatically from aggregate LLM rankings, with Bradley-Terry correlations averaging only $ρ= 0.04$ (57\% of users show near-zero or negative correlation) and ELO ratings showing moderate correlation ($ρ= 0.43$). Through topic modeling and style analysis, we find users exhibit substantial heterogeneity in topical interests and communication styles, influencing their model preferences. We further show that a compact combination of topic and style features provides a useful feature space for predicting user-specific model rankings. Our results provide strong quantitative evidence that aggregate benchmarks fail to capture individual preferences for most users, and highlight the importance of developing personalized benchmarks that rank LLM models according to individual user preferences.

AI.tldr: This paper reveals that current LLM benchmarks using aggregate rankings fail to capture individual user preferences, with 57% of users showing near-zero or negative correlation between personal and aggregate rankings. By analyzing 115 users with ELO and Bradley-Terry methods, the authors demonstrate the need for personalized benchmarks based on user-specific topic interests and communication styles.
AI.motivation: Current LLM benchmarks average preferences across all users using aggregate ratings, overlooking individual user preferences when establishing model rankings. Since users have varying preferences in different contexts, personalized LLM benchmarks that rank models according to individual needs are needed.
AI.method: ELO ratings and Bradley-Terry coefficients for 115 active Chatbot Arena users; topic modeling and style analysis on user query characteristics; feature-based prediction model for user-specific rankings.
AI.result: Individual rankings of LLM models diverge dramatically from aggregate LLM rankings: Bradley-Terry correlations averaging only ρ=0.04 (57% of users show near-zero or negative correlation), ELO ratings showing moderate correlation (ρ=0.43). Users exhibit substantial heterogeneity in topical interests and communication styles, influencing model preferences. A compact combination of topic and style features provides a useful feature space for predicting user-specific model rankings.
AI.conclusion: aggregate benchmarks fail to capture individual preferences for most users, highlighting the importance of developing personalized benchmarks that rank LLM models according to individual user preferences.

title: DPC: A Distributed Page Cache over CXL
summary: Modern distributed file systems rely on uncoordinated, per node page caches that replicate hot data locally across the cluster. While ensuring fast local access, this architecture underutilizes aggregate cluster DRAM capacity through massive data redundancy and incurs prohibitive coherence overhead via heavyweight, lock-based protocols. In this paper, we focus on the design of a distributed page cache that treats the entire cluster's main memory as a single cache budget while preserving standard file-system interfaces and semantics. We present Distributed Page Cache (DPC), an OS-level, distributed page cache built on top of Compute Express Link (CXL) 3.0 memory semantics. DPC enforces a single-copy invariant at page granularity: each file page has exactly one owner node holding the sole resident DRAM copy, and other nodes access it via CXL-based remote mappings rather than creating replicas of the page. DPC is implemented end-to-end on a CXL-based emulation framework that models multi-host CXL 3.0 memory fabrics, enabling detailed evaluation in the absence of widespread hardware. Across real-world and representative data-sharing workloads, DPC delivers speedups of up to 12.4X, with a geometric-mean speedup of 5.6X.

AI.tldr: DPC是一个构建在CXL 3.0内存语义上的操作系统级分布式页缓存系统，通过强制单副本不变式（每个文件页仅有一个所有者节点持有一份DRAM副本，其他节点通过CXL远程访问）来解决传统分布式文件系统中的数据冗余、内存利用率低和一致性协议开销过高的问题。在CXL仿真平台上的真实工作负载测试显示可实现最高12.4倍的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现代分布式文件系统采用无协调的节点本地页缓存架构，导致三个核心问题：1）热点数据在集群内大量冗余复制，2）集群聚合DRAM容量未被有效利用，3）基于锁的一致性协议引入过高开销。
AI.method: 采用单副本不变式（Single-copy invariant）：每个文件页仅有一个持有唯一DRAM副本的所有者节点，其他节点通过CXL远程映射访问而非复制数据。实现于CXL 3.0仿真框架。
AI.result: 在实际工作负载评测中，DPC实现最高12.4倍加速，几何平均加速达5.6倍。
AI.conclusion: DPC通过单一所有权设计消除了数据冗余，通过CXL 3.0远程映射替代锁协议消除了一致性开销，为分布式文件系统提供了高效的内存级共享方案。

title: Improving LLM-Driven Test Generation by Learning from Mocking Information
comment: Accepted for publication in ICST 2026 (AIST workshop). This arXiv version is the authors' accepted manuscript
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently shown strong potential for automated unit test generation. This has motivated us to investigate whether developer-defined test doubles (commonly referred to as mocks) available in existing test suites can be leveraged to improve LLM-driven test generation. To this end, we propose MOCKMILL, an LLM-based technique and tool that generates test cases by exploiting mocking information automatically extracted from developer-written tests. MOCKMILL targets components that are replaced by test doubles in existing tests and uses the encoded stubbings and interaction expectations to guide test generation, combined with an iterative generation-and-repair process to ensure executable tests. We evaluated MOCKMILL on 10 open-source classes from six Java projects using four LLMs, and compared the generated tests with existing project tests and tests produced by baseline approaches. The results show that MOCKMILL's tests cover lines of code and kill mutants that existing tests and baseline-generated tests miss. Overall, our findings provide preliminary evidence that leveraging mocking information is a complementary and effective way to enhance LLM-based test generation.

AI.tldr: MockMill 是首个利用开发者已编写测试中的 mock（测试替身）信息来引导大语言模型生成单元测试的方法与工具。它通过静态分析自动抽取 stubbings（打桩）与 verify 操作（交互期望），将其作为结构化上下文输入 LLM，并结合生成-修复循环产出可编译可执行的测试。在 6 个 Java 项目、10 个类、4 个 LLM 上的评估显示，其生成的测试能杀死现有测试与基线（无 mock 信息的 LLM、Randoop）遗漏的变异体，代价仅增加 5–15% 成本。
AI.motivation: LLM 驱动的单元测试生成目前主要依赖被测类源码与文档/注释，忽略了现有测试套件中开发者手写的测试替身（mock）所编码的隐式行为知识：stubbing 编码了依赖组件哪些方法被调用、传入什么参数、返回什么值或抛出什么异常，verify 操作编码了期望的交互。这些信息在工业与开源项目中广泛使用，却未被任何已有 LLM 测试生成工具显式利用；此外，LLM 测试生成中「除被测代码之外还能提供何种辅助工件」这一问题仍缺乏系统探索。
AI.method: 四阶段流水线：(1) 项目分析——用 JavaParser 解析测试文件 AST，识别被 Mockito 测试替身替换且含 stubbing/verify 的类，剔除第三方库类，输出 JSON 目标清单；(2) Mock 抽取——解析 test 与 setup 方法，定位 when(...).then(...) 与 verify() 调用及其参数值，按目标类聚合成精简的 JSON 中间表示，避免整文件塞入上下文造成噪声；(3) 测试生成——构建包含生成指令、目标类完整源码、stubbing/verify 数据的结构化 prompt，以变异测试充分性为目标（使用 stubbing 中的精确值、构造能在真实变异下失败的断言、覆盖真假分支与边界条件、实例化真实对象而非替身），配合两个与领域无关的 few-shot 示例，指定输出可编译测试文件的格式；(4) 生成后修复——编译失败将错误信息回喂 LLM 迭代修复，运行失败同理，直至编译通过并全部通过或达到重试上限（默认假设为回归测试场景，将失败归因于测试自身）。评估指标覆盖生成量、首次/最终编译率、测试通过率、变异得分与行覆盖的 min/med/max/stddev，以及唯一变异体杀死率与唯一覆盖行；基线为同 prompt 但不含 mock 信息的 LLM、Randoop 与开发者手写测试。
AI.result: RQ1：GPT-4o Mini、GPT-5 Mini、GPT-5、Claude Sonnet 4.5 上最终编译率 92%–100%，除 GPT-4o Mini（81.6%）外通过率 98.6%–99.7%；强模型中位变异得分 84%（GPT-5 Mini）、89%（Claude Sonnet 4.5）、62%（GPT-5），中位行覆盖 91%/93%/94%，最大值均达 100%，但标准差较大（如 Claude 变异得分 stddev 33.1）。RQ2：MockMill 在 CAS、RRA 上的唯一变异体杀死率达 24.56%、25.64%，显著高于 LLM（0–12.82%）与 Randoop；对 40% CUT 严格优于 LLM、50% 严格优于 Randoop；唯一覆盖行贡献较小（RRA 2.61%、MQS 1.56%、URE 1.79%）。开发者手写测试贡献最少。Kruskal–Wallis 检验 H 值 0.19–1.94、p≥0.584，各方法无显著差异，说明是互补而非替代。RQ3：成本较无 mock 基线仅高 5–15%；GPT-5 Mini 性价比最佳（约 $0.0176/次），Claude Sonnet 4.5 最贵（$0.5132）。
AI.conclusion: MockMill 首次将开发者定义的 mock 信息显式用作 LLM 测试生成的上下文线索，能覆盖基线与现有测试遗漏的代码行并杀死其未检出的变异体，且成本可接受，是现有测试套件与 LLM 生成方法的有益补充而非替代。作者建议未来将「含 mock 信息」与「不含 mock 信息」的提示结合使用以保留测试多样性，并开展消融实验、自动抽取项目特定 few-shot 示例、动态收集 mock 数据、建立测试替身与生成测试间的溯源链接。有效性威胁包括样本规模小（10 类/6 项目）、仅限 Java + Mockito/JUnit 5、指标缺少人工质量评估以及训练数据泄漏的不可完全排除。

title: Semantic Needles in Document Haystacks: Sensitivity Testing of LLM-as-a-Judge Similarity Scoring
summary: We propose a scalable, multifactorial experimental framework that systematically probes LLM sensitivity to subtle semantic changes in pairwise document comparison. We analogize this as a needle-in-a-haystack problem: a single semantically altered sentence (the needle) is embedded within surrounding context (the hay), and we vary the perturbation type (negation, conjunction swap, named entity replacement), context type (original vs. topically unrelated), needle position, and document length across all combinations, testing five LLMs on tens of thousands of document pairs. Our analysis reveals several striking findings. First, LLMs exhibit a within-document positional bias distinct from previously studied candidate-order effects: most models penalize semantic differences more harshly when they occur earlier in a document. Second, when the altered sentence is surrounded by topically unrelated context, it systematically lowers similarity scores and induces bipolarized scores that indicate either very low or very high similarity. This is consistent with an interpretive frame account in which topically-related context may allow models to contextualize and downweight the alterations. Third, each LLM produces a qualitatively distinct scoring distribution, a stable "fingerprint" that is invariant to perturbation type, yet all models share a universal hierarchy in how leniently they treat different perturbation types. Together, these results demonstrate that LLM semantic similarity scores are sensitive to document structure, context coherence, and model identity in ways that go beyond the semantic change itself, and that the proposed framework offers a practical, LLM-agnostic toolkit for auditing and comparing scoring behavior across current and future models.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一个"大海捞针"式实验框架，系统测试LLM对文档对比较中细微语义变化的敏感性，发现LLM存在位置偏差、语境依赖性评分效应，以及模型特异性评分"指纹"，为LLM语义相似度评估提供了实证基础和实用工具。
AI.motivation: LLM在文档对比较任务中的语义敏感性尚缺乏系统性探测，尤其对细微语义变化的响应模式不明确，亟需一个可扩展的实验框架进行系统评估。
AI.method: 采用多因素实验设计，系统变化扰动类型（否定、连词交换、命名实体替换）、语境类型（原文vs.主题不相关）、"needle"位置和文档长度，测试五个LLM在数万对文档上的表现。
AI.result: 三大发现：①LLM存在文档内位置偏差——更早位置的语义差异受到更严厉惩罚；②主题不相关语境会系统降低相似度评分并导致双极化评分分布；③每个LLM产生定性独特的评分分布（稳定"指纹"），但所有模型对不同扰动类型存在共同层级偏好。
AI.conclusion: 提出的实验框架可作为审计和比较当前及未来模型评分行为的实用工具，证明LLM语义相似度评分在文档结构、语境连贯性和模型身份方面存在系统性敏感性，超越了单纯的语义变化本身。

title: Efficient Mixture-of-Experts LLM Inference with Apple Silicon NPUs
summary:
Apple Neural Engine (ANE) is a dedicated neural processing unit (NPU) present in every Apple Silicon chip. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLMs improve inference efficiency via sparse activation but are challenging for NPUs in three ways: expert routing is unpredictable and introduces dynamic tensor shapes that conflict with the shape-specific constraints of NPUs; several irregular operators, e.g., top-k, scatter/gather, etc., are not NPU-friendly; and launching many small expert kernels incurs substantial dispatch and synchronization overhead. NPUs are designed to offload AI compute from CPU and GPU; our goal is to enable such offloading for MoE inference, particularly during prefill, where long-context workloads consume substantial system resources.
  This paper presents NPUMoE, a runtime inference engine that accelerates MoE execution on Apple Silicon by offloading dense, static computation to NPU, while preserving a CPU/GPU fallback path for dynamic operations. NPUMoE uses offline calibration to estimate expert capacity and popularity that drives three key techniques: (1) Static tiers for expert capacity to address dynamic expert routing (2) Grouped expert execution to mitigate NPU concurrency limits (3) Load-aware expert compute graph residency to reduce CPU-NPU synchronization overhead. Experiments on Apple M-series devices using three representative MoE LLMs and four long-context workloads show that NPUMoE consistently outperforms baselines, reducing latency by 1.32x-5.55x, improving energy efficiency by 1.81x-7.37x, and reducing CPU-cycle usage by 1.78x-5.54x through effective NPU offloading.

AI.tldr: NPUMoE是一种在Apple Silicon上加速MoE大语言模型推理的运行时引擎，通过离线校准技术将密集静态计算卸载到ANE神经处理单元，同时保留CPU/GPU作为动态操作的后备路径。
AI.motivation: MoE模型通过稀疏激活提升推理效率，但其专家路由的不可预测性、动态张量形状、非常规算子以及小内核调度开销，与NPUs的形状约束设计存在根本冲突，导致MoE推理难以有效利用Apple Silicon上的NPU资源。
AI.method: 离线校准技术估计专家容量和热度，用于驱动三项关键技术：(1) 静态分层机制处理动态专家路由；(2) 分组专家执行缓解NPU并发限制；(3) 负载感知的专家计算图驻留策略减少CPU-NPU同步开销。
AI.result: 在Apple M系列芯片上针对三种MoE模型和四种长上下文工作负载的实验表明，NPUMoE相比基线方案可实现1.32x-5.55x延迟降低、1.81x-7.37x能效提升以及1.78x-5.54x CPU周期减少。
AI.conclusion: 通过有效的NPU卸载策略，NPUMoE成功突破了NPUs在MoE推理中的三大挑战，为Apple Silicon上的高效MoE部署提供了可行的解决方案。

title: RARE: Redundancy-Aware Retrieval Evaluation Framework for High-Similarity Corpora
summary: Existing QA benchmarks typically assume distinct documents with minimal overlap, yet real-world retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems operate on corpora such as financial reports, legal codes, and patents, where information is highly redundant and documents exhibit strong inter-document similarity. This mismatch undermines evaluation validity: retrievers can be unfairly undervalued even when they retrieve documents that provide sufficient evidence, because redundancy across documents is not accounted for in evaluation. On the other hand, retrievers that perform well on standard benchmarks often generalize poorly to real-world corpora with highly similar and redundant documents. We present RARE (Redundancy-Aware Retrieval Evaluation), a framework for constructing realistic benchmarks by (i) decomposing documents into atomic facts to enable precise redundancy tracking and (ii) enhancing LLM-based data generation with CRRF. RAG benchmark data usually requires multiple quality criteria, but LLMs often yield trivial outputs. CRRF scores criteria separately and fuses decisions by rank, improving the reliability of generated data. Applying RARE to Finance, Legal, and Patent corpora, we introduce RedQA, where a strong retriever baseline drops from 66.4% PerfRecall@10 on 4-hop General-Wiki to 5.0-27.9% PerfRecall@10 at 4-hop depth, revealing robustness gaps that current benchmarks fail to capture. RARE enables practitioners to build domain-specific RAG evaluations that faithfully reflect real-world deployment conditions.

AI.tldr: RARE通过原子事实分解和CRRF评分融合机制解决RAG评估中的文档冗余问题，构建的RedQA基准显示现有检索器在高冗余真实场景下性能大幅下降（66.4%→5.0-27.9%）。
AI.motivation: 现有QA基准假设文档之间重叠最小且差异明显，但实际RAG系统（如金融报告、法律条文、专利等）信息高度冗余，文档间相似性强。这种不匹配导致：(1) 检索器因冗余未被考虑而被不公平低估；(2) 在标准基准上表现良好的检索器在真实冗余语料上泛化差。
AI.method: 提出CRRF方法，通过分别评分多个质量标准并通过排名融合决策来解决LLM生成数据中的平凡输出问题；通过将文档分解为原子事实实现精确的冗余追踪。
AI.result: 在Finance、Legal、Patent三个语料上构建RedQA基准，强基线检索器从4-hop General-Wiki的66.4% PerfRecall@10下降至4-hop深度下的5.0-27.9%，揭示了当前基准无法捕获的鲁棒性差距。
AI.conclusion: RARE框架使从业者能够构建领域特定的RAG评估，真实反映实际部署条件，填补了当前基准无法捕捉检索器在冗余文档环境中鲁棒性差距的空白。

title: ReaLB: Real-Time Load Balancing for Multimodal MoE Inference
summary:
Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures are widely used in modern large language models and multimodal models. However, inference efficiency is often limited by highly dynamic and skewed expert workloads across different modalities. During the prefill stage with large batch sizes, vision tokens frequently dominate the input sequences. Under expert parallelism (EP), this leads to severe load imbalance, where a subset of devices becomes overloaded, reducing overall system throughput.
  We propose ReaLB, a real-time load balancing method for multimodal MoE (MMoE) inference that introduces zero scheduling overhead. ReaLB dynamically adjusts the computation precision of MoE experts at runtime on a per-EP-rank basis. For ranks dominated by vision-heavy experts, ReaLB assigns lower-precision computation to improve execution efficiency by exploiting FP4 Tensor Cores. ReaLB does not require redundant experts or additional memory allocation. Instead, it performs layer-wise expert precision transformation on the fly and hides the associated overhead within the dispatch phase before MoE computation. Experiments on representative MMoE models show that ReaLB achieves 1.29x layer-level speedup while limiting accuracy loss to within 1.2%.

AI.tldr: ReaLB是一种针对多模态MoE推理的实时负载均衡方法，通过动态调整不同EP rank上专家的计算精度来平衡负载，利用FP4低精度计算加速视觉密集型rank，同时将精度转换开销隐藏在dispatch阶段。该方法无需冗余专家即可实现1.29倍加速，精度损失小于1.2%。
AI.motivation: 在多模态MoE（MMoE）推理中，不同模态的专家负载高度动态且分布不均，特别是在大batch size的prefill阶段，视觉token主导输入序列，导致在专家并行（EP）下出现严重的负载不均衡问题，使得部分设备过载而降低整体系统吞吐量。
AI.method: ReaLB在运行时动态调整MoE专家的计算精度，采用逐EP-rank的策略：对于视觉负载重的rank分配低精度计算（利用FP4 Tensor Cores），同时在dispatch阶段内隐藏精度转换的开销，实现layer-wise的即时专家精度变换。
AI.result: 在代表性MMoE模型上，ReaLB实现了1.29倍的layer-level加速，同时将精度损失控制在1.2%以内。
AI.conclusion: ReaLB通过动态调整MoE专家的计算精度，在不需要冗余专家或额外内存分配的情况下，实现了显著的推理加速，同时将精度损失控制在可接受范围内。

title: Systematic Detection of Energy Regression and Corresponding Code Patterns in Java Projects
summary: Green software engineering is emerging as a crucial response to information technology's rising energy impact, especially in continuous development. However, there remain challenges in devising automated methods for identifying energy regressions across commits and their associated code change patterns. In particular, little effort has been put into automatically detecting regressions at the commit level by identifying statistically significant changes in energy consumption. In this paper, we introduce EnergyTrackr, an approach designed to detect energy regressions across multiple commits that can then be used to identify code anti-patterns potentially contributing to the increase of software energy consumption over time. We describe our empirical evaluation, including repository mining and source code analysis, made on 3,232 commits from three Java projects, and show the approach's ability to identify significant energy changes. We also highlight recurring anti-patterns such as missing early exits or costly dependency upgrades. We expect EnergyTrackr to assist developers in accurately monitoring energy regressions and improvements within their projects, identifying code anti-patterns, and helping them optimize their source code to reduce software energy consumption.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EnergyTrackr工具，通过对3个Java项目共3,232次提交进行仓库挖掘和源码分析，自动检测代码中的能源回归问题，并识别导致能耗增加的代码反模式（如缺少早期退出或代价高昂的依赖升级），帮助开发者优化代码以降低软件能耗。
AI.motivation: 信息技术对环境的能源影响日益严重，绿色软件工程成为重要应对策略。然而，目前缺乏在提交级别自动检测能源回归的方法，难以识别导致软件能耗随时间增加的代码变更模式。
AI.method: 研究者提出EnergyTrackr方法，对3个Java项目共3,232次提交进行仓库挖掘和源码分析，通过统计方法识别能耗的显著变化，并归纳导致能耗增加的反模式。
AI.result: 实验结果表明EnergyTrackr能够有效识别显著的能耗变化，并发现了一些常见的代码反模式，如缺少早期退出（missing early exits）和代价高昂的依赖升级（costly dependency upgrades）。
AI.conclusion: EnergyTrackr可帮助开发者精确监控项目中的能源回归和改进情况，识别代码反模式，从而优化源码以降低软件能耗。

title: LegalBench-BR: A Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models on Brazilian Legal Decision Classification
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure. Preprint. First public benchmark for Brazilian legal text classification. Dataset and model available on Hugging Face
summary: We introduce LegalBench-BR, the first public benchmark for evaluating language models on Brazilian legal text classification. The dataset comprises 3,105 appellate proceedings from the Santa Catarina State Court (TJSC), collected via the DataJud API (CNJ) and annotated across five legal areas through LLM-assisted labeling with heuristic validation. On a class-balanced test set, BERTimbau-LoRA, updating only 0.3% of model parameters, achieves 87.6% accuracy and 0.87 macro-F1 (+22pp over Claude 3.5 Haiku, +28pp over GPT-4o mini). The gap is most striking on administrativo (administrative law): GPT-4o mini scores F1 = 0.00 and Claude 3.5 Haiku scores F1 = 0.08 on this class, while the fine-tuned model reaches F1 = 0.91. Both commercial LLMs exhibit a systematic bias toward civel (civil law), absorbing ambiguous classes rather than discriminating them, a failure mode that domain-adapted fine-tuning eliminates. These results demonstrate that general-purpose LLMs cannot substitute for domain-adapted models in Brazilian legal classification, even when the task is a simple 5-class problem, and that LoRA fine-tuning on a consumer GPU closes the gap at zero marginal inference cost. We release the full dataset, model, and pipeline to enable reproducible research in Portuguese legal NLP.

AI.tldr: LegalBench-BR 是首个面向巴西法律文本分类的公开基准：包含 3,105 件圣卡塔琳娜州法院（TJSC）上诉案件，经 LLM 辅助标注划分为 5 个法律领域。在类别平衡的测试集上，仅微调 0.3% 参数的 BERTimbau-LoRA 达到 87.6% 准确率与 0.87 宏 F1，显著优于 Claude 3.5 Haiku（+22pp）和 GPT-4o mini（+28pp）。
AI.motivation: 通用大语言模型在葡萄牙语法律文本理解上存在系统性缺陷：既缺少巴西法律体系的领域知识与法条概念（如行政法领域的职权、程序合法性等判定标准），又倾向于将模糊样本归入多数/常见类别（尤其倾向于偏向 civel 民事法），而非真正区分类别。此外，法律 NLP 领域长期缺乏公开、可复现的巴西本地语言基准。论文试图检验的核心假设是：即便是仅 5 类的简单分类任务，通用闭源 LLM 也无法替代领域适配模型，而低成本参数高效微调即可弥合差距。
AI.method:
1) 数据构建：通过 CNJ 的 DataJud API 采集 TJSC 3,105 件上诉程序文书，覆盖五个法律领域（administrativo、civel 等）；采用 LLM 辅助标注并配合启发式规则校验以保证标签质量；构建类别平衡的测试集以排除多数类主导带来的虚高指标。
2) 模型：以葡萄牙语预训练模型 BERTimbau 为骨干，使用 LoRA 仅更新约 0.3% 的参数（消费级 GPU 可训练）；推理阶段无需额外成本。
3) 对比：将微调模型与商业通用 LLM（Claude 3.5 Haiku、GPT-4o mini）在相同任务与相同数据上进行基准比较，按类报告准确率、宏 F1 及逐类别表现。
4) 开源：完整释放数据集、模型权重与标注流水线，支持可复现研究。
AI.result: BERTimbau-LoRA 在平衡测试集上取得 87.6% 准确率、0.87 宏 F1，分别比 Claude 3.5 Haiku 高 22 个百分点、比 GPT-4o mini 高 28 个百分点。差距在 administrativo（行政法）类别上最为突出：GPT-4o mini 的 F1 = 0.00，Claude 3.5 Haiku 的 F1 = 0.08，而微调模型达到 F1 = 0.91。误差分析显示两个商业 LLM 存在系统性偏置——过度倾向 civel（民事法），将模糊/困难样本吸收进该类而非真正判别；该失效模式在领域适配微调后被消除。LoRA 微调在消费级 GPU 上即可完成，且带来零边际推理开销。
AI.conclusion: 通用大语言模型无法胜任巴西法律文本分类这一看似简单的 5 类任务：闭源商用模型因领域知识缺失与类别偏置（尤其行政法类别的近乎完全失败）表现远低于领域适配模型。基于本土预训练模型的 LoRA 参数高效微调以极小的参数更新量（0.3%）和零边际推理成本弥合了与最强通用 LLM 的差距，并消除了其系统性偏置。因此，面向葡萄牙语法律场景的落地路径应优先采用领域适配微调模型，而非直接依赖通用闭源 LLM；LegalBench-BR 的开源为葡语法律 NLP 提供了可复现的评测基础。

title: Reasoning Structure Matters for Safety Alignment of Reasoning Models
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) achieve strong performance on complex reasoning tasks but often generate harmful responses to malicious user queries. This paper investigates the underlying cause of these safety risks and shows that the issue lies in the reasoning structure itself. Based on this insight, we claim that effective safety alignment can be achieved by altering the reasoning structure. We propose AltTrain, a simple yet effective post training method that explicitly alters the reasoning structure of LRMs. AltTrain is both practical and generalizable, requiring no complex reinforcement learning (RL) training or reward design, only supervised finetuning (SFT) with a lightweight 1K training examples. Experiments across LRM backbones and model sizes demonstrate strong safety alignment, along with robust generalization across reasoning, QA, summarization, and multilingual setting.

AI.tldr: 本文针对大推理模型(LRMs)在面对恶意查询时产生有害响应的问题，提出安全风险的根源在于推理结构本身，并据此开发了AltTrain方法——一种通过改变推理结构实现安全对齐的后训练方法，仅需约1000个样本的有监督微调，无需强化学习或奖励设计，即可在多种模型和任务上实现强鲁棒的安全对齐。
AI.motivation: 大推理模型在复杂推理任务上表现优异，但面对恶意用户查询时容易生成有害响应，这是一个严重的安全隐患，亟需有效的安全对齐方法。
AI.method: 本文提出AltTrain方法，核心思想是通过改变推理模型内部的推理结构来实现安全对齐。具体采用轻量化有监督微调(SFT)，仅需约1000个训练样本，无需复杂的强化学习(RL)训练或奖励设计。
AI.result: 实验表明，AltTrain在多种LMR backbone和不同模型规模上均展现出强安全对齐能力，同时保持了良好的泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: AltTrain方法证明了推理结构本身是影响大推理模型安全性的关键因素，通过显式改变推理结构可有效实现安全对齐。该方法具有实用性强、通用性好的优点，为大模型安全对齐提供了新思路。

title: HELM: Harness-Enhanced Long-horizon Memory for Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models fail systematically on long-horizon manipulation tasks despite strong short-horizon performance. We show that this failure is not resolved by extending context length alone in the current reactive execution setting; instead, it stems from three recurring execution-loop deficiencies: the memory gap, the verification gap, and the recovery gap. We present HELM, a model-agnostic framework that addresses these deficiencies with three components: an Episodic Memory Module (EMM) that retrieves key task history via CLIP-indexed keyframes, a learned State Verifier (SV) that predicts action failure before execution from observation, action, subgoal, and memory-conditioned context, and a Harness Controller (HC) that performs rollback and replanning. The SV is the core learning contribution: it consistently outperforms rule-based feasibility checks and ensemble uncertainty baselines, and its effectiveness depends critically on access to episodic memory. On LIBERO-LONG, HELM improves task success rate by 23.1 percentage points over OpenVLA (58.4% to 81.5%), while extending the context window to H=32 yields only a 5.4-point gain and same-budget LoRA adaptation remains 12.2 points below HELM. HELM also improves long-horizon performance on CALVIN and substantially boosts recovery success under controlled perturbations. Ablations and mechanism analyses isolate the contribution of each component, and we release LIBERO-Recovery as a perturbation-injection protocol for evaluating failure recovery in long-horizon manipulation.

AI.tldr: VLA模型在长时程操作任务中失败，根源在于执行循环的三大缺陷（记忆缺口、验证缺口、恢复缺口）。本文提出HELM框架，通过情景记忆模块、状态验证器和控制器的组合，在LIBERO-LONG上将成功率从58.4%提升至81.5%，显著优于单纯扩展上下文窗口或LoRA微调的方法。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在短时程任务表现良好，但在长时程任务中系统性失败。现有方法（如扩展上下文长度）在反应式执行模式下无法解决此问题，亟需新框架系统性地弥补执行循环中的缺陷。
AI.method: 提出HELM框架，包含三个核心组件：1）情景记忆模块(EMM)：通过CLIP索引关键帧检索任务历史；2）状态验证器(SV)：在学习状态下预测动作失败，综合考虑观测、动作、子目标与记忆条件化上下文；3）控制器(HC)：执行回滚和重规划。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-LONG上，HELM将OpenVLA成功率从58.4%提升至81.5%（+23.1pp）；单独扩展上下文至H=32仅提升5.4pp；同预算LoRA适配仍落后HELM 12.2pp。SV模块显著优于基于规则的可行性检查和集成不确定性方法，且其效果关键依赖情景记忆访问。实验还覆盖CALVIN长时程任务及受控扰动下的恢复场景。
AI.conclusion: 长时程任务失败的核心在于执行循环缺陷而非上下文长度限制。情景记忆与可学习的失败预测是提升VLA模型鲁棒性和任务完成率的关键，LIBERO-Recovery可作为标准化的扰动恢复评测协议。

title: IndiaFinBench: An Evaluation Benchmark for Large Language Model Performance on Indian Financial Regulatory Text
comment: 24 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables. Dataset and evaluation code at https://github.com/rajveerpall/IndiaFinBench
summary: We introduce IndiaFinBench, to our knowledge the first publicly available evaluation benchmark for assessing large language model (LLM) performance on Indian financial regulatory text. Existing financial NLP benchmarks draw exclusively from Western financial corpora (SEC filings, US earnings reports, and English-language financial news), leaving a significant gap in coverage of non-Western regulatory frameworks. IndiaFinBench addresses this gap with 406 expert-annotated question-answer pairs drawn from 192 documents sourced from the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) and the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), spanning four task types: regulatory interpretation (174 items), numerical reasoning (92 items), contradiction detection (62 items), and temporal reasoning (78 items). Annotation quality is validated through a model-based secondary pass (kappa=0.918 on contradiction detection) and a 60-item human inter-annotator agreement evaluation (kappa=0.611; 76.7% overall agreement). We evaluate twelve models under zero-shot conditions, with accuracy ranging from 70.4% (Gemma 4 E4B) to 89.7% (Gemini 2.5 Flash). All models substantially outperform a non-specialist human baseline of 60.0%. Numerical reasoning is the most discriminative task, with a 35.9 percentage-point spread across models. Bootstrap significance testing (10,000 resamples) reveals three statistically distinct performance tiers. The dataset, evaluation code, and all model outputs are available at https://github.com/rajveerpall/IndiaFinBench

AI.tldr: IndiaFinBench是首个用于评估大语言模型在印度金融监管文本上性能的公开基准数据集，包含406个专家标注的问答对，涵盖监管解释、数值推理、矛盾检测和时间推理四种任务类型，来源为印度证券交易委员会和印度储备银行的文件。
AI.motivation: 现有金融NLP基准数据集均源自西方金融语料库（如SEC文件、美国财报等），缺乏对非西方监管框架的覆盖，特别是印度这一重要新兴市场的金融监管文本评估。
AI.method: 从SEBI和RBI的192份文件中提取406个问答对，分为四类任务；通过基于模型的二次标注验证和60条人工标注一致性评估确保标注质量。
AI.result: 十二个模型在零样本条件下的准确率从70.4%（Gemma 4 E4B）到89.7%（Gemini 2.5 Flash）不等，均显著超越非专业人类基线（60.0%）；数值推理任务最具区分度（模型间差距达35.9个百分点）；Bootstrap显著性检验揭示三个性能层级。
AI.conclusion: IndiaFinBench成功填补了非西方金融监管NLP评估的空白，为多语言和区域化金融AI研究提供了标准化评估框架。

title: FEPLB: Exploiting Copy Engines for Nearly Free MoE Load Balancing in Distributed Training
summary:
Fine-grained, per-micro-batch load balancing is essential for efficient Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) training, yet every prior dynamic scheduling scheme pays for it with extra communication that is hard to hide. Especially on modern bulk-transfer backends such as DeepEP. We make a simple but consequential observation: on the NVIDIA Hopper architecture the NVLink Copy Engine can move data between intra-node GPUs without consuming any SM cycles, effectively providing a nearly free communication channel that runs in parallel with compute kernels. FEPLB turns this idle hardware into a new parallel dimension for MoE load rebalancing. Its Two-Phase Dispatch first routes tokens across nodes via the standard EP backend, then redistributes dynamic-expert tokens and weights within the NVLink domain through the Copy Engine at nearly zero cost, while a lightweight CPU scheduler runs concurrently with static expert computation. Because FEPLB uses only Copy Engine and CPU that are orthogonal to those consumed by EP and PP, it coexists with existing parallel strategies without reconfiguration.
  On GLM-5's MoE layers (128 experts, no auxiliary loss, up to 16 H100 GPUs), FEPLB reduces the token straggler by 51-70% and the GEMM straggler by 50-68% with no measurable EP communication overhead. Its advantage grows with the EP degree: at EP=8, it achieves 2x lower token straggler than FasterMoE.

AI.tldr: FEPLB 提出把 MoE 动态负载均衡当作一个与 EP/PP 正交的新并行维度：利用 Hopper 架构上不占用 SM 的 NVLink Copy Engine 在节点内以近乎零成本重分配 token 与专家权重，配合 CPU 侧贪心调度器与静态专家计算并行执行，从而在不改动现有并行配置、不增加 EP 通信开销的前提下显著降低 token/GEMM straggler。
AI.motivation: MoE 训练中，路由结果按 micro-batch 随机波动，导致各 EP 设备负载严重不均，同步训练下每个 MoE 层平均浪费 18.6% 的 GPU 时间。现有缓解手段各有缺陷：辅助均衡损失会限制 router 表达力、损害模型质量；接受不均衡则浪费算力；Tutel/SmartMoE 切换预定义并行配置需切分专家权重并引入额外通信；FasterMoE 的 shadow expert + 流水 dispatch 会把 Grouped GEMM 拆成更小的 per-expert kernel、降低 GPU 利用率，且基于预测的调度在路由模式变化时退化；Triton Distributed 融合计算与通信会占用 SM 资源。更深层的问题是 DeepEP/FUSCO 等现代批量传输后端不支持分阶段投递，使得基于"通信分阶段 + 流水重叠"的重平衡方案反而增加通信量。作者的核心观察是：Hopper 上 NVLink Copy Engine 走独立硬件数据通路，不消耗任何 SM 周期，可与计算 kernel 完全并行，等于提供了一条"几乎免费"的节点内通信通道。
AI.method: 核心设计原则是资源级分离（resource-level separation），使动态均衡与 EP/PP 正交：EP 通信不受影响（不增加跨节点流量或 NIC 争用）、PP 调度不变（仅在单个 MoE 层内操作）、所有再均衡通信必须 SM-free。FEPLB 使用两阶段调度（Two-Phase Dispatch）：Phase 1 通过标准 EP 后端（如 DeepEP）按原路径分发静态专家 token，并把动态专家 token 从整个 EP 域收集到本地 NVLink 域并做 permute；Phase 2 用 NVLink Copy Engine（约 900 GB/s 双向）在 NVLink 域内从过载设备向欠载设备重分配动态专家的 token 并拷贝专家权重，全程零 SM 占用；最后 Combine 把结果返回源设备。系统分两个时间尺度：宏层的 Router Predictor 在 checkpoint 时基于历史路由统计周期性优化专家到设备的放置，以摊销迁移开销；微层每个 micro-batch 将专家划分为静态（始终本地）与动态（可被复制）两类，由参数 dyn 控制（128 专家、EP=8 时每卡 16 个，dyn=4 即 4 动态 + 12 静态）。时间线上，GPU 先算静态专家，CPU 专用线程上的贪心负载均衡器（反复选择最过载设备上最繁忙的动态专家，把其权重与 token 整体迁到最欠载设备，受最小 token 阈值 τ 约束）同步决策并向专用 CUDA stream 发出拷贝命令，使均衡与权重拷贝完全隐藏于静态专家计算窗口内（约 50 μs 完成）。整体迁移单个专家而非切分 token，以避免 Grouped GEMM per-expert batch 变小而落入 memory-bound 区间，同时保证各设备可独立确定性地推导出相同的拷贝计划、无需协调。内存开销为每设备 max_num_dyn × W_expert（GLM-5 单专家 72 MiB，max_num_dyn=8 时 576 MiB，<0.7% 的 80 GB HBM3），跨所有 MoE 层复用。由于每个 token 仍由同一专家以相同权重计算，权重重分配保持 MoE 语义精确。适用范围受当前 NVLink 拓扑限制，但在 GB200 NVL72 等全 NVLink 互连的 SuperPod 上 Phase 2 可覆盖整个 EP 组。
AI.result: 实验环境为最多 16 张 H100 SXM5（NVLink 4.0 900 GB/s，节点间 400 Gbps IB），基线为 Megatron-LM MoE + DeepEP + Transformer Engine + 多流 cuBLAS Grouped GEMM，模型为 GLM-5 的 18 层缩减版（128 个路由专家、top-k、无辅助损失），对比 Before LB、FasterMoE（pipe=1/2，且用 SM-free NVLink CE + DeepEP 公平重实现）、Triton Distributed、Tutel。指标为 token straggler（max T_d - mean T_d）与 GEMM straggler（max G_d - mean G_d）。主要结果：(1) 每层执行时间：FEPLB 一致优于或持平所有基线；Triton Distributed 前向比基线慢 1.6–3.3 倍，Tutel 后向因权重切分通信增加 15–16% 开销；在 PP=2/EP=8 下前向从 6.9 ms 降至 6.0 ms（−13%），后向从 12.5 ms 降至 10.6 ms（−15%）；在 PP=4/EP=2 时前向与 FasterMoE 持平（7.9 ms），但后向略高（14.4 vs 14.0 ms），因低 EP 下每卡 64 个专家、整专家迁移的再均衡粒度受限。(2) EP 通信开销：FasterMoE pipe=2 额外增加 46.8% dispatch 与 40.2% combine 时间，验证了分阶段投递在 DeepEP 上不可行的论断；FEPLB 开销 <1%。(3) 负载均衡质量：token straggler 降低 51–70%，GEMM straggler 降低 50–68%；趋势相反——FasterMoE 随 EP 增大从 −55% 退化到 −39%（预测在稀疏路由下失效），FEPLB 从 −51% 提升到 −70%；EP=8 时 FEPLB 的 token straggler（2021 vs 4036）与 GEMM straggler（0.352 vs 0.625 ms）分别比 FasterMoE 低 2× 和 1.8×。(4) 参数敏感性：dyn=2 已能获得大部分收益，dyn 从 2→4、4→8 各只再增加 1–3 个百分点，dyn=4 为实用默认值。
AI.conclusion: FEPLB 证明通过利用现有框架闲置的硬件资源（NVLink Copy Engine + CPU），可以把 MoE 条件计算的动态调度开销基本消除，并把动态负载均衡确立为一个与 EP/PP 正交的新并行维度；Two-Phase Dispatch 在不触碰 EP 跨节点通信模式、不改变并行配置的前提下实现节点内再均衡，并保持 MoE 语义精确、支持完全无辅助损失的训练。主要局限是目前只做整专家迁移而不做 token 级切分，导致低 EP 场景下再均衡粒度受限。

title: Towards Formalising Stakeholder Context using SysML v2
comment: Accepted for presentation at the 2026 INCOSE International Symposium, Yokohama, Japan
summary: This paper presents a framework to bridge the gap between subjective stakeholder context and formal system architecture. This is achieved using Soft Systems Methodology (SSM) and Systems Modelling Language version 2 (SysML v2). The methodology utilises the precision of Kernel Modelling Language (KerML) and the alignment of SysML v2 with ISO 42010 to define a reference architecture for the mapping of SSM outputs to SysML v2 concepts such as stakeholders and concerns. Application of the framework is demonstrated through the use of a case study, highlighting the traceable path from stakeholder context to system architecture. The structured mapping and increased semantic precision of SysML v2 are anticipated to reduce the risk of misinterpretation compared to less formal approaches, though empirical validation across diverse stakeholder contexts remains as future work. The primary identified trade-off is the increased barrier to entry associated with SysML v2's textual notation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个参考架构，将软系统方法论（SSM）的产出——特别是CATWOE根定义要素——系统化地映射为SysML v2（KerML）元素（stakeholder、concern、viewpoint、use case、requirement/constraint、individual、metadata等），并以“新员工工具许可分配”案例演示从主观利益相关者情境到形式化系统架构的可追溯路径，以降低MBSE“解决错误问题”的风险；主要代价是SysML v2文本标记法提高了入门门槛。
AI.motivation: 硬系统工程（如MBSE）对含混需求施加严格逻辑，容易“正确地解决错误的问题”（Mitroff & Featheringham, 1974），而SSM擅长通过利益相关者视角构建系统情境却缺乏形式化语言。历史做法是用SysML v1建模，其源自UML的软件中心语义、模糊标准与不精确实现带来实施不一致（Morkevicius等）；UAF等框架虽规定高层关系但缺乏向建模过渡的程序，翻译过程交由个人裁量。SysML v2通过专用元语言KerML、文本标记法、metadata、需求即约束等机制提升了语义精度，且其与ISO 42010的对齐使stakeholder/concern/viewpoint天然适合承载SSM输出，但目前仍缺少“用SysML v2概念捕获情境”的标准化方法，构成显著研究空白。
AI.method: 采用两阶段方法：阶段一为SSM建模（1对1访谈→基于POPIT（People, Organisation, Processes, Information, Technology）设计问题集以降低情境丢失/误读风险→协作迭代式丰富图片→根定义RD与CATWOE→概念模型CM与监视-控制子系统）；阶段二为参考架构映射：以ISO 42010为中介，对SysML v2元模型相关概念做本体化解读，并建立映射表——Customer/Owner→Individual as Stakeholder、Actor→Individual as Actor、Transformation→Use Case、Worldview→Viewpoint（含Rationale）、Environmental Constraints→Requirement with Constraint。细化建模规则：个体先建individual definition再建occurrence以支持feature typing与redefinition，局部actor usage以subsetting（:>）关联高层usage以保持可追溯；环境约束采用require/assume/assert三类constraint（选require表示系统需求条件）；Transformation用use case表达高层意图、其内嵌action表达步骤，subject为part或item，输入输出用item/reference usage与binding、assign action表达；结构性行为用part内state与guard表达；需求以constraint形式为concern（Concern→Requirement→Use Case objective）建立追溯链；架构视图用view（expose/filter/render）配合viewpoint满足，metadata（含Rationale与自定义CATWOE枚举标签）支持查询过滤。建模工具为CATIA Magic System of Solutions Architect 2026x（并配套GitHub参考架构模板）。
AI.result: 案例（基于对一位管理者的一对一访谈所绘制丰富图片的匿名片段：新员工入职需工具权限，IT分配许可）生成了根定义“由IT拥有、为管理者解决工作请求的系统，在岗位说明书与许可容量约束下，将可用许可分配给正确工具的新员工”，并据此识别CATWOE（Customer=Manager；Actors=IT与Manager；Transformation=分配正确工具的可用许可；Worldview=新员工应获得适当访问并记录许可可用性；Owner=IT；约束=岗位说明书与许可可用性）。随后在SysML v2中完成：个体建模（定义Employee、usage重定义name属性、metadata标注CATWOE角色、Concern“Resources: OwnerConcern”、IT的stakeholder usage subsetting occurrence“it”）；系统结构（Role/Tool/License的part definition与usage、reference part [0..1]、License容量与分配量的derived属性以驱动guard）；环境约束（EC1/EC2 requirement definitions，EC2用require约束刻画许可可用性）；视点（licenseManagement : ResourceAllocation，Worldview以Rationale metadata承载）；Transformation用use case（AssignLicense，subject由“roleA_NewHire”subsetting填充）以及包transformationSystem的part承载完整流程，含decision分支（message输出与assign action改变属性）。结论发现：文本标记法显著提升精确建模与可追溯性，特性类型化与重定义成为自然实践；但文本规模增长后需依赖图形视图维持整体认知，对经验不足者构成门槛（作者预期LLM可缓解：自动生成符合框架的模型元素、自然语言解释、辅助定义复杂视图）；图形表示灵活但存在误示系统结构与行为的风险，进一步说明需要形式化视图定义；SSM流程与参考架构模板产出形式化、可复现的初始系统元素，便于交付给领域专家提高模型准确性。未解决的挑战：系统元素的进一步建模，以及与既有系统模型（尤其由其他框架或无框架构建的模型）的集成。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了将SSM实践与SysML v2结合以形式化利益相关者情境的方法学框架：通过参考架构把CATWOE映射到具体SysML v2元素并以案例验证，情境不再含混，从而提升MBSE模型与上下文沟通的准确性，精度约束成为流程内生要求。主要权衡是SysML v2文本标记法的入门门槛，以及图形视图可能误示系统的风险。作者计划的后续工作包括：探索view的过滤条件与模型查询以支撑特定应用的扩展框架；在SSM协议中加入与形式系统模型（FSM）的对比验证（FSM验证被明确置于本框架范围之外，属ISO 15288中的Verification而非Architecture Definition过程）；针对不同MBSE/SSM经验水平的用户开展案例研究以作为框架的验证与确认（V&V）；详细建模概念模型中的监视-控制回路并探索两个框架模型间的集成；以及跨多样利益相关者情境的实证验证。作者亦指出KerML核心语义仍可能演进，细化定制框架也将反过来服务于KerML/SysML v2的演进。

title: Where Fake Citations Are Made: Tracing Field-Level Hallucination to Specific Neurons in LLMs
summary: LLMs frequently generate fictitious yet convincing citations, often expressing high confidence even when the underlying reference is wrong. We study this failure across 9 models and 108{,}000 generated references, and find that author names fail far more often than other fields across all models and settings. Citation style has no measurable effect, while reasoning-oriented distillation degrades recall. Probes trained on one field transfer at near-chance levels to the others, suggesting that hallucination signals do not generalize across fields. Building on this finding, we apply elastic-net regularization with stability selection to neuron-level CETT values of Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct and identify a sparse set of field-specific hallucination neurons (FH-neurons). Causal intervention further confirms their role: amplifying these neurons increases hallucination, while suppressing them improves performance across fields, with larger gains in some fields. These results suggest a lightweight approach to detecting and mitigating citation hallucination using internal model signals alone.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大语言模型在纯参数记忆下生成参考文献时的幻觉问题，并将其定位到具体字段与神经元层级。核心发现：在9个模型、约10.8万条生成参考文献上，作者名字段错误率远高于其他字段（作者 < 会议 < 标题 ≈ 年份 < DOI），引用格式（8种）对幻觉率无显著影响，推理型蒸馏（DeepSeek-R1-Distill）会显著损害引用召回；针对Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct的线性探针显示各字段的幻觉信号不可跨字段迁移（跨字段AUC仅0.46–0.59，近乎随机）；基于弹性网络+稳定性选择，作者定位出稀疏的字段特异幻觉神经元（FH-neurons，每字段30–224个，占176.9万候选的≤0.013%），因果干预显示放大这些神经元会显著增加幻觉（β=4时各目标字段准确率平均−25.5个百分点），抑制则提升准确率（Title +6.5pp、Authors +6.2pp），且优于随机消融。结论表明，无需外部检索，仅凭模型内部信号即可检测并缓解引用幻觉。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在撰写相关工作与参考文献时常"自信地编造"看似合理的引用：一方面引用是一条结构化复合记录（作者、标题、会议、年份、DOI），各字段可能以不同原因出错；另一方面既有工作多停留在检测/规避层面——事后核验管线（FactScore、SAFE）需每条引用多次API调用且为黑盒，检索增强生成（RAG）依赖外部信息，均无法解释"模型为何会犯此错误"、也未触及内部机制。同时，尽管已有工作发现隐状态中存在线性可解码的真实性信号、且神经元级抑制可降低事实问答错误，但这些工具无法直接迁移到多字段耦合的结构化引用场景；且有研究显示真实性探针跨数据集泛化能力弱，提示内部信号可能按场景分化。因此需要回答三个问题：引用幻觉在不同字段的普遍程度如何？是否在内部表征中以字段特异方式编码？能否通过定向神经元干预降低错误。
AI.method: 论文围绕三个递进问题展开：（1）大规模实证：让9个模型（Qwen2.5-14B/32B-Instruct、Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base/Instruct、Moonlight-16B-A3B、Mistral-Small-24B-Instruct-2501、三个DeepSeek-R1-Distill变体）针对50个计算机科学主题、以8种引用风格（APA/MLA/Chicago/Harvard/Vancouver/IEEE/ACM/AMA）、每次生成N∈{5,10,15}条引用，输出JSON约束的五字段结构，每模型约1.2万条、总计约10.8万条；采用两阶段验证管线——先以OpenAlex REST API两段式检索（DOI直查，否则标题检索取前10候选，按标题相似度/首作者重合/年份接近度匹配）给出逐字段二元标签与全局判定（Supported/Partial/Unsupported），再对Partial/Unsupported引用用带联网检索的GPT-5.4-mini做"有依据的判官"仲裁（该模型不在生成模型之列以避免误差同构），两名专家对200条随机样本复核，与自动判定一致率93%。（2）内部表征探查：在Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct上把每条引用序列化为XML标签文本，用分词器offset mapping映射出字段精确token跨度，逐层（64层）提取该跨度内隐状态作为特征，对每个字段每层独立训练ℓ2正则逻辑回归探针（L-BFGS、类别平衡、1:1下采样、话题级80/20划分以防泄漏），做层-AUC曲线、Spearman趋势、Fisher z两两比较、10,000次置换全局检验与峰值层bootstrap CI，并通过5×5跨字段AUC热图检验信号共享性；在Mistral-Small-24B上复现跨字段迁移。（3）神经元定位与因果干预：定义神经元级CETT贡献 = |a_n|·||W_down[:,n]||₂ / ||y^(ℓ)||₂，通过down-projection前向hook对全部64层计算，每个token得到1,769,472维（64×27,648）特征，按字段跨度取token平均得到每条引用一维特征；采用两阶段筛选——阶段1弹性网络逻辑回归（SGD+近端软阈值，ℓ1比例r=0.8，α网格搜索以AUC与稀疏度复合打分），阶段2稳定性选择（20次50%自助重采样，选择频率>60%且回归权重为正者保留）；用Meinshausen–Bühlmann假发现数界与标签随机置换做零假设校验。最后在down-projection上注册前向pre-hook做激活修补：a_n' = β·a_n，取增强（β=2、4）与抑制（β=0、0.5）条件，并以等数量随机神经元消融作对照（各重复5次，贪心解码），用Wilcoxon符号秩检验做配对统计，另验证JSON schema有效率以排除生成崩坏混淆。
AI.result: 实证层面：作者字段最难（N=15时各模型正确率均<14%），会议次之，标题与年份相近（27–41%），DOI最具模型依赖性（Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct达53.5%，其余17–30%）；顺序效应显著——前两条引用最准，第3条起急剧恶化并趋于平台；引用风格影响可忽略（任意两风格差异<0.04，Kruskal-Wallis全部p>0.05，η²<0.01）；规模与MoE均不能解决作者召回问题（三个模型作者准确率均<14%）；指令微调影响甚微；DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen2.5-14B在N=15总准确率仅0.4%，推理蒸馏以事实记忆换推理结构。探针层面：所有字段在2–4层AUC较高、6–10层下探后分歧；作者从第8层最低0.892升至第46层峰值0.935（Spearman ρ=+0.600），标题单调增强至第64层峰值0.888（ρ=+0.554），DOI稳定在0.878（ρ=+0.763），会议约0.824（ρ=+0.371），年份单调衰减（0.830→0.790，ρ=−0.516）；置换检验p<0.0001，五字段峰值层置信区间四者不重叠。跨字段5×5热图对角AUC 0.812–0.922，非对角仅0.46–0.59，说明各字段幻觉占据结构上彼此独立的表征子空间（Mistral复现显示可解码性可泛化，但字段模块化程度依赖模型）。神经元层面：稳定正权重FH-neurons为Title 224、Year 129、Authors 78、Venue 51、DOI 30个（≤0.013%稀疏度），分布具字段偏倚——作者集中中层（60.3%）、DOI集中早层（66.7%）、标题/年份偏后层（41.5%/46.5%）、会议最分散（跨30层）；标签置乱后无神经元超阈值。干预层面：β=4增强时五个目标字段全部下降（Title 76.3%→4.7%，Authors 17.5%→8.5%，其余降10–21pp，Wilcoxon p=0.031，平均−25.5pp）；β=0抑制时Title +6.5pp、Authors +6.2pp、DOI +0.6pp、Year −2.0pp、Venue −6.1pp（会议目标反而略降，与随机对照持平35.1% vs 35.2%，而β=0.5时恢复至41.1%），相对随机消融在五字段中四字段更优（单侧p=0.062，n=4时，临界未过α=0.05）；随机消融对所有字段造成一致性退化（p=0.031），说明是"非特异性破坏"；JSON有效率基线/抑制100%、增强99.0%、随机对照97.0%。
AI.conclusion: 引用幻觉是一种结构化、可在内部定位的失败：不同字段的失败率不同、由结构性质决定（作者最难），引用格式与指令微调几乎无影响而推理型蒸馏有害；各字段幻觉信号在隐状态中以线性可解码但彼此独立的方式编码（跨字段探针近随机），可通过弹性网络+稳定性选择在百万量级特征空间中定位出稀疏的字段特异幻觉神经元；对这些神经元放大则幻觉激增、抑制则相应字段准确率上升（部分字段存在外溢收益），而随机消融只会普遍破坏生成，证明这些神经元对幻觉具因果作用。由此提出一种轻量方案：仅依赖模型内部信号即可检测并部分缓解引用幻觉，无需外部检索。局限：干预统计仅5个字段、样本量小（p=0.062未达显著），未评估对流畅度影响，探针与神经元定位仅在单一模型（Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct）与50个计算机科学主题上完成，跨架构/跨领域泛化性待验证；干预实验受算力限制仅用2种风格、10个主题、每提示5条引用评估。

title: Preserving Clusters in Error-Bounded Lossy Compression of Particle Data
summary: Lossy compression is widely used to reduce storage and I/O costs for large-scale particle datasets in scientific applications such as cosmology, molecular dynamics, and fluid dynamics, where clustering structures (e.g., single-linkage or Friends-of-Friends) are critical for downstream analysis; however, existing compressors typically provide only pointwise error bounds on particle positions and offer no guarantees on preserving clustering outcomes, and even small perturbations can alter cluster connectivity and compromise scientific validity. We propose a correction-based technique to preserve single-linkage clustering under lossy compression, operating on decompressed data from off-the-shelf compressors such as SZ3 and Draco. Our key contributions are threefold: (1) a clustering-aware correction algorithm that identifies vulnerable particle pairs via spatial partitioning and local neighborhood search; (2) an optimization-based formulation that enforces clustering consistency using projected gradient descent with a loss that encodes pairwise distance violations; and (3) a scalable GPU-accelerated and distributed implementation for large-scale datasets. Experiments on cosmology and molecular dynamics datasets show that our method effectively preserves clustering results while maintaining competitive compression performance compared with SZ3, ZFP, Draco, LCP, and space-filling-curve-based schemes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种校正技术，在解压缩后数据上保持单链接聚类结构。通过空间分区识别脆弱粒子对，利用投影梯度下降优化成对距离约束，并在GPU上实现分布式加速。实验表明该方法在宇宙学和分子动力学数据上有效保留聚类结果且压缩性能具有竞争力。
AI.motivation: 现有有损压缩器仅提供粒子位置的点态误差界，无法保证聚类结果的完整性，而即使微小的扰动也可能改变聚类连通性，损害科学有效性。
AI.method: 提出一种基于校正的技术，保留单链接聚类。首先通过空间分区和局部邻域搜索识别易受影响的粒子对；然后使用投影梯度下降和编码成对距离违规损失的优化公式来强制聚类一致性；最后提供GPU加速和分布式实现以支持大规模数据。
AI.result: 在宇宙学和分子动力学数据集上的实验表明，该方法有效保留了聚类结果，同时保持了与SZ3、ZFP、Draco、LCP和基于空间填充曲线的方案相当的压缩性能。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在保持聚类结果的同时，达到了与SZ3、ZFP、Draco、LCP及基于空间填充曲线的方案相当的压缩性能。

title: Impact of large language models on peer review opinions from a fine-grained perspective: Evidence from top conference proceedings in AI
summary: With the rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs), the academic community has faced unprecedented disruptions, particularly in the realm of academic communication. The primary function of peer review is improving the quality of academic manuscripts, such as clarity, originality and other evaluation aspects. Although prior studies suggest that LLMs are beginning to influence peer review, it remains unclear whether they are altering its core evaluative functions. Moreover, the extent to which LLMs affect the linguistic form, evaluative focus, and recommendation-related signals of peer-review reports has yet to be systematically examined. In this study, we examine the changes in peer review reports for academic articles following the emergence of LLMs, emphasizing variations at fine-grained level. Specifically, we investigate linguistic features such as the length and complexity of words and sentences in review comments, while also automatically annotating the evaluation aspects of individual review sentences. We also use a maximum likelihood estimation method, previously established, to identify review reports that potentially have modified or generated by LLMs. Finally, we assess the impact of evaluation aspects mentioned in LLM-assisted review reports on the informativeness of recommendation for paper decision-making.
