The results indicate that following the emergence of LLMs, peer review texts have become longer and more fluent, with increased emphasis on summaries and surface-level clarity, as well as more standardized linguistic patterns, particularly reviewers with lower confidence score. At the same time, attention to deeper evaluative dimensions, such as originality, replicability, and nuanced critical reasoning, has declined.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统检验了大语言模型对学术同行评审的影响。研究发现LLM导致评审文本更长、更流畅、语言更标准化，但削弱了对原创性、可复现性等深度评估维度的关注。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展，学术交流领域面临前所未有的变革。虽然已有研究表明LLM正在影响同行评审，但学界尚不清楚LLM是否正在改变同行评审的核心评估功能。此外，LLM对评审报告的语言形式、评估重点和推荐相关信号的影响程度尚未得到系统性检验。
AI.method: 研究采用多种方法：1）分析语言特征，包括评论中单词和句子的长度与复杂度；2）自动标注个别评审句子的评估方面；3）使用最大似然估计方法识别可能由LLM修改或生成的评审报告；4）评估LLM辅助评审报告中提到的评估方面对论文决策建议的信息量影响。
AI.result: 研究结果显示：LLM出现后，同行评审文本变得更长、更流畅；评审更强调摘要和表层清晰度；语言模式更加标准化（尤其是置信度较低的评审者）；对深度评估维度的关注（如原创性、可复现性和细致的批判性推理）有所下降。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型的出现导致同行评审文本变得更长、更流畅，评审者更注重摘要和表层清晰度，语言模式更加标准化（尤其是置信度较低的评审者）。与此同时，对深度评估维度的关注（如原创性、可复现性和细致的批判性推理）有所下降。

title: CASCADE: Detecting Inconsistencies between Code and Documentation with Automatic Test Generation
comment: 23 pages, 3 figures. To appear in the proceedings of FSE 2026. Code available at https://github.com/TobiasKiecker/CASCADE/releases/tag/FSE2026-v1.0.0
summary:
Maintaining consistency between code and documentation is a crucial yet frequently overlooked aspect of software development. Even minor mismatches can confuse API users, introduce new bugs, and increase overall maintenance effort. This creates demand for automated solutions that can assist developers in identifying code-documentation inconsistencies. However, since automatic reports still require human confirmation, false positives carry serious consequences: wasting developer time and discouraging practical adoption.
  We introduce CASCADE (Consistency Analysis for Source Code And Documentation through Execution), a novel tool for detecting inconsistencies with a strong emphasis on reducing false positives. CASCADE leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate unit tests directly from natural-language documentation. Since these tests are derived from the documentation, any failure during execution indicates a potential mismatch between the documented and actual behavior of the code. To minimize false positives, CASCADE also generates code from the documentation to cross-check the generated tests. By design, an inconsistency is reported only when two conditions are met: the existing code fails a test, while the code generated from the documentation passes the same test.
  We evaluated CASCADE on a novel dataset of 71 inconsistent and 814 consistent code-documentation pairs drawn from open-source Java projects. Further, we applied CASCADE to additional Java, C#, and Rust repositories, where we uncovered 13 previously unknown inconsistencies, of which 10 have subsequently been fixed, demonstrating both CASCADE's precision and its applicability to real-world codebases.

AI.tldr: CASCADE是一个通过LLM生成单元测试和代码进行交叉验证来检测代码文档不一致的工具，其核心创新在于双重验证机制以降低误报率。
AI.motivation: 代码与文档之间的一致性维护是软件开发中关键但常被忽视的环节。不一致会导致API用户困惑、引入新bug、增加维护成本。虽然自动化检测有需求，但自动报告仍需人工确认，误报会带来严重后果：浪费开发者时间、阻碍工具的实际采用。
AI.method: 利用大语言模型(LLM)从自然语言文档生成单元测试，同时从文档生成代码进行交叉验证。仅当"现有代码测试失败但从文档生成的代码测试通过"这两个条件同时满足时，才报告不一致，从而有效降低误报率。
AI.result: 在来自开源Java项目的71个不一致和814个一致代码-文档对数据集上进行评估；另在Java、C#和Rust仓库中发现13个之前未知的不一致问题，其中10个已被修复。
AI.conclusion: 通过在开源项目中的实际应用，发现13个之前未知的代码文档不一致问题，其中10个已被修复，证明了CASCADE具有良好的精确度和广泛的适用性。

title: Prioritizing the Best: Incentivizing Reliable Multimodal Reasoning by Rewarding Beyond Answer Correctness
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) improves multimodal reasoning by rewarding verifiable final answers. Yet answer-correct trajectories may still rely on incomplete derivations, weak evidence, or statements that contradict their conclusions. This gap between answer correctness and reasoning validity, which we call reasoning-answer inconsistency, motivates trajectory supervision in multimodal RL. We compare two main approaches: reward models (RMs), and Generative Rewards (GRs). RMs are efficient and help early in training, but their gains weaken as the policy distribution shifts; GRs improve performance, but may give unstable rewards and computationally expensive. We therefore propose Groupwise Ranking Reward, which ranks verifier-passed trajectories for the same prompt in one pass and redistributes reward accordingly. Groupwise comparison better separates stronger and weaker correct trajectories with lower judge overhead than GRs. Experiments show that RLVR aggravates reasoning-answer inconsistency, while trajectory supervision alleviates it. Groupwise Ranking Reward performs best overall, improving reliability-conditioned accuracy from 47.4% to 54.7% over RLVR.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多模态推理中强化学习的轨迹监督问题。针对"答案正确但推理无效"的不一致现象，提出Groupwise Ranking Reward方法，通过对同一提示下通过验证器的轨迹进行排序和奖励重新分配，在保持低判断开销的同时提升推理可靠性。
AI.motivation: 多模态推理中存在"推理-答案不一致"问题：答案正确的轨迹可能依赖不完整的推导、弱证据或与结论矛盾的陈述。RLVR虽然奖励可验证的最终答案，但无法保证推理过程的有效性，因此需要轨迹监督来弥补这一差距。
AI.method: 对比两种轨迹监督方法：奖励模型（RMs）效率高但随策略分布偏移效果减弱；生成式奖励（GRs）能提升性能但奖励不稳定且计算开销大。提出Groupwise Ranking Reward：对同一提示下通过验证器的轨迹一次性排序，并相应重新分配奖励。
AI.result: 实验表明RLVR会加剧推理-答案不一致，而轨迹监督可缓解该问题。Groupwise Ranking Reward表现最佳，将可靠性条件下的准确率从RLVR的47.4%提升至54.7%。
AI.conclusion: Groupwise排序比较能更好地区分强弱正确的轨迹，且判断开销低于GRs。该方法在提升推理可靠性方面优于传统RLVR和现有轨迹监督方法。

title: SAVOIR: Learning Social Savoir-Faire via Shapley-based Reward Attribution
summary: Social intelligence, the ability to navigate complex interpersonal interactions, presents a fundamental challenge for language agents. Training such agents via reinforcement learning requires solving the credit assignment problem: determining how individual utterances contribute to multi-turn dialogue outcomes. Existing approaches directly employ language models to distribute episode-level rewards, yielding attributions that are retrospective and lack theoretical grounding. We propose SAVOIR (ShApley Value fOr SocIal RL), a novel principled framework grounded in cooperative game theory. Our approach combines two complementary principles: expected utility shifts evaluation from retrospective attribution to prospective valuation, capturing an utterance's strategic potential for enabling favorable future trajectories; Shapley values ensure fair credit distribution with axiomatic guarantees of efficiency, symmetry, and marginality. Experiments on the SOTOPIA benchmark demonstrate that SAVOIR achieves new state-of-the-art performance across all evaluation settings, with our 7B model matching or exceeding proprietary models including GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet. Notably, even large reasoning models consistently underperform, suggesting social intelligence requires qualitatively different capabilities than analytical reasoning.

AI.tldr: SAVOIR是一个基于合作博弈论的社会强化学习框架，利用Shapley值解决多轮对话中的信用分配问题，在SOTOPIA基准上达到最优性能，7B模型可匹配或超越GPT-4o和Claude-3.5-Sonnet等闭源模型。
AI.motivation: 当前语言智能体在社会交互中面临核心挑战：强化学习训练时难以确定个体话语对多轮对话结果的贡献程度。现有方法直接使用语言模型分发回合级奖励，存在归属追溯性强、理论基础薄弱的问题。
AI.method: SAVOIR框架结合两大互补原则：期望效用将评估从追溯性归因转向前瞻性估值，捕捉话语启用有利未来轨迹的战略潜力；Shapley值通过效率、对称性和边缘性等公理保证实现公平信用分配。
AI.result: 在SOTOPIA基准测试中，SAVOIR在所有评估设置下均达到最优性能，7B模型可匹配或超越GPT-4o、Claude-3.5-Sonnet等闭源模型。
AI.conclusion: 大语言推理模型持续表现欠佳，表明社会智能可能需要与分析推理本质上不同的能力，为该领域后续研究指明方向。

title: A PPA-Driven 3D-IC Partitioning Selection Framework with Surrogate Models
summary: 3D-IC netlist partitioning is commonly optimized using proxy objectives, while final PPA is treated as a costly evaluation rather than an optimization signal. This proxy-driven paradigm makes it difficult to reliably translate additional PPA evaluations into better PPA outcomes. To bridge this gap, we present DOPP (D-Optimal PPA-driven partitioning selection), an approach that bridges the gap between proxies and true PPA metrics. Across eight 3D-IC designs, our framework improves PPA over Open3DBench (average relative improvements of 9.99% congestion, 7.87% routed wirelength, 7.75% WNS, 21.85% TNS, and 1.18% power). Compared with exhaustive evaluation over the full candidate set, DOPP achieves comparable best-found PPA while evaluating only a small fraction of candidates, substantially reducing evaluation cost. By parallelizing evaluations, our method delivers these gains while maintaining wall-clock runtime comparable to traditional baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DOPP（D-Optimal PPA-driven Partitioning selection）：一个面向 3D-IC 网表划分（netlist partitioning）的 PPA 驱动候选选择框架。它先用模拟退火 + 网格化代理空间 Pareto 档案生成代理指标多样化的候选集，再用 D-最优设计（D-optimal design）挑选一个信息量大的小规模核心集（coreset）做昂贵 PPA 评估，用加权最小二乘拟合"局部代理模型"（线性回归）对全部候选排序，再验证 top-10 预测候选，最终在所有已评估候选中选出最优 PPA 解。八个 Open3DBench 设计上相比 Open3DBench 平均改善：拥塞 9.99%、布线线长 7.87%、WNS 7.75%、TNS 21.85%、功耗 1.18%；与全量穷举评估相比，PPA 质量接近但仅评估了候选集的一小部分，墙钟时间与基线相当（靠并行）。
AI.motivation: 3D-IC 设计流程中，网表划分通常以割边（cut size）、面积均衡等代理目标优化，而真正的 PPA（性能/功耗/面积）仅在末端作为"昂贵的验证"被动获取，导致"加大计算预算"只能稳定改善代理空间，无法可靠转化为 PPA 收益。已有机器学习/代理模型方法受限于标注数据稀缺、芯片数据复杂度高和跨设计差异大，泛化不可靠。同时精确求解 D-最优设计是 NP-难的，工程上需要可在有限评估预算下工作的选择策略。核心问题：如何分配少量昂贵的 PPA 评估，使额外算力能一致地转化为 PPA 改进？
AI.method: 框架基于 Open3DBench 的开源 3D 后端工具链（memory-on-logic，逻辑单元固定在底层，存储块分配到两层），分两阶段：(1) 多样化候选集生成——在模拟退火搜索过程中维护基于网格的代理空间 Pareto 档案，代理目标做对数归一化后离散到固定 2D 网格，每格最多保留一个非支配代表解，因此既保留前沿也保留被代理支配但 PPA 可能很强的候选；(2) 局部代理模型与 D-最优设计——PPA 质量用 min-max 归一化后取 ℓ2 范数构成复合代价 S_PPA，特征 φ(c) 含 7 个代理统计特征（割边/总网络数、两层面积差比、存储块数差比、割边度数的 min/max/mean/std）与层级凝聚特征（每个逻辑层次 cluster 的下层凝聚度 coh(h)=[S_h·M_{h,1}+C(M_{h,1},2)]/[S_h·M_h+C(M_h,2)]），维度 d 远小于 N。求解 D-最优设计的非负权重 ω(c)（Σω=1），取权重超过阈值 T 的候选构成核心集 K(T)，对 K(T) 做加权最小二乘得到 θ̂，用 φ(c)ᵀθ̂ 预测并排序全部候选；因小误差会打乱近优解排序，额外评估 top-10 预测候选（K=10），最终在核心集 ∪ 预测 top-10 中选最优者。阈值 T 为超参（多数设计取 1e-2，bp_quad 取 5e-3），评估可在 HPC 上并行。
AI.result: 在 Open3DBench 全部 8 个设计上，DOPP 相对 Open3DBench 基线平均改善 Cong 9.99%、rWL 7.87%、WNS 7.75%、TNS 21.85%、功耗 1.18%。相对"穷举 oracle"（评估全部候选），DOPP 以远少的评估次数（例：bp_quad 25 次 vs 492 次；ariane133 20 次 vs 258 次）取得接近或更好的 PPA（如 bp_multi 上拥塞 0.113 vs 穷举 0.114），墙钟时间与基线持平而总 CPU 时间显著降低。代理-错位假设被验证：网格档案候选数（257）远多于纯 Pareto 前沿（47），且大量 PPA 最优候选位于代理前沿之后。代理模型质量：多数设计真实 top-1 未被预测命中，但真实 top-10 多数落入 surrogate top-10（ariane136 命中 6 个，bp_multi 命中 3 个；swerv_wrapper 全不命中）；候选集规模从 101→916 增大时 Pred@10 由 7 个降至 1 个，说明固定特征表达力不足是主要瓶颈，而同时集内最优 PPA 变好。阈值实验表明核心集越大，Eval@10（已评估集合覆盖真实 top-10 的比例）越好，但 Pred@10 不单调（bp_be、bp_quad 反而变差）。预算-质量曲线显示多数设计随评估数增加复合代价单调下降（ariane133 平坦）。5 seed 随机性实验（bp_multi）显示 DOPP 稳定接近穷举 oracle，显著优于等预算随机采样。偏好实验（ariane133）表明 DOPP 可按 timing/routing/power/balanced 偏好检索单一最优解，而 Open3DBench 的代理权重难以直接映射到 PPA 偏好。
AI.conclusion: DOPP 证明后端 PPA 评估不必仅是被动的末端验证，而可以系统性地作为优化信号：通过 D-最优设计选取信息量大的 coreset，训练局部代理模型并排序候选，可用极小比例的评估预算获得与全量穷举相当的 PPA 质量，同时把额外（并行）评估可靠地转化为更优 PPA，且支持用户自定义 PPA 偏好检索。局限在于性能依赖候选集质量与手工特征的表达力，候选集变大时线性模型欠拟合并导致排序误差上升；未来方向为更丰富的代理表示、更自适应的代理建模策略及推广到更广泛的 3D-IC 划分场景。

title: Crash-free Deductive Verifiers
summary: As deductive verifiers mature, their potential user base is growing from the initial core developers to other users. To convince external users of the suitability of verifiers, these tools must run reliably out of the box, give meaningful error messages and display correct results. Yet deductive verifiers are large and complex software systems and their own full verification is often out of reach. We therefore need complementary means to provide such guarantees. This paper advocates the use of fuzzing as a practical way to improve the quality and robustness of deductive verifiers. We outline how fuzz testing can be applied to deductive verifiers, and demonstrate the idea with the prototype tool AValAnCHE, which is integrated with the VerCors verifier. We report on our experiments in which AValAnCHE uncovered several issues in VerCors and demonstrate that the approach also works for other deductive verifiers

AI.tldr: 本文提出将模糊测试（fuzzing）应用于演绎验证器（deductive verifiers）的质量保证，以解决验证器自身验证困难的问题。通过原型工具AValAnCHE与VerCors验证器的集成实验，成功发现多个问题，并验证该方法对其他演绎验证器同样有效。
AI.motivation: 随着演绎验证器的用户群体从核心开发者扩展到普通用户，需要确保验证器能够开箱即用地可靠运行、提供有意义的错误信息和正确结果。然而验证器本身是复杂软件系统，其完整验证往往难以实现，因此需要补充性方法来保证质量。
AI.method: 提出将模糊测试作为提高演绎验证器质量和鲁棒性的实用方法。开发原型工具AValAnCHE并与VerCors验证器集成，采用黑盒测试方式对验证器进行 fuzzing。
AI.result: AValAnCHE在实验中发现了VerCors的多个问题，并证明该方法对其他演绎验证器同样适用。
AI.conclusion: 模糊测试是提高演绎验证器质量和鲁棒性的实用可行方法，可作为验证器自身验证的补充手段。

title: Less Is More: Cognitive Load and the Single-Prompt Ceiling in LLM Mathematical Reasoning
comment: Companion repository: https://github.com/israelcazares/sair-prompt-engineering | Zenodo DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19598433 | v15: final Contributor Network data (n=52, competition close April 20, 2026)
summary:
We present a systematic empirical study of prompt engineering for formal mathematical reasoning in the context of the SAIR Equational Theories Stage 1 competition. The task requires deciding whether one equational law implies another over all magmas -- a problem that is undecidable in general but decidable for FALSE via finite model search. Over five weeks, we designed, tested, and analyzed more than 40 prompt variants, ranging from 0 to 4,878 bytes, across four evaluation splits and three language models (gpt-oss-120b, Llama 3.3 70B, Gemma 4 31B).
  Our central finding is a single-prompt ceiling: despite substantial engineering effort, balanced hard accuracy plateaus in an empirical saturation region of approximately 60--79% for gpt-oss-120b, compared to a 59.75% no-cheatsheet baseline. We identify three mechanisms underlying this ceiling: (1) the mathematical undecidability of the TRUE case limits what any finite prompt can encode; (2) complex rule systems decrease performance on weaker models (Llama 3.3 70B collapses to 0% TRUE recall with prompts exceeding 2KB); and (3) prompt ordering effects interact with model attention in fragile, non-monotonic ways.
  Our best submission (AN45c, 2,252 bytes) achieves 79.25% accuracy on hard3 (n=400; 95% CI: [75.0%, 82.9%]), with TRUE recall of 95.9% and FALSE recall of 63.4%, representing a +19.5 percentage-point improvement over the no-cheatsheet baseline (59.75%). We release all prompt variants, evaluation scripts, and results at https://github.com/israelcazares/sair-prompt-engineering

AI.tldr: 本文对 SAIR 等式理论（Equational Theories）Stage 1 竞赛任务——判定等式律 E1 是否在所有 magma（单二元运算结构）上蕴含 E2——进行了系统性的提示工程实证研究。五周内设计测试 40+ 提示变体（0–4,878 字节），在 4 个数据划分、3 个模型（gpt-oss-120b、Llama 3.3 70B、Gemma 4 31B）上评估。核心发现是"单提示天花板"：gpt-oss-120b 在平衡 hard 划分上的准确率饱和于约 60–79%（无 cheatsheet 基线 59.75%）。最佳本地提交 AN45c（2,252 字节）达 79.25%（n=400, 95% CI [75.0%, 82.9%]，True 召回 95.9%、False 召回 63.4%），比基线提升 19.5 个百分点；但在 SAIR 官方基准上仅 55.5%，低于基线，而更简单的 AN38 反而取得稳健的 +5.6pp 提升，揭示"跨分布权衡面"与饱和区的脆弱性。
AI.motivation: 该任务与传统数值型数学基准（GSM8K、MATH）根本不同：推理要求对所有结构（含无限结构）的普遍量化。判定具有计算不对称性——False 实例只需一个有限反例即可判定（可由有限模型搜索判定），而 True 实例需要证明不存在任何反例，一般情形不可判定。这种不对称性天然构成提示工程的设计空间：提供反例表应提升 False 准确率，简要的"singleton-forcing"提示应提升 True 准确率。作者的动机是系统检验该假设是否成立，并刻画静态文本提示的极限。作者亦引用了上下文位置效应（lost-in-the-middle）、认知负荷与谄媚性等相关研究作为理论基础。
AI.method: 任务：SAIR Equational Theories Stage 1，判断 E1⇒E2 在所有 magma 上是否成立（标签 True/False）。数据：HuggingFace 上的公开数据集 SAIRfoundation/equational-theories-selected-problems，划分 normal(n=1000, 50/50)、hard1(n=69, 35% True)、hard2(n=200, 50/50)、hard3(n=400, 49/51，主评估划分)。模型：gpt-oss-120b（主，OpenRouter/DeepInfra bf16，扩展推理模式）、Llama 3.3 70B（Together AI）、Gemma 4 31B（Together AI，max_tokens=8192 以启用原生推理）。推理配置统一 temperature=0、seed=42；max_tokens 对 gpt-oss 为 4096、Gemma 为 8192（预实验显示 512/1024/2048 会导致 100% 截断错误）。指标：准确率、True 召回、False 召回、3 模型平均分。提示格式：单个 ≤10KB UTF-8 文本，含 {{equation1}} 与 {{equation2}} 占位符；设计维度包括反例表内容（2 元 4 个→2 元 7 个+3 元 5 个）、singleton-forcing 规则（S1 可靠、S2 对右零 magma 不可靠）、Block 结构分类规则、指令顺序（trivial-magma 检查先于反例表 vs. 反之）、长度（0–4,878 字节）。共 45+ 变体（AN1–AN45f），先小样本（n=20–50）筛选再大规模（n=200–400）验证。
AI.result: 1) 单提示天花板/经验饱和区：gpt-oss-120b 在 hard3 大样本上的平衡准确率稳定在 71–79%，45+ 变体无一超出该区间；基线为 59.75%（True 82.6%/False 38.0%）。2) 最佳变体 AN45c（trivial-magma 先行 + 反例表 A–N）达 79.25%（n=400，CI [75.0%, 82.9%]），True 95.9%、False 63.4%，较基线 +19.5pp；其增益主要来自"顺序重排"而非新增内容（AN38 反例表先行仅 71.8%）；AN45d 的微小改动使准确率从 90% 跌至 70%，说明顺序效应依赖精确 token 序列。3) 长度非单调：最长变体 AN5（4,878 B）最差（54%），最短有效 AN39（385 B）达 70%；无变体能同时使两类召回超 80%。4) 合并模式为 avg(A,B) 而非 max(A,B)：AN38 合并 AN35/AN35b 后接近算术均值，三次后续合并均复现该现象，因静态提示无法实现条件路由。5) 跨模型：AN3c（4,306 B）使 Llama 3.3 70B 的 True 召回崩塌至 0%（全面输出 False）；>2KB 提示普遍摧毁其 True 召回；Gemma 受 token 门控（2048 令牌→50% 准确率、0% False 召回；8192→85%），属配置假象；最小提示 AN19c（289 B）是唯一在 Llama 上保持平衡的变体；DeepSeek V3.2 用 AN19c 达 80%（n=10）且成本约 $0.0008/题。6) 理论框架类变体（KB 重写、语义不变量、Tamari/树结构）全部退化，错误方向为 False→True。7) 分布错配失效模式：AN3c 在 False 偏重的 hard1 上达 78.3%（研究内最高），在平衡 hard2 降至 60%，将 51% 的 True 误判为 False。8) 官方基准（n=20, DeepInfra bf16）验证：AN45c 仅 55.5%（低于 56.3% 基线），AN38 为 65.3%（+5.6pp，F1 67.6%，为非过拟合提交中最高）；hard2 上两者均低于基线。9) 52 份 Contributor Network 提交中仅 Arjun Garg 的 bank_lookup_v8 在 hard2/hard3 双双超过 65%；作者据此提出"跨分布权衡面"，并由纯结构分类器（无数学内容）与路由假说获得独立佐证。
AI.conclusion: 提示长度与多模型泛化呈反比；有效增益并非教会模型新数学，而是控制其已有数学的应用顺序——"少而有序胜过多而繁复"（less, structured deliberately, beats more）。饱和区本质是脆弱区：局部收益具分布依赖性，结构创新会在未见分布上引入失效模式，因此跨分布双划分验证是区分真实上限改进与分布特异优化的必要手段。突破 71–79% 饱和区需跳出单提示范式：(a) 按句法特征外部路由的专用提示集成；(b) 在 Equational Theories Project 约 2,200 万标注方程对上微调；(c) LLM+符号验证器（如 Mace4 等价工具）混合架构。局限：AN45c 结果存在本地-官方 −23.75pp 落差，AN38 更稳健；Gemma/DeepSeek 样本量小（n=20/n=10）；结论是否外推至其他形式推理域尚属开放问题；完整排行榜（1,007 名参与者）结果待 4 月 30 日后更新。

title: On Accelerating Grounded Code Development for Research
summary: A major challenge for niche scientific and technical domains in leveraging coding agents is the lack of access to up-to-date, domain- specific knowledge. Foundational models often demonstrate limited reasoning capabilities in specialized fields and cannot inherently incorporate knowledge that evolves through ongoing research and experimentation. Materials scientists exploring novel compounds, communication engineers designing and evaluating new protocols, and bioengineering researchers conducting iterative experiments all face this limitation. These experts typically lack the resources to fine-tune large models or continuously embed new findings, creating a barrier to adopting AI-driven coding agents. To address this, we introduce a framework that gives coding agents instanta- neous access to research repositories and technical documentation, enabling real-time, context-aware operation. Our open-source im- plementation allows users to upload documents via doc-search.dev and includes zed-fork, which enforces domain-specific rules and workflows. Together, these tools accelerate the integration of coding agents into specialized scientific and technical workflows

AI.tldr: This paper presents a framework to help coding agents access specialized scientific and technical knowledge in real-time. By integrating with research repositories and technical documentation through open-source tools (doc-search.dev and zed-fork), the solution enables domain experts in materials science, communications, and bioengineering to leverage AI coding agents without needing to fine-tune models or manually update knowledge bases.
AI.motivation: The core challenge is that coding agents in specialized scientific and technical domains (materials science, communication engineering, bioengineering) lack access to up-to-date, domain-specific knowledge. Foundational models have limited reasoning capabilities in specialized fields and cannot incorporate evolving research findings. Domain experts typically lack resources for fine-tuning large models or continuously embedding new knowledge.
AI.method: The authors propose an open-source framework that provides coding agents with real-time, context-aware access to research repositories and technical documentation. This includes: (1) doc-search.dev - a document upload and retrieval system, and (2) zed-fork - a tool for enforcing domain-specific rules and workflows.
AI.result: The framework enables instantaneous, context-aware operation for coding agents by integrating them with research repositories and technical documentation. The open-source implementation provides practical tools for document retrieval and domain-specific workflow enforcement.
AI.conclusion: The proposed framework successfully bridges the gap between coding agents and specialized domain knowledge, enabling scientists and engineers to leverage AI-driven tools without fine-tuning or manual knowledge embedding. The open-source implementation (doc-search.dev and zed-fork) provides practical solutions for domain-specific rule enforcement and real-time documentation access.

title: Rethinking Dataset Distillation: Hard Truths about Soft Labels
comment: CVPR 2026 (Oral). First two authors contributed equally
summary: Despite the perceived success of large-scale dataset distillation (DD) methods, recent evidence finds that simple random image baselines perform on-par with state-of-theart DD methods like SRe2L due to the use of soft labels during downstream model training. This is in contrast with the findings in coreset literature, where high-quality coresets consistently outperform random subsets in the hardlabel (HL) setting. To understand this discrepancy, we perform a detailed scalability analysis to examine the role of data quality under different label regimes, ranging from abundant soft labels (termed as SL+KD regime) to fixed soft labels (SL) and hard labels (HL). Our analysis reveals that high-quality coresets fail to convincingly outperform the random baseline in both SL and SL+KD regimes. In the SL+KD setting, performance further approaches nearoptimal levels relative to the full dataset, regardless of subset size or quality, for a given compute budget. This performance saturation calls into question the widespread practice of using soft labels for model evaluation, where unlike the HL setting, subset quality has negligible influence. A subsequent systematic evaluation of five large-scale and four small-scale DD methods in the HL setting reveals that only RDED reliably outperforms random baselines on ImageNet-1K, but can still lag behind strong coreset methods due to its over-reliance on easy sample patches. Based on this, we introduce CAD-Prune, a compute-aware pruning metric that efficiently identifies samples of optimal difficulty for a given compute budget, and use it to develop CA2D, a compute-aligned DD method, outperforming current DD methods on ImageNet-1K at various IPC settings. Together, our findings uncover many insights into current DD research and establish useful tools to advance dataefficient learning for both coresets and DD.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过scalability analysis揭示了软标签设置下DD方法与随机基线性能相当的深层原因，发现在SL+KD regime下性能饱和与子集质量无关。基于HL设置的评估结果，开发了CAD-Prune剪枝指标和CA2D方法，通过识别最优难度样本在ImageNet-1K上取得了先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 质疑大规模数据集蒸馏(DD)方法的真实有效性：1) 发现简单随机基线与SRe2L等SOTA DD方法表现相当（使用软标签训练时）；2) 这与coreset文献中高质量coreset在硬标签设置下优于随机子集的结论相矛盾。需要理解这种差异的根本原因。
AI.method: 1) 多 regime  scalability analysis：对比SL+KD、SL和HL三种标签 regime 下数据质量的作用；2) 系统性评估：5个大尺度和4个小尺度DD方法在HL设置下的表现；3) 开发CAD-Prune：一种计算感知的剪枝指标，用于识别给定计算预算下最优难度的样本；4) CA2D方法：基于CAD-Prune的对齐DD方法。
AI.result: 1) 高质量coreset在SL和SL+KD regime下未能明显优于随机基线；2) SL+KD设置下性能饱和，无论子集大小和质量均接近全数据集的最优水平；3) HL设置下仅RDED可靠地优于ImageNet-1K上的随机基线，但因过度依赖简单样本补丁仍落后于强coreset方法；4) CA2D在ImageNet-1K各种IPC设置下优于当前DD方法。
AI.conclusion: 在硬标签(HL)设置下，CAD-Prune指标和CA2D方法能够有效识别最优难度样本，在ImageNet-1K的多种IPC设置下优于现有DD方法。这些发现揭示了软标签评估的问题，并为coreset和DD领域的数据高效学习提供了有价值的工具。

title: Optimal Routing for Federated Learning over Dynamic Satellite Networks: Tractable or Not?
summary: Federated learning (FL) is a key paradigm for distributed model learning across decentralized data sources. Communication in each FL round typically consists of two phases: (i) distributing the global model from a server to clients, and (ii) collecting updated local models from clients to the server for aggregation. This paper focuses on a type of FL where communication between a client and the server is relay-based over dynamic networks, making routing optimization essential. A typical scenario is in-orbit FL, where satellites act as clients and communicate with a server (which can be a satellite, ground station, or aerial platform) via multi-hop inter-satellite links. This paper presents a comprehensive tractability analysis of routing optimization for in-orbit FL under different settings. For global model distribution, these include the number of models, the objective function, and routing schemes (unicast versus multicast, and splittable versus unsplittable flow). For local model collection, the settings consider the number of models, client selection, and flow splittability. For each case, we rigorously prove whether the global optimum is obtainable in polynomial time or the problem is NP-hard. Together, our analysis draws clear boundaries between tractable and intractable regimes for a broad spectrum of routing problems for in-orbit FL. For tractable cases, the derived efficient algorithms are directly applicable in practice. For intractable cases, we provide fundamental insights into their inherent complexity. These contributions fill a critical yet unexplored research gap, laying a foundation for principled routing design, evaluation, and deployment in satellite-based FL or similar distributed learning systems.

AI.tldr: 本文针对"在轨联邦学习"（卫星作为客户端、经多跳星间链路中继与服务器通信）中最优路由的可计算性，给出了一张完整的"可解性—复杂度"地图。基于段路由（SR）与时变图（TVG）建模，将问题按下载（全局模型分发）与上传（本地模型收集）两阶段，分别在单播/组播、可分/不可分流、单模型/双模型、有无客户端选择（CS）等设定下逐一严格证明：能多项式时间求得全局最优者给出高效算法；否则证明其 NP-hard（若干变体甚至是 NP-complete）。结论填补了卫星FL路由设计的理论空白，为可落地的路由方案与系统架构选择提供了明确边界。
AI.motivation: 地面FL为星型拓扑、客户端直连、链路连续；而已有在轨FL工作普遍采用聚类式分层服务器（簇内或簇间假设直连/交给黑盒协议），或仅做"逐快照、贪心、只看当下"的短视路由优化，且局限于单播+可分流流的理想化假设，未考虑客户端选择（CS）、与路由协议的跨层耦合、以及多模型并发训练。而卫星网络拓扑高度动态、链路间歇、只能靠中继通信，路由方案直接决定哪些客户端来得及上传（CS可行域），进而影响FL收敛速度与轮次时长。因此必须回答一个基础问题：在时变图上对FL模型做最优路由，究竟是可多项式求解的，还是本质上NP-hard、只能退而求其次用次优解？这决定了算法与系统架构设计的理论边界，此前无人系统研究。
AI.method: 形式化建模：在带截止期限（deadline）的FL轮次内，用时变图 G=(V,A) 表示卫星星座——快照内链路（容量为速率×快照时长）与快照间链路（建模卫星缓存转发，缓存容量视为无限，即归一化后 ≥ q|C|）刻画拓扑演化与 cache-and-forward；路由采用段路由（SR）以支持源端路径控制、单播/组播（复制指令）与多路径。下载阶段目标为最小化各客户端收到全局模型的快照索引：加权和 WS(Σ w_c k_c) 与 min-max MM(max k_c)；上传阶段目标为在最后一个快照 K 前送达：无CS时是可行性问题，有CS时是"截止期约束下的效用最大化"（u_c 为实时效用，κ_c 为可开始上传的最早快照）。随后针对各变体分别构造算法或归约：（1）可解情形用最小费用流（整数性定理保证不可分流解自动整数化）、LP 可行性（可分流）、二分搜索快照索引 + 可行性检验、以及带辅助终端节点的最小费用Steiner有向树（Chu-Liu/Edmonds 算法）求解；（2）困难情形用多项式时间归约自 3SAT（设计字面量对、子句节点、容量 1+1/n、n/(n+1)、1/(n+1) 等精妙取值构造"二快照拆分"与"路径二选一"两种编码）、最小点覆盖 MVC（用于带CS的单模型可分流情形，通过贪心覆盖顺序定义每客户端分流份额 η_i 构造双向等价）、MAX-3SAT（用于双模型不可分流的CS效用最大化），以及有向图两条边不相交路径（用于双服务器组播）。多模型扩展与双服务器版本均单独给出论证。
AI.result: 单播下载：1-UF-WS、1-UF-MM、1-SF-MM、2-SF-MM 为多项式时间可解（分别归约为最小费用流、可行性流/二分搜索）；1-SF-WS、2-UF-WS、2-UF-MM、2-SF-WS 为 NP-hard。组播下载：Mul-1-MM、Mul-1-WS 多项式可解（前者退化为图连通性；后者归约为最小费用 Steiner 有向树，且因终端节点无出弧的性质，其最优树必为生成树，故可用 Chu-Liu/Edmonds 多项式求解）；Mul-2-MM、Mul-2-WS 为 NP-hard，且在双服务器、且两模型等大小时仍 NP-hard。上传/模型收集：无CS时 1-SF-NCS、2-SF-NCS（LP 可行性）、1-UF-NCS 多项式可解，2-UF-NCS 为 NP-complete；有CS时仅 1-UF-CS 多项式可解（整数最小费用流中以负效用边实现效用最大化），1-SF-CS、2-UF-CS、2-SF-CS 均为 NP-hard。此外结论对两个独立服务器以及两个以上模型均成立（NP-hard者可由两模型直接推广；2-SF-NCS、2-SF-MM 可推广）。整体规律：单模型几乎均可解（除1-SF-WS与带CS的可分流情形），双模型几乎均困难；min-max目标比加权和更"可解"，不可分流流比可分流流更"可解"，无CS比有CS更"可解"；组播仅在单模型时保持多项式可解。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次系统刻画了卫星时变网络上联邦学习最优路由的计算复杂度全景，为"何种设定可达全局最优、何时必须接受次优解"给出了严格边界，可直接支撑可落地的路由算法与系统架构设计（可解情形的多项式算法可直接用于实践，困难情形则说明需依赖近似、启发式、网络切片或放宽CS目标）。后续方向包括：完全去中心化、异步FL（无中心服务器、节点间直接交换更新）下的路由复杂度分析；在通信资源受限的多模型FL中引入网络切片与组播；以及更细粒度时间（快照进一步切分）下的建模推广。作者同时提醒，NP-hard性是最坏情形刻画，小规模或具有容量保持等良好性质的启发式算法在实际系统中仍可能表现良好。

title: On Reasoning-Centric LLM-based Automated Theorem Proving
summary:
Automated theorem proving is fundamental to formal methods, and the recent trend is to integrate large language models (LLMs) and proof assistants to form effective proof agents. While existing proof agents show promising performance, they inadequately leverage reasoning capabilities of modern LLMs in high-level planning and self-critique. We argue that proof agents should not merely generate tactics but also reason strategically about proof plans and critically evaluate their own proposals.
  This paper introduces ReCent-Prover, a reasoning-centric LLM-based proof agent for Rocq that addresses two critical limitations in current systems. First, we present validation with reflection, enabling LLMs to scrutinize their generated tactics and synthesize failure summaries when reflection identifies potential errors, filtering out potentially misapplied tactics earlier. Second, we propose retrieval with planning, which conditions retrieval on LLM-generated proof plans rather than subgoal similarity, retrieving lemmas and proofs that align with the anticipated proof strategy. Both techniques increase the number of invocations of LLMs. However, when evaluated on the CoqStoq benchmark, even under the same budget of LLM invocations, ReCent-Prover achieves a 22.58% relative improvement in the number of proved theorems over the previous state-of-the-art, demonstrating that our reasoning-centric design significantly enhances automated theorem proving capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向 Rocq 的推理中心 LLM 证明代理 ReCent-Prover，通过"带反思的验证"（对可能被误用的 tactic 做选择性 LLM 自检并生成失败摘要以早期过滤）与"带计划的检索"（用 LLM 生成的自然语言证明计划而非子目标相似度来检索引理与证明样例）两个模块，在 CoqStoq 基准上以相同 LLM 调用预算相对此前的 SOTA（CobbleStone）多证明 22.58% 的定理（114/222 vs 93/222），同时 token 消耗约为其 1/3。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 证明代理（CobbleStone、ProverBot9001 等）主要关注"LLM 与证明助手如何交互"（如何解析错误反馈、如何检索上下文），而没有充分利用现代 LLM 的高层规划与自我批判能力。论文指出两个关键局限：(1) 代理会无差别接受所有语法合法的 tactic，即使该 tactic 使目标变得更难或把搜索引入不可证分支（如误用 apply 产生有反例的子目标、对错误变量归纳、归纳前未泛化假设导致归纳假设过弱）；(2) 检索依赖"子目标相似 ⇒ 证明计划相似"这一不成立的代理假设，实际证明所需的引理/证明样例在语法上常与子目标不相似（如 mulRCA 这类代数重排引理会被 BM25 因 exp2R 等高频符号而排到低位）。作者主张证明代理应以 LLM 自推理为核心：既要战略性地规划证明，又要批判性评估自己提出的策略。
AI.method: 实现 ReCent-Prover（Reasoning-Centric Prover），面向 Rocq 8.18 的迭代式证明代理，每轮先尝试 CoqHammer（25 秒超时、最多 64 线程），失败则走 LLM 流程，迭代上限 T=25。核心两大模块：(1) validation with reflection（验证+反思）：对 LLM 生成的 tactic 序列逐条执行，同时让 LLM 审查自身 tactic 是否"误用/无效/导向不可证状态"；只对可能产生多子目标或导致不可证状态的 tactic 类别做反思（ReflCat：assert/have/pose、apply/eapply、left/right、induction/destruct/case/elim），排除 intros/simpl/rewrite 等；Reflection 子程序做两项检查——(a) 判断新生成子目标是否可证、是否含反例（含 in-context 示例，如前提矛盾、无前提但结论矛盾）；(b) 对 induction/destruct 检查是否归纳变量错误、是否过度绑定变量导致归纳假设不泛化（并对比归纳前后目标）。为定位问题，模块维护回滚点 pid（最近一次"证明开始/子目标被完全证明/执行 ReflCat tactic"的位置）与 g_pre，一旦判定误用即回滚到 pid，并把"（失败子目标, 从 pid 到当前的连续 tactic 序列, LLM 生成的失败原因摘要）"三元组写入按子目标维护的失败历史，供下一轮提示使用。(2) retrieval with planning（带计划的检索）：离线预处理——用 LLM 为每个引理生成自然语言语义描述并用 text-embedding-3-large 嵌入，为每个已有证明生成自然语言证明计划并嵌入；在线——先提示 LLM 对当前子目标生成分步自然语言证明计划（结构化 <step> 格式），再对每个计划步骤嵌入，与引理描述做余弦相似度检索；证明样例则用整段计划嵌入检索。每次检索取 8 条引理与 8 条证明；查询时将候选限制为数据库与当前 proof library 的交集以避免数据泄漏；提示包含子目标+相关定义+检索到的引理/证明+失败历史，tactic 用 <coq> 装饰器包裹以便解析。实验设置：CoqStoq 基准、Rocq 8.18、Intel Xeon Gold 6230/503GB、检索与生成与反思共用同一后端模型；对比 SOTA 时使用 GPT-4 后端并把每定理 LLM 调用数限制为 20（与 CobbleStone 对齐），在两系统基准交集 222 个定理上评估。
AI.result: (1) 整体性能：在 CoqStoq 随机 200 个定理上，以 o4-mini 为后端，ReCent-Prover 证明 138/200（69%）。(2) 与 SOTA 对比：在 222 个交集基准上（GPT-4 后端、每定理 20 次 LLM 调用上限、相同硬件与 CoqHammer 超时），CobbleStone 证明 93 个，ReCent-Prover 证明 114 个，相对提升 22.58%；同时显著优于 PALM（+32.56%）、ProverBot9001（+200%）、Rango（+43.84%）、Tactician（+133.33%）。(3) Token 效率：ReCent-Prover 平均 15.6K tokens/定理，CobbleStone 为 48.2K，约 3.1× 更省。(4) 消融（200 样本）：C1 仅 Hammer 55（24.1K）；C2 Hammer+LLM+BM25 118（30.0K）；C3 +Planning 128（58.5K）；C4 +Refl+BM25 130（45.5K）；C5 完整系统 138（66.7K）。在 BM25 下加反思提升 10.17%，在 planning 下加反思再提升 7.81%；planning 相对 BM25 提升 8.47%（无反思）与 6.15%（有反思）；完整系统较纯符号基线提升 150.91%。(5) 跨模型泛化：以开源 MiniMax-M2.5（10B 激活参数）在 100 样本上为 61 vs 52（+17.31%），与 o4-mini 下的 16.95% 一致。(6) 统计显著性：C5 对各基线的 p 值均 < 0.05（vs CobbleStone 0.0196）。
AI.conclusion: 论文结论是：把 LLM 的推理（高层规划 + 自我批判）置于证明搜索的核心位置是有效的设计范式。"带反思的验证"通过选择性对高风险 tactic 做 LLM 自检、捕获问题 tactic 序列并生成失败摘要，使搜索更稳健；"带计划的检索"通过用自然语言证明计划作为引理与证明样例的检索代理，挖掘出超越子目标相似度、与策略真正对齐的知识。两者虽增加 LLM 调用次数，但在相同调用预算下仍带来 22.58% 的相对提升且更省 token。作者认为随着 LLM 推理能力演进，推理中心的证明代理有望与人类专家互补，持续提升形式化论证的机械化水平。局限方面：基线 CobbleStone 结果直接引用其开源仓库报告值而非重跑，且两者 Rocq 版本不同（8.12 vs 8.18），仅在基准交集上对齐；完整系统 token 开销显著高于简化配置（C5 66.7K vs C2 30.0K）；反射检查依赖 LLM 判断，可能存在误判与漏判。

title: LogosKG: Hardware-Optimized Scalable and Interpretable Knowledge Graph Retrieval
comment: Accepted to the ACL 2026 Main Conference. 9 pages
summary: Knowledge graphs (KGs) are increasingly integrated with large language models (LLMs) to provide structured, verifiable reasoning. A core operation in this integration is multi-hop retrieval, yet existing systems struggle to balance efficiency, scalability, and interpretability. We introduce LogosKG, a novel, hardware-aligned framework that enables scalable and interpretable k-hop retrieval on large KGs by building on symbolic KG formulations and executing traversal as hardware-efficient operations over decomposed subject, object, and relation representations. To scale to billion-edge graphs, LogosKG integrates degree-aware partitioning, cross-graph routing, and on-demand caching. Experiments show substantial efficiency gains over CPU and GPU baselines without loss of retrieval fidelity. With proven performance in KG retrieval, a downstream two-round KG-LLM interaction demonstrates how LogosKG enables large-scale, evidence-grounded analysis of how KG topology, such as hop distribution and connectivity, shapes the alignment between structured biomedical knowledge and LLM diagnostic reasoning, thereby opening the door for next-generation KG-LLM integration. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/LARK-NLP-Lab/LogosKG, and an online demo is available at https://lark-nlp-lab-logoskg.hf.space/.

AI.tldr: LogosKG是一个硬件对齐的知识图谱多跳检索框架，通过符号化表示和硬件高效操作实现可扩展、可解释的k-hop检索，集成了度感知分区、跨图路由和按需缓存等优化，在亿级边规模图上实现显著效率提升，同时保持检索保真度，并成功应用于生物医学知识与LLM诊断推理的对齐分析。
AI.motivation: 知识图谱与大型语言模型的整合中，多跳检索是核心操作，但现有系统在效率、可扩展性和可解释性之间难以平衡。
AI.method: 提出LogosKG框架，基于符号化知识图谱表示，将遍历操作分解为硬件高效的对主语、宾语和关系表示的计算；为扩展到十亿级边图谱，集成了度感知分区、跨图路由和按需缓存机制；通过两轮知识图谱-语言模型交互进行下游应用验证。
AI.result: 相比CPU和GPU基线方法取得显著效率提升，且未损失检索保真度；成功展示了知识图谱拓扑结构（如跳数分布和连通性）如何影响结构化生物医学知识与语言模型诊断推理之间的对齐。
AI.conclusion: LogosKG为下一代知识图谱-语言模型整合提供了可扩展、可解释的多跳检索能力，开辟了大规模证据驱动分析的可能性。

title: Plausible Reasoning and First-Order Plausible Logic
comment: 28 pages. arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:1703.01697
summary: Defeasible statements are statements that are likely, or probable, or usually true, but may occasionally be false. Plausible reasoning makes conclusions from statements that are either facts or defeasible statements without using numbers. So there are no probabilities or suchlike involved. Seventeen principles of logics that do plausible reasoning are suggested and several important plausible reasoning examples are considered. There are 14 necessary principles and 3 desirable principles, one of which is not formally stated. A first-order logic, called Plausible Logic (PL), is defined that satisfies all but two of the desirable principles and reasons correctly with all the examples. As far as we are aware, this is the only such logic. PL has 8 reasoning algorithms because, from a given plausible reasoning situation, there are different sensible conclusions. This article is a condensation of my book `Plausible Reasoning and Plausible Logic' (PRPL), which is to be submitted. Each section of this article corresponds to a chapter in PRPL, and vice versa. The proofs of all the results are in PRPL, so they are omitted in this article.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个名为Plausible Logic (PL)的一阶逻辑系统，用于在不使用概率数值的情况下进行合情推理。该系统基于17条推理原则，能够从事实和可推翻陈述中得出合理结论，并提供了8种推理算法来处理不同情境下的推理需求。据作者所述，这是目前唯一能够正确处理所有示例的此类逻辑。
AI.motivation: 当处理日常推理时，我们需要一种方法来处理可推翻陈述（probable/usual true but may be false）和合情推理（plausible reasoning），但又不想使用概率或数值方法。这种需求源于现实世界中许多推理依赖于不完全确定的知识。
AI.method: 定义了名为Plausible Logic (PL)的一阶逻辑，该逻辑基于17条推理原则（14条必要原则和3条可选原则），通过8种推理算法从给定的前提（包括事实和可推翻陈述）推导出不同的合理结论。
AI.result: 提出了17条逻辑原则（14条必要+3条可选），定义了满足除两条可选原则外的所有原则的PL逻辑，并实现了8种推理算法，能够正确处理多个重要的合情推理示例。
AI.conclusion: PL是已知唯一能够正确处理所有示例的此类逻辑，具有8种推理算法以应对不同情境下的合理结论。该逻辑定义了17条原则（14条必要原则和3条可选原则），满足除两条可选原则外的所有原则。

title: Curvature-Aware PCA with Geodesic Tangent Space Aggregation for Semi-Supervised Learning
summary: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a fundamental tool for representation learning, but its global linear formulation fails to capture the structure of data supported on curved manifolds. In contrast, manifold learning methods model nonlinearity but often sacrifice the spectral structure and stability of PCA. We propose \emph{Geodesic Tangent Space Aggregation PCA (GTSA-PCA)}, a geometric extension of PCA that integrates curvature awareness and geodesic consistency within a unified spectral framework. Our approach replaces the global covariance operator with curvature-weighted local covariance operators defined over a $k$-nearest neighbor graph, yielding local tangent subspaces that adapt to the manifold while suppressing high-curvature distortions. We then introduce a geodesic alignment operator that combines intrinsic graph distances with subspace affinities to globally synchronize these local representations. The resulting operator admits a spectral decomposition whose leading components define a geometry-aware embedding. We further incorporate semi-supervised information to guide the alignment, improving discriminative structure with minimal supervision. Experiments on real datasets show consistent improvements over PCA, Kernel PCA, Supervised PCA and strong graph-based baselines such as UMAP, particularly in small sample size and high-curvature regimes. Our results position GTSA-PCA as a principled bridge between statistical and geometric approaches to dimensionality reduction.

AI.tldr: GTSA-PCA extends PCA to curved manifolds by combining curvature-weighted local tangent subspaces with a geodesic alignment operator, achieving geometry-aware spectral embedding with semi-supervised support and strong empirical performance.
AI.motivation: PCA's global linear formulation cannot capture curved manifold structures, while existing manifold learning methods sacrifice the spectral structure and stability of PCA.
AI.method: GTSA-PCA replaces the global covariance operator with curvature-weighted local covariance operators on a k-NN graph, then uses a geodesic alignment operator combining intrinsic graph distances with subspace affinities to synchronize local representations, yielding a spectral decomposition for geometry-aware embedding.
AI.result: Consistent improvements over PCA, Kernel PCA, Supervised PCA, and graph-based baselines (e.g., UMAP), especially in small sample size and high-curvature regimes.
AI.conclusion: GTSA-PCA provides a principled bridge between statistical and geometric approaches to dimensionality reduction, demonstrating consistent improvements over multiple baselines in challenging regimes (small sample size, high-curvature) and with semi-supervised guidance capability.

title: Predictive Autoscaling for Node.js on Kubernetes: Lower Latency, Right-Sized Capacity
summary:
Kubernetes offers two default paths for scaling Node.js workloads, and both have structural limitations. The Horizontal Pod Autoscaler scales on CPU utilization, which does not directly measure event loop saturation: a Node.js pod can queue requests and miss latency SLOs while CPU reports moderate usage. KEDA extends HPA with richer triggers, including event-loop metrics, but inherits the same reactive control loop, detecting overload only after it has begun. By the time new pods start and absorb traffic, the system may already be degraded. Lowering thresholds shifts the operating point but does not change the dynamic: the scaler still reacts to a value it has already crossed, at the cost of permanent over-provisioning.
  We propose a predictive scaling algorithm that forecasts where load will be by the time new capacity is ready and scales proactively based on that forecast. Per-instance metrics are corrupted by the scaler's own actions: adding an instance redistributes load and changes every metric, even if external traffic is unchanged. We observe that operating on a cluster-wide aggregate that is approximately invariant under scaling eliminates this feedback loop, producing a stable signal suitable for short-term extrapolation.
  We define a metric model (a set of three functions that encode how a specific metric relates to scaling) and a five-stage pipeline that transforms raw, irregularly-timed, partial metric data into a clean prediction signal. In benchmarks against HPA and KEDA under steady ramp and sudden spike, the algorithm keeps per-instance load near the target threshold throughout. Under the steady ramp, median latency is 26ms, compared to 154ms for KEDA and 522ms for HPA.

AI.tldr: 针对Kubernetes Node.js工作负载，提出预测性扩展算法替代被动响应式扩展，通过集群级聚合度量消除扩展行为的反馈干扰，配合度量模型和五阶段流水线实现稳定预测信号，实验显示中位延迟较KEDA和HPA降低80%以上。
AI.motivation: 现有Kubernetes扩展方案存在结构性缺陷：HPA基于CPU利用率无法反映事件循环饱和度（Pod可在CPU适中时已排队请求并错失延迟SLO）；KEDA虽支持更丰富触发器但仍为被动控制循环，在检测到过载时系统已降级；降低阈值仅转移工作点而非改变动态本质，导致永久过度配置。
AI.method: 提出预测性扩展算法，基于短期预测主动扩展而非被动响应；定义度量模型（三元函数编码度量与扩展的关系）并设计五阶段流水线，将原始不规则、部分度量的数据转换为干净预测信号；采用集群级聚合度量而非实例级度量以消除扩展行为对度量信号的反馈干扰。
AI.result: 基准测试表明，算法在稳态爬升和突发峰值场景下均能将实例负载维持在目标阈值附近；稳态爬升场景中位延迟26ms，较KEDA（154ms）和HPA（522ms）分别降低83%和95%。
AI.conclusion: 通过使用集群级聚合指标避免缩放反馈循环，实现稳定且可预测的扩展信号，在稳态爬升场景下中位延迟仅为26ms，显著优于KEDA（154ms）和HPA（522ms）。

title: MORPHOGEN: A Multilingual Benchmark for Evaluating Gender-Aware Morphological Generation
summary: While multilingual large language models (LLMs) perform well on high-level tasks like translation and question answering, their ability to handle grammatical gender and morphological agreement remains underexplored. In morphologically rich languages, gender influences verb conjugation, pronouns, and even first-person constructions with explicit and implicit mentions of gender. We introduce MORPHOGEN, a morphologically grounded large-scale benchmark dataset for evaluating gender-aware generation in three typologically diverse grammatically gendered languages: French, Arabic, and Hindi. The core task, GENFORM, requires models to rewrite a first-person sentence in the opposite gender while preserving its meaning and structure. We construct a high-quality synthetic dataset spanning these three languages and benchmark 15 popular multilingual LLMs (2B-70B) on their ability to perform this transformation. Our results reveal significant gaps and interesting insights into how current models handle morphological gender. MORPHOGEN provides a focused diagnostic lens for gender-aware language modeling and lays the groundwork for future research on inclusive and morphology-sensitive NLP.

AI.tldr: MORPHOGEN是一个针对形态丰富语言中性别感知生成的大规模基准数据集，聚焦法语、阿拉伯语和印地语三种类型多样的语法性别语言，任务要求将第一人称句子改写为相反性别。评估了15个多语言LLM（2B-70B），揭示了当前模型在处理形态性别方面的显著差距。
AI.motivation: 多语言LLM在翻译和问答等高层任务上表现良好，但在语法性别和形态一致处理方面研究不足。形态丰富语言中，性别影响动词变位、代词甚至第一人称结构，性别感知生成是一个重要但未被充分探索的领域。
AI.method: 构建MORPHOGEN基准数据集，包含法语、阿拉伯语和印地语三种类型多样的语法性别语言。定义GENFORM核心任务：保留原意和结构的前提下，将第一人称句子改写为相反性别。评估15个流行的多语言LLM（参数规模2B-70B）。
AI.result: 实验结果揭示了当前模型在形态性别处理方面存在显著差距，并提供了关于多语言模型如何处理形态性别的有趣洞察。
AI.conclusion: MORPHOGEN为性别感知语言建模提供了聚焦的诊断工具，为未来关于包容性和形态敏感NLP的研究奠定了基础。

title: Learning Lifted Action Models from Unsupervised Visual Traces
comment: Accepted to the 36th International Conference on Automated Planning and Scheduling (ICAPS-26)
summary: Efficient construction of models capturing the preconditions and effects of actions is essential for applying AI planning in real-world domains. Extensive prior work has explored learning such models from high-level descriptions of state and/or action sequences. In this paper, we tackle a more challenging setting: learning lifted action models from sequences of state images, without action observation. We propose a deep learning framework that jointly learns state prediction, action prediction, and a lifted action model. We also introduce a mixed-integer linear program (MILP) to prevent prediction collapse and self-reinforcing errors among predictions. The MILP takes the predicted states, actions, and action model over a subset of traces and solves for logically consistent states, actions, and action model that are as close as possible to the original predictions. Pseudo-labels extracted from the MILP solution are then used to guide further training. Experiments across multiple domains show that integrating MILP-based correction helps the model escape local optima and converge toward globally consistent solutions.

AI.tldr: 该论文解决从无标注图像序列中学习动作模型的难题，通过深度学习联合框架与MILP逻辑约束相结合，突破局部最优，实现全局一致的提升动作模型学习。
AI.motivation: 现实应用中构建能够捕捉动作前提条件和效果的动作模型至关重要。现有方法依赖高级状态描述或动作序列标注，学习难度较大。该研究旨在解决更具挑战性的场景：从状态图像序列中学习提升动作模型，且无需动作观察。
AI.method: 提出一个联合学习框架，同时学习状态预测、动作预测和提升动作模型；引入混合整数线性规划(MILP)来防止预测崩溃和自强化误差，通过在部分轨迹上求解逻辑一致的状态、动作和动作模型来生成伪标签指导后续训练。
AI.result: MILP校正模块能够防止预测崩溃和自强化误差，帮助模型逃离局部最优，实现全局一致性。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果证明MILP校正模块能有效帮助模型逃离局部最优，收敛到全局一致解。该方法在多个领域验证有效。

title: The High Explosives and Affected Targets (HEAT) Dataset
summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI) surrogate models provide a computationally efficient alternative to full-physics simulations, but no public datasets currently exist for training and validating models of high-explosive-driven, multi-material shock dynamics. Simulating shock propagation is challenging due to the need for material-specific equations of state (EOS) and models of plasticity, phase change, damage, fluid instabilities, and multi-material interactions. Explosive-driven shocks further require reactive material models to capture detonation physics. To address this gap, we introduce the High-Explosives and Affected Targets (HEAT) dataset, a physics-rich collection of two-dimensional, cylindrically symmetric simulations generated using an Eulerian multi-material shock-propagation code developed at Los Alamos National Laboratory. HEAT consists of two partitions: expanding shock-cylinder (CYL) simulations and Perturbed Layered Interface (PLI) simulations. Each entry includes time series of thermodynamic fields (pressure, density, temperature), kinematic fields (position, velocity), and continuum quantities such as stress. The CYL partition spans a range of materials, including metals (aluminum, copper, depleted uranium, stainless steel, tantalum), a polymer, water, gases (air, nitrogen), and a detonating material. The PLI partition explores varied geometries with fixed materials: copper, aluminum, stainless steel, polymer, and high explosive. HEAT captures key phenomena such as shock propagation, momentum transfer, plastic deformation, and thermal effects, providing a benchmark dataset for AI/ML models of multi-material shock physics.

AI.tldr: 洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室公开发布了 HEAT 数据集：一个由其 Eulerian 多材料冲击波传播程序 PAGOSA 生成的高物理保真度二维柱对称仿真数据集，含 PLI（扰动分层界面）与 CYL（膨胀激波圆柱）两个分区，共约 7491 次仿真、661,507 个快照快照，记录了压力、密度、温度、速度、位置、应力等完整流体力学场，用于训练/验证 AI 多材料冲击与高爆驱动问题的代理模型。
AI.motivation: 高爆驱动、多材料冲击传播的物理仿真需要材料专属状态方程(EOS)、塑性、相变、损伤、流体不稳定性与多材料界面耦合模型，计算极其昂贵；而实验数据昂贵、危险且空间分辨率受限（无法直接观测内部射流、爆轰波与材料变形细节）。目前社区中尚无公开数据集可用于训练和验证此类多物理场问题的 AI/ML 代理模型。因此作者构建 HEAT：一种基于 Eulerian 网格、时间步等间隔、场变量齐全的仿真派生数据集，可在设计早期减少实验试错、降低成本与风险，并为自回归代理模型（形似视频生成任务）提供统一时空离散的训练基准。
AI.method: 使用 LANL 的 Eulerian 多材料冲击传播 CFD 程序 PAGOSA 生成。PLI 分区：固定材料配置（高爆、不锈钢壳、聚合物缓冲层、铝撞击层、铜抛射层、空气），仅随机化定义四条界面样条曲线的 6 个样条系数（striker anchor sa、striker thickness st、cushion thickness ct、throw thickness tt），时间步约 0.25 μs 至 t=25.0 μs；CYL 分区：HMX 派生高爆（booster + 主装药，规定燃速）管外包圆柱壁再嵌入背景介质，随机变化 HE 厚度、圆柱壁厚与雷管位置 (rDet, zDet)，壁/背景材料覆盖 6 种含强度材料（Cu、不锈钢、Al、Be、贫铀、Ta）与 4 种无强度介质（空气、水、氮气、聚合物）。物理建模：FSD(Fast Sweeping Detonation) 爆轰燃烧模型（二阶空间精度）、Standard Strength Model（各向同性弹塑性、von Mises 径向返回、Jaumann 应力率）、Wilkins 人工黏性、各材料 EOS 表；单精度、单位制 cm–g–μs–K。输出为 numpy-zip 文件，每个时间步存有各材料的密度、温度、压力、体积分数、应力、应变、剪切模量、屈服强度、塑性应变、cell-average yield、声速及速度/位置场；另提供 _full/_half 两种空间分辨率与 csv 目录文件，并配套 python 包 Yoke（含 LSC_rho2rho_temporal_DataSet、TemporalDataSet 数据集类）。
AI.result: 数据集共含 661,507 个快照（其中 7,491 个为初始条件）：PLI 约 5330 次仿真 × 101 快照 = 538,330；CYL 2161 次仿真 × 57 快照 = 123,177。数据托管于 oceans11.lanl.gov（/heat/pli/、/heat/cyl/，支持单例、按时间步或整包 tar 下载），并通过 Yoke 可直接构建 PyTorch 张量式输入-输出对用于自回归训练。数据集成功捕捉了关键现象：冲击波传播、动量传递、激波能量输入、热传递、可压缩流、塑性流动与热效应，内部可见复杂 baroclinic 射流几何、钢壳塑性变形及高爆内反射激波等实验难以观测的细节。
AI.conclusion: HEAT 是首个面向 AI/ML 的公开多材料高爆驱动冲击数据集，填补了多物理代理模型训练数据的空白，可作为基准支撑从低分辨率到高保真度的代理建模，并有望减少早期设计阶段的实弹试验需求。作者同时明确局限：所有固体均未启用损伤/断裂模型，仅有弹塑性变形，故会高估承载与抗毁性，并因激波被吸收而引入非物理温升与波阻尼；Eulerian 框架还存在数值扩散导致的界面模糊、守恒律轻微违背、混合材料单元界面追踪误差、固定网格的方向性偏置、EOS 加权平均的热力学不一致，以及长期预测中累积的认知与偶然不确定性。

title: PlayCoder: Making LLM-Generated GUI Code Playable
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong results in code generation, but their ability to generate GUI applications, especially games, remains insufficiently studied. Existing benchmarks mainly evaluate correctness through test cases, which are inadequate for GUI applications because these systems are interactive, event-driven, and require correct state transitions across sequences of user actions. Their evaluation therefore should consider interaction flows and UI logic rather than only pass/fail outcomes. To study this problem, we introduce PlayEval, a repository-aware benchmark built from 43 multilingual GUI applications in Python, TypeScript, and JavaScript. Unlike prior GUI benchmarks that are difficult to adapt to desktop environments, PlayEval covers six major GUI application categories and directly supports code-generation evaluation. We further propose Play@k, a metric that measures whether at least one of *k* generated candidates can be played end-to-end without logical errors. To support reliable evaluation, we develop PlayTester, an LLM-based agent that performs task-oriented GUI playthroughs and detects logic violations automatically. Experiments on 10 state-of-the-art code LLMs show that, despite high compilation rates, they achieve near-zero Play@3, revealing major weaknesses in generating logically correct GUI applications. To address this limitation, we present PlayCoder, a multi-agent, repository-aware framework that generates, evaluates, and iteratively repairs GUI application code in a closed loop. PlayCoder substantially improves both functional correctness and semantic alignment for open-source and closed-source models, reaching up to 38.1% Exec@3 and 20.3% Play@3. Case studies further show that it can uncover silent logic bugs missed by traditional metrics and fix them through targeted edits.

AI.tldr: PlayCoder 面向 GUI 应用（尤其游戏）的代码生成与评测，提出仓库感知的评测基准 PlayEval（43 个 Python/TypeScript/JavaScript 多语言 GUI 应用）、行为正确性指标 Play@k，以及基于视觉反馈闭环的 GUI 测试代理 PlayTester 与多智能体框架 PlayCoder（PlayDeveloper 生成 + PlayRefiner 修复）。实验显示 10 个 SOTA 代码 LLM 编译率高但 Play@3 接近零，PlayCoder 最高达到 38.1% Exec@3 与 20.3% Play@3，显著超越 SCoT、HCPCoder、MetaGPT、OpenManus、DeepCode 等基线。
AI.motivation: 现有代码生成基准（HumanEval、CoderEval、SWE-Bench 等）依赖单元测试与静态分析来判定正确性，但 GUI 应用是事件驱动、状态化、交互式的，其正确性体现为跨用户动作序列的状态转换与交互流程，传统的"能编译 + 通过测试"范式无法覆盖。GUI 应用尤其容易出现"静默逻辑缺陷"（silent failure）——例如 GPT-4o-mini 生成的 Flappy Bird 可以穿过管道、不会判定碰撞结束游戏，代码可运行且单测通过，但完全违背核心游戏机制。现有 GUI 测试工具（Selenium、Playwright、GPTDroid、LLMDroid 等）依赖 DOM/无障碍树等结构化表示，对 PyGame 画布渲染、桌面原生 GUI 等像素级渲染应用不适用，难以移植到桌面平台。因此需要：(1) 面向 GUI 代码生成的多语言仓库级基准；(2) 以交互式端到端游玩为判据的行为正确性指标；(3) 能利用视觉与动态交互反馈修复静默逻辑缺陷的生成-评测-修复闭环框架。
AI.method: 1) 构建 PlayEval 基准：43 个多语言 GUI 应用（637 文件、188,432 LOC、4,497 函数、595 类，覆盖游戏模拟/经典游戏/游戏引擎/MMORPG/独立应用/桌面小组件六大类），平均圈复杂度 10.2、嵌套深度 11.0、控制流密度 30.4/kLOC、测试用例 2,104 个（原仓库行覆盖率仅 47.2%）。每个评测实例包含函数签名、LLM 生成并经专家抽检的需求描述（95.6% 认可度）、仓库上下文（导入、类定义、相关函数体）。2) 三阶段评测流水线：编译执行 Exec@k → 单元测试 Pass@k（并用 LLM 补充单元/集成/功能/边界测试）→ GUI 行为测试 Play@k，采用 Pass@k 无偏估计式 1-C(n-c,k)/C(n,k)，并提出 Efficiency@k = Play@k / (Token_k/(N·10³))。3) PlayTester：基于 pyautogui/PIL 的 VisualObserver（跨平台窗口检测、缓存最近 3 帧做状态变化检测）、ActionExecutor（click/type/hotkey/press/scroll/wait/finish，含坐标边界与 failsafe）、Test Manager（VLM 规划测试，对游戏用目标驱动策略、对非游戏用覆盖驱动策略），经人工验证（3 名资深 GUI 工程师，200 个样本）假阴性 16%、假阳性 5%，Krippendorff α=0.790、Kendall τ_b=0.795。4) PlayCoder 多智能体闭环：PlayDeveloper（工具集 ContextSearchTool/FileReadTool/BashTool/ConversationTool，few-shot 提示）生成仓库感知代码 → PlayTester 进行行为测试 → PlayRefiner（ContextSearcher/Validator/Executor）按"诊断—补丁生成—原子写回—构建与运行时验证—迭代"五阶段修复，最多 T=6 轮，直至通过每样本行为检查；辅以 AgentTrajectory 轨迹记录、确定性沙箱与种子控制。5) 实验：10 个 SOTA LLM（GPT-5、GPT-5-mini、GPT-4o、GPT-4o-mini、Claude-Sonnet-4/3.7、Grok-3-mini、GLM-4.5、DeepSeek-V3、Qwen3-Coder）与 5 个增强方法（SCoT、HCPCoder、MetaGPT、OpenManus、DeepCode）对比，n=3 采样、5 次重复、95% 置信区间（t 分布），并做组件消融（去 APR / 去 GUI 反馈 / 去上下文 / 去智能体）。
AI.result: 基线普遍存在"能编译但行为错"的大幅落差：最佳基线 Claude-Sonnet-4 在 Python 上 Exec@3 18.6% → Play@3 仅 9.9%，GPT-5 从 17.5% 跌至 6.9%；TypeScript 的执行-行为差距最大。HCPCoder 近乎灾难（Play@3 0.2–0.6%），MetaGPT 甚至低于基座模型，说明仅靠提示工程、仓库检索或多智能体角色分工无法解决 GUI 行为正确性。PlayCoder 在全部语言与全部骨干模型上均优于基线：Qwen3-Coder 达 38.1% Exec@3 / 18.9% Play@3（Python），Claude-Sonnet-4 达 36.8% Exec@3 / 20.3% Play@3，JS 上 Exec@3 达 44.5%；相对最佳基线提升 Exec@3 最高 20.2pp、Play@3 最高 11.0pp。效率方面，PlayCoder 以 164K tokens（5480 tokens/函数）取得最高 Efficiency@1 1.51 / Efficiency@3 1.79，其中测试阶段约占 22% token，生成与打补丁约占 78%。消融显示：去掉 APR 使 GPT-5-mini 的 Python Exec@3 从 26.8% 降至 18.3%（-8.5pp），去掉 GUI 反馈使 Play@3 在 Python/JS/TS 分别下降 4.5/4.7/4.2pp，完全去除组件则性能崩塌，验证三者协同必要性。案例显示框架能发现并修复 MetaGPT 生成的 2048 中"白字白底数字不可见"这类单测无法发现的缺陷。
AI.conclusion: GUI 应用代码生成的正确性判据必须从"编译/单测通过"转向"交互过程中的行为语义正确"，Play@k 比 Pass@k 更严格且更能反映真实可用性；将端到端 GUI 测试智能体作为行为预言机（behavioral oracle）嵌入代码生成闭环，并配合仓库感知的自动程序修复，是当前提升 GUI 代码功能正确性与语义对齐的有效路径，且收益与模型无关、对开源与闭源模型均有效。局限包括：离散轮询式截图采样难以覆盖高频帧与长时运行缺陷（43 个项目中约 9% 如 Flappy Bird、Snake 类快节奏游戏仍失败）；依赖 VLM 感知能力；Wayland 平台因安全机制不支持跨窗口截图与输入注入；Wayland 支持依赖 pyautogui 的 PR。作者指出未来方向为更高频视觉采样与更低延迟推理。作者公开了提示、代码与数据（https://github.com/Tencent/PlayCoder）。

title: Proposing Topic Models and Evaluation Frameworks for Analyzing Associations with External Outcomes: An Application to Leadership Analysis Using Large-Scale Corporate Review Data
summary: Analyzing topics extracted from text data in relation to external outcomes is important across fields such as computational social science and organizational research. However, existing topic modeling methods struggle to simultaneously achieve interpretability, topic specificity (alignment with concrete actions or characteristics), and polarity stance consistency (absence of mixed positive and negative evaluations within a topic). Focusing on leadership analysis using corporate review data, this study proposes a method leveraging large language models to generate topics that satisfy these properties, along with an evaluation framework tailored to external outcome analysis. The framework explicitly incorporates topic specificity and polarity stance consistency as evaluation criteria and examines automated evaluation methods based on existing metrics. Using employee reviews from OpenWork, a major corporate review platform in Japan, the proposed method achieves improved interpretability, specificity, and polarity consistency compared to existing approaches. In analyses of external outcomes such as employee morale, it also produces topics with higher explanatory power. These results suggest that the proposed method and evaluation framework provide a generalized approach for topic analysis in applications involving external outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本研究针对现有主题建模方法在可解释性、特异性和极性一致性方面的不足，提出利用大语言模型生成满足这三个属性的话题，并设计专门的评估框架。使用日本企业点评平台OpenWork的数据验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有主题建模方法难以同时实现以下三个关键属性：(1) 可解释性；(2) 主题特异性（与具体行动或特征的关联程度）；(3) 极性立场一致性（话题内不存在混合的正负面评价）。这限制了主题分析在涉及外部结果（如员工离职率、绩效等）的应用中的有效性。
AI.method: 提出了一种利用大语言模型（LLM）生成满足可解释性、主题特异性和极性立场一致性三个属性的话题的方法，并设计了专门针对外部结果分析的评估框架。该框架将主题特异性和极性立场一致性作为明确的评估标准，并检验了基于现有指标的自动化评估方法。使用日本大型企业点评平台OpenWork的员工评论数据进行验证。
AI.result: 相比现有方法，所提方法在可解释性、特异性和极性一致性方面均有提升。在员工士气等外部结果分析中，生成的话题具有更强的解释力。
AI.conclusion: 该方法和评估框架为涉及外部结果的主题分析应用提供了一种通用方法。未来可扩展到其他领域（如产品评论、社交媒体分析等）的主题分析任务。

title: Reinforcement Learning Improves LLM Accuracy and Reasoning in Disease Classification from Radiology Reports
summary: Accurate disease classification from radiology reports is essential for many applications. While supervised fine-tuning (SFT) of lightweight LLMs improves accuracy, it can degrade reasoning. We propose a two-stage approach: SFT on disease labels followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to refine predictions by optimizing accuracy and format without reasoning supervision. Across three radiologist-annotated datasets, SFT outperformed baselines and GRPO further improved classification and enhanced reasoning recall and comprehensiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种两阶段训练框架，通过先微调后强化学习的方式，在提升放射学报告疾病分类准确率的同时，避免推理能力退化问题。
AI.motivation: 现有监督微调方法虽能提升疾病分类准确率，但会损害模型的推理能力，需要寻找在不牺牲推理性能的前提下提高分类准确性的方法。
AI.method: 采用两阶段方法：先用疾病标签进行监督微调(SFT)，随后使用群体相对策略优化(GRPO)进行预测精炼，优化目标为准确率和格式规范，而非显式推理监督。
AI.result: 在三个放射科医生标注数据集上，SFT基线已优于对比方法，GRPO进一步提升了分类准确率，并增强了推理的召回率和完整性。
AI.conclusion: Two-stage SFT+GRPO framework有效平衡了医学影像报告分类中的准确性与推理能力，GRPO阶段无需推理监督即可同时提升分类性能和推理质量。

title: One Step Forward and K Steps Back: Better Reasoning with Denoising Recursion Models
summary: Looped transformers scale computational depth without increasing parameter count by repeatedly applying a shared transformer block and can be used for iterative refinement, where each loop rewrites a full fixed-size prediction in parallel. On difficult problems, such as those that require search-like computation, reaching a highly structured solution starting from noise can require long refinement trajectories. Learning such trajectories is challenging when training specifies only the target solution and provides no supervision over the intermediate refinement path. Diffusion models tackle this issue by corrupting data with varying magnitudes of noise and training the model to reverse it in a \textit{single step}. However, this process misaligns training and testing behaviour. We introduce Denoising Recursion Models, a method that similarly corrupts data with noise but trains the model to reverse the corruption over \textit{multiple} recursive steps. This strategy provides a tractable curriculum of intermediate states, while better aligning training with testing and incentivizing non-greedy, forward-looking generation. Through extensive experiments, we show this approach outperforms the Tiny Recursion Model (TRM) on ARC-AGI, where it recently achieved breakthrough performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Denoising Recursion Models方法，通过多步递归去噪训练替代扩散模型的单步去噪，解决长轨迹学习中的训练-测试不一致问题。该方法为模型提供中间状态课程表并激励前瞻性生成，最终在ARC-AGI上超越TRM取得突破性进展。
AI.motivation: 在需要搜索类计算的困难问题中，从噪声状态到达高度结构化的解需要很长的精炼轨迹。当训练仅指定目标解而对中间精炼路径缺乏监督时，学习这样的轨迹具有挑战性。传统扩散模型虽然通过不同幅度的噪声腐败数据并训练模型单步逆转，但这种方法会导致训练与测试行为的不一致。
AI.method: 该方法对数据施加噪声干扰，但训练模型通过多个递归步骤逐步反转噪声腐败过程，而非像传统扩散模型那样在单一步骤中完成去噪。这种训练范式为模型提供了可处理的中间状态课程表，并更好地对齐了训练与测试阶段的行为模式，同时激励模型进行非贪心、前瞻性的生成。
AI.result: 在ARC-AGI基准测试中，该方法优于Tiny Recursion Model (TRM)，并取得了突破性性能。
AI.conclusion: Denoising Recursion Models通过多步递归去噪训练策略，成功解决了长轨迹学习中的训练-测试不一致问题，在ARC-AGI上取得了突破性性能，为需要搜索类计算的复杂推理任务提供了新的方法框架。

title: Do Agents Dream of Root Shells? Partial-Credit Evaluation of LLM Agents in Capture The Flag Challenges
comment: Accepted to AIWare'26 Benchmark and Dataset Track
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly proposed for autonomous cybersecurity tasks, but their capabilities in realistic offensive settings remain poorly understood. We present DeepRed, an open-source benchmark for evaluating LLM-based agents on realistic Capture The Flag (CTF) challenges in isolated virtualized environments. DeepRed places an agent in a Kali attacker environment with terminal tools and optional web search, connected over a private network to a target challenge, and records full execution traces for analysis. To move beyond binary solved/unsolved outcomes, we introduce a partial-credit scoring method based on challenge-specific checkpoints derived from public writeups, together with an automated summarise-then-judge labelling pipeline for assigning checkpoint completion from logs. Using DeepRed, we benchmark ten commercially accessible LLMs on ten VM-based CTF challenges spanning different challenge categories. The results indicate that current agents remain limited: the best model achieves only 35% average checkpoint completion, performing strongest on common challenge types and weakest on tasks requiring non-standard discovery and longer-horizon adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出开源基准 DeepRed，用于在隔离虚拟化环境中评测 LLM 智能体在真实 CTF 挑战中的自主攻击能力，并提出基于检查点的部分得分（partial credit）评分法与「摘要—判定」自动化标注流水线。在 10 个 VM 型 CTF 挑战上对 10 个商用 LLM 的评测表明：最佳模型 GPT-5.1 Codex Max 平均仅完成 35% 检查点，且无任何挑战取得 root flag，说明当前智能体在长程规划、记忆与失败适应方面仍显薄弱。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体被广泛提出用于自主网络安全任务，但其在真实进攻场景中的能力边界仍不清楚。CTF 作为可控且真实的攻防实践代理，涵盖 Web 利用、逆向、二进制利用、密码学等类别，要求多步推理、命令行交互、迭代实验与策略调整。已有评测多依赖「是否拿旗」的二值指标，分辨率过低：当前智能体极少端到端解题，却常取得可测量的中间进展，因此需要细粒度的部分得分方法。此外，现有基准多在精选/净化设置中测「基准完成率」，缺少攻击机与目标机分离的完整虚拟化环境与可复现的轨迹日志分析。
AI.method: 1) DeepRed 基准框架：采用完整虚拟机（而非共享宿主内核的容器）以获得更强隔离与真实系统行为；在 Kali 攻击机上启动 getty，经 Unix 域套接字暴露终端会话给宿主，包装为超时式终端工具（支持 ssh 等无终止标记的交互命令与长时间任务），并提供经过滤的 DuckDuckGo 搜索（过滤 flag 与已知 writeup 引用）。每轮 episode 从干净快照启动 Kali VM，与目标 CTF VM 接入私有内网，结束后回滚快照保证可复现。智能体采用基于 smolagents 的 CodeAgent，以生成短 Python 程序编排命令与状态；系统提示设定授权渗透测试角色、目标 IP、flag 格式。2) 数据集构建：从 HackMyVM 选取 10 个低-中等难度、可命令行解决、以 VM 镜像分发、有公开 writeup、含可识别中间阶段的挑战，覆盖 Web 利用、提权、模糊测试/目录发现、SSH 密钥操纵、隐写术、服务利用六类；另备 20 个更高难度挑战（HackMyVM 与 VulnHub）供后续使用。3) 模型集：通过 OpenRouter 程序化筛选（文本-文本、适合 agentic、上下文≥250k、输入≤$5/M、输出≤$10/M），再人工挑选 10 个模型（半数开放权重）。4) 部分得分与自动标注：由公开 writeup 线性分解出每个挑战的二元检查点序列，按结果（而非特定工具）判定；采用两阶段「摘要—判定」流水线——Summary LM 将长轨迹分块压缩为结构化摘要（保留每 5 步的反思/计划消息），Judge LM 依据 rubric 与结构化输出 schema（配合 Response Healing）输出检查点标签；以 Cohen's kappa 与 Krippendorff's alpha 评估人类标注者一致性（60 条轨迹、4 名评分者、每条 2 人标注）并对 3 个摘要模型 × 4 个判定模型组合做与人类的一致性比较。5) 主实验：10 模型 × 10 挑战 × 3 次重复，报告平均检查点完成率、token 消耗与步数。
AI.result: 标注可靠性：人类一致性高（Krippendorff α=0.819，平均两两 Cohen's κ=0.7800）；自动流水线最佳组合为 Gemini 3 Flash 摘要 + Claude Sonnet 4.6 判定，κ=0.7234（同一模型自摘要自判定时 Gemini 3 Flash 为 0.6241 最优），而使用 Grok 4.1 Fast 做摘要的全部组合 κ 为负，说明摘要质量是下游标注可靠性的决定因素；流水线将单条轨迹评估从数小时人工降到数分钟。基准结果：最佳 GPT-5.1 Codex Max 平均 35% 检查点完成率（区间 29%–44%），第二梯队 MiniMax-M1 22%、Devstral 2512 21%、MiMo-V2 Flash 20%、Palmyra X5 20%、Gemini 2.0 Flash 16%、Nova-2 Lite v1 13%、Grok Code Fast 1 12%、Qwen3-Next 80B 12%、Nemotron-3 Nano 30B 5%；所有核心挑战均未获得 root flag。挑战难度分化明显：Whitedoor 24.6%、Quick 23.5%、SysAdmin 22.8%、Jan 21.4% 最高，Fuzzz 10.1%、Thirteen 12.9% 最低。token 消耗与成绩无正相关（Grok Code Fast 1 仅 8.8M token 却最弱之一；GPT-5.1 Codex Max 用 31.9M 却最好）；步数集中于 40–60，主要受 60 步上限约束，说明差异来自动作质量而非轨迹长度。失败模式：多数进展出现在前 20 步后即迷失，缺乏坚持性、长期状态跟踪与失败后的策略修正，重复失败命令或从头重启，且不利用 Kali 环境持久状态、反复重做已完成步骤。
AI.conclusion: DeepRed 提供了可复现、可扩展的真实 CTF 评测框架与基于执行日志的细粒度部分得分方法，证明可从轨迹中自动识别侦察、伪影发现、部分利用等语义阶段，且标注可靠性经人类基线验证。当前智能体虽能取得部分进展，但仍远未达到稳健的端到端自治：擅长常规「Web  foothold→提权」流程，弱于目录爆破、SSH 密钥处理、混淆披露等非常规发现与长程适应。作者指出的局限包括：统一使用 SmolAgents 框架带来的构念混淆、模型训练数据与 writeup 的潜在数据泄漏、每配置仅 3 次重复的样本量不足、仅 10 模型 10 挑战且题目偏易、系统提示作为混淆因素、CTF 表现仅为网络安全能力的代理（不含隐蔽性、持久化、横向移动、对抗防守者等要素）。未来方向包括跨框架（LangGraph、AutoGen、OpenHands）稳定性检验、层次化规划与显式记忆/自反思、多智能体分工、自动从 writeup 抽取检查点，以及将评测流水线推广至其他有公开指南的长程任务；所有框架组件、挑战配置、评分 rubric 与日志均已开源。

title: Disparities In Negation Understanding Across Languages In Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit affirmation bias: a systematic tendency to select positive captions ("X is present") even when the correct description contains negation ("no X"). While prior work has documented this failure mode in English and proposed solutions, negation manifests differently across languages through varying morphology, word order, and cliticization patterns, raising the question of whether these solutions serve all linguistic communities equitably. We introduce the first human-verified multilingual negation benchmark, spanning seven typologically diverse languages: English, Mandarin Chinese, Arabic, Greek, Russian, Tagalog, and Spanish. Evaluating three VLMs - CLIP, SigLIP, and MultiCLIP - we find that standard CLIP performs at or below chance on non-Latin-script languages, while MultiCLIP achieves the highest and most uniform accuracy. We also evaluate SpaceVLM, a proposed negation correction, and find that it produces substantial improvements for several languages - particularly English, Greek, Spanish, and Tagalog - while showing varied effectiveness across typologically different languages. This variation reveals that linguistic properties like morphology, script, and negation structure interact with model improvements in fairness-relevant ways. As VLMs are deployed globally, multilingual benchmarks are essential for understanding not just whether solutions work, but for whom.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示了视觉-语言模型在处理多语言否定时的公平性问题。研究发现现有解决方案对不同语言的效果差异显著，突出了开发考虑类型学多样性的多语言基准测试的必要性。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言模型存在肯定性偏差问题，即使正确答案包含否定表述（"无X"），模型也倾向于选择肯定性描述（"X存在"）。先前解决方案仅针对英语设计，但否定现象在不同语言中通过形态变化、词序和附着词等不同方式实现，这些解决方案是否能公平地服务于所有语言社区尚不明确。
AI.method: 构建首个经人工验证的多语言消歧基准测试，涵盖7种类型学多样语言（英语、普通话、阿拉伯语、希腊语、俄语、塔加洛语、西班牙语），对三种VLM（CLIP、SigLIP、MultiCLIP）进行评估，并测试SpaceVLM的否定纠正效果。
AI.result: 标准CLIP在非拉丁字母语言上的表现低于随机水平；MultiCLIP获得最高且最均匀的准确率；SpaceVLM在英语、希腊语、西班牙语和塔加洛语上表现显著提升，但在不同类型学语言上效果差异明显。
AI.conclusion: 多语言消歧基准测试对于识别VLM解决方案的公平性至关重要，因为模型改进效果与语言类型学特性（如形态学、文字系统、否定结构）之间存在显著关联，需要针对不同语言社区进行差异化优化。

title: OLLM: Options-based Large Language Models
summary: We introduce Options LLM (OLLM), a simple, general method that replaces the single next-token prediction of standard LLMs with a \textit{set of learned options} for the next token, indexed by a discrete latent variable. Instead of relying on temperature or sampling heuristics to induce diversity, OLLM models variation explicitly: a small latent space parametrizes multiple plausible next-token options which can be selected or searched by a downstream policy. Architecturally, OLLM is a lightweight "plug-in" that inserts two layers: an encoder and a decoder, before the output head, allowing almost any pretrained LLM to be converted with minimal additional parameters. We apply OLLM to a 1.7B-parameter backbone (only $1.56\%$ of parameters trainable) trained on OpenMathReasoning and evaluated on OmniMath. The SOTA LoRA-adapted baselines peak at $51\%$ final answer correctness, while OLLM's option set allows up to $\sim 70\%$ under optimal latent selection. We then train a compact policy in the latent space that emits latents to control generation. Operating in a low-dimensional option space makes reward optimization far more sample-efficient and substantially reduces common misalignments (e.g., language switching or degenerate reasoning), as the policy is constrained to options learned during SFT. Crucially, this alignment arises from model structure rather than additional KL or handcrafted alignment losses. Our results demonstrate that optionized next-token modeling enhances controllability, robustness, and efficiency in math reasoning, and highlight latent-space policy learning as a promising direction for reinforcement learning in LLMs.

AI.tldr: OLLM 提出把标准 LLM 的“单一 next-token 分布”改造为“由离散隐变量索引的一组可学习选项（options）”：在冻结的 lm_head 之前插入编码器与解码器两层轻量插件（实验中仅 1.56% 参数可训练），训练时编码器依据“上下文隐状态 + 目标 token 嵌入”给出 K=10 个选项的隐变量分布，解码器把该隐变量转成对隐状态的偏置向量，推理时改用一个紧凑策略网络在隐空间中选择选项。在 1.7B 蒸馏 Qwen2.5-DeepSeek-R1 骨干、OpenMathReasoning 训练 / OmniMath 评测的数学推理设定下，LoRA 基线最终答案正确率约 51%（且很快过拟合停滞），而 OLLM 在最优隐变量选择下达约 70%（per-token 约 83% vs 基线 74%）；作者主张由于策略被限制在 SFT 学到的选项内，低维动作空间使奖励优化更样本高效，并天然抑制语言切换/退化推理等错配，无需额外的 KL 或手工对齐损失。
AI.motivation: 标准 LLM 只能在单一 next-token 分布上用温度/top-k 等采样启发式制造多样性，这既浪费了真实的多模态结构，也让下游 RL 只能在全词表空间探索。作者在 OmniMath 上统计了 token 预测熵：约 15% 位置近似确定性（熵<1 nat），约 58% 位置高度歧义（熵>3 nats），top-2 token 累计概率不足 53.98%，说明大量位置本就有多个合理续写（歧义多出现在短语/句子/数学表达式起始处，随生成推进趋于确定）。同时传统 RLHF/RL 微调在词表级动作空间上样本效率低、易引发能力漂移、语言切换、奖励投机与退化推理。已有隐空间控制工作（PriorControl、latent ODE、CriticControl、EAGLE、JAM、Prefix-tuning 等）多数依赖情感/主题等额外文本标签或改动骨干，而 OLLM 追求无标签、骨干不变、动作空间紧凑（K≈10）且可直接做下游策略/RL 的通用方法。
AI.method: 架构：冻结骨干 LLM 与 lm_head，在输出头之前插入编码器 E_ψ 与解码器 D_ω 两个轻量模块。训练时将目标 token 经输入嵌入层得到 e(y_{t+1})（避免编码器随词表规模膨胀），编码器联合条件于上下文隐状态 h_t 与 e(y_{t+1}) 输出离散隐变量分布 p(z)=E_ψ(h_t, e(y_{t+1}))∈Z（K 维 one-hot）；联合条件可避免退化为词表的静态划分，学到上下文敏感的选项指派（同一目标 token 在不同推理轨迹可对应不同选项）。解码器以 (z, h_t) 为输入产生偏置 Δh_t=D_ω(z,h_t)，隐状态相加后 ũ_t=h_t+Δh_t，再经 lm_head 得到 logits，以标准交叉熵训练。KL 正则：L_KL=KL(E_ψ(·|h_t,y_{t+1}) ‖ U(1,K))，用自适应模块每步调节权重 α，使 KL 维持在目标值 0.2，兼顾低熵区过惩罚与峰值区惩罚不足，防止隐变量塌缩。策略学习：轻量策略 π_φ(z|h_t) 用行为克隆（SFT）模仿编码器的 argmax 隐变量指派，损失为与策略 logits 的交叉熵。总损失 L = L_CE(ψ,ω) + L_KL(ψ) + L_policy(φ)，一步联合优化。推理阶段不用编码器，替换为策略网络从 h_t 输出隐变量。核心机理是把 next-token 分布分解为 K 个选项上的混合分布，每个选项拥有独立 logit 空间，从而使竞争性续写不再在同一 softmax 单纯量上互相争夺概率质量。实验设定：骨干为蒸馏 Qwen2.5-DeepSeek-R1 1.7B（仅 1.56% 参数可训练），训练集 OpenMathReasoning，评测集 OmniMath，K=10，基线为 SOTA LoRA 适配器。
AI.result: 基线 LoRA 达 per-token 准确率约 74%、最终答案正确率约 51%，但因过拟合早早停滞；OLLM 在最优隐变量（oracle）选择下达 per-token 约 83%、最终答案正确率约 70%，且训练全程持续提升，未见早期停滞。作者归因于不同 token 备选被分离到不同隐变量/不同 logit 空间，不再在同一概率单纯量内互相竞争，因而可同时保留多个合理续写而不被单一主导模式吞没；且即使简单的隐空间策略也能显著提升最终答案正确率。定性分析显示：在确定性位置（如 “beans”、固定符号序列）所有选项收敛到同一 token；在中等歧义位置选项略有分化（如 big/large/huge/square）；在高歧义位置选项明显多样（Let/And/Then/I/The/Each/So…），不同选项可驱动不同的逻辑推理分支，体现可解释性与可控性。作者强调在低维选项空间做奖励优化样本效率更高、策略方差更低，能抑制语言切换与退化推理等常见错配，且这种对齐源自模型结构本身而非额外 KL/手工对齐损失。
AI.conclusion: 把 next-token 建模“选项化”（离散隐变量索引的多候选 token 集合）可提升数学推理的可控性、鲁棒性与效率：既改善 token 级与答案级准确率，又为下游 RL 提供紧凑且有依据（grounded）的动作空间，使探索被限制在 SFT 学到的行为分布内，从而无需显式 KL 惩罚即可获得对齐收益。作者将“隐空间策略学习/RL”视为 LLM 强化学习的有前景方向，并计划在选项空间上直接做 RL，检验理论效率增益能否转化为进一步性能提升；亦可扩展到代码生成、科学问答与多步规划。主要局限：约 70% 的成绩依赖“最优隐变量选择”这一 oracle 上界，论文对实际训练策略（行为克隆后的真实策略）性能、消融（KL 目标值、K 大小、编码器/解码器结构）报告有限；实验仅在 1.7B 数学推理单域小规模验证，跨域与更大规模的泛化性、训练开销（需同时过一遍目标 token 的编码）以及与标准 RL 基线的样本效率对比仍待验证；文中骨干参数量在正文与附录（1.7B vs 1.5B）表述不一致。

title: Task Switching Without Forgetting via Proximal Decoupling
summary: In continual learning, the primary challenge is to learn new information without forgetting old knowledge. A common solution addresses this trade-off through regularization, penalizing changes to parameters critical for previous tasks. In most cases, this regularization term is directly added to the training loss and optimized with standard gradient descent, which blends learning and retention signals into a single update and does not explicitly separate essential parameters from redundant ones. As task sequences grow, this coupling can over-constrain the model, limiting forward transfer and leading to inefficient use of capacity. We propose a different approach that separates task learning from stability enforcement via operator splitting. The learning step focuses on minimizing the current task loss, while a proximal stability step applies a sparse regularizer to prune unnecessary parameters and preserve task-relevant ones. This turns the stability-plasticity into a negotiated update between two complementary operators, rather than a conflicting gradient. We provide theoretical justification for the splitting method on the continual-learning objective, and demonstrate that our proposed solver achieves state-of-the-art results on standard benchmarks, improving both stability and adaptability without the need for replay buffers, Bayesian sampling, or meta-learning components.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于算子分裂的持续学习方法，将任务学习与稳定性 enforcement 分离。 learning step 最小化当前任务 loss，proximal step 通过稀疏正则化剪枝不必要参数保留关键参数。无需 replay buffer、贝叶斯采样或元学习即可达到 SOTA 性能。
AI.motivation: 当前持续学习方法将学习与稳定性信号耦合在同一梯度更新中，随着任务序列增长导致模型过度约束，限制正向迁移且容量利用效率低。
AI.method: 采用算子分裂框架：学习 step 最小化当前任务 loss，proximal 稳定性 step 应用稀疏正则化剪枝冗余参数、保留任务相关参数。两步骤通过两个互补算子协商更新，实现稳定性-可塑性的平衡。
AI.result: 在标准 benchmarks 上达到 SOTA，兼顾稳定性与适应性，无需 replay buffers、贝叶斯采样或元学习组件。
AI.conclusion: 算子分裂方法为持续学习提供理论基础和有效实践方案，将稳定性-可塑性从冲突梯度转化为互补算子更新，提升模型容量利用效率。

title: A Mechanism and Optimization Study on the Impact of Information Density on User-Generated Content Named Entity Recognition
summary: Named Entity Recognition (NER) models trained on clean, high-resource corpora exhibit catastrophic performance collapse when deployed on noisy, sparse User-Generated Content (UGC), such as social media. Prior research has predominantly focused on point-wise symptom remediation -- employing customized fine-tuning to address issues like neologisms, alias drift, non-standard orthography, long-tail entities, and class imbalance. However, these improvements often fail to generalize because they overlook the structural sparsity inherent in UGC. This study reveals that surface-level noise symptoms share a unified root cause: low Information Density (ID). Through hierarchical confounding-controlled resampling experiments (specifically controlling for entity rarity and annotation consistency), this paper identifies ID as an independent key factor. We introduce Attention Spectrum Analysis (ASA) to quantify how reduced ID causally leads to ``attention blunting,'' ultimately degrading NER performance. Informed by these mechanistic insights, we propose the Window-Aware Optimization Module (WOM), an LLM-empowered, model-agnostic framework. WOM identifies information-sparse regions and utilizes selective back-translation to directionally enhance semantic density without altering model architecture. Deployed atop mainstream architectures on standard UGC datasets (WNUT2017, Twitter-NER, WNUT2016), WOM yields up to 4.5\% absolute F1 improvement, demonstrating robustness and achieving new state-of-the-art (SOTA) results on WNUT2017.

AI.tldr: 本研究揭示了NER模型在用户生成内容（UGC）上性能下降的根本原因——信息密度（ID）低，而非表面噪声问题。通过引入注意力频谱分析（ASA）量化"注意力钝化"机制，提出基于LLM的窗口感知优化模块（WOM），在多个基准数据集上实现SOTA性能提升。
AI.motivation: 当前NER模型在clean corpora上表现优异，但在noisy UGC（如社交媒体）上出现灾难性性能下降。现有研究多聚焦于点对点症状修复（如新词、别称漂移、非标准正字法、长尾实体、类别不平衡），但这些改进泛化能力差，因为忽略了UGC固有的结构性稀疏性这一根本问题。
AI.method: 1. 层级混淆控制重采样实验（控制实体稀有度和标注一致性）；2. 注意力频谱分析（ASA）量化信息密度降低如何导致注意力钝化；3. 提出窗口感知优化模块（WOM）：利用LLM识别信息稀疏区域，通过选择性反向翻译增强语义密度。
AI.result: 在WNUT2017、Twitter-NER、WNUT2016等标准UGC数据集上，基于主流架构部署WOM后，F1绝对提升达4.5个百分点，在WNUT2017上达到新的SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 表面噪声症状存在统一根因——低信息密度；注意力钝化是ID影响NER性能的因果机制；WOM作为模型无关的LLM赋能框架，能够在不改变模型架构的前提下方向性增强语义密度，实现鲁棒的NER性能提升。

title: Towards Scalable Lifelong Knowledge Editing with Selective Knowledge Suppression
summary: Large language models (LLMs) require frequent knowledge updates to reflect changing facts and mitigate hallucinations. To meet this demand, lifelong knowledge editing has emerged as a continual approach to modify specific pieces of knowledge without retraining the entire model. Existing parameter editing methods struggle with stability during sequential edits due to catastrophic forgetting. While retrieval-based approaches are proposed to alleviate this issue, their applicability remains limited across various datasets because of high training costs. To address these limitations and enhance scalability in lifelong settings, we propose LightEdit. Our framework first selects relevant knowledge from retrieved information to modify the query effectively. It then incorporates a decoding strategy to suppress the model's original knowledge probabilities, thereby enabling efficient edits based on the selected information. Extensive experiments on ZSRE, Counterfact, and RIPE benchmarks demonstrate that LightEdit outperforms existing lifelong knowledge editing methods. Furthermore, by minimizing training costs, LightEdit achieves cost-effective scalability, enabling easy adaptation to various datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LightEdit框架，通过知识选择和概率抑制解码策略实现LLM的高效持续知识编辑，在多个基准上超越现有方法，且具备低成本易扩展的优势。
AI.motivation: LLM需要频繁更新知识以反映变化的事实和减少幻觉。现有参数编辑方法在顺序编辑中因灾难性遗忘而难以保持稳定性；检索增强方法虽能缓解此问题，但因训练成本高而在不同数据集上的适用性受限。
AI.method: LightEdit框架包含两个核心组件：1）从检索信息中选择相关知识以有效修改查询；2）采用解码策略抑制模型的原始知识概率，从而基于选定信息实现高效编辑。
AI.result: 在ZSRE、Counterfact和RIPE三个基准测试中，LightEdit优于现有 lifelong knowledge editing方法；同时显著降低了训练成本，实现了成本效益可扩展性，易于适应各种数据集。
AI.conclusion: LightEdit通过检索增强和概率抑制解码策略，有效实现了低成本、高稳定性的持续知识编辑，为LLM知识更新提供了可扩展的解决方案。

title: ParamBoost: Gradient Boosted Piecewise Cubic Polynomials
summary: Generalized Additive Models (GAMs) can be used to create non-linear glass-box (i.e. explicitly interpretable) models, where the predictive function is fully observable over the complete input space. However, glass-box interpretability itself does not allow for the incorporation of expert knowledge from the modeller. In this paper, we present ParamBoost, a novel GAM whose shape functions (i.e. mappings from individual input features to the output) are learnt using a Gradient Boosting algorithm that fits cubic polynomial functions at leaf nodes. ParamBoost incorporates several constraints commonly used in parametric analysis to ensure well-refined shape functions. These constraints include: (i) continuity of the shape functions and their derivatives (up to C2); (ii) monotonicity; (iii) convexity; (iv) feature interaction constraints; and (v) model specification constraints. Empirical results show that the unconstrained ParamBoost model consistently outperforms state-of-the-art GAMs across several real-world datasets. We further demonstrate that modellers can selectively impose required constraints at a modest trade-off in predictive performance, allowing the model to be fully tailored to application-specific interpretability and parametric-analysis requirements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ParamBoost，一种结合梯度提升与三次多项式叶节点的新型GAM，能够整合专家知识约束（连续性、单调性、凸性等），在保持可解释性的同时显著提升预测性能，并支持根据应用需求灵活定制模型。
AI.motivation: 传统GAM虽具有玻璃盒可解释性，但无法整合建模者的专家知识，限制了其在需要领域知识的实际应用中的灵活性。
AI.method: 提出ParamBoost，一种新型GAM，使用梯度提升算法学习形状函数，在叶节点拟合三次多项式函数。该方法引入了五类约束：连续性（达C2阶导数连续）、单调性、凸性、特征交互约束和模型规格约束，使模型可灵活整合专家知识。
AI.result: 无约束的ParamBoost在多个真实数据集上持续优于最先进的GAM；引入约束后仅需牺牲少量预测性能，即可获得完全符合特定应用需求的模型。
AI.conclusion: ParamBoost成功地将专家知识整合到GAM中，允许模型根据特定应用需求进行定制，在可解释性和预测性能之间取得良好平衡。

title: Assessing Capabilities of Large Language Models in Social Media Analytics: A Multi-task Quest
summary: In this study, we present the first comprehensive evaluation of modern LLMs - including GPT-4, GPT-4o, GPT-3.5-Turbo, Gemini 1.5 Pro, DeepSeek-V3, Llama 3.2, and BERT - across three core social media analytics tasks on a Twitter (X) dataset: (I) Social Media Authorship Verification, (II) Social Media Post Generation, and (III) User Attribute Inference. For the authorship verification, we introduce a systematic sampling framework over diverse user and post selection strategies and evaluate generalization on newly collected tweets from January 2024 onward to mitigate "seen-data" bias. For post generation, we assess the ability of LLMs to produce authentic, user-like content using comprehensive evaluation metrics. Bridging Tasks I and II, we conduct a user study to measure real users' perceptions of LLM-generated posts conditioned on their own writing. For attribute inference, we annotate occupations and interests using two standardized taxonomies (IAB Tech Lab 2023 and 2018 U.S. SOC) and benchmark LLMs against existing baselines. Overall, our unified evaluation provides new insights and establishes reproducible benchmarks for LLM-driven social media analytics. The code and data are provided in the supplementary material and will also be made publicly available upon publication.

AI.tldr: 本文在统一的评测框架下，首次系统性地评估了 GPT-4、GPT-4o、GPT-3.5-Turbo、Gemini 1.5 Pro、DeepSeek-V3、Llama 3.2、BERT 等模型在社交媒体分析三大任务——作者身份验证、帖子生成、用户属性推断——上的能力，并引入系统化的用户/帖子采样框架、2024 年 1 月后新采集推文的"未见数据"泛化测试、以及首个面向真实用户的主观真实性用户研究。结论：GPT-4 在作者验证上最强（加权 F1 约 0.85，未见数据上仍领先），DeepSeek/Gemini/Llama 在生成任务中各有语义或词汇优势且获得最高人类真实性评分，Gemini 在属性推断上全面最优；同时强调负样本采样策略（影响约 17 个百分点）远大于正样本用户采样（6 个百分点），并警示单一自动指标无法可靠预测感知真实性。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体分析面临内容非正式、含歧义、俚语与迷因快速演化等挑战，而 LLM 在情感分析、立场检测、虚假信息分类等任务上已展现强能力，但缺少跨任务的统一、细粒度评测基线。此前研究通常只聚焦单一任务、单一属性，忽视社交图谱与个人简介等上下文信号，也很少使用标准化分类体系，且普遍存在"已见数据"（训练数据泄漏）偏差——作者在模型知识截止日期之后的内容可能被记忆。此外，生成任务缺少来自真实用户本人的主观评价，自动指标与人类感知的一致性不明。作者身份验证、个性化内容生成与用户属性推断共同刻画用户身份（独特身份、风格签名、潜在人口学属性），因此需要一体化的多任务评测框架。
AI.method: 数据：Kheiri et al. (2023) 的 Twitter/X 数据集（123,829 用户、约 292 万关系、15 周时间快照）；另用 X API 补充采集 2024 年 1 月后推文用于未见数据测试。任务 I 作者身份验证：3 种正样本用户采样（随机/近期活跃/Top 活跃）× 5 种负样本采样（随机/主题相似/关注者/关注对象/互关），k=m1=m2=20，指标为加权 F1；LLM 温度为 0。任务 II 帖子生成：筛选 VAPOR 用户（已验证、活跃≥200 条原创推文、粉丝>500、关注>100、简介>20 字符）共 383 人，输入 50 条推文+简介+粉丝/关注数，生成 10 条 ≤280 字符推文（温度 0.7）；用 BLEU/ROUGE-1/ROUGE-L、GPT-2 困惑度，以及基于 SBERT 余弦相似度矩阵的新指标 AOS、AGR、ARG、GDR、RDR，对比"提示集"与"非提示集"；另做 IRB 批准的用户研究（19 人参与、12 份有效，Qualtrics，每人 20 条模型生成推文+2 条真实推文作注意力检查，5 级李克特量表，χ² 检验）。任务 III 属性推断：由两位作者依据简介与推文标注职业与兴趣，第三位资深作者仲裁；兴趣用 IAB Tech Lab 内容分类法 v3.1（25 类），职业用 2018 SOC 一级（18 类）与二级（38 类），以 50 条推文做 JSON 严格输出预测，用准确率与加权 F1 评估，对比高斯过程+Word2Vec、few-shot BART、DBpedia 实体分类器、TF-IDF 梯度提升等基线。实验环境为 4×RTX A4000，总 API 成本约 220 美元。
